Who You'll Be Working With

 

The Data Powered Industries and Domains (DPID) team, part of Capgemini’s Insights and Data practice in the UK, is growing its Architecture capability. Join a team that sits at the heart of our most important client relationships, advising on complex data, AI and analytics challenges with deep expertise across the entire delivery lifecycle. We build trusted partnerships with senior stakeholders by translating business needs into technology solutions and measurable outcomes. As a key driver of growth, we help shape and advance our clients’ data and AI vision and capabilities.

 

PLEASE NOTE: 

Security Clearance: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC)clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

The Focus of Your Role

 

As an Enterprise or Solution Architect within DPID, you will play a key role in shaping client engagements—providing strategic advice and technical leadership across complex, cross-domain challenges. You will help organisations unlock the value of their data by defining and guiding architectures that enable effective use of data, AI, and analytics to address their most critical business problems.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Advising senior stakeholders on data, AI, and analytics architecture
    Being a trusted advisor to C-level and senior business and technology leaders, helping them navigate the opportunities, risks, and trade-offs of adopting data, AI, and analytics. Providing clear, pragmatic guidance on how architectural decisions influence business outcomes, operating models, and long-term value.
  • Leading on architecture across complex client engagements and business development
    Taking ownership of architecture for large, complex, and often multi-disciplinary engagements—shaping solution direction from early sales through to delivery. Playing a key role in business development by defining compelling, feasible architectural approaches that address client needs and differentiate our offerings.
  • Providing technical leadership across key domains in data and AI
  • Demonstrating deep expertise in one or more areas such as data platforms, AI/ML, analytics, data governance, or integration. Setting direction, establishing best practices, and ensuring architectural quality across engagements, while staying at the forefront of emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Building capability and sharing knowledge across the organisation
    Actively contributing to the growth of the wider architecture and data community by mentoring colleagues, sharing expertise, and developing reusable assets, patterns, and thought leadership. Fostering collaboration and continuous learning across teams and disciplines.

What You'll Bring

 

You’ll bring a blend of proven architecture experience, strong data and AI expertise, and the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly, while building trusted relationships, navigating ambiguity, and collaborating effectively to deliver impactful solutions.


Experience:


We know that great candidates don’t always meet every requirement. If you’re excited about this role and feel you bring many of these qualities, we’d love to hear from you.

 

  • Proven experience in Enterprise and/or Solution Architecture, ideally within data, AI, or analytics-focused environments 
  • Experience shaping or delivering AI/ML and advanced analytics solutions, with an appreciation of both technical and ethical considerations 
  • Demonstrated experience advising senior stakeholders and building trusted relationships across business and technology teams 
  • Experience leading or contributing to complex programmes, balancing strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery 
  • Experience of working effectively in diverse, multi-disciplinary teams 
  • Exposure to one or more industry-specific data challenges (e.g. public sector, manufacturing, consumer products, energy, etc.) (nice to have) 
  • Working knowledge of one or more major cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS, GCP) and their data/AI ecosystems (nice to have) 
  • Working knowledge of one or more architectural frameworks such as TOGAF (nice to have) 
  • Holds UK security clearance or is willing to undergo clearance processes


Must Have Skills:

 

  • Strong understanding of modern data-centric architectures and technologies (e.g. cloud data platforms, data lakes/warehouses, integration patterns) and how they enable business value 
  • Understanding of responsible AI, data governance, and security principles in practical contexts 
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences 
  • Strong communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to influence and inspire confidence 
  • Collaborative mindset with strong interpersonal skills 
  • Comfortable working in ambiguity and helping define both problems and solutions 
  • Passion for continuous learning and curiosity about emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in data and AI 
  • Commitment to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and fostering a learning culture

 

Additional Info

 

Hybrid working

 

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

What we’ll offer you 

 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Why we’re different 

At Capgemini, we help organisations across the world become more agile, more competitive, and more successful. Smart, tailored, often ground-breaking technical solutions to complex problems are the norm. But so, too, is a culture that’s as collaborative as it is forward thinking. Working closely with each other, and with our clients, we get under the skin of businesses and to the heart of their goals. You will too.
 
Capgemini is proud to represent nearly 130 nationalities and its cultural diversity. Our holistic definition of diversity extends beyond gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, race, age, and religion. Capgemini views diversity as everything that makes us who we are as an organization, including our social background, our experiences in life and work, our communication styles and even our personality. These dimensions contribute to the type of diversity we value the most: diversity of thought.

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

We’re seeking fellow platform engineers who want to grow their career and delight customers through a hybrid of project and foundational activities. We take a modern approach of working collaboratively internally and externally to achieve high levels of satisfaction both for our clients and ourselves collectively. We achieve this through focused groups of technical people, coming together to deliver and maintain cloud services to UK clients. The strength of our deliveries lies within our people, fostered by a supportive team culture. Our ideal candidate would thrive in such an environment.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

As an integral part of a delivery team, you’ll have fantastic opportunities to develop both yourself and our collective capabilities as you progress both project and foundational requirements with other likeminded Cloud DevOps Engineers. As part of the team, you’ll be empowered to:

  • Build and maintain cloud platforms with a high degree of focus on automation and innovation.
  • Embrace modern ways of working and feel part of our customer’s outcomes as we group around activities in agile type sprints.
  • Continue to strengthen and bolster your existing capabilities in platform engineering through a mix of professional training, certifications, and experiences.
  • Collaborate and influence our iterative Capgemini offerings.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • We’d particularly welcome applications from people with experience in Databricks or Splunk
  • A proven track record in platform engineering, particularly with: Azure/AWS/GCP, Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and VCS (GitHub).
  • Can demonstrate tangible experiences of end-to-end delivery.
  • A background in infrastructure and networking would be advantageous, as would experience working in an Agile manner. 

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

  • You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

 

Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

 

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

 

 

Your role:

As an AI and Digital Trust Director, you will lead strategic client engagements that strengthen trust in AI, cyber, cloud and digital transformation. You will advise senior stakeholders, shape market-leading propositions and deliver practical, measurable outcomes across regulated and complex environments. 

 

Key responsibilities will include: 

 

  • Lead senior client engagements across AI assurance, digital trust, cyber resilience, OT security, data protection, sovereignty and responsible technology. 
  • Shape AI and Digital Trust strategies aligned to business priorities, regulatory expectations and risk appetite. 
  • Develop and scale market-facing offers across AI governance, responsible AI, OT security, cloud security, sovereignty, post-quantum cryptography readiness and regulatory readiness. 
  • Oversee complex transformation programmes involving AI governance, cyber risk, identity, privacy, resilience and digital trust operating models. 
  • Lead proposals, RFPs, client pitches, account development and consulting revenue generation. 
  • Build and mentor high-performing consulting teams, fostering inclusive, collaborative and innovative ways of working. 
  • Work with Microsoft, cloud providers and other partners to shape integrated AI, cloud, cyber, OT, data, privacy and sovereignty solutions. 

 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: 

 

  • Business development – contributing to proposals, bids, proposition development, client pitches and events. 
  • Practice development – supporting campaigns, thought leadership, recruitment, internal communities and offering development. 
  • Learning and development – building skills and certifications aligned to market demand and career growth.

 

Your profile:

You will bring: 

 

  • Deep expertise in AI and Digital Trust, including experience in some of the following areas: cyber strategy, cloud security, identity, OT security, sovereignty, post-quantum cryptography readiness, privacy, threat intelligence and risk management. 
  • Experience leading business transformation and complex consulting delivery across regulated or security-critical environments. 
  • Strong senior stakeholder management, client relationship and matrix leadership skills. 
  • Proven experience building propositions, shaping opportunities and generating consulting revenue, with Director-level expectations of approximately £2m. 
  • A consulting background, either within a major consulting firm or industry role with significant consulting experience. 
  • Desirable certifications include CISSP, CISM, CISA, relevant Microsoft, AWS, Azure, Google, ISO/IEC 42001, AI risk management, responsible AI, privacy, cloud security or digital trust credentials. 

 

What you'll love about working here:

A purpose-driven culture that values trust, innovation, and impact. 


Opportunities to shape the future of cybersecurity across industries and geographies. 


A collaborative environment where your voice matters and your ideas drive change. 


Flexibility, autonomy, and support to grow your career in a way that works for you. 

Need to know:

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

 

CSR:

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 

Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

About the job you're considering

Capgemini is seeking an experienced senior delivery leader to lead large-scale, complex digital transformation programmes for strategic clients in the Consumer Goods sector.


You will act as a strategic delivery partner to clients, accountable for execution of global transformation programmes across products, platforms, and applications. You will govern digital delivery, orchestrate cross-domain teams, and ensure resilient, scalable, and secure operations, while shaping strategy, managing risk, and delivering measurable business outcomes.


This is a senior, client-facing role operating at executive level, with accountability for multi-million delivery portfolios, delivery excellence, and growth.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work day to day will vary according to your role, your needs and that of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client site and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home for 100% of the time.

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual), or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Your role

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead end-to-end delivery strategy: Translate client strategy into clear execution roadmaps, plans, and operating models
  • Orchestrate complex delivery: Align multiple teams, domains, and platforms; manage dependencies and drive joined-up execution
  • Own governance & performance: Run planning cycles, steering forums, and delivery governance to ensure predictable, high-quality outcomes
  • Act as escalation point: Manage complex risks, issues, and client escalations with pace and confidence
  • Drive operational excellence: Ensure reliability, scalability, and secure-by-design delivery across the technology landscape, promoting transformation, engineering excellence and continuous improvement across teams.
  • Optimise cost & performance: Use data-driven insights to improve flow, efficiency, and capacity
  • Lead at executive level: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and shape key decisions
  • Enable growth: Identify and drive delivery-led opportunities across the client portfolio

Your skills and experience

Delivery Leadership:

  • Proven experience leading large, complex global delivery and transformation programmes or portfolios (£20m+)
  • Experience operating as an executive escalation point and senior delivery partner
  • Strong track record of delivering global technology transformation outcomes at scale, in agile product & platform delivery models

 

Global Salesforce Delivery Expertise:

  • Experience delivering large-scale Salesforce programmes in global organisations, ideally including Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud (CGC) and Trade Promotion Management (TPM)
  • Understanding of Product & Platform operating models and Agile delivery
  • Experience of global delivery models, including onshore/offshore teams

 

Industry Knowledge:

  • Global Consumer Goods experience, ideally with both B2B and B2C exposure
  • Understanding of key domains such as B2B and B2C Commerce, Trade Loyalty, RGM/TPM, Retail Execution, Marketing

 

Leadership & Commercial Skills:

  • Strong executive communication and storytelling capability
  • Experience in strategy development and delivery planning
  • Proven ability to drive delivery-led growth and commercial outcomes

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.


As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

 

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Your wellbeing 
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 

 

Impactful Experiences
You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  But when you join Capgemini, you join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  A powerful source of energy that drives us all to find new ways technology  can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses. And it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. And you’ll use them to help our clients leverage technology to grow their business and give innovation that human touch the world needs. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.  

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 


Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Who You Will Be Working With

As a Data Engineer at Capgemini, you'll design, build and operate reliable, scalable data pipelines and data products: the trusted foundations that power analytics, AI, GenAI and increasingly agentic systems. You'll work hands-on with modern data engineering tooling and cloud services to ingest, transform and serve data, and you'll prepare and govern the datasets that AI models and AI agents depend on to behave safely and correctly. You'll also use AI-assisted engineering to accelerate your own delivery, while keeping clear human ownership of every outcome.

 

You'll be part of the Data Platforms team within the Insights and Data Global Practice, which has seen strong, sustained growth across a wide range of sectors. Data Platforms is home to Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, Solution Architects and Business Analysts driving our customers' digital and data transformation on modern cloud platforms. We specialise in the latest frameworks, reference architectures and technologies across AWS, Azure and GCP, and data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake.

PLEASE NOTE:

Security Clearance: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC)clearance or DV (Developed Vetting clearance). 

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

The Focus of Your Role

 

You'll build and run the data products that modern AI depends on. That means classic, high-quality data engineering (batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse and warehouse patterns, well-governed and auditable datasets), and the newer discipline of engineering data for AI and agents: retrieval pipelines, embeddings and vector stores, feature and context preparation, and the observability needed when the systems consuming your data are non-deterministic and can't simply be unit tested.


You'll build and run the data products that modern AI depends on. That means classic, high-quality data engineering (batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse and warehouse patterns, well-governed and auditable datasets), and the newer discipline of engineering data for AI and agents: retrieval pipelines, embeddings and vector stores, feature and context preparation, and the observability needed when the systems consuming your data are non-deterministic and can't simply be unit tested.


What you’ll be doing:

  • You'll work within agreed security and compliance boundaries throughout, which matters in the regulated and public sector environments we operate in.
  •  Build and maintain data pipelines and data products. Use appropriate ETL/ELT and distributed processing to ingest, transform and curate trusted data in cloud storage and analytics platforms.
  • Engineer data for AI and agentic use cases. Prepare curated, governed datasets and features for analytics and ML; build retrieval and embedding pipelines (vector stores, chunking, metadata) that serve RAG and agent workflows; and help expose data to AI systems through patterns such as APIs and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Apply data modelling, quality and governance. Develop scalable models, apply validation and quality checks, and maintain lineage and documentation so data products are reliable and auditable. This matters even more when an AI agent, not just a human, is acting on them.
  • Build in observability for non-deterministic systems. Implement logging, alerting and SLAs for production pipelines, and contribute to evaluation and monitoring of AI-facing data and outputs (e.g. drift, retrieval quality, anomaly detection) with clear human review.
  • Use AI-assisted engineering responsibly. Accelerate development, testing and documentation with coding assistants, applying good prompt hygiene, protecting confidential data, and owning the results.
  • Collaborate across teams. Work with business analysts, platform engineers, data scientists and DevOps to deliver secure, well-tested solutions in an agile environment, communicating your design decisions clearly.
  • Keep raising the bar. Use version control, code review, automated testing and CI/CD; share knowledge, contribute to accelerators and standards, and keep current with modern data and AI engineering practice.

What You Will Bring and Experience Needed

 

You'll bring solid, hands-on experience delivering data engineering in production, and a genuine interest in how AI and agentic systems change what good data engineering looks like. You don't need to have done all of the AI-specific work below already, but you should be eager to, and able to show the engineering fundamentals that make it possible.

 

Essential:

 

  • Hands-on experience delivering data pipelines and data platforms in production environments.
  • Strong Python and SQL, with sound software engineering practice (Git, code review, unit testing, CI/CD) and the ability to troubleshoot production issues.
  • Experience with distributed data processing and modern lakehouse/warehouse patterns, with good data modelling and performance instincts.
  • Experience with cloud data services (storage, compute and orchestration) on at least one major cloud.
  • Practical use of AI coding assistants in a real engineering workflow, with an understanding of data confidentiality and secure, responsible use.
  • A continuous-learning mindset and clear communication with technical and non-technical colleagues.


Nice to have

  • Exposure to GenAI/agentic building blocks: RAG, embeddings and vector search, LLM orchestration (e.g. LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel), or LLM evaluation/observability (e.g. LangSmith, Ragas).
  • Streaming and event-driven experience (e.g. Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming).
  • Relevant cloud and/or data engineering certifications.

 

Specialist tracks  (we'd love depth in one of these; you don't need all of them):

 

  • Azure / Databricks Azure Data Lake Storage, Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Azure Data Factory, MLflow; and, for the AI edge, Databricks Mosaic AI, Vector Search and Unity Catalog, or Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI Search.
  • AWS: Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, Kinesis, EMR, Athena, Redshift, S3 data lakes; and, for the AI edge, Amazon Bedrock, Knowledge Bases for Bedrock

Additional Info

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

What we’ll offer you 

 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Why we’re different 

 

At Capgemini, we help organisations across the world become more agile, more competitive, and more successful. Smart, tailored, often ground-breaking technical solutions to complex problems are the norm. But so, too, is a culture that’s as collaborative as it is forward thinking. Working closely with each other, and with our clients, we get under the skin of businesses and to the heart of their goals. You will too.
 
Capgemini is proud to represent nearly 130 nationalities and its cultural diversity. Our holistic definition of diversity extends beyond gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, race, age, and religion. Capgemini views diversity as everything that makes us who we are as an organization, including our social background, our experiences in life and work, our communication styles and even our personality. These dimensions contribute to the type of diversity we value the most: diversity of thought.

Consultant / Senior Consultant - Data Management

CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us in driving transformation that not only solves our clients’ current challenges but unlocks future value and delivers lasting impact. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Join Capgemini’s Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA) team working at the forefront of data + AI. You’ll play an influential role in designing and shaping data & AI foundations that power cutting-edge AI, agentic AI and advanced analytics, ensuring our clients trust their data, scale intelligent products and accelerate business impact.

YOUR ROLE

This role sits at the intersection of advisory, strategy and delivery, perfect for someone who thrives on shaping vision and guiding clients through complex data challenges. From enabling AI-ready data foundations to embedding ethical governance for advanced analytics, you’ll help organisations unlock the full potential of their data.

  • We ADVISE on data, analytics and AI strategy – You will act as a trusted advisor, shaping vision and defining AI-driven data management strategies, articulating the business benefits of robust governance, quality and MDM capabilities.
  • We TRANSLATE complexity into clarity – You will guide and influence senior stakeholders, bridging the gap between technical concepts and business priorities to secure buy-in and drive cultural change toward data-driven outcomes.
  • We DESIGN operating models – You will define and design elements of the data management operating model, including roles, processes, standards and stewardship frameworks, embedding these into client organisations.
  • We ENABLE trusted AI and analytics – You will support the discovery and design of data governance, data quality and master data management solutions that ensure compliance, transparency and ethical AI practices.
  • We COLLABORATE for impact – You will work alongside business leaders, developers, architects and data scientists to ensure governance, quality and compliance are integrated into technical solutions and AI products.
  • We LEAD and DEVELOP talent (Senior Consultant Level) – You will lead workstreams, coach junior colleagues and shape best practices across accounts, contributing to thought leadership and capability development in data and AI foundations.

As part of your role alongside client work you will have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

  • Business Development – Leading / contributing to RFIs, RFPs / Proposals / Bids, Proposition Development, client pitches & hosting at events.
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

As a member of the Data & AI Strategy Team you’ll be part of the future of AI consulting. We look for individuals who align with our core values, are creative problem solvers and have a genuine interest in AI and emerging technologies. You’ll be passionate about helping organisations unlock the potential of AI not just through technical delivery, but by driving strategic change.

Below are some of the key skills and experiences we look for in candidates. We don't expect you to hit every point – we want to build a team which has diverse backgrounds, perspectives and strengths.

  • Strong advisory skills, stakeholder communication and problem-solving skills
  • Proven hands-on experience designing and implementing data management, governance, or MDM solutions (consulting or industry).
  • Practical experience identifying and deploying of at least one data management or governance tool, such as: Informatica, Collibra, Alation, Ataccama, Microsoft Purview.
  • Candidates should be able to demonstrate prior project experience where they led or contributed to data management initiatives - e.g., data catalogue implementation, data lineage mapping, master data consolidation, data quality, metadata management .
  • Experience defining and operationalising data stewardship roles and responsibilities within federated or centralised data governance models.

Desirable:

  • Experience in AI-related data preparation, data management use case identification, AI governance or Responsible AI frameworks.
  • Understanding of model lifecycle management, bias detection and explainability.
  • Familiarity with DMBOK framework.


Data management is a broad field and therefore we’re looking to hear from people with diverse skillsets. You should apply if you have experience in one of the following roles: analyst, data engineer, data architect and specialists that have expertise in areas such as metadata management and master data management.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

As a Consultant / Senior Consultant, you will have the chance to shape responsible AI foundations for tomorrow’s intelligent enterprises.
•    A clear path to professional certification (DAMA, Cloud Data).
•    The opportunity to support the delivery of bespoke AI products
•    Access to our Data Academy and AI upskilling programs.
•    Flexible working, wellbeing benefits and a supportive community that values balance and growth., contributing to cutting-edge projects that shape industries, while advancing your own career in a collaborative and inspiring environment.
We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to make it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring your whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce as a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

CSR

We’re committed to using technology as a force for good. That means reducing our own carbon footprint and expanding access to the digital world for everyone. This isn’t just a statement; it’s a core part of who we are. In fact, Capgemini has been recognised by the Ethisphere Institute as one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for 10 consecutive years. When you join us, you become part of a team that does the right thing.

Your base location will be London, Manchester, or Glasgow, but flexibility is essential. These roles may require travel and short-notice assignments away from home.
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Your Role

As a Senior Manager in our Finance Transformation practice, you will lead complex workstreams on major global finance projects for FTSE 100 and Fortune 500 clients. You will support Finance leaders in delivering programmes across AI‑native Finance Operating Models, S/4HANA Finance, Global Business Services (GBS) and Integrated Performance Management (IPM).  You will take day‑to‑day leadership of delivery, help shape solutions, contribute to proposals, and manage teams to ensure high‑quality outcomes.


Finance Operating Model
•    Support sales and lead workstreams that help clients design and implement AI‑native Finance Operating Models, engaging senior Finance stakeholders and shaping transformation approaches.
•    Deliver Finance Operating Model components including organisation structures, spans & layers, role clarity and decision rights, Global Process Ownership, governance and controls, data ownership, and service‑delivery models (Retained Finance, GBS/GCCs, hubs, CoEs), with embedded


Transformation Delivery and S/4 Hana
•    Support sales and lead S/4HANA Finance workstreams, collaborating with client Finance teams and SI partners to shape scope, plan delivery and manage risks.
•    Deliver S/4 Finance across key processes (R2R, FP&A, Group Reporting, P2P, O2C) using fit‑to‑standard and clean‑core approaches, supporting process harmonisation, data and controls design, testing, readiness and value tracking. Integrate AI‑enabled forecasting or automation where beneficial.


Integrated Performance Management
•    Support sales and deliver IPM‑related workstreams including planning, reporting and analytics components; contribute to shaping propositions and extensions.
•    Deliver KPI frameworks, PB&F calendars, performance dialogues, and EPM/reporting models (e.g., SAC, Group Reporting) aligned to S/4 data structures. Apply AI‑supported insights such as predictive planning, variance analysis and narrative generation.


You will contribute to business development across proposals, bids and account growth and will have an annual sales expectation of £1M.

Your Profile

•    Passionate about finance transformation and making this real for clients, you will have:
•    Experience delivering finance transformation or ERP‑enabled change in FTSE 100, Fortune 500 or major enterprise environments, or experience gained in a Big 4 / global consultancy
•    Strong understanding of Finance Operating Model, GBS/GCC and end‑to‑end finance process design
•    Solid hands‑on experience in S/4HANA Finance delivery
•    Ability to engage and influence senior Finance stakeholders (e.g., FDs, Controllers, Heads of FP&A)
•    Proven leadership of multi‑disciplinary workstream teams across business and technology
•    Strong problem‑solving, communication and client‑facing skills

What You'll Love About Working Here

You’ll love working here if you value a culture that supports you as a person as much as it challenges you as a professional. You’ll be trusted to shape meaningful work, encouraged to bring your whole self to the team, and supported by colleagues who care about collaboration, inclusion and doing the right thing. Our values: team spirit, boldness, honesty, freedom, trust, modesty and fun show up every day in how we work together and how leaders empower you to grow, innovate and make an impact.

Need to Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
 
•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


Please opt in during the application process.

CSR:
We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

data.description:
The Role You Are Considering

You'll be part of the Data Platforms team within the Insights and Data Global Practice, which has seen strong, sustained growth across a wide range of projects and sectors. Data Platforms is home to the Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, Solution Architects and Business Analysts driving our customers' digital and data transformation on modern cloud platforms.

 

We specialise in the latest frameworks, reference architectures and technologies across AWS, Azure and GCP, and we're looking for talented people who want to grow their career in a high-performing team that cares about increasing the value of data and analytics for our clients.

PLEASE NOTE:

Security Clearance: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance  . 

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Your Role

We're looking for a versatile Full Stack Engineer who's equally comfortable building data pipelines and the applications that sit on top of them. You'll deliver robust, cloud-native solutions that turn data into things people actually use: dashboards, data products, secure APIs and, increasingly, GenAI-powered applications such as conversational and retrieval-based interfaces. You'll work across the full stack and the full data lifecycle, from ingestion and processing through to the web and API layer, with quality, security and reliability built in from the start.


What you’ll be doing


Data engineering

  • Design and build scalable data pipelines (for example Apache Spark, Airflow, dbt) and maintain data lakes, warehouses and real-time streaming solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, governance and compliance across platforms.

 

Full-stack application development

  • Design, code, test and deploy scalable, efficient web applications, building responsive, interactive user interfaces with a modern front-end framework and robust server-side logic, databases and APIs.
  • Develop APIs and microservices that expose data securely and efficiently.
  • GenAI-powered applications
  • Build the application layer for AI: conversational and RAG interfaces, agent-facing front-ends and APIs, and streaming LLM responses, integrating 

 

 

GenAI and orchestration services (including patterns such as tool-calling and the Model Context Protocol) into production web applications with appropriate guardrails.

  • DataOps, deployment and reliability
  • Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines (for example GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) and deploy cloud-native microservices on Kubernetes, hosted on Red Hat OpenShift.
  • Build in observability and monitoring for both data pipelines and AI-driven features, optimising for performance, scalability and reliability, including for the non-deterministic
  • behaviour of AI components.

Your Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer amd Data Engineer.
  • Proficiency in front-end technologies: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React (must), Angular, Vue.js.
  • Strong back-end development skills: Java and Node.js (must); Python or Ruby on Rails is a plus.
  • Experience with cloud-native architectures and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with Red Hat OpenShift.Experience with CI/CD tools and version control systems (Git, GitHub, ArgoCD).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.Strong communication and collaboration skills.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with relational databases, especially PostgreSQL.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and DevOps culture.
  • Exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Fabric) or custom dashboards.

About Capgemini

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion , we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.


Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in we llbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy .


We work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions. Working for Capgemini you get to be at the forefront of designing future experiences, which truly impact our clients and wider society for the better.

 

Hybrid Working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

Why We're Different:

 

At Capgemini, we help organisations across the world become more agile, more competitive, and more successful. Smart, tailored, often ground-breaking technical solutions to complex problems are the norm. But so, too, is a culture that’s as collaborative as it is forward thinking. Working closely with each other, and with our clients, we get under the skin of businesses and to the heart of their goals. You will too.
 
Capgemini is proud to represent nearly 130 nationalities and its cultural diversity. Our holistic definition of diversity extends beyond gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, race, age, and religion. Capgemini views diversity as everything that makes us who we are as an organization, including our social background, our experiences in life and work, our communication styles and even our personality. These dimensions contribute to the type of diversity we value the most: diversity of thought.

data.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Your Role

We are seeking a senior, commercially astute Vice President to lead Capgemini Invent's Construction consulting business within our Transport, Infrastructure & Environment sector, shaping and delivering strategy, growth and client success across the construction, capital projects and built environment market.


In this role you will play a key part in:


• Leading strategic relationships with major construction clients, infrastructure developers, contractors, programme delivery partners and asset owners, positioning Capgemini as their trusted digital and business transformation partner.
• Developing and taking to market propositions across digital construction, capital project transformation, digital engineering, connected asset management, data-driven programme delivery, AI-enabled construction and digital twins.
• Owning and driving the growth plan, aligned to Invent's strategy, for our Construction consulting business. This will include:
o Growth within established construction and infrastructure sector accounts; and
o Expansion into new clients across construction, major projects, infrastructure delivery, utilities, real estate and the wider construction ecosystem.
• Leading multi-disciplinary teams to deliver high-impact consulting engagements spanning digital transformation, operating model design, business change, technology advisory, digital construction and capital project delivery.
• Generating c. £4m+ of annual consulting revenue by leveraging your industry network, client relationships, market profile and Capgemini Group capabilities.
• Acting as a recognised industry leader in digital construction through thought leadership, industry forums, professional networks, conferences and client-facing market engagement.


As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth through activities that form part of the following categories:


• Business Development – Engaging at Board and C-Suite level, developing trusted client relationships and helping organisations define strategies, transformation roadmaps and digital construction ambitions. You will have accountability for originating and closing new consulting opportunities, demonstrating strong commercial acumen and sales leadership. Leading and contributing to proposals, bids, proposition development, client pitches and industry events.
• Internal Contribution – Campaign development, thought leadership, white papers, industry insights, practice development, recruitment, team leadership and offering development across the Construction and Built Environment sector.
• Learning & Development – Supporting your own professional growth and the development of our wider team through coaching, mentoring, industry engagement and continued learning.

Your Profile

We are looking for an accomplished Construction consulting leader with the following capabilities:
• Deep consulting experience delivering technology advisory, digital transformation and business change engagements within the construction, infrastructure and capital projects sector.
• A strong track record of originating, selling and delivering consulting services to construction clients, including major contractors, developers, infrastructure owners, engineering organisations and programme delivery partners.
• Recognised expertise in digital construction and the application of technology to improve project delivery, productivity, collaboration, programme performance and asset outcomes.
• An established industry profile demonstrated through client relationships, participation in industry bodies, conference speaking engagements, thought leadership and market visibility.
• Strong knowledge of construction industry challenges, delivery models and emerging trends including digital engineering, BIM, digital twins, AI, data platforms, connected assets and modern methods of construction.
• Highly collaborative, with proven success shaping propositions that bring together consulting, business transformation, data, digital and technology capabilities.
• Experience scaling and inspiring teams, shaping practice strategy and driving commercial outcomes, including responsibility for c. £4m+ annual consulting revenue.
• Proven ability to operate successfully within a matrix organisation and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions.
• Experience of proposition development, solution shaping and consulting engagement delivery within the Construction and Built Environment sector.
• Business Development – utilising a combination of your own network, Capgemini's existing relationships and broader market ecosystem relationships, you will generate c. £4m+ of annual consulting revenues.
• Currently working within a leading consulting organisation, or within the construction industry with a strong consulting background and demonstrable consulting sales and delivery success.

What You'll Love About Working Here

•    Freedom to shape this new market for Capgemini
•    A growth mindset inherent in our organizational DNA
•    A chance to develop your career within a leading global technology and consulting business 

Need To Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
 
•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


Please opt in during the application process.


CSR:
We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.


Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

Your role

Capgemini Engineering is looking for Senior Engineer who can objectively design, lead and deliver work packages that demonstrate how advanced digital engineering tools can dramatically accelerate product development while generating measurable business outcomes. You will bring the ability to articulate and navigate the space between the needs of engineers and the capabilities of the toolset. 

 

We need an innovative thinker who has deep expertise in digital engineering platforms, specifically Siemens NX and Teamcenter, and the ability to not just implement tools, but to strategically configure and deploy them in ways that fundamentally transform engineering workflows. Your background in industries such as defence, where precision and innovation are paramount, will be a significant advantage.

Your profile

You will join a growing team of experts working on high-profile projects within the defence sector. You will use creative problem-solving skills to formulate, develop and deliver design engineering solutions.

 

Technical skills:

  • Mechanical design engineering experience (or similar, e.g electrical)
  • Advanced Siemens NX CAD software expertise
  • Product lifecycle management (PLM) tools knowledge (Teamcenter)
  • Siemens Capital experience would be desirable but not essential
  • Digital engineering transformation techniques, Systems integration understanding
  • Technical configuration of engineering tools, Performance optimisation of design processes
  • Data management and digital thread implementation, Advanced engineering workflow design
  • Knowledge and experience working across Engineering and Manufacturing including NX, TC, ERP, MES

 

If you're excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we stillencourage you to apply, your unique experience could be just what we need.

Make it real - what does it mean for you?

  • Open access to digital learning platforms​
  • Active employee networks promoting diversity, equity and inclusion like OutFront, CapAbility or Women@Capgemini​

 

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:​

  • Declare they have a disability, and ​
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.​
  • Please opt in during the application process.​

​

Capgemini. Make it real.

Need to know

  • Due to the nature of this work, we will only be able to consider sole UK nationals who are eligible for SC.
  • This is a hybrid role requires travel to Barrow-in-furness every 3 days fortnight. All travel cost will be covered.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusivefuture is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We havebuilt a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.​

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.​

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
Who You Will Be Working With

 

The Data Platforms team is part of the Insights and Data Global Practice and has seen strong growth and continued success across a variety of projects and sectors.   Data Platforms is the home of the Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, Solutions Architects and Business Analysts who are focused on driving our customers digital and data transformation journey using the modern cloud platforms. 

We specialise on using the latest frameworks, reference architectures and technologies using AWS, Azure and GCP along with various data platforms like Databricks, Snowflake, Quantexa, Palantir, SAS.

The Role You Are Considering

 

As a Data Engineer, you will be an integral part of our team dedicated to building scalable and secure data platforms. You will leverage your expertise to design, develop, and implement data warehouses, data lakehouses, and AI/ML models that fuel our data-driven operations.

What You Will Bring

  • Design and build high-performance data pipelines: to extract, transform, and load data into Cloud Data Lake Storage and other Cloud services. 
  • Develop and maintain secure data warehouses and data lakehouses: Implement data models, data quality checks, and governance practices to ensure reliable and accurate data. 
  • Implement ETL/ELT Processes: Develop Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) or Extract, Load, Transform (ELT) workflows to seamlessly move data from source systems to Data
  • Warehouses, Data Lakes, and Lake Houses using Open Source and cloud tools.

 

  • Build and deploy AI/ML models: Integrate Machine Learning into data pipelines, leveraging ML to develop predictive models and drive business insights. 
  • Monitor and optimize data pipelines and infrastructure: Analyze performance metrics, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimizations for efficiency and scalability. 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Work closely with business analysts, data scientists, and DevOps engineers to ensure successful data platform implementations. 
  • Stay ahead of the curve: Continuously learn and adapt to the evolving landscape of big data technologies and best practices with a focus on how AI can support you in your delivery work
  • Minimum 10+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role.
  • Proven expertise in the technologies below, and data pipeline development and strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills and strong communication and teamwork skills.

 

In addition to these core skills, you should have specialist experience in one or more of the following technologies

 

Azure Databricks

  • Design and build high-performance data pipelines: Utilize Databricks and Apache Spark to extract, transform, and load data into Azure Data Lake Storage and other Azure services. 
  • Experience of Databricks ML and Azure ML to develop predictive models and drive business insights. 
  • Proven expertise in Databricks, Apache Spark, and data pipeline development and strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and practices.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud platform, including Azure Data Lake Storage, Databricks and Azure Data Factory.
  • Azure Data Engineer Associate and Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional

 

AWS

  • Proficiency with AWS Tools: Demonstrable experience using AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, Amazon EMR , Amazon Athena, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Cloudwatch, Amazon SNS and AWS Step Functions.
  • Programming Skills: Strong experience with modern programming languages such as Python, Java, Scala & Pyspark.
  • Expertise in Data Storage Technologies: In-depth knowledge of Data Warehouse, Database technologies, and Big Data Eco-system technologies such as AWS Redshift, AWS RDS, and Hadoop.
  • Experience with AWS Data Lakes: Proven experience working with AWS data lakes on AWS S3 to store and process both structured and unstructured data sets

Further Info

 

Security Clearance: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC)clearance. 


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)


What we’ll offer you 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

 

Why we’re different 

At Capgemini, we help organisations across the world become more agile, more competitive, and more successful. Smart, tailored, often ground-breaking technical solutions to complex problems are the norm. But so, too, is a culture that’s as collaborative as it is forward thinking. Working closely with each other, and with our clients, we get under the skin of businesses and to the heart of their goals. You will too.
 
Capgemini is proud to represent nearly 130 nationalities and its cultural diversity. Our holistic definition of diversity extends beyond gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, race, age, and religion. Capgemini views diversity as everything that makes us who we are as an organization, including our social background, our experiences in life and work, our communication styles and even our personality. These dimensions contribute to the type of diversity we value the most: diversity of thought.
