ROLE DETAILS

SBU - Invent

CU - Business Technology 

Global Grade - B 

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

Our Full Stack Engineers sit within Digital Excellence, part of the Business Technology practice in Capgemini Invent, which leads digital transformation projects across Capgemini. We are a new and dynamic community that values innovation, professional development, and the ability to make a real difference for our clients. We work in diverse multi-disciplinary teams, hand-in-glove with our clients.

Our Java Full Stack Engineers are responsible for creating the visions of our clients and driving better business outcomes. They are tasked with building cutting-edge digital solutions for our clients, combining a clear understanding of business value and a consultative approach to make the difference. They will be able to work on a vast variety of projects and get exposure to a variety of technology such as (but not exhaustively) NodeJS, Java, Kotlin, Spring boot framework, RESTful microservices, NoSQL databases.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Extensive experience of building microservices with Java (Spring Boot)
  • Experience using JavaScript/Typescript to build fronted web applications using React, HTML and CSS
  • Experience using version control software - Git
  • Experience using online version control tools - GitHub, GitLab etc
  • Experience using Docker, Docker Compose
  • Experience with CI/CD (Gitlab, GitHub, Jenkins)
  • Experience with cloud technologies such AWS or Azure
  • Experience working in an agile team environment

DESIRABLE

  • Familiarity using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform
  • Familiarity building and integrating with NoSQL database (familiarity with MongoDB is preferred) or SQL databases such as Postgres
  • Familiarity with web standards, accessibility, and development best practice

Bonus:

  • Building microservices in C#
  • Experience building solutions that integrate with LLMs using tools such as Vercel AI, Langchain etc.
  • Using the GOV.UK Design System and using Nunjucks

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work in the UK’ accolade for 4 consecutive years. To see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page. Capgemini Invent offers Consultants a culture of learning, ownership, and focus on value.

  • You’ll gain exposure to high-profile transformations and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies.
  • Our consultants are formally trained by industry experts in consulting and client delivery. Consultants have access to a vast array for different training and certifications in a variety of areas: Cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM), cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), and Agile delivery (Scrum Master, Product Owner, Scaled Agile Framework). Capgemini Invent offers you the flexibility to develop various areas of knowledge in technical domains aligned both to your interests and our client’s outcomes.
  • Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities that will help us and our clients to succeed.
  • We hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
  • There are monthly team drinks, and it’s a chance to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.

The monthly team breakfasts give you a different, more relaxed setting to meet up in the office to hear from the leadership, meet colleagues and discuss the trends and insights within the market. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: 

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. 

Please opt in during the application process. 

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
 
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Your Role

In this role you will play a key role to: 

  • Own the vision, own the backlog, and lead the team to deliver
  • Support the team in all facets of cross-functional delivery. 
  • Manage stakeholder relationships and the delivery of value.
  • Understand user needs, business requirements and priorities, and technical constraints.
  • Support discovery and experimentation activities, specifically where AI could help solve user problems and create measurable value. 
  • Help test and validate AI-enabled features to support client strategy and drive innovation.
  • Promote and implement Agile ways of working as a transformation specialist.

You will also contribute to the business and your own development, through the following activities: 

 

Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 

Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 

Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 

Your Profile

  • Agile delivery of a user-centred product. 
  • Experience working within either: public sector using Government Digital Service (GDS) standards, or private sector (retail, financial services or energy).
  • Ability to communicate use cases and benefits of generative AI, and the risks and challenges of its implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience of owning a product vision and a supporting backlog. 
  • Ability to influence and manage stakeholders, to enable decision making based on user needs and business priorities.
  • A collaborative approach to leading cross-functional teams.

What you'll love about working here?

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work in the UK’ accolade for 4 consecutive years. To see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor Page. Capgemini Invent offers Consultants a culture of learning, ownership, and focus on value.

 

  • You’ll gain exposure to high-profile transformations and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies.
  • Our consultants are formally trained by industry experts in consulting and client delivery. Consultants have access to a vast array for different training and certifications in a variety of areas: Cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM), cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), and Agile delivery (Scrum Master, Product Owner, Scaled Agile Framework). Capgemini Invent offers you the flexibility to develop various areas of knowledge in technical domains aligned both to your interests and our client’s outcomes.

 

  • Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities that will help us and our clients to succeed.
  • We hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
  • There are monthly team drinks, and it’s a chance to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: 

  

  • Declare they have a disability, and  
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. 

Please opt in during the application process. 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester, Newcastle or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
 
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.
 
In order to commence a role with Capgemini UK plc you will be required to provide documentary proof prior to joining the Company that you are entitled to live and work in the UK.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.  

Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

YOUR ROLE

As a Consultant / Senior Consultant in our Operational Analytics team, you will work directly to help clients make tangible improvements to their operations through Data, Analytics and AI. Your assignments may focus on supply chain, capital infrastructure and asset management, process intelligence, commercial analytics or other operational challenges across the public and private sectors.  

In your role, you will: 

  • Work alongside clients and multidisciplinary teams to understand challenges and design, build, test and deliver AI-enhanced analytics solutions.  
  • Apply analytics, AI and automation techniques to areas such as supply chain planning, forecasting, logistics, network optimisation, asset reliability, process improvement and cost-to-serve analysis.  
  • Turn complex data into clear analyses, models, dashboards and decision-support tools that help clients act on insights.  
  • Understand business challenges, identify opportunities for AI-enabled transformation, gather and translate stakeholder requirements, and help shape practical solutions that deliver measurable operational value 
  • Take ownership of defined tasks or a workstream, with responsibility increasing in line with your experience, and contribute to high-quality project delivery.  
  • Support proposals, reusable assets and new ideas that strengthen our Operational Analytics capability, while sharing knowledge and helping teammates grow.  
  • Keep learning as AI technology evolves, considering responsible use, explainability and appropriate governance throughout delivery. 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: 

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 

YOUR PROFILE

You should have a skillset that combines rigorous thinking, creativity and thoughtful leadership. 

We welcome people with different backgrounds and routes into technology. You do not need to meet every criterion to apply. We are interested in candidates who bring hands-on delivery experience in some of the areas below, or a strong practical interest in AI technology and the motivation to develop these skills.  

  • AI analytics and decision intelligence: experience applying AI, machine learning, advanced analytics or data science techniques to generate insights and support business decision-making. This may include forecasting, optimisation, anomaly detection, predictive modelling, simulation, recommendation engines, digital twins, scenario analysis, or decision-intelligence solutions that improve operational performance and business outcomes. 
  • AI-driven workflow orchestration and automation: experience designing, building or deploying AI-enabled workflows that combine data, analytics and automation to improve operational outcomes. Familiarity with agentic AI, workflow orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool integration, decision-support systems, and human-in-the-loop processes would be beneficial.  
  • AI-enhanced process mining and process intelligence: experience with Process Mining tools (Celonis, SAP Signavio), and an understanding of event data, process discovery, process conformance, bottleneck analysis and process improvement.  
  • Observability and digital operations analytics: experience using observability platforms such as Dynatrace or comparable tools to analyse system performance, application behaviour and operational processes. Familiarity with distributed tracing, telemetry data, root-cause analysis, service dependency mapping, anomaly detection and AI-assisted operational insights would be advantageous. 
  • Entity resolution and contextual intelligence: experience with Quantexa or comparable decision intelligence, entity resolution and contextual analytics platforms. 
  • Graph and network analytics: experience with Neo4j, Cypher or graph algorithms to explore relationships, dependencies, flows or networks.  
  • Cloud-based analytics and data automation: practical skills in SQL, Python or Alteryx for data preparation, integration and repeatable workflows, plus visualisation experience with Power BI, Tableau or Qlik.  
  • Data pipelines and quality: an understanding of data extraction, transformation, normalisation, validation and quality controls for scalable analytics or AI solutions.  
  • Consulting and collaboration: ability to structure ambiguous problems, communicate clearly, work with diverse teams and turn complex analysis into useful recommendations.  
  • Delivery ownership: confidence managing your own work and, for more experienced candidates, leading a workstream and supporting the development of others. 

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

You will join a collaborative team where you can do meaningful client work, build practical expertise and shape your career around your strengths and interests.  

Investment in your AI career through training and certification opportunities across emerging and frontier AI technologies, enabling you to develop market-leading skills and stay at the forefront of innovation. 

Hands-on opportunities to apply AI, analytics and automation to real operational challenges across different sectors and problem areas.  

Access to colleagues with varied technical, industry and consulting experience, with support to learn from one another and share ideas.  

Mentoring, training and opportunities to deepen your skills in emerging AI and analytics technologies.  

Clear development support for both Consultant and Senior Consultant responsibilities, without expecting every candidate to follow the same career path.  

Hybrid working and a culture that values wellbeing, inclusion, collaboration and shared success.  

Opportunities to contribute beyond client delivery through propositions, thought leadership, recruitment and team initiatives.  

Join a team of talented professionals from a broad mix of backgrounds and experiences, where diversity of thought is actively encouraged, different perspectives are valued, and collaboration drives better outcomes. 

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively work to make it a reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring your whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
 
•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent on grade and on company and personal performance.

ROLE TITLE: Junior UX Designer (SC Cleared / SC Eligible) - Associate Consultant – AI & Digital Factory


LOCATION: London, Manchester, Glasgow, Newcastle, and Bristol
We offer hybrid working, however depending on your project you may have to travel to client locations.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

YOUR ROLE

As a Junior User Experience Designer, you will be joining the growing and exciting AI & Digital Factory community who are continually sharing knowledge and expertise. We are all passionate about user centred design, critical thinking, problem solving and designing and building digital services and products.  


In this role you will:

  • Use different techniques to understand users and their needs, translating user stories and proposing user-focused, evidence-based design approaches.
  • Design and prototype user interfaces ensuring alignment with user needs and business goals for our public and private sector clients.
  • Advocate for accessible and impactful services, ensuring solutions meet accessibility and inclusivity standards.
  • Work in a fast-paced, evolving environment, using an iterative method and flexible approach to enable rapid Agile delivery.
  • Communicate across organisational and technical boundaries, understanding the context and making complex and technical information simple and accessible for non-technical audiences.
  • Learn how we can use AI to enhance design processes.

 

As part of your role, you will also contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

  • Business Development – Contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • At least 1 year of experience in a User Experience Designer role or working in a design-focused role in a professional setting.
  • A love of learning – you are eager to take opportunities to develop your skills in parallel with the needs of your clients.
  • A keen interest in the field of User-Centred Design, keeping up to date with industry developments and conducting self-led learning.
  • Eligible for SC (Security Check) Clearance.
  • An empathetic approach and ability to listen to the needs of technical and business stakeholders to interpret them clearly for both audiences.
  • Working knowledge of iterative design processes and UCD methodologies.
  • Competence in using design tools to prototype user interfaces at different levels of fidelity to test and validate designs.  
  • Basic experience using HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
  • Basic familiarity with Government Digital Service (GDS) service standards and GDS design principles.
  • Clear and effective communication of design decisions to present concepts to team members and stakeholders. 

 

Ideally, you would also have: 

 

  • A design portfolio that showcases the design work you have produced.
  • Experience working within a User Centred Design team.  
  • Ability to build prototypes using code to create dynamic prototypes using HTML, CSS and JavaScript at a basic level.
  • Experience with GOV.UK Prototyping Kit and Figma.
  • Knowledge of relevant accessibility standards and legislation, such as the Web Content Accessibility Regulations (WCAG).

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

You will be part of a supportive UCD community, paired with a mentor who will invest in your development. You will work together to expand your skills in this profession. Our User Experience Designers champion inclusive design practices throughout our project lifecycles, ensuring solutions are accessible to as many users as possible. This includes engaging with diverse user research, applying accessibility guidelines and legislation, and advocating for inclusive design principles in your deliverables. 

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

 


We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 


Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 

 

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 

Please opt in during the application process.

CSR:

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

 

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester, Glasgow, Newcastle, and Bristol as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 

 


Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Capgemini’s technical architects, and consulting teams to help clients scope their future business models, build compelling cases for change, design and implement digital transformations, and drive successful rollouts and adoption. This is an AI centric role, where you will be expected to lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic initiatives, using AI to transform business capabilities and drive outcomes for clients.

 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

•    Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
•    Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
•    Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for the following core capabilities for Senior Consultant level candidates:


•    Able to collect and evaluate new demand requests, validating their strategic alignment, expected benefits, scope, and timing
•    Able to conduct Business Analyst activities during early-stage project definition, including requirements gathering and initial scoping
•    Able to interface with client stakeholders across a broad level (junior through to senior) to elicit, document and validate business requirements
•    Able to analyze existing processes and identify areas for improvement.
•    Able to manage and lead small project teams and interface with third party vendors to deliver discrete changes into production with good outcomes for the client
•    Able to architect a delivery solution using either Waterfall or Agile for specific features or supporting the delivery of one or more epics
•    Able to leverage strong delivery expertise and translate this into opportunities to sell future Capgemini Invent work
•    Able to create effective business models and diagrams that represent the organisation, processes, relationships, information and interactions
•    Able to identify and analyse the functionality that systems deliver or need to deliver, create system and data models and documentation with minimal supervision
•    Able to identify business scenarios and develop acceptance criteria to ensure requirements can be traced to develop functionality
•    Able to apply basic techniques to analyse, validate and prioritise user experience needs, and present findings in an accessible and easy to understand way
•    Able to lead end to end delivery of complex, AI enabled initiatives, with demonstrable impact on transforming business capabilities and delivering measurable client outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE:

Business Technology (BT) is the largest and fastest growing practice at Capgemini Invent. We are a trusted technology consulting & transformation business partner to our clients' Chief Digital Information Officers (CDIOs) and the global Capgemini Group. We combine emotional intelligence, human-centric design, and technology expertise to digitally transform our clients’ web and workplace experiences. We are successful in achieving this through our end-to-end portfolio of digital transformation service offers – Strategy, Design, Delivery, Architecture, Security and Change Management.
 
 
We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page.

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 
We are a Disability Confident Employer Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
 
· Declare they have a disability, and
· Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
 
Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
 
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.
 
ABOUT CAPGEMINI
 
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

About the job you're considering

The ServiceNow Platform Implementation Solution Specialist is a technical and strategic role within Digital Customer Experience’s (DCX) Business Technology practice in the UK. This role focuses on developing, customizing, and integrating ServiceNow solutions to enhance Customer Experience, Technology Experience, and Employee Experience. It requires a strong understanding of what drives excellent customer experiences from marketing, sales, and commerce perspectives, as well as how great employee experiences are built around key moments such as onboarding, daily work, and talent development. The role also involves leveraging ServiceNow’s platform to enable seamless workflows that optimize productivity and satisfaction for both customers and employees.

Your role

Technical Development - Design and develop solutions for ServiceNow workflow applications, including: 

  • Customer Experience Workflow Applications - Customer Service Management (CSM), Field Service Management, Customer Service Portal
  • Technology Experience Workflow Applications - IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), IT Asset Management (ITAM)
  • Employee Experience Workflow Applications - HR Service Delivery (HRSD), Employee Onboarding and Transitions, Workplace Service Delivery

 

User Experience - Utliise ServiceNow's Experience Layer components to build modern, intuitive user interfaces

  • Configure and enhance the Next Experience UI for tailored and seamless interactions
  • Use UI Builder and Service Portal to deliver role-based dashboards and customised workflows that meet client-specific requirements

Integration and Data Management

  • Integrate ServiceNow applications with external systems (e.g., CRMs, HR systems, and eCommerce platforms) using REST/SOAP APIs and IntegrationHub.
  • Manage data migration and ensure alignment across ServiceNow modules and external systems for consistent data integrity.
  • Workflow data fabric and RaptorDB

Your skills and experience

•    ServiceNow Expertise: Proven experience with the ServiceNow platform, focusing on Customer Experience, Technology Experience, and Employee Experience workflows.
•    Customer and Employee Insights:
•    Deep understanding of customer journey optimization, including touchpoints in marketing, sales, and commerce.
•    Strong knowledge of employee lifecycle touchpoints, such as onboarding, daily productivity, and career development.
•    Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and ServiceNow-specific tools like Glide API, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub.
•    Integration Skills: Expertise in integrating ServiceNow with external systems to create end-to-end workflows.

About the job you're considering

As a Salesforce AI Engineer, you'll design, build and ship AI features on the Salesforce platform for some of the world's leading organisations. Working across industries including Consumer Goods, Utilities, Automotive, Telecommunications, and Financial Services, you'll spend most of your time hands-on, building autonomous agents, connecting large language models to enterprise data, and getting AI systems running reliably in production.
This is an engineering role, not a configuration one. As Salesforce grows into a serious AI platform, you'll be building with Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder, Model Builder, and Data Cloud to create agents and AI-driven features that hold up under real workloads.
The work varies a lot. One day you might be designing an agent's reasoning and actions in Agentforce, the next writing Apex to ground a model in Salesforce data, tuning prompts and retrieval so answers stay accurate, or setting up evaluation harnesses to catch problems before they reach users.

Your role

Partner with Salesforce Functional Consultants, Solution Architects, and AI Specialists to design and deliver innovative Salesforce and AI-powered business solutions.
Leverage Agentforce, Einstein AI, Prompt Builder, Model Builder, and Data Cloud to develop intelligent experiences, autonomous agents, and AI-augmented business processes.
Act as a Salesforce and AI subject matter expert within the Digital Customer Experience (DCX) practice, helping shape our next-generation consulting capabilities and AI delivery methodologies.
Design and develop scalable Salesforce solutions using a combination of declarative and programmatic technologies including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, JavaScript, Platform Events, and APIs.

Build AI-enabled solutions that combine customer, operational, and enterprise data to deliver personalised, predictive, and proactive business experiences.
Integrate Salesforce with enterprise systems using MuleSoft, APIs, Event-Driven Architectures, and AppExchange solutions to create connected digital ecosystems.

Utilise AI-assisted development tools and modern DevOps practices to accelerate delivery, increase quality, and improve developer productivity.
Contribute to continuous innovation by evaluating emerging Salesforce AI capabilities and identifying opportunities to apply them across client engagements.
Support Agile delivery teams and champion modern engineering practices using tools such as Gearset, Copado, Flosum, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines.
Engage directly with client stakeholders, helping them understand how AI, automation, and Salesforce technology can unlock measurable business value.

 

Why You?

You'll thrive at the intersection of technology, business consulting, and AI innovation.
Working alongside clients, you'll transform and develop  ambitious business objectives into practical, scalable Salesforce solutions powered by automation, intelligence, and next-generation AI capabilities. You'll be expected not only to solve today's challenges but to help clients prepare for an increasingly autonomous, AI-driven future.

Whether you're designing Agentforce agents, building enterprise-grade Salesforce applications, integrating Data Cloud, or advising executives on AI adoption, you'll become a trusted advisor capable of translating complex technology into meaningful business outcomes.

Most importantly, you'll help shape the future role of the Salesforce consultant—leveraging AI to move beyond configuration and development into strategic solution design, innovation, and business transformation.

Your skill and experience

Technical Expertise
•    Strong Salesforce technical experience across one or more core clouds including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Industries Cloud, or Field Service.
•    Hands-on experience developing solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flow, JavaScript, APIs, and Salesforce integration patterns.
•    Hands-on experience building with Agentforce, Einstein, Prompt Builder and Model Builder, including designing agent actions, writing and tuning prompts, and grounding models in Salesforce data.
•    A working understanding of how large language models behave in practice: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), grounding, and how to reduce hallucination.
•    Experience testing and evaluating AI features, for example building eval sets, measuring accuracy, and monitoring quality, cost and latency once live.
•    Knowledge of enterprise integration approaches, including MuleSoft, event-driven architectures, REST/SOAP APIs, and external system connectivity, including connecting to AI models hosted outside Salesforce.
•    Experience building solutions for large-scale environments supporting hundreds or thousands of Salesforce users.
•    Nice to have: familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP), vector search and embeddings, or Python for AI tooling.

Consulting & Delivery
•    Proven experience translating complex business requirements and user stories into scalable technical solutions.
•    Experience delivering solutions using Agile methodologies within cross-functional teams of engineers, architects, and business stakeholders.
•    The ability to explain technical and AI concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
•    Experience collaborating with third-party delivery partners and Salesforce ecosystem vendors.
•    Solid grounding in DevOps and modern software engineering practices across the Salesforce delivery lifecycle.

Certifications & Continuous Learning
•    Salesforce Administrator
•    Platform Developer I & II
•    JavaScript Developer I
•    AI Specialist 
•    Data Cloud Consultant
•    Salesforce Consultant Certifications (Sales, Service, Experience, Field Service, etc.)
•    Agentblazer Legend


A genuine appetite for learning, shown through certifications, Trailhead credentials, hands-on Agentforce work, and keeping up with how AI capabilities are moving.

 

The most successful engineers will combine:

•    Salesforce platform expertise
•    Hands-on Agentforce
•    Data and integration knowledge
•    Clear technical communication
•    Automation-first thinking
•    Modern engineering and DevOps practices


As Salesforce grows into a serious enterprise AI platform, you'll be the one building the autonomous agents and intelligent features that make it real and setting the standard for how Salesforce AI Engineering is done.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Impactful Experiences
You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Your Role

As an ERP Program Manager at Capgemini Invent, you will be responsible for leading complex ERP transformation initiatives that drive significant business value for our clients. You will oversee the strategic direction and execution of ERP programs, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and delivery of high-quality outcomes. Your ability to navigate multifaceted project requirements and manage diverse stakeholder expectations will be critical to the success of these initiatives.

 

Join Capgemini Invent as an ERP Program Manager to leverage your expertise in managing intricate ERP projects while driving innovation and value for our clients in a fast-paced and collaborative environment. Your leadership will be instrumental in shaping the future of their enterprise resource planning capabilities.

 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities),  offering development.
  • Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your Profile

 

In this role, you will play a key role in:

 

  • Comprehensive Budget Analysis and Financial Acumen: Expertise in developing, managing, and analyzing program budgets, ensuring financial accountability and alignment with organizational goals. Ability to conduct cost-benefit analyses, forecast financial impacts, and identify funding opportunities while mitigating financial risks throughout the ERP lifecycle.
  • Advanced Program Management Skills: Proficient in applying advanced program management methodologies (such as Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid) to oversee multi-faceted ERP projects. This includes creating detailed project plans, defining milestones, managing timelines, and ensuring compliance with best practices and organizational standards.
  • Scope Assessment and Challenge: Strong capability to critically assess and challenge project scope, ensuring that all requirements are aligned with strategic objectives. Ability to facilitate scope definition workshops, manage scope creep, and implement change control processes to maintain focus on project deliverables.
  • Risk Management and Mitigation: Expertise in identifying, analyzing, and mitigating risks associated with ERP implementations. Develop and implement risk management strategies that address potential challenges (technical, operational, and organizational) while ensuring business continuity and project success.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Leadership: Proven ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, operations, and HR, to ensure cohesive program execution. Strong interpersonal skills to foster collaboration, resolve conflicts, and align diverse stakeholders around common objectives.
  • Performance Measurement and Continuous Improvement: Experience in establishing key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure program success and effectiveness. Ability to analyze performance data, gather insights, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program outcomes and client satisfaction.
  • Change Management Expertise: Strong understanding of change management principles and practices in the context of ERP implementations. Ability to develop and execute change management strategies that facilitate user adoption, minimize resistance, and ensure that stakeholders are engaged and supported throughout the transformation journey.
  • Leading ERP Transformation Programs: Manage end-to-end ERP program delivery, including planning, execution, and monitoring of projects across various stages of the ERP lifecycle, ensuring alignment with client objectives and industry best practices.
  • Stakeholder Management: Engage with executive leadership, cross-functional teams, and external partners to define program scope, objectives, and success criteria, while facilitating effective communication and collaboration throughout the program lifecycle.
  • Complex Requirements Analysis: Collaborate with clients to identify and articulate complex business requirements, translating them into actionable ERP solutions that enhance operational efficiency, accuracy, and compliance across financial, supply chain, and operational functions.
  • Delivery Standards and Quality Assurance: Establish and enforce rigorous delivery standards, methodologies, and governance frameworks to ensure high-quality project outcomes, risk management, and adherence to timelines and budgets.
  • Change Management and Training: Develop and implement change management strategies to facilitate smooth transitions to new ERP systems, including stakeholder training, user adoption initiatives, and post-implementation support to drive sustainable improvements.

Need To Know

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

 

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

Our SAP Packaged Based Solutions Practice team supports and implements SAP Tax and Revenue Management (TRM) solutions to our public sector client, which is the largest implementation of its kind globally. We are a dynamic and fast-moving business unit, with an expectation of further growth over the coming years to ensure that we can continue to deliver high-quality SAP solutions.

We are looking for SAP consultants who can combine strong functional expertise with a client-centric, consultative approach to support the continued growth and success of the TRM solution. This is a challenging and multi-faceted role that requires strong functional SAP knowledge, a commitment to continuous learning and big-picture thinking.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: 
identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

In this role, you'll combine your SAP expertise with strong consulting and delivery leadership skills to shape solutions that drive transformation across our client's SAP platform. Working closely with senior stakeholders, architects and delivery teams, you will act as a trusted advisor, leading workshops, shaping business requirements and designing SAP solutions that deliver measurable outcomes and support wider organisational objectives.

You will take collaborative ownership across the full project lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through to implementation, testing and transition into live service, ensuring solutions remain aligned to client priorities, governance standards and operational excellence goals.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and delivery of end-to-end SAP solutions across a major transformation programme.
  • Facilitate client workshops and stakeholder engagements, building trusted relationships and developing a deep understanding of business challenges to define effective SAP solutions.
  • Produce and maintain key design artefacts, including blueprints, functional specifications and solution documentation.
  • Configure SAP solutions and provide functional leadership throughout the build, test and deployment lifecycle.
  • Work as One-Team with architects, developers, testers and client stakeholders to deliver high-quality, business-aligned solutions that maximise value throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, managing risks, dependencies and governance to drive successful outcomes.
  • Support the successful transition into live service while mentoring consultants and contributing to the growth of the wider SAP practice.
  • Demonstrate curiosity and continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimise processes, challenge existing approaches and introduce innovative SAP solutions. 

Your skills and experience

  • Experience delivering and supporting SAP solutions within complex, high-volume environments, with exposure to platforms such as PSCD, Tax and Revenue Management (TRM), IS-U, FI-CA, BRIM, or related industry solutions.
  • A strong consulting background, with the ability to develop trusted client relationships, influence stakeholders and translate business needs into solutions that deliver measurable value.
  • Proven experience across the full project lifecycle, from requirements and design through build, testing, deployment and live service support.
  • Good understanding of financial processes, including UK statutory accounting, management accounting principles and integration across the wider SAP ecosystem.
  • Strong problem-solving, incident management, testing, documentation and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technical teams.
  • Experience of SAP S/4HANA transformations and relevant SAP or financial certifications would be beneficial but are not essential.


We value diverse experiences and perspectives. If your skills and experience are relevant to this role, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement outlined above. We're committed to creating an environment where people can develop, grow and realise their potential.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.


As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more,

You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

The role will also involve collaboration with our UK SAP Centre of Excellence to assist with active development of our pipeline, driving improvement of our offers and go-to-market.  You will be engaged in project delivery roles, both advisory and implementation, in a senior capacity.

data.description:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.  

YOUR ROLE

We are looking for a ServiceNow HR Business Analyst consultant to join our growing Employee Experience and HR practice. This role supports the design and delivery of HR Service Delivery solutions on the ServiceNow platform, helping organisations improve HR operations, streamline workflows and enhance employee experiences.

You will work with business stakeholders, delivery teams and customer representatives to support requirements gathering, process mapping and the delivery of ServiceNow HRSD capabilities such as case management, employee portals, knowledge management and HR services.

This is not a hands-on configuration or development role. Instead, you will support the bridge between the customer and delivery teams, helping translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, process designs and functional outcomes, with guidance from more senior consultants and architects.

This is an opportunity to grow your ServiceNow, HR transformation and consulting skills while contributing to meaningful technology-enabled change programmes and building a clear pathway into more senior advisory roles.

What you will be responsible for: 


HR process and requirements analysis
•    Support the analysis and documentation of business requirements for ServiceNow HRSD solutions.
•    Work with HR teams and senior consultants to understand existing processes, pain points and improvement opportunities.
•    Assist with current-state and future-state HR process mapping, helping identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve the employee experience.
•    Translate agreed business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, functional notes and process documentation, with review and guidance from senior team members.


ServiceNow implementation delivery support
•    Support the delivery of platform capabilities and features. You will not be required to configure or develop in the platform but should become comfortable walking through deliverables and explaining how they meet business needs.
•    Work with technical teams to help ensure requirements are understood, tracked and delivered in line with agreed outcomes.
•    Support customer workshops, playback sessions, requirements validation activities and follow-up actions.
•    Contribute to workflow diagrams, functional designs, testing inputs and business process documentation.
•    Work collaboratively with architects, senior consultants, developers, senior business analysts, testers and change and enablement teams throughout implementations.


Customer and delivery team interface
•    Act as a developing technology consultant, helping customer stakeholders and delivery teams understand requirements, decisions, actions and next steps.
•    Support engagement with ServiceNow representatives and ecosystem partners where required, learning how the wider platform and partner ecosystem supports customer outcomes.


Business development
•    Support responses to RFPs and RFIs by contributing research, case study inputs, solution notes and proposal content, with guidance from senior colleagues.
•    Assist with proposal preparation and client presentation materials, building confidence in contributing to sales and pre-sales activities over time.


What makes this role unique
•    Opportunity to develop your skills in a growing globally recognised HR Transformation organisation.
•    A clear pathway into senior ServiceNow HRSD business analysis, solution advisory and customer-facing consulting roles.
•    Work within Capgemini’s strong ServiceNow ecosystem and partnerships.
•    Exposure to global deals and opportunities across the full sales to delivery lifecycle, with the support and coaching needed to grow.

YOUR PROFILE

Essential experience & certifications

•    ServiceNow certifications or training relevant to the role, ideally including ServiceNow Certified System Administrator or a willingness to achieve it within an agreed timeframe.
•    ServiceNow HRSD experience or HR transformation experience, with CIS HRSD in progress or a clear commitment to work towards certification.

  • Proven experience via
    •    Exposure to at least one large ServiceNow implementation or enhancement project, OR
    •    Experience supporting HR process improvement, HR service delivery, employee experience or digital HR initiatives
  • A good understanding of HR operations, the employee lifecycle and how HR services are delivered across an organisation.
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow HRSD capabilities such as HR case management, employee service centre, HR knowledge management, HR service catalogue, employee journeys, workbooks and flows.
  • A developing understanding of how HR connects with other business functions such as IT, Procurement and Finance.
  • Interest in learning how to articulate and demonstrate ServiceNow HR and AI features to customers, with support from senior colleagues.


Key traits and capabilities
•    Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with a willingness to learn structured consulting approaches.
•    Clear communication skills and confidence engaging with stakeholders at working-group level.
•    Ability to support the interface between business stakeholders, customer teams and technical delivery teams.
•    A practical awareness of the technology delivery lifecycle, including discovery and requirements gathering, solution design, testing, rollout, change management, hypercare and continuous improvement.
•    Familiarity with Agile ways of working, or a willingness to develop Agile delivery experience.
•    (Nice to have) Experience supporting project coordination, workshop preparation, action tracking, testing, training or change activities within a delivery framework such as Agile, SAFe or PMP-led environments.

 

A developing HR ServiceNow professional who:
•    Understands HR processes and is interested in how technology improves employee experiences.
•    Enjoys working with stakeholders to understand problems, capture requirements and shape practical solutions.
•    Can support the bridge between business teams and technical delivery teams, with guidance from more experienced colleagues.
•    Is curious about the ServiceNow platform and its wider ecosystem.
•    Is keen to support workshops, proposals, testing, rollout and change activities.
•    Wants to build a career in ServiceNow HRSD, business analysis and technology-enabled transformation, with room to grow into more senior consulting responsibilities.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

You will be part of the Employee Experience & HR team, which has a collaborative culture. You will work with a diverse group of talented professionals who are passionate about HR, technology, Employee Experience, AI, and dedicated to delivering exceptional solutions to diverse clients. A team that thrives on creativity and innovation, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

 

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page. 

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work. 

 

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing. 

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice. 

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance. 

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

About the job you’re considering

You will work within the SAP Integration team to deliver inventive and often pioneering SAP solutions to some of the UKs most successful and forward thinking organisations. As part of a team of skilled and professional consultants you will receive the support required to deliver as well as grow within the Capgemini organisation.

About our UK SAP Practice Team:  Capgemini UK is a leading SAP Integration Partner, helping our clients navigate through complex SAP transformations. Capgemini UK has 1000 + SAP practitioners across UK & India and are ranked #1 for SAP S/4HANA® certifications in UK and globally. We work closely with our clients to transform their business together using the latest SAP products and architecture, a deep knowledge of industries and markets , and innovative delivery methodologies. 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: Identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your Role

  • Deliver agile services from across the Company portfolio in a fast-changing environment. Drive the industrialization of services delivery and the implementation process
  • Ensure customer success, satisfaction, and reference ability in SAP Integration projects
  • SME Face-off for external and internal stakeholders is the point of expertise related to the area under consideration for both the customer as well as the internal team
  • Provide strategic direction to the competency build for the area in terms of areas of focus and related roadmaps

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, stiving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Extensive implementation and consulting experience for implementing in SAP PI/PO, Cloud Platform Integration, Integration Suite and APIs
  • Experience of transforming businesses and business processes using SAP integration technologies
  • Strong customer focus with good client facing consulting capability as roles are working collaboratively with our clients, and on behalf of our clients
  • Playing an active part in Process Improvement, ensuring compliance with all relevant quality processes and procedures, including completion of all the specified quality records

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your Security Clearance 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 12 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.
Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini 

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
