To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester, Newsactle or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 
Join our Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA) Financial Services team and be part of the future of AI consulting. We are redefining how organisations adopt and scale AI, moving beyond experimentation to embedding agentic systems, human-AI workflows and data products into every aspect of how they operate, compete, and create value. 
We are looking for experienced Data & AI leaders who combine AI technical expertise and commercial acumen to shape enterprise-wide transformation. You will lead client engagements from strategy through to execution that combine modern data platforms, semantic architectures and agentic AI solutions to deliver measurable business value, whilst contributing to the growth of our EDA Financial Services practice.

YOUR ROLE

This role is for a programme leader with genuine technical depth - not a solution architect, and not a pure strategist. You will own complex, multi-workstream data and AI programmes for major Financial Services clients: the client relationship, the commercials, the delivery and the team. You will need enough hands-on background to challenge an architecture decision credibly, and enough consulting judgement to hold a boardroom. You will not be building the architecture yourself.
You will work across retail and commercial banking, insurance and capital markets, on problems where the value is clear and the constraints are real - credit decisioning, underwriting, claims, KYC and AML operations, complaints handling and trade surveillance, alongside the data foundations underneath them. You will be expected to operate fluently within the regulatory environment that shapes AI delivery in Financial Services.
We Make AI Useful. You will own the commercial and value agenda - making sure the AI we build is worth building.
•    Acting as a trusted advisor to executive and C-suite stakeholders, shaping AI strategy, investment cases and roadmaps, and being the person the client escalates to when the programme is under pressure
•    Owning the business case end to end: defining the value, agreeing the measurement approach with the client’s finance and risk functions, and being accountable for the benefits actually landing
•    Making the difficult trade-off calls - build versus buy, platform choice, delivery sequencing, and where technical debt is acceptable and where it is not


We Make AI Usable. You will lead the human-centred design of AI solutions around the needs of users and the way organisations operate.
•    Translating business and regulatory problems into AI-enabled products, agentic workflows and intelligent decision platforms, with defined user needs, business outcomes and success metrics
•    Designing operating models that integrate people, AI agents and business processes - including role redesign, human-in-the-loop controls, and the change strategy that makes adoption stick
•    Partnering with business, product and engineering leaders to embed AI into customer journeys, colleague experience and operational decision-making at enterprise scale
We Make AI Reliable. You will set the technical direction and hold the delivery to account, without designing it yourself.
•    Directing the design of AI-ready data foundations, platforms and semantic layers that provide trusted business context and reliable access to enterprise information, and holding your architects to account on those decisions
•    Assuring agentic architectures - interrogating how agents interact with enterprise systems and people, where they fail, how failure is detected, and what the cost curve looks like at scale
•    Establishing the governance, security, responsible AI and operational practices required to run AI in production under regulatory scrutiny

As part of your role, you will be expected to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:
•    Business Development - Leading proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitches and Thought leadership that positions the organization at the forefront of modern Data & AI consulting.
•    Internal contribution - Supporting practice development through offering development, recruitment, campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, operational excellence and capability building across Data, AI and Agentic AI.
•    Learning & Development - Continuously developing your own expertise in emerging data and AI technologies and consulting leadership through training, certifications and applied innovation, while fostering a culture of continuous learning across the practice.

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for a T-shaped leader: broad enough to run an enterprise programme end to end, and deep enough in data and AI to be a genuine peer to the engineers and architects you lead. What matters most is your ability to connect business problems, regulatory constraints and technology into outcomes clients can actually operate.
The essential criteria below are what we screen against, and we expect candidates to meet all of them. The desirable experience that follows is genuinely a bonus - strong candidates will have several, and nobody has all of them. We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and unless stated otherwise these criteria can be evidenced in any sector.
Essential criteria
•    Programme leadership at scale. You have led complex, multi-workstream data or AI programmes with teams, and have been personally accountable for the outcome - not for a workstream within someone else’s programme.
•    AI delivered into production, not just piloted. You can describe at least one AI or advanced analytics capability you took from concept into live operational use, including what went wrong along the way and how you dealt with it.
•    Financial Services experience. Experience delivering for banking, insurance or capital markets clients, with a solid working understanding of how these businesses operate, what regulation means for them and what actually drives value. You can translate business requirements into delivery that produces measurable outcomes.
•    Technical credibility. Sufficient hands-on background in data engineering, data platforms, machine learning or Generative AI to be a genuine peer to your architects and engineers. You should be able to explain, without notes, how a RAG architecture fails in production and what you would do about it.
•    Team leadership. Experience leading and coaching consultants, engineers or architects within your programme, and building an inclusive, high-performing team culture people want to stay in.
•    Consulting and commercial track record. Experience in a consulting or senior client-facing environment advising executive stakeholders and presenting to client governance boards, with a demonstrable record of originating and selling work.
Desirable experience
•    Hands-on delivery experience with one or more major cloud and data platforms - Databricks, Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP or Snowflake - and familiarity with the wider AI ecosystem including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google
•    Experience designing semantic layers, data products or knowledge platforms that serve both analytics and AI consumers
•    Experience shaping agentic architectures - how AI agents interact securely with enterprise systems, data platforms, business processes and human decision-makers
•    Practical experience of responsible AI in production: model evaluation, lineage, monitoring, bias testing, privacy and risk frameworks
•    Published thought leadership, conference speaking or a visible market profile in Data and AI

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

As a Senior Manager, you will have the opportunity to work at the forefront of AI and analytics innovation, contributing to cutting-edge projects that shape industries. Your leadership will make a tangible impact on clients’ digital transformations while advancing your own career in a collaborative and inspiring environment.
We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 4 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively work to make it a reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring your whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
 
•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.
CSR:
We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent on grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 
Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

data.title: Manager/Senior Manager - Data Management

data.description:
Role Purpose

As part of the UK ADM Centre of Excellence, the Senior Solution Director shapes and leads complex Managed Service solutions that enable client transformation, business growth, and measurable outcomes. The role supports the full sales lifecycle, from early opportunity shaping through solution development, commercial positioning, proposal creation, and client presentation.
Working across existing and prospective clients, the role combines deep ADM expertise with consulting, commercial, and stakeholder management capabilities to develop differentiated solutions underpinned by AI, Data, Agile, Product-Centric Delivery, Cloud, Automation and Managed Services innovation.
The Senior Solution Director acts as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and works closely with Market Units, Sales, Account Executives, Delivery Leaders, Portfolio teams, and Strategic Partners to create competitive, outcome-focused propositions.

Key Responsibilities

         Client and Opportunity Shaping

  • Lead early-stage client engagement and opportunity shaping discussions.
  • Understand client objectives, business challenges, transformation ambitions, and operational priorities.
  • Develop trusted advisor relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Help clients define future-state operating models, transformation roadmaps, and target outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to position and expand ADM Managed Services capabilities.

    Solution Leadership

  • Lead the design of complex Managed Service solutions across application development, maintenance, transformation, modernisation, cloud, automation, AI, and service operations.
  • Create differentiated, commercially competitive propositions aligned to client priorities leveraging emerging technologies including Agentic and GenAI.
  • Balance client value, delivery feasibility, commercial objectives, and risk management.

    Market and Offer Development
  • Support the evolution of ADM Managed Service offers and go-to-market propositions.
  • Tailor messaging to market demands, emerging AI capabilities, industry trends, and customer priorities.
  • Collaborate with global and UK teams to industrialise reusable assets, accelerators, frameworks, and reference architectures.

    Sales and Pursuit Support
  • Coordinate with Market Units to identify, qualify, and progress opportunities.
  • Lead solution workstreams within strategic pursuits and large-scale bids.
  • Develop value propositions, business cases, proposal content, and commercial strategies.
  • Provide leadership throughout the pursuit lifecycle, from qualification to contract signature.

    Executive Stakeholder Engagement
  • Engage confidently with senior IT leaders, CxOs, Board, and senior executive stakeholders.
  • Facilitate strategic workshops and executive discussions.
  • Present complex business and technology solutions clearly and compellingly.
  • Influence decision-making through industry insight, market knowledge, and solution expertise.

    Storytelling and Communication
  • Craft compelling executive narratives, presentations, proposals, and solution collateral.
  • Simplify complex concepts into clear business messaging.
  • Credibly present how emerging AI technologies transform services.
    Develop persuasive storylines for business and technology audiences.

    Leadership Expectations

  • Provide visible leadership across strategic pursuits and client engagements.
  • Coach and mentor solution teams and emerging solution architects.
  • Promote collaboration across Market Units, Sales, Delivery, Industry Teams, and
  • Global ADM Communities.
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement within the ADM Centre of Excellence.

Essential Skills and Experience

         Business and Client Leadership

  • Proven ability to engage and influence CxO-level stakeholders.
  • Strong consulting, stakeholder management, and relationship-building capability.
  • Demonstrated success in shaping large-scale transformation opportunities and strategic outcomes.

    Solution and Delivery Expertise

  • Extensive experience designing and leading complex Managed Service solutions.
  • Strong understanding of ADM, AI, Agile, DevOps, Product-Centric Delivery, Application Modernisation, Cloud and Automation.
  • Experience developing transition, transformation, service management, and operating model solutions.

    Commercial Acumen

  • Strong commercial awareness and financial modelling capability.
  • Experience developing compelling business cases and investment propositions.
  • Ability to balance value creation, risk mitigation, and competitive positioning.

       
         Communication and Storytelling

  • Exceptional executive communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to simplify complex business and technology concepts.
  • Strong proposal writing and workshop facilitation skills.

         
        Personal Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with strong business and commercial acumen.
  • Credible relationship builder with strong executive presence.
  • Innovative, outcomes-focused, self-motivated, and resilient.
  • Recognised as a trusted advisor, thought leader, and ambassador for Capgemini.

       
         Success Measures

 

  • Increased win rate across strategic ADM pursuits.
  • Growth in qualified Managed Services opportunities and revenue.
  • Strong executive stakeholder engagement and satisfaction.
  • Development and adoption of differentiated reusable ADM solution assets.
  • Contribution to UK ADM strategic objectives and market positioning.

data.title: ADM Managed Services , Senior Solution Director

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

As a Data and Insights Driven Solutions Lead, your core purpose is to use data, service insight and analysis to build the most efficient and best-priced solutions for our clients across Cloud Infrastructure Services, spanning cloud computing, traditional infrastructure, end user services, enterprise service management and cyber security. You will collate and interrogate existing service data and operational practices to uncover where effort, cost and waste sit within service delivery, and apply Capgemini’s ESOAR framework to turn those insights into improvement actions and automation projects. Leveraging your expertise in data storytelling, presentation and business communication, you will translate this insight into compelling, evidenced client proposals. Your role will involve leading cross-functional teams, managing senior stakeholders, and ensuring the deliverability of solutions from conception to implementation.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

  • Service Data & Effort Analysis: Collate and analyse existing service data and operational practices/runbooks to identify the effort spent in the delivery of services, establishing a clear, evidenced baseline of cost and effort drivers.
  • ESOAR-Led Improvement: Apply Capgemini’s ESOAR framework (Eliminate, Standardise, Optimise, Automate, Robotise) to determine improvement actions and projects, with the aim of eradicating wastage and automating repeatable tasks.
  • Insight-Led Solutioning: Lead the integration of data, analytics and insight into new and existing solutions, working collaboratively with clients to shape and incubate opportunities and respond to RFIs, RFPs and similar procurement frameworks.
  • Client-Centric Vision: Clearly articulate a client-centric, evidence-based vision using data storytelling and advanced presentation skills.
  • Business Communication: Demonstrate concise and business-focused written communication and general writing skills, translating complex data and analytics into compelling narratives.
  • Competitive & Cost Analysis: Use data and analytics to understand competitive pressures on price, identify cost levers, and deliver the most cost-effective and competitive solutions.
  • Requirements & Data Analysis: Undertake requirements analysis and translation, using operational and service data to understand service components, standard service offerings, and potential gaps.
  • Commercial Understanding: Possess detailed commercial understanding, including risks, terms and conditions (T&Cs) and service schedules, as well as contractual drafting.
  • Financial & Insight Analysis: Conduct detailed price, cost and benefits analysis, including internal business case creation grounded in data and analytics.
  • Coaching and mentoring: Undertake coaching, mentoring and people management of colleagues to develop data, insight and solutioning skills and capabilities.
  • Break boundaries: Whilst demonstrating mastery of data, analytics and insight capability, you will possess a broad understanding of the wider cloud and infrastructure portfolio and technologies to deliver holistic solutions to our clients. 


You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Solution Leadership: Ability to lead insight-driven solutions across different business units, including senior internal stakeholder management.
  • Service Data Analysis: Ability to collate, interrogate and translate operational service data and runbooks into actionable insight on cost, effort and service efficiency.
  • Process Improvement & Automation: Experience applying structured improvement methodologies, such as ESOAR, Lean or Six Sigma, to eliminate waste and drive automation of repeatable tasks.
  • Solution Deliverability: Work with internal delivery teams to design and articulate solutions that are deliverable once signed.
  • Creativity: Think creatively to craft data-led solutions that meet customer requirements and differentiate from competitors.
  • Portfolio Awareness: Apply the company’s Cloud Infrastructure Services portfolio to solutions, making it real and demonstrating our capability to deliver.
  • Emerging Technologies: Stay aware of the latest developments in data, analytics, automation, and AI, and bring insights and future benefits to new solutions.
  • Client Business Case: Create and communicate client business cases and benefits realization, including financial analytics and modelling.
  • Proven Experience: Significant demonstrated experience in data and insights-led solution design, solution architecture, or a related role within IT services, outsourcing or infrastructure services.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Leadership Abilities: Proven ability to lead cross-functional and senior teams and manage stakeholders at a senior level.
  • Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of commercial terms, conditions, and service schedules.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in data analytics, price and cost analysis, financial modelling, and business case creation.
  • Creative Thinking: Ability to think creatively and innovate data-led solutions.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong awareness of cloud, infrastructure, service management, cyber security, data platforms, automation, and AI

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2023. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

data.title: Data and Insights Driven Solutions Lead

data.description:
Your role

  • AI & Agentic Opportunity Identification: Identify where AI and agentic solutions can be applied across our working practices to reduce manual effort and repetitive, low-value tasks.
  • AI-Enabled Portfolio Development: Embrace and shape the latest AI and agentic developments within our portfolio, ensuring they are embedded in the solutions and services we deliver to clients.
  • Insight-Led Solutioning: Lead the integration of AI-enabled capability into new and existing solutions, working collaboratively with clients to shape and incubate opportunities and respond to RFIs, RFPs and similar procurement frameworks.
  • Value & Benefits Realisation: Define and track the benefits and value outcomes of AI adoption, ensuring anticipated gains in efficiency, cost and quality are realised for both Capgemini and our clients.
  • Client-Centric Vision: Clearly articulate a client-centric, AI-enabled vision using storytelling and advanced presentation skills.
  • Business Communication: Demonstrate concise and business-focused written communication and general writing skills, translating complex AI concepts into compelling, accessible narratives.
  • Competitive & Cost Analysis: Understand competitive pressures on price and identify how AI and automation can act as cost levers to deliver the most cost-effective and competitive solutions.
  • Internal Priorities: Understand and address internal priorities and governance, including the responsible and ethical use of AI, across the Cloud Infrastructure Services portfolio.
  • Requirements Analysis: Undertake requirements analysis and translation to understand where AI platforms and agentic technology can address service components, standard service offerings, and potential gaps.
  • Leadership: Lead cross-functional teams collaboratively across cloud, infrastructure, end user services, enterprise service management and cyber security to achieve shared outcomes, and execute external and internal stakeholder management and communication.
  • Commercial Understanding: Possess detailed commercial understanding, including risks, terms and conditions (T&Cs) and service schedules, as well as contractual drafting relevant to AI-enabled services.
  • Financial Analysis: Conduct detailed price and cost analysis, including internal business case creation for AI and automation investment.
  • Coaching and mentoring: Undertake coaching, mentoring and people management of colleagues to build AI literacy, skills and capabilities across the Solutions Team.
  • Break boundaries: Whilst demonstrating mastery of AI platforms and agentic technology, you will possess a broad understanding of the wider cloud and infrastructure portfolio to deliver holistic solutions to our clients.


You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • AI Solution Leadership: Ability to lead the adoption of AI and agentic solutions across different business units, including internal stakeholder management.
  • AI Platform Expertise: Extensive, current knowledge of AI platforms and technology, including generative AI, agentic frameworks, and automation and orchestration tools, and how they can be applied to working practices.
  • Solution Deliverability: Work with internal delivery teams to design and articulate AI-enabled solutions that are deliverable once signed.\
  • Creativity: Think creatively to craft AI-enabled solutions that meet customer requirements and differentiate from competitors.
  • Portfolio Awareness: Apply the company’s Cloud Infrastructure Services portfolio and latest AI developments to solutions, making it real and demonstrating our capability to deliver.
  • Emerging Technologies: Stay aware of the latest developments in AI, agentic technology and automation, and bring insights and future benefits to new solutions.
  • Responsible AI: Understand the ethical, governance and risk considerations of deploying AI and agentic solutions, both internally and for clients.
  • Environmental Impact: Consider the environmental impact and sustainability of AI-enabled proposals.
  • Solution Pricing Strategy: Drive the solution pricing to a winning position, understanding how AI and automation can be used as cost levers.
  • Client Business Case: Create and communicate client business cases and benefits realisation for AI adoption, including financial analytics and modelling.
  • External Stakeholder Management: Manage external stakeholders and develop client intimacy through site visits, industry days, and client presentations.
  • Contract Management: Drive contract closure and transition from sales to delivery, including early life support and hyper-care phases.
  • Proven Experience: Demonstrated experience applying AI, agentic or automation technology within solution architecture, delivery or a related role.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Leadership Abilities: Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage stakeholders.
  • Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of commercial terms, conditions, and service schedules.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in price and cost analysis, financial modelling, and business case creation.
  • Creative Thinking: Ability to think creatively and innovate AI-led solutions.
  • Technical Knowledge: Deep awareness of AI platforms, agentic technology and automation, alongside cloud, infrastructure, service management and cyber security.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.title: AI Adoption and Solutions Lead

data.description:
Who You'll Be Working With

 

As a Data & AI Solution Architect at Capgemini, you will design and lead the delivery of intelligent data platforms and AI-native solutions that unlock advanced analytics, GenAI, and autonomous decision-making at scale. You will translate business strategy into AI-ready, governed architectures and take ownership from data foundations through to AI-driven outcomes.


You will work within the Data Platforms team, at the forefront of Databricks Lakehouse, Azure AI, and emerging agentic frameworks, helping clients modernise and transform their data and AI capabilities.

PLEASE NOTE:

Security Clearence: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC)clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

The Focus Of Your Role

 

You will shape next-generation data and AI platforms by combining deep Databricks expertise with modern engineering practices. Using tools such as VS Code and AI-assisted development, you will rapidly design, build, and scale enterprise solutions while continuously bringing new innovations into delivery.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Design scalable, secure Databricks Lakehouse architectures that unify data, analytics, and AI.
  • Use GenAI and developer tooling to accelerate delivery, generating production-ready pipelines, infrastructure, and business logic.
  • Build enterprise-grade data pipelines and AI workflows using reusable, governed patterns.
  • Embed GenAI capabilities including RAG, vector search, and AI assistants into data platforms.
  • Design and orchestrate AI agents and multi-agent workflows to enable intelligent automation.
  • Apply MLOps and LLMOps practices to ensure AI solutions are scalable and maintainable.
  • Monitor and optimise platform performance, cost, and model effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with engineering, data, and business teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Stay ahead of emerging capabilities across Databricks AI and Azure agentic ecosystems and apply them to real-world use cases.

 

 

What You'll Bring

 

You will bring strong experience in delivering modern data and AI platforms, with a focus on scalable, governed solutions. You will be confident using AI-assisted development approaches to improve delivery speed and quality.


You will be able to translate business requirements into practical data and AI architectures, establish reusable engineering patterns, and lead teams towards automation-first approaches while ensuring security, governance, and responsible AI practices are maintained.


Experience:

  • Proven experience designing and delivering data and AI platforms using Databricks.
  • Strong knowledge of Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, MLflow, and AI workloads.
  • Experience developing GenAI solutions such as RAG, embeddings, and LLM integration.
  • Experience designing agentic workflows and orchestration patterns.
  • Strong understanding of Azure AI services and their integration with Databricks.
  • Experience using VS Code and AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.
  • Proven ability to accelerate SDLC using automation, templates, and standardised engineering approaches.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and leadership skills.


Key differentiators:

 

  • Actively explores and brings new ideas from the Databricks AI and Azure ecosystem into delivery.
  • Uses GenAI and developer tooling to improve productivity and solution quality.
  • Focuses on reusable, scalable patterns rather than one-off implementations.
  • Understands how AI can transform both business processes and the software development lifecycle.
  • Brings a strong perspective on enterprise AI adoption, governance, and architecture.

Additional Info

 

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

What we’ll offer you 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Why we’re different 

At Capgemini, we help organisations across the world become more agile, more competitive, and more successful. Smart, tailored, often ground-breaking technical solutions to complex problems are the norm. But so, too, is a culture that’s as collaborative as it is forward thinking. Working closely with each other, and with our clients, we get under the skin of businesses and to the heart of their goals. You will too.
 
Capgemini is proud to represent nearly 130 nationalities and its cultural diversity. Our holistic definition of diversity extends beyond gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, race, age, and religion. Capgemini views diversity as everything that makes us who we are as an organization, including our social background, our experiences in life and work, our communication styles and even our personality. These dimensions contribute to the type of diversity we value the most: diversity of thought.

data.description:
Who You'll Be Working With

 

As a Data Solution Architect at Capgemini, you will design and lead the delivery of modern data platforms that enable analytics, AI, GenAI, and data driven decision making at scale. You will translate business strategy into robust, governed, and AI ready architectures, taking end to end ownership from vision through to delivery and value realisation.


You will be part of the Data Platforms team  that is part of the Insights and Data Global Practice that has seen strong growth and continued success across a variety of projects and sectors.  Data Platforms is the home of the Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, Solutions Architects and Business Analysts who are focused on driving our customers digital and data transformation journey using the modern cloud platforms. We specialise on using the latest frameworks, reference architectures and technologies using AWS and GCP along with various data platforms like Databricks and Snowflake

 

Please Note:  Security Clearance: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC)clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

The Focus Of Your Role

 

As a Solution Architect with a Databricks focus, you will be an integral part of our team dedicated to building scalable and secure data platforms. You will combine deep Databricks and Apache Spark expertise with strong client engagement skills to shape solutions from early-stage opportunity through delivery. You will lead our Databricks partnership activity, helping develop joint propositions, enablement, and go-to-market plans, and you will support pre-sales by contributing to discovery, solution design, estimates, and compelling client-facing materials.

 

  • Design and build high-performance data platforms: Utilize Databricks and Apache Spark to extract, transform, and load data across cloud and on-premises sources and targets.
  • Design and oversee the delivery of secure data warehouses and data lakehouses: Implement data models, data quality checks, and governance practices to ensure reliable and accurate data.
  • Ability to design, build and deploy AI/ML models: Integrate Machine Learning into data pipelines and leverage Databricks capabilities to develop predictive models and drive business insights.
  • Design, Monitor and optimize data pipelines and infrastructure: Analyze performance metrics, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimizations for efficiency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Work closely with business analysts, data scientists, and DevOps engineers to ensure successful data platform implementations.
  • Stay ahead of the curve: Continuously learn and adapt to the evolving landscape of big data technologies and best practices.
  • Lead the Databricks partnership: Own the day-to-day relationship, coordinate joint account planning, support enablement and certifications, and contribute to joint propositions and go-to-market activity.
  • Support pre-sales activity: Lead/assist discovery workshops, define solution options and reference architectures, contribute to estimates and delivery approaches, and help produce high-quality proposals and presentations.
  • Be a Databricks champion or on the pathway to become one

 

What You'll Bring

 

You will bring deep experience delivering data platforms and data architecture within complex public sector environments, with a strong understanding of government operating models, regulatory obligations, and the need for trusted, mission critical data. You will have a proven ability to design secure, scalable, and well governed data foundations that support analytics, AI, and GenAI while meeting requirements for data protection, sovereignty, transparency, and auditability. You will be comfortable working with senior stakeholders to translate outcomes into pragmatic data and AI architectures, balancing innovation with risk management. You will bring strong leadership and collaboration skills, enabling multi supplier delivery teams to align around shared standards, reuse platforms effectively, and build sustainable data capabilities that deliver long term value for citizens and public services.


Experience:

  • Minimum 7+ years of experience as a Data Architect with experience in designing, developing and implementing Databricks solutions 
  • Proven expertise in Databricks, Apache Spark, and data platforms with a strong understanding of data warehousing concepts and practices.
  • Experience designing and delivering data platforms on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure and/or GCP preferred).
  • Experience working in pre-sales roles, including shaping opportunities, producing estimates, and contributing to proposals and client presentations.
  • Experience leading or contributing to vendor alliances/partnerships (ideally Databricks), including joint proposition development and go-to-market activity.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills and strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Passion for data and a thirst for learning and is either already a Databricks champion or working towards it
  • Relevant architecture certifications from Databricks and/or cloud providers.

 

Additional Information

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

What we’ll offer you 

 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Why we’re different 

 

At Capgemini, we help organisations across the world become more agile, more competitive, and more successful. Smart, tailored, often ground-breaking technical solutions to complex problems are the norm. But so, too, is a culture that’s as collaborative as it is forward thinking. Working closely with each other, and with our clients, we get under the skin of businesses and to the heart of their goals. You will too.
 
Capgemini is proud to represent nearly 130 nationalities and its cultural diversity. Our holistic definition of diversity extends beyond gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, race, age, and religion. Capgemini views diversity as everything that makes us who we are as an organization, including our social background, our experiences in life and work, our communication styles and even our personality. These dimensions contribute to the type of diversity we value the most: diversity of thought.

data.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

AS A SENIOR SERVICE DESIGNER YOU WILL

  • Lead workstreams through the end-to-end service design process to design and develop innovative products and services from ideation through to solution build and testing for our public sector clients.
  • Define and structure service design approaches, methods and outputs tailored to your client’s needs based on their design maturity and project specific needs
  • Develop and oversee the delivery of high-quality service design artefacts ensuring consistency and impact
  • Apply deep expertise in GDS standards, accessibility and inclusive design in order to successfully pass service assessments
  • Facilitate and lead workshops and co-design sessions as necessary
  • Communicate complex ideas using storytelling and visualization
  • Possess strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to balance competing views as part of the design process and advocate for user-centred design
  • Manage priorities, risks, dependencies and delivery
  • Support the service design capability and the mentoring of junior colleagues, delegating when necessary
  • Shape service design tools, methods and propositions within AI & Digital Factory by staying in tune with trends and demands in the market
  • Hold active SC (Security Check) Clearance.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience designing services and products.
  • Proven experience leading a service design workstream with multiple clients or projects, autonomously with minimal support
  • Deep expertise working with Government Digital Service (GDS) service standards, applying GDS design principles with public sector clients and passing service assessments or similar
  • Proven experience not only creating service design artefacts and outputs, but defining the best approach, methods and appropriate artefacts for your client based on their maturity and parameters
  • Experience facilitating workshops, ideation sessions and related activities to progress through design sprints
  • Experience breaking down complex problems in a fast-paced environment, with a knack for storytelling to diverse stakeholders
  • Strong understanding and experience of working in an agile (scrum) environment in a cross-functional team including but not limited to user researchers, UX/UI designers, business analysts, product owners, delivery managers and developers
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a tight timeframe with a proactive mindset  
  • Experience working directly with other teams such as legal or policy and facilitating conversations to progress design and service decisions that meet the needs of all stakeholders
  • Comfortability picking up responsibilities where there is a gap across UCD disciplines or project management when necessary
  • You will be expected to show examples of work, this does not need to be a formal portfolio or comprehensive story but rather speak to your diverse experience through visual artefacts so that we may understand your process and the type of artefacts you typically output.
  • Hold active SC (Security Check) Clearance

YOUR ROLE

As a Senior Service Designer, you will be expected to lead the design and delivery of service design workstreams on our public sector client projects, taking ownership of the approach, outputs and outcomes. You will work independently within multidisciplinary teams, shaping services end-to-end and ensuring the delivery of high-quality, user-centred solutions.

You will be joining the growing and exciting AI & Digital Factory community who are continually sharing knowledge and expertise. As a Senior Service Designer, you will also contribute to business development and the growth of the service design capability. You will be part of a collaborative and high-performing community passionate about user-centred design and transformation. You will bring strong service design expertise and experience leading workstreams independently within complex environments.
As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

We are delighted to have received the“Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years. To see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page. Capgemini Invent offers Consultants a culture of learning, ownership, and focus on value.

 

  • You’ll gain exposure to high-profile transformations and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies.
  • Our consultants are formally trained by industry experts in consulting and client delivery. Consultants have access to a vast array for different training and certifications in a variety of areas: cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), programming (Java, Kotlin, NodeJS, Spring Boot), DevOps (Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker), Cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM) and Agile delivery (Scrum Master, Product Owner, Scaled Agile Framework). Capgemini Invent offers you the flexibility to develop various areas of knowledge in technical domains aligned both to your interests and our client’s outcomes.
  • Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities that will help us and our clients to succeed.
  • We hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
  • There are monthly team drinks, and it’s a chance to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. The monthly team breakfasts give you a different, more relaxed setting to meet up in the office to hear from the leadership, meet colleagues and discuss the trends and insights within the market. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 

Please opt in during the application process.

CSR:

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 

 

Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend strategic, creative and scientific capabilities to help clients solve complex business challenges and unlock measurable value. Join us to shape and deliver bold transformation programmes informed by data, amplified by creativity and design, and enabled by technology with purpose. 

Your role

Prerequisite: 8–12 years’ management consulting experience with a proven track record in large-scale supply chain and operating model transformation.


Sales Target: Approximately £2m annual management consulting sales.


We are seeking a commercially credible, client-facing Director to drive growth and delivery of Supply Chain GBS (Global Business Services) transformation engagements within our Intelligent Industry practice. Working across sectors including Consumer Products, Life Sciences and Automotive, you will lead strategy, operating model design and complex transformation programmes that help clients unlock value through process standardisation, shared services, automation, analytics and AI-enabled operations.


Key Responsibilities

 

Business Development & Sales

  • Develop and grow the Supply Chain GBS consulting proposition.
  • Originate, qualify and convert consulting opportunities across UK and global organisations.
  • Build trusted C-suite relationships and drive repeat business.
  • Lead proposals, RFP/RFI responses and commercial negotiations to achieve annual sales targets.

 

Programme Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end supply chain and GBS transformation programmes.
  • Deliver diagnostics, business cases, target operating models, transition plans and transformation roadmaps.
  • Advise clients on planning, customer service, logistics, inventory, master data and performance management.
  • Ensure high-quality, value-led delivery with strong executive stakeholder engagement.

 

Practice & People Leadership

  • Collaborate across consulting, digital, engineering and BPO teams to deliver client outcomes.
  • Coach and develop consulting teams, fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Contribute to thought leadership, proposition development, recruitment and practice growth.
  • Support capability building through training, certifications and knowledge sharing.

 

Candidate Profile

  • Strong consulting leadership experience in Supply Chain, Shared Services or GBS transformation.
  • Proven ability to sell, shape and deliver complex consulting engagements.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with expertise in operating model design, process harmonisation and digital transformation.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, commercial acumen and executive communication skills.

Your skills and experience

  • 8–12+ years’ management consulting experience, with a strong track record leading large-scale Supply Chain, GBS and operating model transformation programmes.
  • Proven business development success, generating c.£2m annual consulting revenue through client relationships, market presence and network development.
  • Deep expertise in Supply Chain GBS, shared services and target operating model design, including governance, service transition, KPIs/SLAs and continuous improvement.
  • Strong end-to-end supply chain knowledge across planning, customer operations, logistics, inventory, master data and performance management, with experience driving standardisation and digital enablement.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence C-suite stakeholders, shape strategic transformation agendas and lead complex consulting engagements from sales through delivery.
  • Proven people leader with experience building high-performing teams, developing consulting capabilities and driving change across global, matrixed organisations.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service) Some roles will also require an additional level of security clearance; BPSS OR Security Clearance OR Developed Vetting.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

As a globally renowned technology and digital leader, we have the responsibility, ambition and capability to contribute to solving major societal questions shaping our future world. Invent for Society reflects our belief that social impact should be embedded in what we do. 

 

Our work spans multiple sectors and combines strategic depth with practical delivery. From global operating model redesign to large-scale transformation programmes, you will have the opportunity to shape critical business change for some of the world’s leading organisations. 

Why you should consider Capgemini

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively work to make it a reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring your whole self to work. 

 

We aim to support a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements a day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. To help support wellbeing we have trained Mental Health Champions across each of our business areas and have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 

 

CSR: 

We are focused on using technology to create positive social impact. We are working to reduce our carbon footprint and improve access to a more inclusive digital world. 

 

Whilst you will have London or Manchester as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice. 

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefit options for you to select to suit your personal circumstances. The package includes a variable element dependent upon grade and on both company and personal performance.

.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

 

Your role:

As a result of our significant growth in Healthcare, we are seeking experienced Managing Consultants and Senior Consultants at Capgemini Invent. We want you to bring your significant sector expertise to support our ambition to be the Healthcare Consultancy partner of choice. We are passionate about helping our clients to deliver sustainable, innovative change that makes a meaningful difference to citizens across the nation.

We will need you to work with our Vice President, Directors and Senior Managers to manage and deliver complex workstreams for our clients, contribute to business development activities, actively contribute to internal initiatives and develop yourself and the team from a skills, experience, and capability perspective. Our Healthcare business is fast growing. This translates to abundant opportunities to shape the subsector positively for the future; a challenge we want our Senior Consultants and Managing Consultants to actively contribute to.  While working in a supportive team environment, you will have the confidence and experience to drive success for our clients. 

In this role you will play a key role in:

  • Helping our clients realise their strategic transformation agenda through leading insight and exceptional delivery. You’ll be up to date on Public Sector trends and issues and with clinical and/or operational subject matter expertise in Healthcare.
  • Developing deep, trust-based relationships with clients in a sell-deliver model.
  • Bringing the power of the global Capgemini organisation to drive improved account delivery and client success.
  • Supporting the leadership team in the Public Sector to build the team that will continue to deliver excellence for our clients. This means engaging, developing and supporting a diverse team, and role-modelling your passionate focus on delivering the best outcomes for every client.
  • Supporting Capgemini Invent’s market offerings by contributing to innovative propositions that reflect our position as a leading public sector management consultancy.

As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

  • Business development – Contributing to proposals, RFIs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, team events and activities), and proposition development.
  • Learning and development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

 

Your profile:

  • A passion for Healthcare in the Public, Private and VCSE Sectors and a keen interest in making a positive difference for society.
  • Direct NHS consultancy and digital transformation experience at a mid to senior level, including complex delivery (operational and/or clinical) and team management.
  • A background from a management consulting practice or equivalent experience.
  • Experience of delivering large scale, complex programme management and transformation initiatives in the Public Sector.
  • Currently working in a major Consulting firm, and/or in industry but having a consulting background.
  • Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions.
  • Experience of proposition building and delivery

 

What you'll love about working here:

You’ll thrive in a collaborative and diverse environment that empowers you to innovate, grow your skills, and make a real impact—whether you’re shaping solutions for clients or driving positive change in society. You will be supported by a culture that values inclusion, continuous learning, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to work every day.

 

Need to know:

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
 

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

CSR:

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

 

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 

Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

  • Support our clients through the end-to-end service design process to design and develop innovative products and services from ideation and inception through to solution build and testing.
  • Create service design artefacts including user journeys, personas, service blueprints, mapping and proof of concepts
  • Apply GDS standards and service design principles across both public and private sector clients
  • Identify and address accessibility and inclusion considerations in the development of services
  • Work effectively within agile, cross-functional teams while owning delivery service design artefacts and collaborating with other UCD disciplines
  • Communicate insights and design outputs clearly with strong visuals
  • Support facilitation of workshops, ideation sessions or similar
  • Identify risks and escalate appropriately within your team
  • Advocate for user-centred design within teams and to wider stakeholders
  • Ability to adopt a curious and inquisitive mindset – with a passion for asking ‘why’

YOUR EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience designing services and products.
  • Proven experience working across a service design process, autonomously with minimal support
  • Experience working with Government Digital Service (GDS) service standards, applying GDS design principles or working to similar design standards
  • Ability to create service design artefacts and outputs, such as current and future-state user journeys, personas, service concepts, service blueprints and other artefacts
  • Ability to identify potential accessibility barriers for complex user groups
  • Experience facilitating workshops, design sprints, ideation sessions or similar
  • Ability to visualize complex services in an easy-to-understand format for varying audiences
  • Experience breaking down complex problems in a fast-paced environment, with a knack for storytelling
  • Experience of working in an agile (scrum) environment in a cross-functional team including but not limited to user researchers, UX/UI designers, business analysts, product owners, delivery managers and developers
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a tight timeframe with a proactive mindset  
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to balance competing views as part of the design process
  • Aptitude for being an advocate for user-centricity, with the ability to develop and translate user stories and propose design approaches or services to meet these needs and engage in meaningful interactions and relationships with users  
  • You will be expected to show examples of work, this does not need to be a formal portfolio or comprehensive story but rather speak to your diverse experience through visual artefacts so that we may understand your process and the type of artefacts you typically output.
  • Be eligible for SC clearance (by being a UK resident for at least 5 years and not having left the country for more than 28 consecutive days during this period)

  • You’ll gain exposure to high-profile transformations and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies.

  • There are monthly team drinks, and it’s a chance to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.
