data.description:
Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Your Role

This is a high-impact role within the Cloud Advisory capability unit, contributing to our leadership in Service Management, AI-enabled Operations and Cloud Transformation across clients in a variety of industry sectors.

 

As a Consultant in Service Management Transformation, you will support clients in modernising their service management capabilities, operational practices and technology environments through the adoption of cloud technologies, AI, automation and modern service management principles. Working as part of multidisciplinary teams, you will contribute to assessments, transformation programmes and service improvement initiatives that enhance business outcomes, user experience and operational resilience. 

 

  •  Service Management Transformation – Support the design and delivery of service management transformation initiatives, including operating model improvements, process optimisation, governance enhancements and ITSM capability development.
  • Service Assessments & Analysis – Contribute to service management, operational maturity, tooling and organisational assessments by gathering data, analysing findings and supporting the development of recommendations, improvement plans and transformation roadmaps.
  • AI in Service Management – Support clients in understanding and adopting AI-enabled capabilities across service management, including intelligent automation, virtual agents, knowledge management, workflow optimisation and service analytics.
  • AIOps & Intelligent Operations – Develop an understanding of modern operational practices including observability, monitoring, intelligent alerting, event management and AIOps capabilities, supporting clients in improving operational performance through automation and data-driven insights.
  • Cloud & Digital Operations – Support the design and evolution of service management approaches that enable cloud adoption, operational resilience and digital transformation outcomes.
  • Transformation Delivery – Work collaboratively with clients and Capgemini teams to deliver transformation activities, workshops, process improvements and organisational change initiatives.
  • Performance & Continual Improvement – Help analyse service performance data and identify opportunities for continual improvement across service management and operational practices.

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
  • Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your Profile

You'll bring experience in service management and technology-enabled transformation, with an understanding of modern operating models, cloud services, AI-enabled capabilities and digital operations.

You will be able to analyse client challenges, contribute to service and operational assessments, identify improvement opportunities and support the delivery of transformation initiatives that improve business outcomes, operational resilience and service performance.


You will bring proven skills and experience in several of the following areas:

 

  • Practical experience applying ITIL 4 service management principles and practices, including Incident Management, Change Enablement, Problem Management, Service Request Management and Continual Improvement.
  • Understanding of emerging service management trends, including ITIL Version 5, Digital Product and Service Management, AI-enabled operations, experience-led service delivery and value-driven service management.
  • ITIL 4 Foundation or ITIL Version 5 certification is desirable.
  • Experience supporting service management transformation, service improvement or operational change initiatives.
  • Knowledge of how AI and automation can be applied within service management to improve operational efficiency, employee experience and service outcomes.
  • Awareness of modern AIOps and observability capabilities, including monitoring, event correlation, anomaly detection, intelligent alerting, operational analytics and automation.
  • Familiarity with enterprise service management platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, Freshworks or similar technologies.
  • Experience contributing to service assessments, current-state reviews, maturity assessments or tooling evaluations, including analysing findings and supporting recommendations.
  • Understanding of cloud technologies and operating models across Microsoft Azure, AWS or Google Cloud environments.
  • Cloud and AI Foundation Certification desirable, such as Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), Microsoft AI Fundamentals (AI-900), AWS Cloud Practitioner, Google Cloud Digital, equivalent AI credentials.
  • Knowledge of DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and modern operational practices would be beneficial.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to gather information, analyse data and contribute to practical recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience working within a consulting organisation, technology organisation, operations function or service management environment would be beneficial.

What You'll Love About Working Here?

  • Client engagements give you the opportunity to work with our leadership and experienced consulting management, where you can learn from them, challenge them, and accelerate your hands-on experience, delivery capability and industry insights.
  • You’ll learn how we write compelling client propositions, structure, and lead high-profile transformation, and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies, often taking an idea from a concept to a vision, to strategy and then execution.
  • Our consultants are formally trained from industry experts on management consulting and client delivery.
  • We provide a host of opportunities for learning and certification through internal and partner led programmes from AWS, Google and Microsoft.
  • Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities which will help us and our clients to succeed.
  • We hold monthly showcases of our initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
  • There are many opportunities like monthly team drinks to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. There are regular leadership connect sessions that will give you a different, more relaxed setting to meet up in the office to hear from the leadership, meet colleagues and discuss the trends and insights within the market. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.  

Need to Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively make it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.


Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

 

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

data.description:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

As the digital innovation, design and transformation brand of the Capgemini Group, Capgemini Invent enables CxOs to envision and shape the future of their businesses. Located in more than 36 offices and 37 creative studios around the world, it comprises a 10,000+ strong team of strategists, data scientists, product and experience designers, brand experts and technologists who develop new digital services, products, experiences and business models for sustainable growth.


Business Technology is Capgemini Invent’s technology consulting and transformation advisory practice. Within Business Technology, our AI & Digital Acceleration team focuses on helping our clients deliver technology transformation programmes for business value and optimise the effectiveness and impact of their IT capability.  
We are looking to hire a Managing Consultant into AI & Digital Acceleration to help sell and deliver ServiceNow-enabled risk, cyber and resilience transformation programmes and grow the Business Technology portfolio within our clients.


As a Managing Consultant – Risk, Cyber & Resilience Transformation, you will help clients build secure, compliant and resilient enterprises by transforming risk management, security operations and governance processes using ServiceNow. You will act as a techno-functional SME across ServiceNow Security and Risk capabilities, helping organisations strengthen resilience while navigating evolving regulatory and AI governance requirements.

 

Key expectations from this role include:

 

Client Delivery & Advisory

  • Define risk, cyber and resilience transformation strategies leveraging ServiceNow
  • Advise senior stakeholders on: 
    • Risk operating models
    • Cyber resilience
    • Regulatory compliance
    • AI governance and responsible AI
    • Translate business requirements into integrated risk and security solutions

Risk & Compliance Transformation

  • Support implementation of:
    • Integrated Risk Management (IRM)
    • Controls, compliance and audit processes
    • Enterprise risk management frameworks
    • Align solutions to industry and regulatory standards

 

Security Operations Transformation

  • Support implementation of: 
    • Vulnerability management
    • Incident response
    • Security operations workflows
    • Enable integration with broader security ecosystems

 

AI Governance & Operational Resilience

  • Support definition of: 
    • Responsible AI frameworks
    • AI governance models
    • AI Control Tower-aligned operating approaches
  • Enable resilience, business continuity and crisis management capabilities

 

Business Development & Practice Contribution

  • Contribute to proposals, RFPs and client pitches focused on risk and cyber transformation
  • Support development of ServiceNow IRM and SecOps offerings
  • Participate in thought leadership and market-facing initiatives

YOUR PROFILE

Core Experience

    • Proven experience in risk, compliance, cyber security or resilience transformation consulting
    • Experience delivering governance, risk or security transformation programmes
    • Strong understanding of enterprise risk and regulatory environments       

 

Technical & Functional Capabilities

    • Experience in 2 or more of the following areas:
      • ServiceNow IRM
      • ServiceNow SecOps
      • Cyber security transformation
      • Risk and compliance management
      • Operational resilience
      • AI governance and responsible AI
    • Understanding of:
      • Regulatory frameworks (DORA, NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR)
      • Security operations processes
      • Risk management operating models

 

Consulting & Leadership Skills

    • Strong stakeholder management skills, including engagement with CISO, CRO and Compliance leadership
    • Ability to translate risk and security concepts into business outcomes
    • Experience contributing to proposals and sales activities
    • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work across business and technology teams

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

Business Technology (BT) is the largest and fastest growing practice at Capgemini Invent. We are a trusted technology consulting & transformation business partner to our clients' Chief Digital Information Officers (CDIOs) and the global Capgemini Group. We combine emotional intelligence, human-centric design, and technology expertise to digitally transform our clients’ web and workplace experiences. We are successful in achieving this through our end-to-end portfolio of digital transformation service offers – Strategy, Design, Delivery, Architecture, Security and Change Management.
 
 
We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page.

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 
We are a Disability Confident Employer Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
 
· Declare they have a disability, and
· Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
 
Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
 
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.
 

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

data.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Your role:

Our clients in defence and aerospace are facing unprecedented change, facing into a world of uncertainty and increasing risk. Within Europe alone we are witnessing a significant rearmament phase, driven by geopolitical shifts and increasing investments across the defence landscape.   

 

We are seeking talented consulting professionals to join our growing defence and aerospace team within Capgemini Invent. As a key member of our team you will work with colleagues and partners to build and deliver solutions for our clients that enable them to increase their defence outputs, drive efficiency and utilise the latest enabling digital technologies.   

 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to both client and personal growth by engaging in activities including:  

  • Developing new client solutions by working across Capgemini to bring together a unique combination of tech enabled, people centred and output centric solutions. 
  • Building a unique outcome based commercial approach that enables Capgemini to deliver major programmes linked to the business outcomes achieved. 
  • Working with colleagues across Capgemini to generate new business in a partner centric way. Including building consortiums and partnering with other complimentary organisations to bid for major global defence programmes. 
  • Operating as a delivery lead on major defence programmes, including building business cases, designing transformation programmes and rolling up your sleeves to see changes through to front-line implementation. 
  • Developing both yourself, your team and your clients to continually improve and push the boundaries of what is possible. Humility is a key value within Capgemini, we see this as a fantastic foundation for self-learning and development.  

Your profile:

We are seeking consultants with the following experiences:

  • Proven background in a management consulting environment where you have delivered major parts of complex transformation programmes for Aerospace and Defence major clients 
  • Proven background in supporting the creation of new business from business relationships
  • AI curiosity and ideally experience in creation of AI augmented propositions  
  • Experience managing client relationships, fostering trust and building credibility across your domain of expertise.  
  • Knowledge of defence programmes and experience solving complex problems across the enterprise, covering both the public and private sector players. 
  • Experience of forming industry and defence relationships at a variety levels.
  • Passion for solving your clients most pressing challenges, achieving tangible outcomes through a mix of technical expertise and strong people skills. 
  • Knowledge of constructing commercial models where incentives align across clients and their advisors to jointly deliver meaningful defence outcomes. 
  • Importantly an ability to lead our people, demonstrating both the integrity and humility needed to engage a diverse group of talent, bringing out the best performance for our clients.  

What you'll love about working here?

Glassdoor Recognition
We are delighted to be in the top 10 for the ‘Glassdoor Best Places to Work UK 2025’. Having received this accolade for four consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page.

Flexibility to Work Your Way
You will have the freedom to structure your day in the way that works best for you. We prioritise our output more than the number of hours we work – which is why one of our key values is ‘Freedom’. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed flexible working in all that we do, and all UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Your Wellbeing
You’d be joining an organisation that puts your wellbeing at the top of its priorities, with a range of health & wellbeing communities and regular listening surveys. We have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. You will have the freedom to express your ideas to colleagues who are attentive to your viewpoints – which is what makes us an innovative workplace, and why another of our key values is ‘Boldness’.

Regular Promotion Cycles
We truly believe in the importance of recognising people for their great work, which is why we have regular promotion cycles to reward and compensate our people.

Need to know:

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

CSR:

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 
Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

As a Solution Manager, you will be responsible for designing and articulating comprehensive solutions that deliver business outcomes and value to our clients. Solutions that exceed client expectations and needs while optimising for cost-effectiveness and competitiveness. You will leverage your expertise in storytelling, presentation, and business communication to create compelling proposals. Your role will involve leading cross-functional teams, managing stakeholders, and ensuring the deliverability of solutions from conception to implementation.


Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

  • Solution Incubation: You will work to collaboratively shape and incubate new opportunities with clients as well as respond to client requests through RFIs, RFPs and similar procurement frameworks.
  • Client-Centric Vision: Clearly articulate a client-centric vision using storytelling and advanced presentation skills.
  • Business Communication: Demonstrate concise and business-focused written communication and general writing skills.
  • Competitive Analysis: Understand competitive pressures on price and identify cost levers to deliver the most cost-effective and competitive solutions.
  • Solution Optimization: Maximize scoring and mitigate competitive advantage by optimizing the solution and response.
  • Internal Priorities: Understand and address internal priorities and governance.
  • Requirements Analysis: Undertake requirements analysis and translation to understand service components, standard service offerings, and potential gaps.
  • Leadership: Lead teams collaboratively to achieve shared outcomes and execute external and internal stakeholder management and communication.
  • Commercial Understanding: Possess detailed commercial understanding, including risks, terms and conditions (T&Cs) and service schedules, as well as contractual drafting.
  • Financial Analysis: Conduct detailed price and cost analysis, including internal business case creation.
  • Coaching and mentoring: Undertake coaching, mentoring and people management of colleagues to develop skills and capabilities.
  • Break boundaries: Whilst demonstrating mastery of the cloud and infrastructure portfolio, you will possess a broad understanding of the wider functions and technologies to deliver holistic solutions to our clients. 


You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Solution Leadership: Ability to lead a solution across different business units, including internal stakeholder management.
  • Solution Deliverability: Work with internal delivery teams to design and articulate solutions that are deliverable once signed.
  • Creativity: Think creatively to craft solutions that meet customer requirements and differentiate from competitors.
  • Portfolio Awareness: Apply the company’s portfolio to solutions, making it real and demonstrating our capability to deliver.
  • Emerging Technologies: Stay aware of the latest developments in emerging technology, automation, and AI, and bring insights and future benefits to new solutions.
  • Environmental Impact: Consider the environmental impact and sustainability of proposals.
  • Solution Pricing Strategy: Drive the solution pricing to a winning position, understanding cost levers and how to use them.
  • Client Business Case: Create and communicate client business cases and benefits realization, including financial analytics and modelling.
  • External Stakeholder Management: Manage external stakeholders and develop client intimacy through site visits, industry days, and client presentations.
  • Contract Management: Drive contract closure and transition from sales to delivery, including early life support and hyper-care phases.
  • Proven Experience: Demonstrated experience in solution architecture or a related role.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Leadership Abilities: Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage stakeholders.
  • Commercial Acumen: Strong understanding of commercial terms, conditions, and service schedules.
  • Analytical Skills: Proficiency in price and cost analysis, financial modelling, and business case creation.
  • Creative Thinking: Ability to think creatively and innovate solutions.
  • Technical Knowledge: Awareness of emerging technologies, automation, and AI

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2023. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Your Role

As part of Capgemini Invent's Intelligent Industry practice, our Digital Engineering team is seeking an experienced PLM Managing Consultant to support clients on complex transformation programmes.


Intelligent Industry focuses on creating powerful synergies between the digital and engineering worlds, helping organisations design, build, and operate intelligent products, services, and operations at scale. We work with clients to drive innovation, accelerate transformation, and unlock new value through technology, engineering, and data-driven solutions.

 

Summary introduction of the role 

 

  • You will work on high profile, impactful programmes, helping clients define, design and deliver Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) capabilities that improve speed to market, product quality, regulatory compliance and cost performance.
  • Our consultants bring strong PLM business consulting skills (process, data, governance, operating model and change) alongside a clear perspective on how digital continuity across engineering, manufacturing and service unlocks measurable value.
  • We work collaboratively with stakeholders at all levels to shape the PLM vision, target operating model and roadmap, and to translate business outcomes into requirements for people, process and technology.
  • You will help clients improve core lifecycle processes such as requirements and configuration management, product data management, BOM and variant management, change control (ECR/ECO), product costing and product compliance.
  • You will support selection, implementation and adoption of leading PLM and adjacent platforms, working with solution architects and delivery teams to ensure designs meet business needs and are fit for scale.
  • You  will be familiar with the use of Agentic AI for digital continuity. 
  • We move from ‘idea to action’ quickly, building stakeholder alignment and confidence through pragmatic delivery, value tracking and strong change management to sustain outcomes.

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities),  offering development.
  • Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your Profile

We’re growing our team and looking for a range of skills and experiences. We’d like to hear from you if you have held prominent roles within Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Data Management (PDM), configuration management or digital engineering domain, or have applied these in a consultancy role.
 
We are looking for entrepreneurial individuals with the knowledge and creativity to deliver truly inventive solutions to our clients.
  
Depending on the stage you are at in your career, we’re looking for appropriate levels of knowledge and/or experience in PLM and digital continuity, including one or more of the following areas:

  • Experience of working in a consultancy environment and/or delivering internal business improvement initiatives, with strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Solid understanding of end-to-end product lifecycle processes and how PLM enables digital continuity across engineering, manufacturing, quality and service.
  • Experience defining target operating models, governance, roles and responsibilities for PLM (e.g., data ownership, design authority, change control and configuration governance)
  • Practical experience improving core PLM business capabilities such as requirements and configuration management, EBOM/MBOM alignment, variant management, ECR/ECO, and product compliance.
  • Strong data and information management skills (product structures, classification, metadata, master data, data quality) and familiarity with integration patterns (PLM–ERP–MES–ALM).
  • Experience supporting PLM selection, implementation and adoption, including requirements definition, fit-gap, vendor evaluation, UAT support and benefits/value tracking.
  • Working knowledge of one or more PLM platforms such as Siemens Teamcenter, PTC Windchill, Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE/ENOVIA, SAP PLM, Aras Innovator, or Autodesk Fusion Manage.
  • Understanding of adjacent domains and methods such as MBSE, ALM, digital thread/digital twin, systems engineering, and model-based product definition.
  • Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organization, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions.
  • Experience contributing to propositions, thought leadership and business development activities (e.g., proposals, RFPs, client pitches, and asset development).

What You'll Love About Working Here

As part of the Digital Engineering team in Invent you will work on high profile, impactful projects with industry leading organisations, helping them transform how they conceive, develop, industrialise and support products across the end-to-end lifecycle.

 


You will use your knowledge and experience to help our clients exploit digital technologies to transform the way they operate and to integrate their manufacturing operations within their organisation’s value chain. 
The work is varied and you will have the opportunity to work on a variety of client facing projects across multiple industry sectors. Projects may touch on various aspects of managing products throughout their lifecycle including product design and development, product manufacture and through life support and maintenance. 

 


You will use your business and technical knowledge, together with your strong understanding of Industry 4.0 and 5.0 concepts, to help clients develop the justifications for change, identify the opportunities for value realisation as well as defining the elements that need to put in place to realise their ambitions. This would typically include transformation roadmaps, business cases, operating model design and solution architectures.

Need to Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

 

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

 

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester, Newcastle or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

About the job you’re considering

Capgemini’s Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is a dynamic part of our global cybersecurity consulting practice. With over 200 successful digital identity engagements in the past five years, we’re proud to be recognized as one of the world’s leading IAM strategic consulting, advisory, and delivery providers.

We take a business-first approach to digital identity and welcome professionals with a range of experiences - whether your strengths lie in business consulting, technology consulting, or a blend of both. Our diverse team works collaboratively to ensure IAM solutions are effective, inclusive, and tailored to our clients’ needs.

We cover all aspects of digital identity, including:

  • Access Management
  • Identity Governance and Administration
  • Privileged Access Management

Our consulting is backed by world-class technology delivery and service operations from our global team. We remain proudly independent and invest heavily in training to ensure our consultants offer trusted, unbiased advice across established and emerging technologies. Joining Capgemini’s IAM team means working at the forefront of digital identity innovation.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

 

Your role

We work in all aspects of Identity and Access Management (IAM), including strategy, design and solution delivery for Enterprise, Customer and Privileged IAM.

Everyone in our IAM team contributes in one or more of the following areas:

  • Understanding and defining IAM business requirements
  • Designing and implementing IAM solutions, including technology and process improvements
  • Advising clients on IAM strategy and transformation
  • Contributing to or leading successful IAM projects


You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

We value a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. You may have practical experience in areas such as:

  • IAM consultancy and advisory work, helping organizations improve digital identity practices
  • Developing IAM Target Operating Models and effective processes
  • Designing IAM solutions and architecture
  • Delivering IAM solutions using technologies like Microsoft Azure, Ping Identity, Okta, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, BeyondTrust — or other modern IAM tools
  • For delivery and architecture roles, we are particularly interested in candidates who hold hands-on practitioner or architect-level certifications in relevant IAM technologies. These certifications help demonstrate your depth of expertise and commitment to excellence in the field.

We understand IAM is a broad field, and we welcome candidates with transferable skills, whether your experience is more technical, business-focused, or based on less common IAM products.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. 
  • To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.
  • You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

 

Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

 
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you're considering

Capgemini is strengthening its SAP architecture capability to support major transformation programmes across the UK Public Sector. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in shaping and delivering enterprise-scale SAP solutions that underpin critical government services and national programmes. 

We are looking for SAP Solution Architects with deep SAP platform expertise and strong delivery leadership experience. You will operate across the full solution lifecycle - from early shaping and design, through build and deployment, to live service - ensuring that solutions are robust, secure and aligned to both client outcomes and SAP best practice. 

Our SAP architects act as trusted technical leaders, working closely with clients, delivery teams and partners to design solutions that balance functional fit, technical integrity and long-term sustainability. You will help clients modernise complex ERP landscapes, including SAP S/4HANA transformations, integrations with wider enterprise ecosystems and adoption of modern SAP capabilities. 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: 
identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

As an SAP Solution Architect, you will take accountability for the end-to-end solution design and provide architectural leadership throughout delivery. 

Key responsibilities include: 

  • Supporting early lifecycle activities, including solution shaping, estimates and commercial proposals 
  • Producing end-to-end SAP solution architectures covering functional design, technical architecture, integration, data and security (for both brownfield and greenfield solutions) 
  • Leading the design of SAP-based solutions across S/4HANA, ECC and associated SAP platforms and services 
  • Advising clients on SAP best practices, deployment options and target architectures aligned to their business strategy  
  • Confidently presenting complex solutions and architectures, easily translating content for a broad stakeholder group  
  • Owning architecture decisions and ensuring adherence to agreed architecture governance, design standards and delivery controls 
  • Working closely with delivery managers, functional leads and technical teams to safely deliver solutions into live operation 
  • Managing dependencies across SAP modules, non-SAP systems and third-party products in complex enterprise landscapes 
  • Building strong, trusted-advisor relationships with client stakeholders through clarity, credibility and constructive challenge 
  • Engaging with SAP and other partners/vendors to ensure solutions remain aligned with customer strategy, product roadmaps and best practice  
  • Owning technical risk, issue management and resolution within your solution scope and beyond 
  • Actively contributing to Capgemini’s SAP and Architecture communities, sharing knowledge and developing practice capability 

Your skills and experience

Essential 

  • You will bring strong SAP architecture experience and credibility in front of senior stakeholders and the ability to lead delivery in complex, regulated environments. 
  • Able to achieve UK Government Security Check (SC) clearance. 
  • We are looking for demonstrable experience in: 
  • Designing and delivering SAP solutions at enterprise scale, ideally within Public Sector or similarly complex organisations 
  • SAP S/4HANA (PCE or On-Premise) architectures, including brownfield, greenfield, or hybrid transformation approaches 
  • Strong understanding of SAP functional domains (e.g. Finance, Contract Accounting, PSCD/Utilities), with the ability to design cross-functional solutions 
  • SAP technical architecture, including landscape design, security, identity management, data management, networks, environments, transport strategy and non-functional requirements 
  • Integration of SAP with wider enterprise ecosystems using SAP Integration Suite, APIs, middleware, or event-driven approaches 
  • Data considerations within SAP programmes, including migration, data quality and cutover planning 
  • Modern delivery approaches such as Agile, DevOps, CI/CD and structured test and release management 
  • Delivery across on‑premise, cloud and hybrid SAP environments including SAP RISE awareness/experience 
  • Leading and setting direction for multi-disciplinary delivery teams and managing technical deliverables 
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, particularly when explaining complex architectural decisions 
  • Confident decision-making, issue management and prioritisation aligned to delivery constraints and long-term client strategy 
  • Resilience and adaptability in fast-moving programmes with changing priorities 
  • Calm, measured and collaborative in high-intensity situations where critical problem-solving is required (e.g. P1 incidents) 
  • Strong commercial awareness including building proposals and delivering to both time-and-materials and fixed-price contracts 

 

Desirable 

  • The following experience would be advantageous: 
  • Experience working with SAP RISE, SAP BTP, or cloud-hosted SAP environments 
  • Exposure to SAP security and authorisation design, including role concepts and compliance considerations 
  • Experience contributing to large-scale SAP bids, proposals, or solution shaping activities 
  • Understanding of how extension or emerging capabilities (e.g. automation, analytics, or AI-enabled services) complement SAP solutions 
  • Experience operating within formal design authorities or governance boards 

 

Personal Attributes 

  • We are looking for architects who combine technical authority with strong interpersonal skills and a delivery mindset. 
  • You are likely to be: 
  • A confident technical leader who takes ownership and accountability for outcomes 
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions and influencing decisions with evidence, empathy and pragmatism 
  • Client-focused, with a strong desire to deliver solutions that genuinely improve outcomes 
  • Collaborative and inclusive, able to work effectively across functional, technical and commercial teams 
  • Calm under pressure, with the resilience to manage risk and complexity 
  • Curious and motivated to stay current with SAP’s evolving roadmap and delivery approaches 

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
Declare they have a disability, and 
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearence

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real - what does it mean for you?

We realise a Total Reward package should be more than just compensation. At Capgemini we offer range of core and flexible benefits and have a Peer Recognition Portal called Applaud. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. About the job you’re considering

We have an exciting opportunity for a SIAM Change and Software Asset Configuration Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for governing and coordinating the end-to-end change management process across a multi-supplier environment, while also ensuring the effective management of software assets and configuration data throughout the service lifecycle. You will ensure that changes are planned, assessed, approved, and implemented successfully, whilst maintaining accurate configuration information, optimising software asset utilisation, minimising risk to live services, and protecting service stability


As a key member of the Service Integration and Management (SIAM) function, you will collaborate with internal teams, suppliers, and client stakeholders to ensure that change, software asset, and configuration management activities are delivered in line with agreed governance, contractual obligations, and industry best practices. By taking a proactive approach to identifying risks, dependencies, licensing considerations, and service impacts, you will drive continual improvement, maintain the integrity of configuration management data, support successful change delivery, and help enhance the overall customer experience.


Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time. 


If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

  • Govern and coordinate the end-to-end Change Management and Service Asset & Configuration Management (SACM) processes across a multi-supplier SIAM environment, ensuring changes are implemented successfully and configuration information remains accurate, reliable, and controlled.
  • Ensure change risks, dependencies, conflicts, service impacts, Configuration Items (CIs), relationships, and service dependencies are identified, assessed, maintained, and managed to support effective decision-making and operational stability.
  • Collaborate with suppliers, client stakeholders, and internal teams to plan, communicate, govern, and deliver changes, while maintaining configuration baselines, data quality, and compliance with agreed standards and policies.
  • Chair and facilitate Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, configuration reviews, audits, and governance activities to ensure effective decision-making, stakeholder engagement, and adherence to Change and SACM controls.
  • Monitor, report on, and communicate the progress, outcomes, health, accuracy, and completeness of change and configuration management data, escalating issues that could impact service stability, change success, or operational performance.
  • Drive continual improvement of Change Management and SACM processes, tooling, governance, and CMDB quality to strengthen service visibility, improve risk and impact assessment, and enhance overall service performance across the SIAM ecosystem.

Your skills and experience

  • Proven experience in IT Service Management, Service Asset & Configuration Management (SACM) and Change Management, with Service Integration within a complex multi-supplier SIAM environment.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL best practices, particularly Service Asset & Configuration Management and Change Enablement, with ITIL Foundation certification essential and SIAM knowledge or certification desirable.
  • Experience of managing and maintaining CMDBs, configuration data, service assets, and CI relationships, ensuring data quality, governance, and alignment across multiple suppliers and service providers.
  • Strong understanding of service dependencies, configuration baselines, asset lifecycle management, and impact analysis, enabling effective support for change, incident, problem, and service continuity processes.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively with suppliers, technical teams, service owners, and business stakeholders at all levels.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and able to exercise sound judgement when assessing configuration risks, data integrity issues, service dependencies, and business impacts.
  • Experience using ServiceNow or similar IT Service Management tools to manage CMDBs, service asset records, configuration governance, reporting, audits, and service management activities.
  • Experience of driving continual service improvement initiatives, enhancing configuration management processes, CMDB accuracy, governance controls, and the overall effectiveness of service management within a SIAM model.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 
 
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 
 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
 

 

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.
 
 
If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
 
 
 
Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
 
 
 
 
Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
 
 
 
 
Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

Our Automation Assurance Specialists play a critical role in ensuring the reliability and quality of technical solutions delivered to our clients. Their work provides confidence that implementations meet expectations and adhere to specifications. Responsibilities include executing comprehensive testing across areas such as Accessibility, Performance, Security, and Functional validation.

 

We value continuous improvement, so the role requires strong experience in designing and maintaining clean, robust automation test suites and integrating them into a continuous integration pipeline.

 

They will be able to work on a vast variety of projects and get exposure to a variety of technologies such as (but not exhaustively) NodeJS, Java, Kotlin, Spring boot framework, RESTful microservices, NoSQL databases. Our Automation Assurance Specialists sit within Digital Excellence, part of the Business Technology practice at Capgemini Invent, which leads digital transformation projects across Capgemini. We are an enthusiastic and dynamic community that values innovation, professional development, and the ability to make a real difference for our clients. We work in diverse multi-disciplinary teams, hand-in-glove with our clients.

In this role you will play a key role in:

  • You’ll undertake cross-functional engineering projects, working in small teams with other engineers in different knowledge spheres, building supportable, sustainable, and reliable services
  • Be part of a community of engineers within Capgemini Invent. You will be able to work together as a community and help each other to deliver and develop as professionals. We work on large scale, technically challenging projects
  • Take personal responsibility for assuring confidence in the technical delivery – collaborating with other engineers and the design team.
  • Continually improve our teams’ processes, practices, tools, and techniques
  • Share your knowledge and experience with colleagues as you coach them and mentor them, helping the team to grow their skills, as well as developing your own skills by experimenting with and learning new technologies
  • Encourage innovation, inclusion, teamwork, self-organisation, and diversity
  • Work with clients and internal teams to develop new opportunities and open-source projects and initiatives

As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following:

  • Business Development – Contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
  • Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

To be a part of our team, you will have a mixture of the following experience:

Required:

  • Have a certified ISTQB background; ISTQB Foundation at a minimum. Equivalent qualifications or experience may be considered.
  • Experience with these core testing techniques: Exploratory, Integration, Manual, Functional
  • Experience setting up and contributing to test frameworks in Java or JavaScript
  • Experience writing a variety of backend and frontend automated tests using Selenium, Playwright, Cucumber, REST etc.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience using online version control tools - GitHub, GitLab etc.
  • Experience with self-managing and being able to self-identify areas that needs work

Desirable:

  • Experience with a wider range of testing techniques (Accessibility, Performance, Security etc.)
  • Experience with applying structured evaluation methods (AI evals) to validate outputs in real-world scenarios
  • Experience using Docker to aid testing
  • Experience using Maven to run your automated tests
  • Experience with CI/CD (Gitlab, GitHub, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with web standards, accessibility, and test automation best practices
  • Knowledge of the GOV.UK design system

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work in the UK’ accolade for 4 consecutive years. To see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page. Capgemini Invent offers Consultants a culture of learning, ownership, and focus on value.

  • You’ll gain exposure to high-profile transformations and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies.
  • Our consultants are formally trained by industry experts in consulting and client delivery. Consultants have access to a vast array for different training and certifications in a variety of areas: Cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM), cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP), and Agile delivery (Scrum Master, Product Owner, Scaled Agile Framework). Capgemini Invent offers you the flexibility to develop various areas of knowledge in technical domains aligned both to your interests and our client’s outcomes.
  • Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities that will help us and our clients to succeed.
  • We hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
  • There are monthly team drinks, and it’s a chance to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.
  • We hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
  • There are monthly team drinks, and it’s a chance to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city. The monthly team breakfasts give you a different, more relaxed setting to meet up in the office to hear from the leadership, meet colleagues and discuss the trends and insights within the market. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: 

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. 

Please opt in during the application process. 

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
