About the job you’re considering

Capgemini’s Global Cybersecurity Practice is home to over 4,000 professionals delivering secure, innovative solutions across IT and OT environments—from networks to cloud services and everything in between.

 

This role primarily focuses on delivery, but also offers opportunities to contribute to business development, collaborate across teams, and shape our evolving Cloud security offerings. You’ll also play a key role in mentoring colleagues, including graduates and apprentices, helping to grow our inclusive and forward-thinking Cloud security community.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

Your role

In this role, you’ll work closely with clients and colleagues to design and implement secure cloud solutions. Your work may include:

  • Supporting clients in developing enterprise security use cases aligned with their Cloud strategy
  • Designing and building security reference architectures for public, private, and hybrid Cloud systems
  • Collaborating on the architecture, design, and deployment of secure Cloud environments
  • Working with cross-functional teams to select technologies to support cloud deployments and integrate across hybrid IT ecosystems
  • Sharing knowledge and coaching others—both clients and Capgemini teams—on security technologies and best practices

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and experiences. You may have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Producing security, configuration, deployment and devsecops models for cloud-based services
  • Producing secure cloud architectures and governance models
  • Protecting cloud environments across network, application, and data layers, abiding by zero trust principles
  • Conducting threat modelling and design reviews as part of secure by design
  • Using automation and orchestration tools to manage secure deployments, potentially including use of agentic AI
  • Hold relevant vendor security certifications from one or more cloud hyperscalers

 

If you’re passionate about cybersecurity and eager to grow in a supportive and inclusive environment, we’d love to hear from you.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
  • To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.
  • You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

 

Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.


Make it real | www.capgemini.com

CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

YOUR ROLE

In this role, you will lead and shape complex, large scale HR transformation programmes, translating operating model design ambition into actionable, enterprise wide change.

 

As a HR Operating Model Specialist, you will shape how our People function delivers high‑quality, efficient and future‑ready services. Working within Employee Experience & HR team, you will design and optimise operating models, enabling seamless, insight‑driven and scalable HR ecosystems that supports our clients’ organisational strategy and enhances the employee experience.

 

In this role you will play a key role in:
•    Designing and evolving our HR Operating Model client offering, ensuring it is modern, efficient, and able to meet our clients’ current and future workforce needs.
•    Reviewing and optimising end‑to‑end HR processes, identifying opportunities to improve service quality, clarity, governance and cross‑functional alignment.
•    Leading diagnostic assessments and organisational design activities, using data and evidence‑based approaches to inform strategic decisions.
•    Partnering with HR, digital, finance and operational leaders to drive coherence across roles, capabilities, processes and technologies.
•    Supporting the adoption of new ways of working, embedding continuous improvement, capability uplift and a culture of operational excellence across our clients’ organisations.

 

As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

•    Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
•    Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
•    Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

•    Strong HR transformation and operating model expertise, with experience designing future‑state structures, processes and governance within complex organisations.
•    Skilled in data‑led analysis and problem solving, able to simplify complexity and translate insights into clear recommendations and actionable designs.
•    Highly collaborative and influential, confident engaging senior stakeholders, facilitating workshops, and building alignment across diverse teams.
•    A proactive, delivery‑focused mindset, demonstrating sound judgement, adaptability, and a passion for improving employee and service‑experience outcomes.

 

Optional: Required certifications, licenses or languages
•    Currently working in a major Consulting firm, and/or in industry but having a Consulting background
•    Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions.
•    Experience of proposition building and delivery. 

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

You will be part of the Employee Experience & HR team, which has a collaborative culture. You will work with a diverse group of talented professionals who are passionate about HR, technology, Employee Experience, AI, and dedicated to delivering exceptional solutions to diverse clients. A team that thrives on creativity and innovation, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible. 
 
We are delighted to have received the ‘Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 4 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page 

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce as a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer
Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

data.description:
Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Your Role

You will be joining, the Industrial Data & AI squad of the Digital Engineering team in Invent. As a Managing Consultant, you’ll help set the direction and contribute to driving forward the business thanks to data-driven insights.  

You’ll be designing state-of-the-art architectures leveraging data & AI to improve your clients’ operations and help them deliver sustained profitability, efficiency, quality and behavioural change improvements. To assist you in your work, you will be able to collaborate with colleagues from other parts of Capgemini such as Engineering, Frog, Cambridge Consultants to develop comprehensive propositions for improving our client’s business. 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities),  offering development.
  • Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your Profile

Our ideal candidate will bring a combination of the following skills and experience:

  • Experience in python programming language and SQL.
  • Experience in Data & AI cloud microservices AWS and Azure. Experience with Data & AI platforms: Cognite Data Fusion, C3 AI, Hexagon, Palantir is beneficial. 
  • At least one cloud architecture certification i.e. TOGAF, Cloud platform certifications (AWS, Azure), Databricks or other similar.  
  • Experience in working within the fields of Data Science and Analytics, with a proven track record of successfully delivered work across the ML lifecycle. 
  • Experience with Large Language Models architectures and techniques: AI-agents, GraphRAGs, fine-tuning, semantic grounding. 
  • A desire to provide solutions to the real-world issues and challenges with data that our clients face regularly. 
  • Domain-specific knowledge of asset management from one or more of the following: Automotive, Aerospace and Defence, Utilities, Energy, Construction, FMCG and Life Sciences is beneficial.
  • Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively within the team. 
  • Have effective and clear communication skills both written and verbal.  
  • Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills, with experience in enabling clients to better understand and derive better value and insights from their data. 

 

 

What You'll Love About Working Here

We offer unique training opportunities to help you grow and develop your career. Some of our consultants even get the chance to attend our flagship conference at Les Fontaines near Paris, France, a truly inspiring experience that connects you with colleagues from around the world.


Beyond formal training, collaboration is at the heart of what we do. Our teams make time to support one another, share knowledge, and work together to deliver exceptional results.

 

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 4 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page

Need To Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

data.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.  

YOUR ROLE

In a world of digital transformation, AI acceleration, and evolving operating models, organisations are facing significant disruption that is reshaping how they think and act. As a Consultant in Capgemini Invent’s Workforce Transformation team, you will support organisations to build future-ready workforces that can thrive in an environment of constant change. 

 

You will work with senior business, HR and transformation leaders to shape workforce strategies, develop critical skills for the future, and create cultures that drive engagement, innovation and growth. Combining structured problem solving with practical delivery, you will support clients to translate ambition into tangible outcomes for their workforce and organisation, including the application of AI and emerging technologies. 

 We’re looking for someone with experience in one or more of the below areas:   

  • Workforce Strategy – Support clients in defining and delivering workforce strategies that align talent, skills and organisational capabilities with business objectives. This includes forecasting workforce trends, workforce planning, skills-based workforce transformation, organisational effectiveness and future workforce strategy development. 

 

  • Learning & Skills – Help organisations build the capabilities needed now and for the future. This includes understanding learning maturity assessments, capability frameworks, learning strategies, workforce upskilling and reskilling initiatives and learning platforms/technology, and the development of capabilities required to adopt and work alongside AI. 

 

  • Culture Transformation – Support the design and delivery of culture and behaviour change in the context of digital and AI-driven transformation, helping organisations embed new ways of working enabled by AI. This includes understanding of culture diagnostics, leadership and employee engagement initiatives, change management, and the development of high-performing, inclusive and innovative workplace cultures. 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: 

  • Business Development – Contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 

YOUR PROFILE

To be successful in this role you would need to have the following mixture of skills and experience: 

  • Knowledgeable of and excited about trends in workforce transformation and learning, including the impact of AI on work, skills, culture and organisations. 
  • Passionate about developing innovative and industry-leading solutions for clients.  
  • Desirable to be currently working in a Consulting firm, and/or in industry but having a Consulting background.  
  • Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions.  
  • Skilled at establishing brilliant working relationships with client and teams, contributing to high-quality delivery and collaboration.  
  • Experience in proposition building and delivery.   

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

This is an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and energised practice, from its establishment in 2021, the team has grown to over 50 people in the UK setting a path for continued growth and diverse client base. Proactivity and ambition flourish at Capgemini Invent. There are countless opportunities available to propel your development forward: seek out those that suit you, and we will back you all the way.  In summary, we believe it’s a great place to work:  

 

 

  • Show how single minds make for better teams: Work alongside fierce intellects who love to collaborate  
  • Build momentum in your career: Develop your role and your career what you want it to be  
  • Stay true to who you are: Play to your strengths and bring your individuality  
  • Aim for nothing less than leading edge: We thrive on knowing the Digital work we do has real impact  
  • Give your curiosity freedom and focus: A place where inquisitiveness and entrepreneurial thinking are encouraged.  

 

At Capgemini Invent, we make it real for our clients.  

By combining strategy, technology, data science, and creative design expertise with an inventive mindset, we partner with our clients to innovate and transform their business, helping them navigate today, while plotting a course for the future.  

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion; we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.  

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.  

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.  

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:  

  • Declare they have a disability, and  
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.  

Please opt in during the application process.  

CSR

 

 

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing. 

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester, Newcastle or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice. 

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance. 

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real. | https://www.capgemini.com/

Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

 

Your Role

As demand for our Supply Chain and Global Business Services (GBS) transformation offerings continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Senior Manager to lead workstreams, manage teams and deliver high-quality consulting engagements across Supply Chain GBS strategy and transformation programmes. This role sits within our Intelligent Industry practice and offers strong growth opportunities across Consumer Products, Life Sciences, Automotive, and others. 

 

This is an opportunity for an experienced transformation consultant who can lead and deliver end-to-end consulting services spanning diagnostics, process assessment, target operating model design, service management, transition planning, performance improvement and digitally enabled transformation. You will combine structured problem-solving with practical execution and bring a clear understanding of how supply chain services can be redesigned within a GBS environment to improve cost, control, service quality and scalability. 

 

The Senior Manager – Supply Chain GBS Transformation is expected to lead from the front in delivery, manage senior client stakeholders with confidence and help build the proposition through thought leadership, proposal support and team development. 

 

As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth through activities that form part of the following categories: 

 

Growing the Supply Chain GBS consulting business 

 

  • Support market development activities, proposition evolution and client campaigns aligned to changing Supply Chain GBS priorities. 
  • Contribute to bids, proposals, RFP / RFI responses and account growth initiatives through strong content, insight and delivery credibility. 
  • Build trusted working relationships with client stakeholders across Supply Chain, Operations and GBS functions. 
  • Develop reusable methods, tools, points of view and delivery assets that strengthen our market offer. 

 

Programme delivery 

 

  • Lead workstreams and manage consulting teams on Supply Chain GBS transformation programmes, ensuring quality delivery and strong client outcomes. 
  • Analyse current-state processes, identify opportunities for standardisation and efficiency, and support the design of future-state operating models. 
  • Drive implementation planning across service transitions, governance, KPI / SLA design, stabilisation and continuous improvement. 
  • Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and executive-ready outputs that support decision-making and change execution.

  • Support the development of junior team members and contribute to practice capability building.

Your Profile

The ideal candidate will demonstrate many of the qualities below and be excited by the opportunity to apply their expertise in a collaborative and fast-paced environment:

 

  • Significant consulting and/or transformation delivery experience in Supply Chain, GBS, Shared services or Operating model redesign.

What You'll Love About Working Here

As a globally renowned technology and digital leader, we have the responsibility, ambition and capability to contribute to solving major societal questions shaping our future world. Invent for Society reflects our belief that social impact should be embedded in what we do. You will work on high-profile transformation programmes across multiple sectors, supporting clients as they redesign operations, improve performance and build future-ready supply chain service models. 

Need to Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively work to make it a reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring your whole self to work. 

 

We aim to support a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements a day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. To help support wellbeing we have trained Mental Health Champions across each of our business areas and have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

We are focused on using technology to create positive social impact. We are working to reduce our carbon footprint and improve access to a more inclusive digital world. 

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester, Newcastle or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice. 

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefit options for you to select to suit your personal circumstances. The package includes a variable element dependent upon grade and on both company and personal performance. 

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer

 

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


•    Declare they have a disability, and

Please opt in during the application process.

We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

data.description:
Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Your Role

As part of the Digital Engineering team in Invent, you will work on high-profile projects with leading organisations to define and deliver engineering transformation—reshaping how products are designed, developed and supported throughout their lifecycle. You will help clients exploit digital technologies and innovative operating models to transform engineering functions and align hardware/software for future-ready products.


You will leverage your expertise to help clients harness digital technologies to transform engineering operations, redesign operating models and integrate engineering and design functions seamlessly across the value chain.


The work is diverse, giving you the opportunity to deliver client-facing projects across multiple industries. These projects may span the full product lifecycle—from design and development through engineering operations, manufacturing to through-life support and improvement.


You will apply your business and technical expertise to help clients build the case for change, identify opportunities for value creation, define transformation roadmaps and deliver digital initiatives.

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities),  offering development.
  • Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your Profile

We’re growing our team and looking for individuals with experience in delivering high-impact engineering transformation initiatives. This includes leading or contributing to complex engineering change projects, digital transformations, operating model redesigns and improvements across engineering and design operations. Experience applying digital technologies to improve engineering operations and deliver operational excellence is highly valued, ideally within a consulting context.

We are seeking entrepreneurial individuals with the knowledge, creativity and experience to deliver engineering transformation—modernizing engineering processes, adopting digital technologies and aligning hardware and software development to enable future-ready products.

You will have looking for relevant knowledge and experience in engineering transformation and related domains, including one or more of the following areas:

 

  • Previous consulting experience and proven ability with mobilising and managing projects to successful delivery.
  • Strong understanding of engineering operations and product development across sectors such as Automotive, Aerospace & Defence, Industrial Engineering, FMCG and Life Sciences
  • Experience with engineering and product lifecycle platforms (PLM, MBSE) and proven ability to integrate these with enterprise systems (ERP) and manufacturing execution systems (MES) to enable end-to-end data flow, digital continuity and operational efficiency
  • Appreciation of digital engineering concepts, including digital twin, AI applications in engineering and data-driven design and development
  • Experience in designing and implementing engineering operating models, including process optimisation, organisational structure, governance and integration of digital technologies
  • Experience with innovation frameworks, product lifecycle management processes and associated value drivers
  • Proven experience in delivering engineering and digital transformation programs, including change management and stakeholder engagement

 

It’s a bonus if you have experience in:

  • Experience in Agile delivery methods, Lean methodologies or program & portfolio management; certification is a plus
  • Experience designing and implementing complex engineering or digital solutions that align with enterprise architecture and transformation objectives
  • Experience of proposition building and delivery
  • Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions

Security Check (SC) Clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. (https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant#levels-of-national-security-clearance)

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

What You'll Love About Working Here

As part of the Digital Engineering team at Invent, you’ll work on high-profile projects with leading organisations to define and deliver engineering transformation, reshaping how products are designed, developed and supported throughout their lifecycle. You’ll help clients harness digital technologies and innovative operating models to transform engineering functions and align hardware and software for future-ready products.


The work is diverse and you will have the opportunity to work on a variety of client facing projects across multiple industry sectors. Projects may touch on various aspects of managing products throughout their lifecycle including product design and development, product manufacture and through life support and maintenance. 


You’ll be at the forefront of digital engineering innovation—helping global organizations adopt cutting-edge technologies like digital twins, AI-driven design, and model-based systems engineering. Your work will directly influence how next-generation products are conceived, built, and supported, giving you the chance to make a tangible impact on industries and society.

Need to Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

data.description:
Who You Will Be Working With

As an AWS API Engineer / Data Architect at Capgemini, you'll design and deliver secure, scalable APIs and microservices that connect systems, data and, increasingly, AI agents. APIs are where modern AI meets the enterprise: they're how an agent retrieves context, calls a tool, or takes an action, so the quality, security and governance of your interfaces directly shapes whether AI-driven systems behave safely and predictably. You'll own solutions from design through build, deployment and production support, making sure services are observable, reliable and cost-effective on AWS.


You'll be part of the Data Platforms team within the Insights and Data Global Practice, which has seen strong, sustained growth across a wide range of sectors. Data Platforms is home to Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, Solution Architects and Business Analysts driving our customers' digital and data transformation on modern cloud platforms. We specialise in the latest frameworks, reference architectures and technologies across AWS, Azure and GCP, and data platforms such as Databricks and Snowflake.


Please Note:


Security Clearance: To be appointed to this role, you must be eligible to obtain UK Security Check (SC) clearance. To obtain SC clearance, you must have resided continuously in the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria. Throughout the recruitment process you'll be asked about your security clearance eligibility, including country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons, so you may be asked about your citizenship.

The Focus of Your Role

You'll take primary responsibility for API and microservices data architecture and system integration on AWS. You'll design RESTful APIs and clean service boundaries, define integration standards, and increasingly design agent-ready interfaces: endpoints that AI agents and LLM-based applications can call safely and reliably. You will participate in data architecture decisions (such as PostgreSQL, document and vector stores) that enable robust, end-to-end, AI-enabled solutions You'll work with product, delivery, data and cybersecurity colleagues to ensure secure access patterns, strong observability and smooth deployments. Where needed, you'll also contribute to.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Design serverless and microservices APIs on AWS. Build API architectures using Lambda and API Gateway, aligned to product roadmaps, with consistent design patterns, versioning and documentation across the API lifecycle.
  • Design agent-ready and tool-calling interfaces. Build APIs that AI agents and LLM applications can invoke, including exposing data and capabilities through patterns such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), with clear schemas, scoped machine identities and appropriate guardrails so autonomous callers behave safely.
  • Support system and data integration. Enable integration across distributed services, including event-driven patterns, and contribute to retrieval and vector data access for RAG and other AI use cases where required.
  • Own secure access patterns. Integrate with identity providers and enforce IAM and token-based authentication, designing access control that works for autonomous (non-human) callers as well as users.
  • Build in observability and auditability. Implement logging, monitoring, tracing and audit trails, including for non-deterministic AI-driven traffic, with clear human oversight of what agents are permitted to do.
  • Modernise pragmatically. Assess and address technical debt and recommend sensible modernisation approaches, and support deployment planning, cutover and post-go-live stabilisation.
  • Contribute to data architecture. Help shape document store and data design (PostgreSQL, document and vector stores) in collaboration with data engineering teams.

What You'll Bring

 

You'll bring strong, hands-on experience delivering API and integration solutions in complex, often regulated environments, and an interest in how AI agents change what good API design looks like. You don't need to have built agent-facing systems already, but you should be ready to, and able to show the integration and security fundamentals that make them safe.


Essential:

  • Strong, hands-on experience designing and building APIs and microservices in production. _ Hands-on experience with AWS serverless technologies (Lambda, API Gateway) and sound security and networking fundamentals (IAM, VPC, and similar).
  • Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, integration patterns and distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend language (e.g. Python) with strong software engineering practice (Git, code review, unit testing, CI/CD) and the ability to troubleshoot production issues.
  • Experience across the delivery lifecycle (CI/CD, release planning, cutover, post-go-live stabilisation) and with observability tooling (CloudWatch and/or ELK, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Clear communication of architecture decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Nice to have:

  • Exposure to AI and agentic integration: tool-calling or function-calling APIs, MCP, Amazon Bedrock and Bedrock Agents, Knowledge Bases for Bedrock, or vector search (e.g. OpenSearch, pgvector).
  • GraphQL (Apollo).
  • Event streaming (e.g. Apache Kafka).
  • Progress toward AWS certification (Developer Associate, Solutions Architect Associate or Professional, or Security Specialty).


Technologies you may work with:

  • AWS: Lambda, API Gateway, Aurora/RDS, EC2, Route 53, ECR, STS, VPC, S3, and Amazon Bedrock for AI integration.
  • API, integration and security: RESTful APIs, Apollo GraphQL, MCP; IAM, token-based authentication, external identity providers.
  • Data and messaging: PostgreSQL, Apache Kafka, document and vector stores.
  • Engineering and operations: CI/CD pipelines, ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana. 

Additional Info

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

What we’ll offer you 

 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Why we’re different 

 

At Capgemini, we help organisations across the world become more agile, more competitive, and more successful. Smart, tailored, often ground-breaking technical solutions to complex problems are the norm. But so, too, is a culture that’s as collaborative as it is forward thinking. Working closely with each other, and with our clients, we get under the skin of businesses and to the heart of their goals. You will too.
 
Capgemini is proud to represent nearly 130 nationalities and its cultural diversity. Our holistic definition of diversity extends beyond gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, race, age, and religion. Capgemini views diversity as everything that makes us who we are as an organization, including our social background, our experiences in life and work, our communication styles and even our personality. These dimensions contribute to the type of diversity we value the most: diversity of thought.

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

Capgemini’s Global Cybersecurity Practice is home to over 4,000 professionals delivering secure, innovative solutions across IT and OT environments - from networks to cloud services and everything in between. Capgemini’s Technical Assurance Services (CTAS) team in the UK is a dynamic part of our Global Cybersecurity Practice.

 

As a penetration tester in our CTAS team you’ll play a vital role in helping our clients detect, understand and manage their security risks. You’ll be responsible for undertaking rigorous tests that identify vulnerabilities which are present in the IT infrastructure, applications and networks on which our client’s businesses rely. You’ll employ both manual and automated techniques to simulate real world attacks which help our clients assess their  security posture against any potential threats to their business. You’ll also be expected to keep your knowledge of the ever-evolving threat landscape up-to-date and adhere to ethical guidelines, especially when handling sensitive data.

As well as having proven technical skills, you’ll also need to demonstrate the strong communication skills needed to describe complex findings to a range of different, often non-technical, stakeholders.

 

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

Being certified as a CHECK Team Member (CTM) is a prerequisite to joining our CTAS team as a penetration tester. As a member of this team, you’ll deliver high‑quality penetration testing and consultancy services as well as a full range of security assessments (including specialist areas and IT Health Checks) in line with Capgemini’s policies, core values, methodologies, and commercial expectations. This includes:

  • Producing accurate, concise documentation including technical reports, executive summaries, scopes, and proposals.
  • Engaging a variety of different stakeholders, some technically minded and others not, to ensure they understand work you have delivered.
  • Ensuring relevance, maintaining confidentiality, aligning with the QA manual, meeting client expectations, and upholding Capgemini’s own standards.
  • Maintaining your strong technical expertise and contributing to service development by staying up-to-date with emerging threats, technologies, vulnerabilities and methodologies.
  • Sharing your knowledge across the team, participating in research and involving yourself in initiatives which enhance capability. 

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Proven experience working in a Penetration Testing role as a certified Check Team Member (CTM) is essential.
  • Strong knowledge of penetration testing tools including (Burpsuite, Metasploit, Nmap, etc).
  • Good knowledge of multiple Operating Systems (OS) including Windows & *NIX.
  • Ability to configure network devices, firewalls, IDS/IPS devices and wireless technologies.
  • Good understanding of common security standards and regulatory compliance such as GDPR, ISO27001 and PCI DSS.
  • Experience of testing AI / LLMs is desirable but not essential.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (includes writing detailed reports and providing clear recommendations for remediation).
  • Proven organisation skills which include working under pressure and dealing with ambiguity to meet deadlines.
  • Ability and willingness to work effectively and positively within a team e.g. collaborating by sharing knowledge and skills
  • Willingness to travel to client locations across the UK.

 

If you’re passionate about penetration testing and eager to grow in a supportive and inclusive environment, we’d love to hear from you.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  
    To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.
  • You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

 

Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

 

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

Our offer

Capgemini Engineering UK is a global leader in innovation and high-tech engineering services, focusing on Intelligent Systems, Innovative Product Development, Lifecycle Experience, Mechanical Engineering, and Information Systems.

Capgemini is committed to delivering high-quality services and solutions that meet customer expectations and contractual commitments. The CCM / Export SME is responsible for ensuring the delivery and commercial risks are understood with specific responsibility for assessment and management of export compliance.

The role provides expert input to bids and delivery on export risks, export licensing requirements and compliance management.  The SME will manage all ERD UK licences and be accountable for reporting and audit against these licence.  The post holder will also provide general commercial guidance to bids and delivered projects on broader contractual issues and commercial risks resulting from framework terms and provide guidance on developing SoWs.

Your role

  1. Global trade governance: Support Global Trade activities across ERD UK and provide expert guidance on compliance with UK export and import controls and applicable US EAR and ITAR requirements.
  2. Classification and risk assessment: Support the export classification of contract deliverables and identify export-control risks throughout the bid, contracting and delivery lifecycle.
  3. Compliance planning: Manage the creation, implementation, maintenance, approval and continual improvement of Export and Technology Compliance Plans across the business.
  4. Licensing and authorisations: Prepare and commercially manage export licences and supporting documentation; manage UK licences and US sub-licensing agreements; and ensure activities, deliveries, records and reports meet all applicable authorisation requirements.

Your profile

  1. Minimum 5 years' experience in roles involving export control / compliance.
  2. Experience managing risks and compliance programmes.
  3. Demonstrable experience engaging with senior stakeholders and customer leadership teams.
  4. Experience supporting bids and service delivery lifecycle activities.
  5. Experience in large-scale IT services, engineering services or managed service environments is desirable.

Our offer

  • Open access to digital learning platforms
  • Active employee networks promoting diversity, equity and inclusion like OutFront, CapAbility or Women@Capgemini

data.description:
Capgemini Invent

The Strategy and Transformation consultant supports Capgemini clients to innovate and develop new strategies, services and products. He/she designs and implements new business and operating models and brings to life the organizations of the future. He/she develops customer insights, organizational knowledge and market perspectives.

Your Role

We are rapidly growing our Supply Chain and Enterprise Transformation capability, using our established track record of delivering value for clients globally. As a Consultant / Senior Consultant, you will help set the direction, drive forward our business, role model our values and behaviours, and collaborate with or coach junior members of the team.

 

First and foremost, you will be responsible for delivering innovative Order-to-Cash (O2C) solutions for leading global Consumer Products, Retail, Manufacturing and Automotive organisations. Your work will help organisations transition from functional silos to integrated Demand-to-Cash value chains. You will drive tangible outcomes including improved customer experience, reduced order errors and disputes, faster cash conversion cycles, better alignment between supply and revenue, and stronger working capital performance.  

 

Drawing on your expertise across customer fulfilment, order management, and cash realisation, you will work collaboratively with clients to diagnose challenges across the order capture to cash collection lifecycle, design future-state O2C operating models integrated with supply chain processes, and deliver transformation programmes that improve cash flow, service levels and working capital. 

 

You will also play a key role in linking front-office demand signals with supply chain execution and financial outcomes, ensuring an integrated, end-to-end value chain. You will align demand planning and order capture, supply availability and order fulfilment, logistics execution and customer delivery, billing accuracy and cash collection.

 

 

Key responsibilities include: 

 

  • Lead and deliver end-to-end O2C transformation workstreams. 
  • Support clients in integrating O2C with supply chain planning and execution. 
  • Address challenges across order capture, order validation, ATP / CTP, fulfilment, delivery performance, billing accuracy, disputes and collections. 
  • Deliver measurable improvements in On-Time In-Full (OTIF), order cycle time, Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), working capital and customer experience. 
  • Support the full transformation lifecycle from strategy, assessment and design through to implementation and optimisation. 

 

Collaboration and innovation

 

You will collaborate closely with Supply Chain Planning, Logistics, Finance and Sales and Commercial teams to create integrated solutions across the end-to-end value chain. 

Using structured consulting approaches, you will run workshops to identify O2C pain points and value leakage, demonstrate innovative digital solutions such as automation and AI-enabled insights, and rapidly prototype solutions to improve service, cost and cash outcomes.

 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities),  offering development.
  • Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your Profile

 

Consulting and Transformation

 

  • Experience working on transformation projects, using consultancy approaches, delivering creative yet realistic solutions to client challenges.
  • Experience designing technology enabled operating models across process, organisation, governance, data and technology, supported by change management.
  • Ability to lead workstreams and deliver against scope, quality, time and commercial objectives. 
  • Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement across business and IT, with the ability to influence senior client teams.
  • Experience of proposition building, business development and delivery is desirable. 

 

Order to Cash and Supply Chain expertise 

 

  • Order capture, order validation and order management systems.
  • Pricing, contracts, claims and rebate management.
  • Available-to-Promise / Capable-to-Promise integrated with supply planning.
  • Warehouse, transport and distribution execution impacts on O2C.
  • Billing, invoicing, revenue assurance and revenue recognition.
  • Credit risk, collections, cash application and dispute management.

 

Supply Chain integration 

 

  • Experience linking O2C to upstream and downstream supply chain processes.
  • Demand planning and forecasting. 
  • Inventory availability, allocation and substitution logic. 
  • Production planning and distribution planning constraints. 
  • Warehouse operations, transport planning and logistics execution. 
  • Service performance, fulfilment reliability and customer delivery experience. 

 

Ideal industry experience

 

  • Consumer Products.
  • Retail / eCommerce. 
  • Manufacturing / Industrial Goods.
  • Automotive.
  • Life Sciences or other product-based industries. 

 

Technology 

 

  • ERP and O2C platforms including SAP S/4HANA, SAP SD / FSCM, Oracle and Microsoft Dynamics. 
  • Order management systems, digital fulfilment platforms and customer service tools. 
  • Integration with planning platforms such as Kinaxis, o9, SAP IBP and Blue Yonder. 
  • Data, analytics, automation and AI use cases across customer fulfilment, billing, collections and dispute management. 

Need to Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

 

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

 

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester, Newcastle or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
