data.description:
About the job you’re considering

We are looking for an experienced SAP S/4HANA PP Consultant to join our Supply Chain Management team. You will play a key role in shaping and delivering end‑to‑end SAP PP/Manufacturing solutions for a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries.

You’ll work on high‑impact SAP transformation programmes, using the latest technologies including S/4HANA, Fiori, Cloud, IoT, automation, Digital Twin and GenAI. Engagements may cover the full project lifecycle from transformation design and agile delivery through to post‑go‑live support.

This is an excellent opportunity to lead, influence, and grow both technically and professionally within one of the UK’s strongest SAP practices.

Your knowledge of core PP solutions will allow you to shape, build and deliver solutions in your functional area as well as contribute to the growth of the SAP SCM Capability. As part of the role, you will have access to enhance your consulting, functional and technical skills, through Capgemini learning and development, and the latest industry recognised certifications.

About our UK SAP Practice Team:  Capgemini UK is a leading SAP Integration Partner, helping our clients navigate through complex SAP transformations. Capgemini UK has 1000 + SAP practitioners across UK & India and are ranked #1 for SAP S/4HANA® certifications in UK and globally. We work closely with our clients to transform their business together using the latest SAP products and architecture, a deep knowledge of industries and markets, and innovative delivery methodologies.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:

identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your Role

  • Lead functional consulting on SAP S/4HANA PP projects
  • Own and deliver your functional workstream across full project lifecycles
  • Translate business requirements into high‑quality, scalable SAP solutions
  • Lead and mentor project team members, including developing junior talent
  • Work collaboratively in cross‑functional, agile teams across Supply Chain
  • Provide advisory input and thought leadership to clients
  • Contribute to practice growth through knowledge sharing, innovation, and pipeline development
  • Expand your expertise into a second SAP functional area over time

Your skills and experience

  • Senior SAP consulting experience across multiple full-cycle S/4HANA or ECC PP/Manufacturing implementations.
  • Proven experience leading teams on client-facing projects.
  • Strong configuration and functional expertise in areas such as:
    • Organisational structures (Plant, Work Centres, Storage Locations).
    • Core master data setup (Material Master, BOMs, Routings, Production Versions, Work Centres).
    • Production master data and order execution.
    • MRP, MPS, Demand Management, planning strategies, and Long-Term Planning.
  • Capacity Planning, Capacity Levelling, and PP/DS.
  • Integration with MES, shop-floor, and external planning systems.
  • Knowledge of SAP MM, SAP QM, SAP EWM, and SAP SD integration points.
  • Experience with Fiori apps in the PP/Manufacturing area.
  • Knowledge of pMRP and/or PP/DS (desirable).
  • Familiarity with project tools such as JIRA, SAP Solution Manager, SAP Signavio.
  • Industry experience in Aerospace & Defence, Consumer Products, Pharma, or Discrete Manufacturing is an advantage.
  • Strong communication skills and a client-focused mindset.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 

-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Developed Vetting (DV) clearance.

To obtain DV clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 10 years, along with other very detailed criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.title: Senior SAP S/4HANA PP Consultant

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

We are looking for a Senior SAP S/4HANA Quality Management (QM) Consultant to join our Supply Chain Management capability. In this role, you will lead the design and delivery of SAP QM solutions, working closely with clients across a wide range of industries to support their S/4HANA transformation journeys.

You’ll work alongside experienced SAP practitioners on innovative programmes, applying modern SAP technologies such as S/4HANA, automation, Digital Twin and GenAI, and helping clients optimise quality and manufacturing processes across their supply chains.

The role offers exposure to the full project lifecycle, including discovery and solution design, agile implementation, and post‑go‑live support, with opportunities to contribute to practice growth and future pipeline development.

About our UK SAP Practice Team:  Capgemini UK is a leading SAP Integration Partner, helping our clients navigate through complex SAP transformations. Capgemini UK has 1000 + SAP practitioners across UK & India and are ranked #1 for SAP S/4HANA® certifications in UK and globally. We work closely with our clients to transform their business together using the latest SAP products and architecture, a deep knowledge of industries and markets, and innovative delivery methodologies.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:

identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

  • Provide senior functional consulting on SAP S/4HANA Quality Management.
  • Lead end‑to‑end solution design and delivery to meet client business requirements
  • Plan and run client workshops to capture requirements, design processes, and configure SAP solutions
  • Translate complex business needs into high‑quality, integrated SAP QM solutions
  • Lead workstreams and make key delivery decisions aligned to best practices
  • Mentor and support team members, including developing junior consultants
  • Provide thought leadership and advisory support to clients on SAP QM and Supply Chain strategies
  • Contribute to the growth of the SAP SCM practice through innovation, knowledge sharing, and pipeline support

Your skills and experience

  • Strong consulting experience in SAP S/4HANA Quality Management, with Manufacturing exposure
  • Proven delivery across multiple end‑to‑end SAP implementation programmes
  • Deep functional and configuration experience in SAP QM, including QA and QC processes
  • Proven experience in cross‑functional integration, for example with:
    • Production Planning / Manufacturing
    • Procurement / MM
    • Warehouse Management
    • Sales & Distribution
    • Plant Maintenance
  • Ability to analyse, model, and document business processes to meet project demands
  • Experience leading small to medium‑sized onshore and offshore teams
  • Industry experience in Aerospace & Defence, Consumer Products or Discrete Manufacturing 
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, communication, and workshop facilitation skills
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous learning and professional growth

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 

-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Developed Vetting (DV) clearance.

To obtain DV clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 10 years, along with other very detailed criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.  

YOUR ROLE

We help leading aerospace and defence manufacturers transform how they design, build and deliver complex products. Combining deep sector expertise with strategy, engineering, data, AI and cloud capabilities, we turn ambitious manufacturing visions into measurable business outcomes.  

 

From defining smart factory strategies and accelerating production ramp-up, to deploying Industry 4.0 technologies and transforming end-to-end operations, we deliver change at scale. Our rare blend of strategy, transformation, engineering and cloud expertise sets us apart. Joining our team means working at the forefront of manufacturing innovation, shaping mission-critical programmes, and helping clients build the resilient, digital and intelligent factories of the future. 

 

As a Manager or Senior Manager with a specialism in Aerospace & Defence manufacturing in our Intelligent Industry practice, you will: 

 

  • Lead large-scale Smart Manufacturing, Industry 4.0 and Digital Operations transformation programmes across leading aerospace and defence organisations. 
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, including Manufacturing Directors, Operations Leaders, Supply Chain Executives and Digital Transformation leaders. 
  • Define and deliver manufacturing transformation strategies focused on production ramp-up, operational excellence, supply chain resilience, quality improvement and industrial performance. 
  • Lead manufacturing assessments, maturity diagnostics and value discovery engagements, identifying opportunities to improve throughput, productivity, quality, cost and agility. 
  • Develop compelling transformation roadmaps, operating models and business cases that secure executive sponsorship and investment. 
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams across strategy, manufacturing, engineering, data, AI, cloud and technology disciplines to deliver business outcomes at scale. 
  • Shape and oversee the deployment of Industry 4.0 solutions, including MES, Industrial IoT, AI-powered manufacturing analytics, digital work instructions, connected worker and digital twin capabilities. 
  • Develop Capgemini’s offerings for Physical and Agentic AI at our manufacturing clients. 
  • Drive client value realisation by ensuring transformation programmes deliver measurable operational and financial benefits. 
  • Coach and develop consultants and senior consultants, building capability across manufacturing transformation, leadership and client engagement. 
  • Build and strengthen executive-level client relationships, identifying opportunities to expand engagements and create long-term partnerships. 
  • Lead complex stakeholder environments, aligning business, operational and technology leaders around a common transformation vision. 
  • Act as a thought leader both internally and externally, contributing to market-facing propositions, industry insights and innovation within the aerospace and defence sector. 

 

As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: 

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 

YOUR PROFILE

We’d love to meet someone with: 

 

  • Significant experience leading manufacturing or supply chain transformation within the Aerospace & Defence sector, gained within leading defence or aerospace organisation, or top-tier consulting firm 
  • Deep expertise in discrete manufacturing operations, including production systems, assembly operations, industrialisation, production ramp-up, quality management and supply chain performance. 
  • Proven experience leading large, complex transformation programmes from strategy and business case development through to implementation and value realisation.  
  • Strong knowledge of Smart Manufacturing and Industry 4.0 technologies including Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Industrial IoT, advanced analytics, AI, digital work instructions and connected worker solutions.  
  • Demonstrable track record of delivering measurable improvements in productivity, lead time, quality, operational efficiency and cost competitiveness.    
  • Strong business acumen, with experience leading compelling business cases, shaping transformation strategies and securing stakeholder buy-in for investment and change. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior executives, align diverse stakeholder groups and operate as a trusted advisor to operational and C-suite leaders.  
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to transform data and insights into practical recommendations and measurable business outcomes 
  • A strong people leadership capability, with experience leading multi-disciplinary teams, coaching, mentoring and developing high-performing teams. 
  • A passion for operational excellence, innovation and the future of manufacturing, with the ability to translate emerging technologies into practical business value while driving sustainable change.  
  • Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organization, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions. 
  • Experience contributing to propositions, thought leadership and business development activities (e.g., proposals, RFPs, client pitches, and asset development).  
  • Ability to obtain UK Security Check (SC) clearance. 

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

No matter the project or customer, your work will have a meaningful impact on society, businesses and lives. It’s really rewarding. And it’s also really varied. You’ll potentially work on a huge variety of projects (some larger than others), so you could gain lots of experience in a short amount of time. 

You will work directly alongside our clients in their manufacturing facilities, keeping the focus of digitisation on the user experience and the business outcomes.  You will typically work with colleagues from Capgemini’s Engineering and Cloud Services businesses, collaborating to design, build and implement digital solutions that enable our clients to improve service levels, reduce costs and improve sustainability outcomes. 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work. 

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 

WE ARE A DISABILITY CONFIDENT EMPLOYER

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing. 

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice. 

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance. 

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

About the job you're considering

Capgemini are recruiting highly skilled Senior Engineers to join their dynamic team, delivering solutions for a major public sector client. This is an opportunity to work on meaningful projects that impact millions of people, in an environment that values innovation and collaboration.

Our mature Agile environment provides a supportive space to collaborate with specialists from other disciplines. You’ll be part of a culture that encourages continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence.

Our Senior Engineer, you’ll focus on delivering critical digital services from cradle to grave working on a variety of projects featuring high-performance cloud platforms using Java based languages and technologies, and on-premises traditional infrastructure.

Hybrid working: Your working location will vary depending on your role, personal needs, and business requirements. This will typically include a mix of company offices, client sites, and remote work from home. If your location is Telford or Worthing (please note the Worthing office will relocate to Brighton & Hove in the second half of 2026) you will be expected to work from the office between 40% and 70% of the time. For all other locations you need to be prepared to come into the Telford or Worthing office once to twice a month (Lead Engineers more frequently). As we align closely with customer requirements, which may change over time, you will need to remain flexible. Please note that fully remote working (100% from home) is not permitted.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:
identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Your role

We’re looking for people who are learning focused, challenge the status quo and are constantly looking to shape their working environment to make it an exciting, fun and interesting place to work.

As a Software Engineer your primary focus will be to deliver user stories whilst working as a part of a multi-disciplined team. You’ll be working closely with analysts and designers to build, deploy and support your services using well established software development techniques such as TDD, BDD and pair programming.

Getting involved with all stages of service delivery including testing, configuring, deploying, supporting, and monitoring using industry standard tooling, to truly work in a DevSecOps capacity.

Whilst working in a collaborative environment you are going to meet a variety of different people who, like you, have a wealth of knowledge and experience. As a part of one or more communities, you will have the opportunity to influence how we grow as a delivery centre and how we do things by sharing ideas and working with others to make things better.

Senior engineers are expected to lead by example, fostering a culture of excellence. You will actively mentor junior engineers and support their wellbeing, professional growth, and development, including through effective performance management.

Our culture

We’re looking for people who are learning focused, can challenge the status quo and are constantly looking to shape their working environment to make it an exciting, fun and interesting place to work.

Keeping things fresh is something we encourage in our working practices, but the culture of continuous improvement is equally as important in our technical approach to building and delivering modern digital services. Your knowledge and experience will be used to change the way we build solutions including utilising new tools and technologies to solve new problems or improve existing services.

Working on our services means you’ll be part of a team, but you’ll also be a part of communities of interest. This means you’ll always have people on hand to share and discuss ideas and get help when needed.  The engineering organisation is engineering led, supporting each other through coaching and mentoring, so if you want to change something it’s within your power to do so.

Your skills and experience

Key Responsibilities:

  • Primary focus is to deliver user stories as part of a multi-disciplined team.
  • Build, deploy, and support services using established software development techniques such as TDD, BDD, and pair programming.
  • Getting involved with all stages of service delivery including testing, configuring, deploying, supporting, and monitoring using industry standard tooling, to truly work in a DevSecOps capacity.
  • Foster a culture of excellence through effective performance management- Actively mentor junior engineers and support their wellbeing, professional growth, and development.

Required Competencies:

  • Strong technical competence in: 
    -    Java
    -    Spring Boot
    -    Open-source integration frameworks
    -    TDD, Unit testing and automated integration testing
    -    Experience of building RESTful APIs in Spring boot
    -    Experience of building loosely coupled synchronous and asynchronous microservices
  • Good working knowledge of Spring JPA, AOP, Transactions, SQL and NoSQL databases, containers and container management platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes is desirable.
  • Experience of Cloud based infrastructure is desirable, along with an understanding of application security principles, continuous integration and continuous delivery.
  • As a well-rounded Agile Software Engineer, we encourage adaptability plus general skills in problem solving, business analysis, quality assurance, application design and architecture to compliment your Java development specialism

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2)   under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
- Declare they have a disability, and 
- Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way. 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is. 

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Join our AI Strategy team and be part of the future of AI consulting. We are redefining how organisations adopt and scale AI by embedding Generative AI, agentic systems, and copilots into every aspect of how they operate, compete, and create value. 

We are looking for experienced Strategy and AI leaders with strong commercial acumen, individuals who understand AI technologies and can translate them into enterprise-wide transformation. You will lead engagements from strategy through to execution, enabling the shift toward AI-enabled enterprises whilst contributing to the growth of our AI Strategy practice. 

YOUR ROLE

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and delivery, perfect for someone who thrives on solving complex problems. From Agentic AI in risk governance, to AI sovereignty in enterprise architecture, to enabling the AI-empowered workforce of tomorrow, you’ll be working at the cutting edge of what’s next. 

We REDEFINE strategy – You will work with clients to define their ambition for AI, identify high-impact use cases and design prioritisation frameworks that guide investment to ensure AI initiatives are aligned with business goals and built for scale.

We ENABLE business transformation with AI – You will help clients disrupt their business model to embed AI and automation into core business processes to unlock new capabilities, drive efficiency, and deliver measurable impact.

We BUILD scalable AI capability - You will help organisations develop and scale AI across functions, embedding the right skills, tools, governance and culture to enable sustainable adoption. From operating models to talent strategy, we ensure AI becomes a core part of how the business operates.

We DRIVE responsible AI adoption - You will help organisations design and implement robust frameworks to safely and responsibly deploy, monitor and assure AI. We ensure AI is used transparently, securely, and inline with core business values.

We SUPERCHARGE delivery - We leverage the power of AI to accelerate delivery and drive innovation for our clients and our business. As part of this role you will be encouraged to experiment with new AI and automation technologies to build proof of concepts, augment research and automate tasks.  

As part of your role alongside client work you will have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

  • Business Development - Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal contribution - Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
  • Learning & development - Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

As a member of the Data & AI Strategy Team, you’ll be part of shaping the future of AI consulting. You’ll help organisations unlock value from AI by combining strategic thinking, technology understanding, and delivery experience. Working at the intersection of business and technology, you’ll define AI opportunities, shape practical strategies, and support implementation to drive real outcomes.
Key skills:
Growth mindset & AI curiosity – Actively explore emerging technologies (especially GenAI and agentic systems) and apply them to solve real business challenges.
Strategic problem solving – Structure complex, ambiguous problems and develop clear, actionable AI strategies and roadmaps aligned to business goals.
Communication & stakeholder engagement – Confident working with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex concepts into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences.
Data & AI expertise – Strong understanding of data ecosystems and AI capabilities (e.g. ML, GenAI, analytics), with the ability to connect technology to tangible business value.
AI strategy & delivery experience – Experience across the lifecycle from discovery and use case definition through to delivery and implementation support.
Capability building & responsible AI – Experience developing AI capabilities (operating models, readiness, training) alongside awareness of AI ethics, risk, and governance.
Technology & delivery experience:
Understanding of GenAI, LLMs, and agentic systems, and their practical application
Workshop design and facilitation to drive ideation and alignment
Strong presentation, storytelling, and executive communication skills
Delivery of high-quality outputs (e.g. strategies, business cases, prototypes)
Awareness of end-to-end delivery, linking strategy through to execution
Senior Consultants:
Bring proven experience delivering AI strategy and transformation projects, with the ability to own workstreams, engage clients independently, and bridge strategy and delivery to drive measurable outcomes.
 

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

Our team drives business transformation by designing the organisations of the future, delivering end-to-end blueprint for AI-enabled enterprises. We are at the cutting edge of the 4th industrial revolution and are uniquely placed to leverage the broad, market-leading capabilities of Capgemini Group.  

We work across a wide range of industries, delivering outcomes that make a real impact on society. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, innovate and shape your own career path, supported by mentoring from our leading experts in data and AI.  

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years. To see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page. 

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self At Cap to work. 

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 

 

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: 

  

Declare they have a disability, and  

Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. 

Please opt in during the application process. 

 

CSR: 

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing. 

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice. 

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance. 

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.  

Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

 


The Invent AI and Digital Trust (AI & DT) practice focuses on ensuring secure business outcomes for our clients, providing cybersecurity advisory and transformation consulting in areas such as security strategy, risk management, human risk management, data and identity security, secure intelligent industry, Gen-AI risk, and security operations modernisation.  

 


Our security specialists and innovators enable our clients to evaluate cyber risks, redesign cybersecurity operating models, modernise digital identity capabilities, lead programmes to drive security culture change, and transform security and compliance regimes to make them efficient, effective, sustainable, and resilient.  

YOUR ROLE

As a Senior Manager within AI & Digital Trust, you will lead complex client engagements, shape strategic solutions, drive business growth across cyber security, Digital Trust and AI-enabled risk transformation. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, helping organisations manage emerging risks while delivering measurable business outcomes.

 

A successful Senior Manager:

  • Shapes client strategy, not just delivery.
  • Leads multiple teams and senior stakeholders through ambiguity and change.
  • Originates and converts new business opportunities.
  • Builds a market profile through thought leadership and proposition development.
  • Develops future talent while strengthening the Digital Trust practice.
  • Is recognised internally and externally as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert.

 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

You will be responsible for:

 

  • Leading large-scale transformation programmes and strategic workstreams from shaping through to delivery.
  • Influencing C-suite, risk, security and technology leaders to drive decision-making and secure buy-in for transformation initiatives.
  • Owning client relationships, engagement quality, commercial performance and delivery outcomes.
  • Driving business development through proposition development, account growth, bids, proposals and market-facing thought leadership.
  • Building and scaling Digital Trust capability through asset development, knowledge sharing, innovation and community leadership. 
  • Coaching and developing consultants and managers, creating high-performing teams and future leaders.
  • Providing recognised expertise in areas such as GenAI Security and Risk management.  

 

Optional: Required certifications, licenses or languages

 

  • Currently working in a major Consulting firm, and/or in industry but having a Consulting background Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions.
  • Experience of proposition building and delivery.
  • Business development – utilising a combination of the organisation’s broader pre-existing relationships, company relationships and your own network, you’ll be generating c.£1m of consulting revenues.

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

Join a practice where you can shape the future of AI and Digital Trust, influence board-level decisions, lead complex transformations, and help build a high-performing, collaborative culture where people are empowered to grow, innovate and make a lasting impact. Grow market-leading offerings, develop future leaders, and accelerate your own journey towards Director and Partner-level leadership, supported by a team that values curiosity, inclusion, continuous learning and collective success.

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

 


We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 


Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 

 

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 

Please opt in during the application process.

CSR:

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 

 


Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Architect to join our growing Employee Experience and HR practice. This role sits at the intersection of technology leadership, client advisory and delivery ownership, helping organisations transform their employee and enterprise service experiences.


You will play a pivotal role in shaping ServiceNow platform strategies, leading end-to-end implementations, and driving high-quality solution design across large-scale transformation programmes.
This is an opportunity to develop from a ServiceNow architect, into a strategic technology leadership role, working with global clients while building your reputation within a leading consulting and transformation organisation.

 

Solution & Architecture Leadership
•    Own the end-to-end architecture and solution design for ServiceNow implementations
•    Produce and maintain technical design documentation, ensuring alignment with client requirements and platform best practices


Engagement & Delivery Ownership
•    Lead end-to-end engagements, including delivery governance and stakeholder management
•    Oversee delivery teams while not being directly responsible for configuration or development


Client advisory and strategy
•    Define ServiceNow platform strategies and roadmaps for customers
•    Act as a technology advisor, guiding; customer leadership teams, programme stakeholders and delivery teams
•    Liaise with ServiceNow representatives and ecosystem partners


Business development
•    Lead responses to RFPs and RFIs, drive proposal development and deliver winning client presentations


What makes this role unique
•    Opportunity to lead high-impact transformation programmes across global enterprises
•    Blend of architecture, advisory, and delivery leadership
•    A clear pathway into senior technology leadership and sector ownership
•    Work within Capgemini’s strong ServiceNow ecosystem and partnerships

 

YOUR PROFILE

Essential experience & certifications
•    ServiceNow certifications at minimum; Certified System Administrator, CIS ITSM, CIS HRSD, CTA / CMA (beneficial)
•    Proven experience working on: 
o    At least one large global / international ServiceNow implementation, OR
o    Multiple end-to-end smaller ServiceNow deployments
•    Deep technical expertise in the ServiceNow platform, across architecture and solution design.
•    Be able to articulate and demonstrate ServiceNow HR / AI features to our customers.


Key traits and capabilities
•    Strong understanding of how technology decisions impact; user experience, operating models, ways of working and transformation delivery (programme and project level)
•    Ability to operate as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders
•     A real desire to transition from hands-on technical delivery into technology leadership and engagement ownership

•    Has strong technical foundations but is moving into (or already in) an architect / leadership role
•    Enjoys engaging with clients, shaping solutions, and influencing strategy
•    Is motivated to build a reputation as a trusted technology leader within a sector

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE:

You will be part of the Employee Experience & HR team, which has a collaborative culture. You will work with a diverse group of talented professionals who are passionate about HR, technology, Employee Experience, AI, and dedicated to delivering exceptional solutions to diverse clients. A team that thrives on creativity and innovation, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible.
We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
 
 
We are a Disability Confident Employer Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
 
· Declare they have a disability, and
· Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

data.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 
The Business Technology practice is one of the leading CIO & CTO advisory and technology innovation teams in the UK and Europe. Our consultants deliver tangible outcomes across business and IT-oriented environments, working collaboratively with major FTSE 100 and government clients to help them achieve their strategic goals and leverage technology as a key driver of sustainable growth and ambitious change. 

YOUR ROLE

Our IT Strategy & Performance team is one of the fastest growing teams in the Business Technology practice. We are structured across three core disciplines: (i) Technology Strategy; (ii) IT Cost & Value; and (iii) IT Mergers and Acquisitions. We are seeking Consultant level candidates with the experience to deliver across our three core disciplines. The ideal candidate will have solid experience in at least one of our disciplines and authentic enthusiasm for developing their breadth of skills and knowledge further. You will have the opportunity to work across a diverse range of sectors and projects. 
The responsibilities of the Consultant role in IT Strategy & Performance typically includes: 
 
  • Client delivery, owning distinct packages of work, self-organising and prioritising your tasks to deliver on client commitments within complex technology engagements. 
  • Building personal credibility with clients through delivery of outcomes and communication. 
  • Identifying and communicating potential leads and preparing proposal and sales materials. 
  • Contributing to the development of our offerings and supporting capability building within the IT Strategy & Performance team as we grow our offers and offer pipelines. 
  • Developing expertise and informed points of view on emerging technologies and digital capabilities: AI, advanced analytics, cybersecurity and cloud-native architectures - evaluating scalability, interoperability, and alignment with the client’s long-term strategy. 
  • Building broad skills across our core disciplines and deepening expertise within at least one.  

 

As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: 
 
  • Business Development – Contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 
 
 

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for Consultant level candidates who can demonstrate the following: 
 
  • Consulting experience across Technology Strategy and/or IT Cost & Value. 
  • Evidence of strong track record delivering within Digital Strategy & Transformation projects and/or technology cost transformation. 
  • Evidence of developing technical and strategic expertise that is relevant to our core disciplines, this may include Technology Strategy, Target Operating Model Design, Transformation Roadmapping, Business-IT Alignment, IT Financial Management, Total Cost of Ownership, Application Portfolio Rationalisation, Benchmarking and Optimisation. 
  •  Experience in identifying real application of technology to drive value from investments. 
 
 
Desirable Experience 
 
  • Proven ability to deliver technology strategy engagements and/or cost and value engagements 
  • Currently working in a consulting firm, and/or in industry with a consulting background or in an internal strategy function.  
  • Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and in supporting business development through preparation of proposals and/or client pitches. 
  • Experience of supporting proposition (offer) building/development and growth.  

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

You’ll be free to make your role and your career what you want it to be.  Proactivity and ambition flourish at Capgemini Invent. There are countless opportunities available to propel your development forward: seek out those that suit you, and we will back you all the way.  In summary, we believe the following make this a great place to work:  
 
 
  • Show how single minds make for better teams:  Work alongside fierce intellects who love to collaborate.  
  • Be comfortable outside your comfort zone:  Self-stretchers thrive in our environment.  
  • Build momentum in your career: Make your role and your career what you want it to be.  
  • Stay true to who you are: Play to your strengths and bring your individuality.  
  • Aim for nothing less than leading edge: We thrive on the knowledge that the Digital work we do has impact.  
  • Give your curiosity freedom and focus:  A place where inquisitiveness and entrepreneurial thinking are encouraged. 

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work. 
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
 
 
 
We are a Disability Confident Employer 
 
Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: 
  • Declare they have a disability, and  
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. 
Please opt in during the application process. 

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing. 
Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice. 
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance. 

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

data.description:
.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

 

Your role:

As part of the huge growth in demand in our Energy Transition & Utilities practice, we are seeking an experienced senior leader to join our highly talented team, working on the pursuit and delivery of major advisory, consulting and transformation services across our sector. 

Our clients within Energy Transition & Utilities include those within the sub-sectors of Energy Networks, Energy Retail, Energy Central Markets, Water and Nuclear. 

Driven by major investment in the sector and the unique position of our Capgemini Invent business, we are seeing a significant increase in demand for our services and teams.  Our vast utilities experience, strong strategic and business transformation skillset, a deep understanding of digital, data and a highly collaborative approach has allowed us to build a successful track record of delivering leading edge consulting services and solutions for our clients. 

This role is designed to further expand and strengthen our position in this market. As a Director within Capgemini Invent’s Energy Networks team, you’ll help set the direction, drive forward the business, own senior client relationships, take a leading role in orchestration across our business, model our values and behaviours and coach and develop junior members of the team.  You will combine deep energy networks sector expertise with strong consulting skills, leading client engagements and supporting the expansion of our client base across electricity and gas transmission and distribution networks. Specifically, you will deliver activities that form part of the following categories: 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, proposition development, opportunity pursuits, account plans, client presentations, client hosting at events, expert panels. 
  • Project Delivery – Leading engagements with our clients and delivering them with quality, on time and on budget.
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 

 

Your profile:

We’d love to meet someone with: 

  • Significant experience gained within Consulting within the Energy & Utilities sector, including with one or many of electricity and gas transmission and distribution network businesses. 
  • Exceptional consulting skills, meaning experience of working in a major Consulting firm, and/or in industry but with a Consulting background.
  • Experience of proposition building and delivery, with a track record of building and leading high-performing teams.
  • Deep understanding of sector trends, regulatory environment, and the challenges facing UK energy networks. 
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, proactive, and able to work independently as well as in teams. 
  • Commitment to personal and team development, with a passion for coaching and mentoring others. 
  • Flexibility to travel and work at client sites as required. 

You will bring subject matter experience, expertise and intellectual capital across a broad range of advisory, consulting and transformation services in the energy networks sector, which may include all or some of: 

  • Corporate strategy, business planning and regulatory advisory services.
  • Business and IT operating model, restructuring and performance improvement.
  • Large scale business transformation and programme delivery, across areas including system operation, asset management, capital infrastructure, operations, customer, cyber and workforce.
  • Design and deployment of digital transformation and AI solutions and services.
  • Emerging business and digital trends in energy networks, such as intelligent system operations, IoT, advanced analytics, mobile applications, automation, energy management, digital twin and BIM.

 

What you'll love about working here:

The energy transition is a generation-defining challenge. But we believe it’s not just what it averts, but what it enables in our economy and society, that matters. We envision a world in which energy is clean, affordable and abundant, powering a new wave of industrial growth and social opportunity. 

The energy industry’s transition to clean energy is a fundamental enabler for every other industry’s ability to reach net-zero.  The transition also provides a huge opportunity to positively impact the human side of business: deeper customer relationships, consumer perception and talent attraction. 

Helping energy and utilities organisations to harness the vast economic and societal potential of the energy transition and build a better future is our passion and purpose. 

 

Need to know:

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

CSR:

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

 

 

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 

Make it real. | www.capgemini.com
