data.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

In this role you will play a key role in:

Solution Delivery & Adoption: Driving delivery of Microsoft Business Applications (Dynamics 365 & Power Platform) by delivering tailored solutions.
 
Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:Engaging users, stakeholders, and decision-makers to understand requirements, communicate complex technical information, and align solutions with business value.
 
Project Management & Agile Execution:Leading project planning and delivery using Agile methodologies, tracking progress, managing risks, and ensuring strategic alignment.
 
Client-Centric Approach:Demonstrating passion for client success, striving for excellence, and proactively managing stakeholder relationships to enhance collaboration.
 
Strategic& Innovative Thinking: Applying innovation practices to design solutions that are feasible, viable, desirable, and sustainable, while delivering impactful strategic presentations.
 
 
 
As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:
 
Business Development
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to understand client business needs and provide expert solutions that shape deals.
  • Supporting solution development, including providing input into staffing, skill requirements, and functional ideation throughout the client delivery lifecycle.
 
Client Advisory and Delivery
  • Lead client meetings to advise on business and technology solution strategies, mapping business value to LCNC adoption.
  • Engage users, stakeholders, and decision makers to understand requirements and design feasible, viable, and sustainable LCNC solutions.
  • Lead project planning and delivery using agile methodologies, managing risks, and delivering quality oversight throughout the lifecycle.
  • Communicate business value through design and delivery artifacts for managers and steering committees, maintaining strong executive-level stakeholder relationships.
 
Innovation and Capability Development
  • Implement LCNC solutions (preferably Power Platform) with advanced analysis skills to provide reliable solutions and estimates.
  • Contribute to the growth of the LCNC technology community and advocate for Microsoft Business Applications to inspire clients.
  • Identify opportunities to accelerate the adoption of LCNC solutions and continuously develop expertise through training and certifications.
  • Stay informed of the competitive technology landscape and assess the feasibility of deploying LCNC solutions on various platforms.
 
 
Operational Excellence
  • Ensuring capacity, skills, and availability are maintained proactively.
  • Contributing to practice development, including operations, recruitment, and team activities.
  • Completing operational tasks with accuracy and timeliness to support smooth execution.

YOUR PROFILE

Security Clearance
 
All candidates must hold active UK Security Clearance due to the nature of the project.
 
 
 
Business and Methods
  • 3+ years’ experience in consulting or relevant business advisory.
  • Demonstrates a functional expertise in LCNC technology, business processes, and cloud deployment.
  • Experience in managing client relationships and delivering effective reporting to ensure client satisfaction.
  • Proven ability to apply strategy and innovation to solve complex, analytical, and technical problems.
 
Capgemini Invent DNA
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, coach peers, and drive team cohesion.
  • Passion for continuous learning and a desire to develop expertise in workplace technologies.
  • Drive performance and continuous improvement within the organization.
 
Leadership
  • Ability to lead and mentor teams, taking responsibility for performance and development.
  • Confidence in delivering high-quality presentations to senior business and technology leaders.
  • Proven experience in client relationship management and delivering successful outcomes.
 
Technical
  • Strong technical certifications in LCNC technologies (Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot, Azure).
  • Demonstration of technical expertise in the latest trends like Generative AI and understanding of technology risks.
  • Experience with cloud environments, particularly Azure and integration with Microsoft Business Applications.
 
Certification and Experience
  • Professional degree (Masters-level or above) in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or Business.
  • Delivery Management certifications such as Scrum, Agile, Change Management, or Project Management.
  • UK government security clearance (BPSS or SC) preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE:

We are a rapidly growing team who places our people and values at the heart of how we do business. You are joining a technology and innovation powerhouse with a focus on helping our clients bring to life the vision of an empowered digital workplace by applying various Microsoft Business Applications technologies (Dynamics 365 and Power Platform).

You will help clients to achieve a more connected, end-to-end employee experience to unlock their creativity and productivity so that they can achieve outcomes faster. We build trusted relationships with our clients and partners, combining empathy and pragmatism, and ensuring that we help organisations embed sustainability and social value in their solutions.

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
 
Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
 
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

data.description:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. With over 2,300 inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. The AI & Digital Workplace tribe within our Business Technology practice empowers clients to redefine how work gets done – transforming collaboration, productivity, and employee experience through AI and digital technology, and organisational change. We work at the intersection of people, processes, and platforms to drive sustainable behavioural and cultural shifts. 

 

We help clients move beyond technology deployment to workforce transformation. Drawing on deep expertise in change management and AI strategy, we help organisations accelerate adoption of frontier AI such as Anthropic’s Claude, realise measurable business value and build sustainable AI-enabled ways of working. 

YOUR ROLE

As Claude Strategy, Change & Adoption Consultant you will help our clients set the strategic direction for Anthropic’s Claude in the workplace, and then make it land. You will pair technology strategy with the change, communications and adoption craft needed to turn Anthropic's Claude into everyday productivity and a genuinely AI-enabled workforce. In this role you will play a key part in: 

 

  • Setting the Claude adoption strategy: Shaping a clear strategic vision for Claude in the enterprise – spanning Claude Chat, Cowork and Claude Code, and the projects, skills and connectors that make them useful – aligned to security, data and automation capabilities. 
  • Driving adoption: Designing and delivering user-centric change and adoption campaigns at scale that tackle AI scepticism, build capability and embed new ways of working. 
  • Proving the value: Helping define value KPIs and track benefits from pilot to enterprise scale, so each wave of investment is backed by evidence from the last. 
  • Leading complex engagements: Owning delivery excellence on Claude strategy and adoption workstreams, escalating and de-risking complex situations as the technology evolves. 
  • Growing the practice: Helping develop the Claude portfolio and client relationships to generate new opportunities and revenue, and coaching colleagues towards high performance and a positive culture. 

As part of your role, you will also be expected to drive the following activities: 

 

Client Advisory and Delivery 

  • Strategy and Vision: Develop AI workforce transformation strategies, advising senior stakeholders on Claude’s capabilities, adoption strategy across workforce groups and business functions, business change requirements, and opportunities to create value through AI-enabled ways of working. 
  • Ways of Working Reinvention: Lead work redesign initiatives that use AI to enhance productivity, employee experience and organisational outcomes through future-state practices, AI-enabled workflows and effective human-AI collaboration. Facilitate workshops to understand current and future ways of working. 
  • Change and Adoption: Drive organisational change and adoption projects from pilot-to-scale that enable successful Claude deployment through communications, training, engagement, leadership alignment and persona-led adoption plans. Tackle AI scepticism and respond to concerns to increase trust. 
  • Training and Facilitation: Design and deliver the enablement sessions, from foundational training on Claude Chat through to hands-on labs on Cowork projects, skills and connectors, and Claude Code for technical teams. 
  • Community and Sustainment: Stand up champion networks, reusable skill and prompt libraries, and onboarding assets that sustain adoption as the Claude estate and feature set evolve. Be innovative! 
  • Benefits Tracking and Value Realisation: Support value measurement across the programme.  
  • Senior Stakeholder Engagement: Drive executive engagement and value communications activities, helping senior stakeholders communicate the vision for AI, demonstrate outcomes and align business and technology leaders around Claude adoption. 

 

In summary you will be required to: 

  1. Drive client workshops and transformation workstreams. 
  2. Manage small consulting teams and workstreams. 
  3. Develop high-quality client deliverables and recommendations. 
  4. Facilitate discussions with business, technology and change stakeholders. 
  5. Translate complex AI concepts into practical business outcomes. 
  6. Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders. 

 

Capability Development 

  • Inspire clients with thought-leadership on AI and Claude trends for the workplace, and opportunities to direct their investment towards transformative work – led by ethical principles. 
  • Contribute to inventing new frameworks that map the benefits, adoption and productivity metrics of frontier AI to business outcomes, continuously strengthening the AI business case. 
  • Drive experimentation on Claude adoption approaches to explore new ways to serve our clients and stay at the forefront of innovation. 
  • Identify opportunities to accelerate your team’s upskilling in Claude, investing in new training and certifications to keep pace with the technology. 
  • Stay informed of competing technologies and assess the feasibility of deploying Generative and Agentic AI solutions such as Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini. 

 

Business Development 

  • Support responses to bids, RFPs, RFIs and proposals, embedding the required governance to meet deadlines and quality. 
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Capgemini to understand client needs and shape new deals with expert solutions. 
  • Drive solution development, including input into staffing, skill requirements and functional ideation across the delivery lifecycle. 
  • Contribute to the development of our enterprise Claude propositions and the supporting value cases. 

YOUR PROFILE

Capgemini Invent DNA 

  • Highly collaborative, able to expand your network within Capgemini to promote the Workplace AI offerings whilst advocating for other teams’ capabilities to your clients. 
  • A passion for continuous learning and a willingness to develop those around you – both clients and colleagues. 
  • Drive performance and continuous improvement, inspiring and celebrating a culture of boldness. 

 

Leadership 

  • Getting buy-in and aligning senior business and technical leaders on the benefits of AI technology, using strong communication, presentation and analytical skills. 
  • Ability to build, grow and coach cross-functional teams, driving cohesion and contributing to the wellbeing of your people. 
  • Upholding strong ethical values, consistently making the conscious choice to ‘do the right thing’ in business and in leading your team. 

 

Business and Methods 

  • Ability to shape and convey compelling storytelling around our Workplace AI offers and the business value on offer. 
  • Proven experience designing and delivering change, communications and adoption at scale, with tangible behavioural results and the numeracy to evidence them. 
  • Proven experience applying strategy and innovation approaches to solve complex, analytical and technical business problems. 
  • Confidence designing and facilitating training and workshops for audiences ranging from graduates to executives, in person and remotely. 
  • Strong project management skills, well-versed in agile principles, and confident managing timelines, budgets and resources. 

 

Technical

  • Relevant technology certifications are nice to have (e.g. Anthropic’s Claude certifications, Microsoft). 
  • Hands-on experience with Generative and Agentic AI solutions, Claude in particular.

Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. Your Wellbeing

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

You will have the freedom to express your ideas to your colleagues who are attentive to your ideas and viewpoints. This is encouraged as that’s what makes us an innovative workplace. Hence, one of our key values is ‘Boldness’.

 

Regular Promotion Cycles

· Declare they have a disability, and
· Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

CSR

data.description:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. With over 2,300 inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. The AI & Digital Workplace tribe within our Business Technology practice empowers clients to redefine how work gets done – transforming collaboration, productivity, and employee experience through AI and digital technology, and organisational change. We work at the intersection of people, processes, and platforms to drive sustainable behavioural and cultural shifts. 

 

We help clients move beyond technology deployment to workforce transformation. Drawing on deep expertise in change management and AI strategy, we help organisations accelerate adoption of frontier AI such as Anthropic’s Claude, realise measurable business value and build sustainable AI-enabled ways of working. 

YOUR ROLE

As Claude Strategy & Governance Consultant you will help our clients set the strategic direction for Anthropic’s Claude in the workplace and, critically, define the governance and cost control that lets them scale it safely. You will operate at the intersection of technology strategy, operating model design, FinOps and AI governance, translating a fast-moving product roadmap into decisions senior leaders can trust. In this role you will play a key part in: 

  • Setting the Claude strategy: Shaping a clear strategic vision for Claude in the enterprise – spanning Claude Chat, Cowork and Claude Code, and the projects, skills and connectors that make them useful – aligned to security, data and automation capabilities, and to the Microsoft estate many clients run alongside it. 
  • Defining the license to operate model: Designing the governance frameworks, guardrails and ‘licence to operate’ models that give clients the confidence to deploy Claude at pace, and applying them in practice. 
  • Building the cost and value picture: Helping build the consumption model, token allowances and benefits tracking that keep spend defensible and prove the return. 
  • Leading complex engagements: Leading complex engagements: Owning delivery excellence on Claude strategy and governance workstreams, escalating and de-risking complex situations as the technology evolves. 
  • Growing the practice: Helping develop the Claude portfolio and client relationships to generate new opportunities and revenue, and coaching colleagues towards high performance and a positive culture. 

As part of your role, you will also be expected to drive the following activities: 

 

Client Advisory and Delivery 

  • Strategy and Vision: Support AI strategy and transformation engagements, helping organisations develop roadmaps, identify workforce productivity opportunities, define future operating models and prioritise investments in frontier AI capabilities. Translate a fast-moving Claude roadmap (Cowork, Claude Code, skills, connectors and managed agents) into advice on what to prioritise, sequence, pilot or hold. 
  • Deployment Pathways: Advise on the enterprise deployment routes for Claude and the trade-offs each carries. Set the options out clearly, with the rationale, so senior stakeholders can decide. 
  • Licensing and Token Management: Advise on Claude commercial models and licence allocation. Help build the consumption model that makes this affordable at scale, and the FinOps routine of reporting, forecasting and right-sizing. 
  • Operating Model: Design and implement AI operating models that define how organisations govern, support and scale Claude adoption at pace and securely, establishing clear ownership, decision rights, accountabilities and service management structures across the enterprise. 
  • Governance Frameworks: Define and implement enterprise AI governance and licence-to-operate frameworks that enable safe, scalable adoption of Claude through effective oversight, responsible AI practices, risk management and compliance guardrails. 
  • Governance in Practice: Operationalise governance so it is lived rather than shelved – standing up governance forums, control gates, approval processes for models, connectors and skills, and the monitoring and review cadences that keep pace as the estate grows. Advise on how this is administered day to day, covering organisation and workspace structure, single sign-on and provisioning, roles and permissions, data retention, and the audit and usage reporting that feeds governance. 
  • Value Definition and Benefits Tracking: Help define value up front and then track it. 
  • Senior Stakeholder Engagement: Drive executive engagement and value communications activities, helping senior stakeholders communicate the vision for AI, demonstrate outcomes and align business, technology and risk leaders around Claude adoption. 

 

In summary you will be required to: 

  1. Drive client workshops and transformation workstreams. 
  2. Manage small consulting teams and workstreams. 
  3. Develop high-quality client deliverables and recommendations. 
  4. Facilitate discussions with business, technology and change stakeholders. 
  5. Translate complex AI concepts into practical business outcomes. 
  6. Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders. 

Capability Development 

  • Inspire clients with thought-leadership on AI and Claude trends for the workplace, and opportunities to direct their investment towards transformative work – led by ethical principles. 
  • Contribute to inventing new frameworks that map the benefits and metrics of frontier AI to business outcomes, continuously strengthening the AI business case. 
  • Contribute to defining governance and standards for scaling AI-led technology across the different legal and compliance boundaries of global Private and Public Sector organisations. 
  • Identify opportunities to accelerate your team’s upskilling in Claude, investing in new training and certifications to keep pace with the technology. 
  • Stay informed of competing technologies and assess the feasibility of deploying Generative and Agentic AI solutions such as Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot and Google Gemini. 

 

Business Development 

  • Support responses to bids, RFPs, RFIs and proposals, embedding the required governance to meet deadlines and quality. 
  • Collaborate with stakeholders across Capgemini to understand client needs and shape new deals with expert solutions. 
  • Drive solution development, including input into staffing, skill requirements and functional ideation across the delivery lifecycle. 
  • Contribute to the development of our enterprise Claude propositions and the supporting value cases. 

YOUR PROFILE

Capgemini Invent DNA 

  • Highly collaborative, able to expand your network within Capgemini to promote the Workplace AI offering whilst advocating for other teams’ capabilities to your clients. 
  • A passion for continuous learning and a willingness to develop those around you – both clients and colleagues. 
  • Drive performance and continuous improvement, inspiring and celebrating a culture of boldness. 

 

Leadership 

  • Ease engaging senior stakeholders – including risk, security and compliance leaders – to influence investment decisions and champion the right governance posture. 
  • Ability to build, grow and coach cross-functional teams, driving cohesion and contributing to the wellbeing of your people. 
  • Upholding strong ethical values, consistently making the conscious choice to ‘do the right thing’ in business and in leading your team. 

 

Business and Methods 

  • Ability to shape and convey compelling storytelling around our Workplace AI and Claude offer and the business value on offer. 
  • A track record of overseeing and delivering digital transformation, with tangible results and benefits for clients. 
  • Proven experience applying strategy and innovation approaches to solve complex, analytical and technical business problems. 
  • Commercial and numerical confidence, contributing to cost models, consumption forecasts and benefit cases that stand up to scrutiny. 
  • Some experience securing, tracking and growing a consulting sales pipeline across multiple accounts and markets. 

 

Technical 

  • Working understanding of Claude across Claude Chat, Cowork and Claude Code, including projects, skills and connectors (MCP), sufficient to build credibility with senior client stakeholders and to judge what needs governing, plus awareness of Microsoft Copilot for the many clients running both. 
  • Understanding of how Claude is deployed and run in a large enterprise: the pathways available (first-party through Anthropic, or via AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud or Microsoft Foundry) and the trade-offs each carries, alongside organisation and workspace structure, single sign-on, roles and permissions, data retention, and how allowances, spend limits and reporting are used to manage consumption. 
  • Practical grasp of AI governance – responsible AI, data protection and permissions, agent lifecycle and risk management – and how to design and apply governance frameworks in a large enterprise. 
  • Understanding of the ethical considerations of AI, how it can be affected by human bias, and techniques to address this. 

 

Certification and Experience 

  • Professional degree (Bachelor’s level or above). 
  • Relevant technology certifications are nice to have (e.g. Anthropic’s Claude certifications, Microsoft). 
  • Hands-on experience with Generative and Agentic AI solutions, Claude in particular. 
  • Experience governing, administering or cost-managing another enterprise AI platform (for example Microsoft 365 Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise or Codex) is also valuable. 
  • UK government security clearance (BPSS or SC) preferred, given our Public Sector work. 
  • Currently working in a consulting firm, with at least 4 years of consulting experience.

data.description:
Who You'll Be Working With

 

As a DataOps Engineer at Capgemini, you will help teams build, run, and continuously improve modern data platforms so they are reliable, secure, and easy to change. You will work across engineering and operations to automate delivery, improve data pipeline observability, and embed good governance so analytics and AI workloads can run at scale.


You will be part of the Data Platforms team that sits within the Insights and Data Global Practice. Data Platforms is home to Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and Solution Architects who help our clients deliver and operate cloud data platforms on AWS, Azure and GCP, including technologies such as Databricks and Snowflake. As a DataOps Engineer, you will partner closely with engineering and delivery teams to standardise ways of working, improve data application reliability, and enable safe, repeatable releases.

 

Please Note: 

 

Security Clearance: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC)clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

The Focus Of Your Role

 

As a DataOps Engineer, you will develop and deliver secure, automated and operational solutions across a variety of public sector client systems. You will provide hands-on technical expertise to architect and deliver DataOps capabilities, with a focus on delivering data applications in an automated approach. You will also implement and manage comprehensive monitoring and observability solutions to ensure data quality across the entire data flow, including supporting delivery in air-gapped and other restricted environments.

 

  • Delivering data applications in an automated and continuous fashion. 
  • Utilising tools like Airflow for orchestration and automating data pipeline deployments using DevOps tools and techniques (Docker, Containers, Terraform, Kubernetes)
  • Building data pipelines using both cloud-native and open-source data tools to deliver self-contained data processing applications. 
  • Understanding of data architecture principles and applying this to your delivery work.
  • To be comfortable working in air-gapped development environments and deploying in classified environments.

What You'll Bring

 

You will bring strong DataOps experience delivering secure and automated delivery capabilities in complex, regulated environments. A key differentiator in this role is your ability to focus on the application of containerisation within a data context, rather than the low-level management of the container platform itself. You will be comfortable translating client needs into practical technical designs and then building and operating them, with a focus on repeatability, assurance and continuous improvement. You will communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and be confident providing technical direction.


Key skills required:

 

  • DataOps
  • Proficiency in data pipeline orchestration tools
  • Containerisation (Docker, EKS, AKS, Kubernetes)
  • Proficiency in CI/CD principles and tools
  • Familiarity with open-source data tools (e.g., Spark, Kafka, PostgreSQL)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible)
  • Air-gapped development
  • Automation
  • Client / stakeholder management
  • Public sector domain understanding
  • Technical architecture


Experience:

 

  • You will have significant experience as a DataOps Engineer delivering DataOps solutions in public sector or similarly regulated environments.
  • Developing, orchestrating and maintaining data pipelines using tools like Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.
  • Containerising data applications using Docker and deploying them to Container Platforms (EKS, AKS and Kubernetes).
  • Implementing CI/CD pipelines for data applications.
  • Monitoring and troubleshooting data pipelines and applications.
  • Working with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) to provision and manage data infrastructure within pre-existing platforms.
  • Optimising data processing for performance and scalability.
  • Any relevant certifications are beneficial (e.g. Kubernetes, cloud platform, DataOps).
  • Experience delivering in restricted/air-gapped and classified environments, and confident engaging clients and stakeholders while contributing to technical architecture and design decisions.

Additional Information

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

What we’ll offer you 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Why we’re different 

At Capgemini, we help organisations across the world become more agile, more competitive, and more successful. Smart, tailored, often ground-breaking technical solutions to complex problems are the norm. But so, too, is a culture that’s as collaborative as it is forward thinking. Working closely with each other, and with our clients, we get under the skin of businesses and to the heart of their goals. You will too.
 
Capgemini is proud to represent nearly 130 nationalities and its cultural diversity. Our holistic definition of diversity extends beyond gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, race, age, and religion. Capgemini views diversity as everything that makes us who we are as an organization, including our social background, our experiences in life and work, our communication styles and even our personality. These dimensions contribute to the type of diversity we value the most: diversity of thought.

data.description:
Who You'll Be Working With

 

You will join the Data Trust Capability in Capgemini’s Insights and Data (I&D) business unit. Insights and Data is a global business unit covering Enterprise Data Management, Cloud Platforms, Enterprise Content Management and AI & Analytics. 

Our team is one of the largest and most successful Data Management teams in the UK delivering innovative Data Management and Governance thought leadership to our clients.

The Enterprise Data Management provides services on Information Strategy, Data Governance, Master Data Management, Data Architecture, Data Migration and Lifecycle Management. 

We help our clients build an enterprise-class data platform that allows them to move ahead in their journey of data and insights. Primarily working with leading software vendors like SAP, Informatica, IBM, Oracle et al, the team are first and foremost Consultants, putting client requirements and industry best practices at the heart of delivery.

PLEASE NOTE:

Security Clearence: To be successfully appointed to this role, must be eligible to obtain Security Check (SC)clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

The Focus Of Your Role

 

We are seeking delivery-focused individual with strong client-facing experience to drive business analysis for our client businesses. You will often act as a conduit into our client and take the lead in driving data issue resolution, enlisting the support of the relevant Business Owners, Data Stewards and other technical forum members, as required, by providing Data Management expertise and guidance.

 

The Business Analyst will be responsible for shaping business processes and requirements, assisting solution design, and contribute to delivery of enterprise scale data management, compliance, risk, and security solutions. This role ensures our clients maximise the value of their data estate while maintaining compliance with regulatory and internal requirements.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Work closely with Business and Technology teams across clients to define, analyse and implement changes.
  • Lead business analysis activities including process definition, requirement elicitation documentation and validation.
  • Shape and articulate clear business, functional, and non-functional requirements.
  • Assist client leads in understanding the scope of their data initiatives.
  • Produce high-quality documentation, results and findings.
  • Raise key issues and risks in a timely manner to the Project Manager/Delivery Lead
  • Liaise with different levels of the hierarchy, especially with Development Leads, Quantitative Analytics teams and Risk Managers
  • Assess feasibility, risks, and data readiness for AI/ML/GenAI opportunities
  • Work with data owners, stewards and architects to identify required data sources, understand data lineage and constraints
  • Ensure requirements include data quality, metadata and governance needs (e.g. definitions, business rules, reference data, retention)
  • Contribute to and consume business glossaries, ontologies and data catalogues to ensure consistent terminology and understanding
  • Help ensure AI use cases comply with data privacy, security and regulatory requirements (e.g. GDPR, sector specific rules),
  • Translate business needs into requirements for AI/analytics solutions (e.g. decision support, predictions, recommendations, GenAI copilots).
  • Work with data scientists / engineers / AI teams to define test scenarios and acceptance criteria that reflect business reality (e.g. edge cases, thresholds for “good enough” accuracy).
  • Follow best practices, as defined by the team standards; ensuring that documentation is complete, comprehensive and signed off
  • Assist with the prioritisation and planning of key deliverables
  • Work in an agile manner whilst still understanding the needs of planning and forecasting the overall delivery
  • Demonstrate strong stakeholder Management, leadership, decision-making and Problem-Solving skills.


You may also offer insights to the wider community through blogs, articles and social media.


At Capgemini, we believe in bringing your whole self to work. Equity, diversity, and inclusion are woven into our everyday culture, creating a welcoming and supportive environment for everyone.

What You'll Bring

 

As a Business Analyst, you will have 7-10+ years in business analyst roles across data, security, compliance, or cloud platforms, with proven experience delivering enterprise scale solutions. You’ll have a strong background in data management and data security/governance programmes.

 

Experience & Core Capabilities:

  • Ability to delve deep into a topic/requirement, analyse the impact and provide solutions
  • Ability to assimilate information quickly and provide recommendation to support informed decision-making
  • Ability to use own initiative to resolve issues/ investigate and find solutions
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation communication skills
  • Experience in working with cross-region teams and projects
  • Ability to guide medium sized teams.
  • Experience in delivering projects using an Agile methodology
  • Strong understanding of data concepts: data quality, master/reference data, metadata, lineage, governance.
  • Ability to interpret outputs from analytics, dashboards and models, and challenge them from a business perspective.


“Must-have” BA skills:

  • Requirements elicitation for functional and non-functional requirements
  • Business Process analysis, modelling and mapping
  • Strong stakeholder management
  • Experience with Waterfall, Agile, Scrum methodologies
  • Communication & consulting skills
  • Experience in data-driven project
  • Cross-industry functional knowledge
  • Full delivery lifecycle experience: elicitation, design, build, testing, business change, operational support
  • Familiarity with AI and machine learning concepts (e.g. supervised vs unsupervised learning, prediction vs classification, model drift, basic evaluation metrics).
  • Comfortable working with requirements / modelling tools (BPMN, UML, user story tools, backlog management)
  • Experience eliciting and documenting data privacy, security and regulatory requirements
  • Understanding of access controls, data minimisation, and appropriate use of data in AI systems
  • Strong stakeholder management – able to bridge business, data, architecture and engineering worlds
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions about AI (“shiny object syndrome”) and focusing on value, feasibility and risk


“Good-to-have” skills:

  • BA/SCRUM/PM qualifications
  • Master Data Management, data governance, data modelling exposure
  • Tools: JIRA, Confluence, etc.
  • Experience working on projects that use AI, ML or advanced analytics – ideally from discovery through to adoption.
  • Experience collaborating around BI/analytics tools (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
  • Exposure to AI platforms (e.g. Azure OpenAI / other LLM services, data science environments, MLOps platforms) – as a partner/user rather than a builder

Additional Info

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

What we’ll offer you 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Why we’re different 

At Capgemini, we help organisations across the world become more agile, more competitive, and more successful. Smart, tailored, often ground-breaking technical solutions to complex problems are the norm. But so, too, is a culture that’s as collaborative as it is forward thinking. Working closely with each other, and with our clients, we get under the skin of businesses and to the heart of their goals. You will too.
 
Capgemini is proud to represent nearly 130 nationalities and its cultural diversity. Our holistic definition of diversity extends beyond gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, race, age, and religion. Capgemini views diversity as everything that makes us who we are as an organization, including our social background, our experiences in life and work, our communication styles and even our personality. These dimensions contribute to the type of diversity we value the most: diversity of thought.

data.description:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.  

 

In a world of globalisation and constant innovation organisations are creating, consuming, and transforming unprecedented volumes of data. We endeavour to work alongside our clients to extract and leverage key insights driven by our Data Science and Analytics expertise and capabilities. It’s an exciting time to join our Data Science Team as we grow together to keep up with client demand and launch offerings to the market. In your role, you will partner with our clients to deliver outcomes through the application of cutting-edge data science methods. 

YOUR ROLE

In this position you will play a key part in:

  • Supporting and leading the delivery of our Agentic & Gen AI, Data Science and Analytics projects and working closely with your colleagues, ensure Client expectations are met at all stages.
  • Inspiring our clients on exploiting the potential of Agentic & Gen AI, data science and analytics in their businesses through demonstrations.
  • Developing and deploying new skills in the fields of AI, Data Science and Analytics, with support from your colleagues, to ensure that current methods are used where appropriate.
  • Delivering work in a structured, efficient manner, balancing creativity with practicality, while collaborating effectively with your team to meet client standards and internal quality expectations at pace.

As part of your role, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: 

Business Development – Contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 

Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 

Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

We’d love to meet someone with:

  • Experience in working within the fields of Agentic & Gen AI, Data Science and Analytics in a client-facing environment, with a proven track record of successfully delivered work across the ML lifecycle and a strong foundation in statistical modelling, natural language processing, time-series analysis, spatial analysis, and mathematical modelling methodologies.
  • Keen to demonstrate the potential that Agentic & Gen AI has to offer to unlock business value.
  • A desire to provide solutions to the real-world issues and challenges with data that our clients face regularly. Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills, with experience in enabling clients to better understand and derive better value and insights from their data.
  • Currently working in a Consulting firm, and/or in industry.


Your Technical Expertise:

  • Architectural and/or feature knowledge of one or more of the listed Data and AI Platforms: Google Cloud Platform, Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, and Databricks.
  • Experience in one or more of the listed Languages such as: Python, R, PySpark
  • Experience in one or more of the following Agentic & Gen AI Platforms: such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Adept AI, UiPath, OpenAI GPT-5 Agents, Orby AI, and Beam AI.

Eligibility:

Due to security clearance requirements, there is a strong preference for candidates who have resided in the UK for more than 5 years.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

Data Science Consulting brings an inventive quantitative approach to our clients’ biggest business and data challenges to unlock tangible business value by delivering intelligent data products and solutions through rapid innovation leveraging AI. We strive to be acknowledged as innovative and industry leading data science professionals and seek to achieve this by focusing on three area of the data science lifecycle: 

 

Exploring the art of the possible with AI by combining domain knowledge and AI expertise to identify opportunities across industries and functions where AI can deliver value and by shaping AI/ML roadmaps, and ideation using use cases aligned with data science and business strategies. 

Accelerating impact with AI by enabling proof of value through prototypes and by translating complex AI concepts into practical solutions that democratise access and maximise business advantage for our clients. 

Scaling AI from lab to live by defining and implementing responsible AI design principles throughout the AI journey and establishing sustainable, resilient, and scalable AI/ML Ops architectures and platforms for integrating AI products and solutions into business processes for real-time decision making. 

 

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page 

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work. 

 

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.  

Make it real. | www.capgemini.com 

WE'RE A DISABILITY CONFIDENT EMPLOYER

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

About the job you're considering

The ServiceNow Platform Developer is a technical and hands-on configuration role within Digital CustomerExperience’s (DCX) Business Technology practice in the UK. This role focuses on building and deployment ofServiceNow solutions to enhance Customer Experience, Technology Experience, and Employee Experience.


You will work under the guidance of senior consultants and architects to contribute to the development ofworkflow applications, integrations, and user experiences that drive operational efficiency and usersatisfaction.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your Role

As a ServiceNow Developer at Capgemini, your responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

  • Developing solutions for Customer Experience, Technology Experience and employee ExperienceServiceNow workflow applications, including HR Service Delivery (HRSD) Customer Service Portal, ITService Management (ITSM), Customer Service Management (CSM), Java Script/Angular, Now Assist,Gen-AI and Workflow Data Fabric.
  • Utilising ServiceNow’s Experience Layer components to build modern, intuitive user interfaces.
  • Using UI Builder and Service Portal to deliver role-based dashboards and customised workflows thatmeet client-specific requirements.
  • Understanding customer journey mapping and what drives excellent experiences in marketing, sales, andcommerce, including personalization, omnichannel engagement, and seamless transaction processes.
  • Leverage ServiceNow solutions to enable proactive support, real-time analytics, and integrated workflowsthat meet evolving customer demand.
  • Work closely with senior team members and cross-functional stakeholders (IT, HR, Customer Service).

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Proven experience with the ServiceNow platform, focusing on Customer Experience, TechnologyExperience, and Employee Experience workflows.
  • Good understanding of customer journey optimisation, including touchpoints in marketing, sales, andcommerce.
  • Strong knowledge of employee lifecycle touchpoints, such as onboarding, daily productivity, and careerdevelopment.
  • Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and ServiceNow-specific tools like Glide API, Flow Designer, andIntegrationHub.
  • Expertise in integrating ServiceNow with external systems to create end-to-end workflows.
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and work effectively with diverse teams.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and deliver innovative solutions.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your Security Clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdomfor the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility suchas, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about yourcitizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

  • You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations throughtechnology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with aunique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across theUK.
  • You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration fromyour teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community ofexperts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When youjoin Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneursand industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together,we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain theexperiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharingknowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills tohelp our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, butmaking the world a better place rarely is.

We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Join our AI Strategy team and be part of the future of AI consulting. We are redefining how organisations adopt and scale AI by embedding Generative AI, agentic systems, and copilots into every aspect of how they operate, compete, and create value. 

We are looking for experienced Strategy and AI leaders with strong commercial acumen, individuals who understand AI technologies and can translate them into enterprise-wide transformation. You will lead engagements from strategy through to execution, enabling the shift toward AI-enabled enterprises whilst contributing to the growth of our AI Strategy practice. 

YOUR ROLE

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, innovation, and delivery, perfect for someone who thrives on solving complex problems. From Agentic AI in risk governance, to AI sovereignty in enterprise architecture, to enabling the AI-empowered workforce of tomorrow, you’ll be working at the cutting edge of what’s next.   

WE REDEFINE AI ASSURANCE - You will design, implement, and continuously enhance AI assurance frameworks that address AI-specific risks across the lifecycle, including fairness, safety, transparency, explainability, privacy, security, robustness, accountability, and regulatory compliance.  

WE PINPOINT AI RISK – You will lead and support AI risk, impact, and control assessments, ensuring AI systems are evaluated for business, operational, ethical, legal, regulatory, and societal risks, particularly in high-risk or regulated environments.  

WE EMBED AI RISK MANAGEMENT- You will integrate AI risk management and assurance activities throughout the end-to-end AI lifecycle (1st line of assurance), from use case selection and design through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, change management, and retirement.  

WE BUILD TRUSTED AI – You will work closely with product, engineering, data science, security, privacy, legal, and compliance teams to ensure AI solutions are designed, developed, and operated in accordance with organisational risk appetite and regulatory expectations, incorporating appropriate controls throughout the AI lifecycle.  

WE ENSURE AI PERFORMANCE - You will define requirements for ongoing monitoring, performance validation, drift detection, incident management, and post-deployment assurance activities to ensure AI systems remain effective, safe, and compliant over time.  

YOUR PROFILE

As a member of the Data & AI Strategy Team you’ll be part of the future of AI consulting. We look for individuals who align with our core values, are creative problem solvers, and have a genuine interest in AI and emerging technologies. You’ll be passionate about helping organisations unlock the potential of AI not just through technical delivery, but by driving strategic change. 

Below some of the key skills and experiences we look for in candidates. We don't expect you to hit every point- we want to build a team which has diverse backgrounds, perspectives and strengths.  

  

Key Skills 

AI Risk Management & Assurance - Demonstrable experience assessing, managing and assuring risks associated with AI systems, including model performance, transparency, explainability, accountability, privacy, security and regulatory compliance 

AI Governance & Lifecycle Management - Experience embedding governance, risk management and assurance activities across the end-to-end AI lifecycle, from use case selection and design through deployment, monitoring, change management and retirement 

Risk & Control Assessments - Proven ability to conduct AI risk assessments, impact assessments, control evaluations and assurance reviews, particularly within regulated or high-risk environments 

Stakeholder Management & Communication - Ability to translate complex technical and regulatory concepts into practical, risk-based recommendations and communicate effectively with technical, operational and executive stakeholders 

AI Monitoring & Observability - Strong knowledge of AI monitoring, observability, performance validation, drift detection, incident management and post-deployment assurance practices, including relevant tooling and best practice 

 

Desirable Experience 

Working across diverse industries, including public sector (e.g. Central Government and Defence) and private industries such (e.g. Manufacturing, Automotive, Life Sciences, Consumer Products & Retail and Financial Services) 

Influencing cross-functional teams and balancing innovation objectives with risk management requirements 

Assessing and managing risks associated with AI systems, including model development and performance, data, transparency, explain-ability, accountability, privacy, security, and regulatory risks 

Designing, implementing, and operating first-line risk management, conducting AI risk assessments, impact assessments, control evaluations, or assurance reviews during development, deployment and monitoring of AI solutions 

Supporting AI initiatives within highly regulated industries or complex risk environments where governance and compliance requirements are critical 

Personal Attributes 

A passionate advocate for the safe, responsible, and scalable adoption of AI, with a proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks throughout the AI lifecycle. Pragmatic and balanced in evaluating opportunities and challenges, with strong communication skills that enable effective engagement with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous learning, while remaining calm and effective in complex or high-pressure environments.

WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE?

Our team drives business transformation by designing the organisations of the future, delivering end-to-end blueprint for AI-enabled enterprises. We are at the cutting edge of the 4th industrial revolution and are uniquely placed to leverage the broad, market-leading capabilities of Capgemini Group.  

We work across a wide range of industries, delivering outcomes that make a real impact on society. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, innovate and shape your own career path, supported by mentoring from our leading experts in data and AI.  

We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years. To see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page. 

NEED TO KNOW

About the job you’re considering

As a Senior SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll Consultant within Capgemini’s leading and award winning SuccessFactors Practice, you will be responsible for supporting complex, large scale SuccessFactors implementations for a range of high profile clients. This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled teams across the global Capgemini Group and to play a pivotal role in designing innovative solutions for our clients.
You will bring experience of working as part of a team delivering large, multi workstream initiatives, including managing business process design and transformation using SAP SuccessFactors. Working for Capgemini provides opportunities for accelerated career progression, along with continued professional development through our unique training programmes.

About our UK SAP Practice Team:  Capgemini UK is a leading SAP Integration Partner, helping our clients navigate through complex SAP transformations. Capgemini UK has 1000 + SAP practitioners across UK & India and are ranked #1 for SAP S/4HANA® certifications in UK and globally. We work closely with our clients to transform their business together using the latest SAP products and architecture, a deep knowledge of industries and markets, and innovative delivery methodologies. 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.
If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:
identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

• Experience developing Payroll architecture blueprints, strategies, and roadmaps
• Translating business and technical requirements into an architectural blueprint that outlines how requirements will deliver the desired business objectives
• Implement innovative, robust, and future-proof SAP SuccessFactors solutions with expertise in SAP/Employee Central Payroll, and supporting technologies, including Payroll Control Centre
• Strong experience in SuccessFactors and/or ECC Payroll configuration and strong knowledge and experience in design and build of payroll related integrations
• Guide clients on SAP best practise and innovations, whilst being up to date with the SuccessFactors roadmap and having an awareness of other HR technologies
• You will have the ability to communicate effectively to stakeholders at all levels within a client’s organization
• Lead high performing teams that can work flexibly, incorporating both on and offshore delivery models
• Support and liaise closely with your corresponding teams to resolve issues, provide solutions, and offer support to meet delivery obligations
• Prepare quality documentation artefacts such as Solution Design Documents, Functional Specifications, WRICEFs, etc
• Ensure quality delivery of our Technology solutions
• Contribute to shaping our response to RFPs and collaborate with other Capgemini teams during the pre-sales process, including the delivery of expert demos to prospective clients
• Build and continually strengthen your network across Capgemini, our Clients and Partners
• Experience of working in a multi supplier environment to deliver projects on time

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

• Experienced SAP Payroll consultant who has gained hands-on experience from working through multiple project lifecycles. Lead requirements workshops and you team through the project delivery, especially focussed on Payroll Comparison testing cycles to verify suitability of the delivered solution. Experience within Live Support environments is advantageous.
• A team player with strong functional SAP Payroll knowledge and broader technical awareness (in things such as Integration to/from 3rd party products in Benefits, Time Mgmt., and Payroll) and broader technical awareness (in things such as Security, Integration, etc.)
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to deliver high quality presentations to senior client stakeholders
• Understands emerging technology trends and disruptions and the practical application of existing, new, and emerging technologies to enable new and evolving business and operating models.
• Enthusiasm and proactiveness for learning and staying current with SAP latest technologies
• Experience in leading pre-sales activities and articulating the benefits SuccessFactors brings to clients
• Enjoy mentoring and developing junior talent as well as sharing knowledge across the team and the wider SAP Practice
• Familiar with supporting technologies such as Payroll Control Centre (PCC), SAP WorkZone, Business Technology Platform (BTP), and how they enhance employee and administrator experience
• Familiarity with the integration to SAP ERP HCM or S/4HANA via BIB would be beneficial as well as other HR dependent processes within an ERP platform
• Passionate to work with our clients advising them on how to get the most out of their SAP technologies
• Good understanding of product management, agile principles and development methodologies and capability of supporting agile teams by providing advice and guidance on opportunities, impact, and risks, taking account of technical and architectural debt.
• Innovative and open minded in your thinking with a passion for change and dynamic working in a team providing a first-class service to our client
• Troubleshooting and resolution of payroll-related activities, ensuring timely resolution and accurate payroll processing

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your Security Clearance 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 12 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.
Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini 

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion. 
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

  • Strong expertise in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning (SAC), with exposure to SAP BDC or SAC Seamless Planning
  • Deep understanding of financial planning, forecasting, and budgeting processes
  • Strong blend of technical and functional expertise across FP&A solution design and delivery
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and influence senior stakeholders
  • Experience contributing to sales, pre-sales, and business development
  • Exposure to SAP BPC, BW, or BI-IP is advantageous
