About the job you’re considering

CIS UK is looking for a Senior Director to strengthen how we deliver and grow our business across the account portfolio within Projects & Consulting. This is a hybrid delivery-and-growth role: part of the remit is to raise delivery discipline across our projects, and part is to unlock further sales growth within existing accounts by working closely with delivery and account teams. The role is deliberately broad at this stage and will be shaped further with the successful candidate.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

  • Delivery discipline. Bring a consistent standard of governance, risk management and commercial control across our portfolio of projects and managed services, so delivery quality and predictability improve across accounts.
  • Growth through delivery. Work with account and delivery leads to identify and convert organic growth opportunities, using strong delivery performance as the platform for expanding our footprint and share of wallet.
  • Frameworks and collateral. Build reusable frameworks, templates and collateral (for example delivery playbooks, governance packs, transition toolkits) that make good practice easy to adopt across the business.
  • Standardisation. Drive a consistent approach across accounts to core practices such as account planning and the handover from sales into delivery, closing gaps that currently cause variable outcomes.
  • Offer-led selling. Support the delivery community to sell from our defined offers, connecting delivery teams with the propositions and assets that make account growth conversations easier and more consistent.


What success looks like

  • A portfolio with fewer delivery escapes, clearer governance and more predictable commercial performance.
  • Demonstrable organic growth in target accounts, attributable in part to delivery-led opportunities.
  • A working set of frameworks and templates in active use across multiple accounts, not just published.
  • A common, recognisable approach to account planning and sales-to-delivery transition across P&C.
  • Increased use of standard offers within delivery-led sales conversations.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Substantial senior delivery leadership experience, gained in a large IT services or consulting environment.
  • A track record of contributing to commercial growth from within delivery, not just executing to scope.
  • Experience designing and embedding frameworks, playbooks or standard operating models across multiple teams or accounts.
  • Strong stakeholder skills, credible with account leadership, delivery teams and clients alike.
  • Comfortable operating with a broad, evolving mandate and shaping the role as priorities become clearer.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2023. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Our offer

We are seeking an experienced Product Assurance Manager to support a major space systems programme within a Space Systems Quality organization.  

You will have a strong knowledge of Product Assurance frameworks, including ECSS and a strong understanding of electrical and electronic systems within complex space assemblies. 

You will act as the key quality interface between engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and the customer, ensuring that Product Assurance activities are effectively planned, executed, and delivered. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will be accountable for delivering quality outcomes in line with programme milestones and customer expectations. 

Your role

Act as the Product Assurance lead within the project team, owning delivery of PA activities across a range of electrics and electronics suppliers across the full product lifecycle. 

Ensure compliance with space systems standards such as ECSS and customer requirements. Advise on resolution of non-conformances against standards and requirements.  

Lead non-conformance management, including root cause analysis, corrective/preventive actions, and review boards (NRB/MRB) for non-conforming product.  

Drive quality performance through KPI analysis, continuous improvement, and promotion of “right first time” principles. 

Manage quality processes such as quality gates, audits, and process adherence activities. 

Interface with engineering (particularly electrical/electronic), manufacturing, suppliers, and customers as the primary PA authority. 

Your profile

4 – 6 years experience in Product Assurance / Quality Engineering within space environments. Strong understanding of space industry manufacturing, including satellite build, cleanroom operations, and high-reliability assembly practices. Demonstrated capability to lead recovery of problematic suppliers 

Strong working knowledge of ECSS / ESA standards and quality frameworks  

Solid understanding of electrical/electronic systems and ability to engage with related engineering teams. 

Excellent coaching and stakeholder engagement skills. Ability to influence without authority across multidisciplinary teams and supply chains. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strict configuration, documentation, and compliance requirements. 

Proven experience in non-conformance management, root cause analysis, and structured problem-solving (e.g. 8D, FMEA).Experience with lifecycle reviews, quality gates, and working within regulated, high-reliability programmes. 

What you'll love about working here

What You'll Love About Working Here

  • Hybrid working
  • Open access to digital learning platforms
  • Active employee networks promoting diversity, equity and inclusion like OutFront, CapAbility or Women@Capgemini

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
  • Please opt in during the application process.

Need to know

  • All roles will require a level of security clearance; This role requires SC clearance
  • You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusivefuture is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We havebuilt a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

About the job you’re considering

As a Senior Out of Hours Analyst, you will provide senior operational control across the Out of Hours service, with primary accountability for Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management and escalation management. You will identify emerging risk, coordinate the appropriate response, maintain clear operational oversight and help protect service availability during out-of-hours periods.

 

You will operate as a senior point of coordination on shift, working closely with technical support teams, suppliers and stakeholders to ensure events and incidents are assessed, prioritised, escalated and progressed effectively. A secondary element of the role is to provide dynamic support to Out of Hours Analysts during busy periods, complex demand or priority activity.

 

This role requires you to be on site in Inverness 5 days per week with a shift pattern of 4 nights on, 4 nights off, 4 days on, 4 days off.

Your role

  • Monitor operational alerts, events and incidents during Out of Hours periods, assessing impact and ensuring appropriate action is taken in line with agreed processes.
  • Coordinate with technical teams, suppliers and stakeholders to support the effective management, escalation and resolution of incidents and service disruptions.
  • Maintain accurate event and incident records, provide timely updates, and ensure effective handovers to support continuity of service across shifts.
  • Support the prioritisation and progression of operational activity, helping to identify risks, emerging issues and service impacts, escalating where appropriate.
  • Provide guidance and assistance to Out of Hours Analysts during periods of increased demand, complex issues or major service events, promoting consistent ways of working.
  • Contribute to service quality and continual improvement by identifying trends, highlighting process improvements and maintaining knowledge of services, procedures and support models.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Experience working in a Service Desk, Incident Management, Monitoring, Technical Support or IT Operations environment.
  • Good understanding of IT service management principles, including incident management, event monitoring, escalation processes and service restoration.
  • Ability to assess and prioritise operational issues, make sound decisions and remain effective when working under pressure.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clear updates, handovers and escalation information.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret information, identify trends and support operational decision-making.
  • Proficient in the use of IT systems and tools, including Microsoft Office, ticket management systems and monitoring platforms, with a collaborative and customer-focused approach.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 
 
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 
 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
 

 

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.
 
 
If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
 
 
 
Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more. 
 
 
 
Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
Your role

Capgemini Engineering is looking for DevOps Engineer, you will design, build and maintain the pipelines, environments and automation frameworks that enable PLM delivery teams to move safely from development through test, UAT, staging and production.

 

You will work closely with PLM architects, configurators, developers, testers, security teams and release stakeholders to ensure that platform changes are repeatable, traceable and supportable.

 

This is a hands-on role focused on Siemens Teamcenter, NX and related digital engineering services. Success will be measured by pipeline reliability, environment stability, deployment repeatability, release quality and the clarity of the technical controls and documentation supporting each release.

Your profile

  • Strong hands-on experience in DevOps, platform engineering, build engineering or release engineering within an enterprise or complex programme environment.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or equivalent tooling.
    Practical knowledge of Git-based source control, branching strategies, release branches, pull requests, artefact repositories and configuration baselines.
  • Experience automating infrastructure, application deployment or environment configuration using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform or similar technologies.

 

Useful but not essential

  • Experience with Siemens Teamcenter deployment approaches and utilities, potentially including BMIDE, TEM, Active Workspace, Dispatcher, preferences, workflow templates and environment promotion.
  • Experience with NX or other CAD authoring environments integrated with enterprise PLM platforms.
  • Experience supporting Teamcenter upgrades, patching, cloning, environment refreshes or disaster-recovery rehearsals.
  • Knowledge of automated testing approaches for PLM, web applications, integrations and CAD-connected workflows.
  • Experience supporting data-migration rehearsals, cutover planning, deployment rehearsals or go-live for enterprise engineering platforms.
  • Experience in defence, aerospace, nuclear, rail or another highly regulated engineering sector.

 

If you're excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply, your unique experience could be just what we need.

Make it real - what does it mean for you?

  • Open access to digital learning platforms​
  • Active employee networks promoting diversity, equity and inclusion like OutFront, CapAbility or Women@Capgemini​
    ​

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:​

  • Declare they have a disability, and ​
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.​
  • Please opt in during the application process.​
    ​

Capgemini. Make it real.

Need to know

  • Due to the nature of the project this role requires Sole UK National. ​
  • This is a hybrid role requires 2 days fortnight office presence based in Barrow-In-furness.
  • You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusivefuture is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We havebuilt a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

About Capgemini

We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. data.description:
About the job you’re considering

As an OOH Shift Lead, you will provide leadership, governance and operational control across the Out of Hours service, ensuring the shift operates with clear ownership, disciplined execution and effective management oversight. The role is accountable for maintaining service stability, leading Major Incident Management activity, managing operational risk and ensuring all events, incidents, escalations and handovers are controlled in line with agreed service management processes.


You will act as the shift authority for operational decision-making, coordinating Senior and Junior Out of Hours Analysts, technical resolver teams, suppliers and stakeholders to ensure activity is prioritised, progressed and governed effectively. The role carries management responsibility for the Out of Hours analyst team on shift, including work allocation, performance oversight, coaching, process adherence and associated operational responsibilities.

 

This role is based onsite 5 days a week in Inverness and you will be required to work the following shift pattern: 4 nights on, 4 nights off, 4 days on, 4 days off

Your role

  • Lead the Out of Hours shift, ensuring operational activity is prioritised, controlled and delivered in line with agreed service management processes, procedures and service levels.
  • Provide oversight of live events, incidents, escalations and service risks, making operational decisions and ensuring appropriate action is taken to protect service stability.
  • Lead Major Incident Management activity during Out of Hours periods, coordinating technical teams, suppliers and stakeholders to support effective service restoration and communication.
  • Manage and support Out of Hours Analysts on shift, allocating work, balancing priorities, providing coaching and maintaining high standards of service delivery and process adherence.
  • Oversee monitoring, event management and escalation activities, ensuring risks, service impacts and operational issues are identified, managed and handed over effectively between shifts.
  • Contribute to governance, reporting and continual improvement activities by identifying trends, risks and opportunities to enhance operational performance and service quality.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Experience in a Shift Lead, Team Lead, Major Incident, Service Desk, Technical Operations or similar operational leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of IT service management principles, including Major Incident Management, Incident Management, Event Management and escalation processes.
  • Experience leading and developing teams, allocating work, managing priorities and maintaining operational control in a live service environment.
  • Ability to assess risk, impact and priority, make sound decisions and remain effective under pressure during service-impacting events.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clear updates, briefings, reports and handovers.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with good knowledge of operational tools, ticketing systems, monitoring platforms and Microsoft Office applications.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: 
identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2023. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

Are you passionate about cybersecurity? Are you an excellent communicator with demonstrable experience of delivering security services within organisations? Would you relish putting these skills into practice by taking on a role within Capgemini to protect us and our clients from cyber threats?

 

We are seeking a Vulnerability Management Analysts with proven experience to join our cybersecurity team.

 

Reporting to the Vulnerability Management Lead, you will work closely with suppliers to ensure identified security vulnerabilities are understood, prioritized, and remediated within agreed timescales.

 

Rather than operating the vulnerability management tools directly, you will review findings, coordinate remediation activities, track progress, and provide guidance on risk reduction. The role focuses on stakeholder engagement, risk management, reporting, and driving timely resolution of security issues across the environment.

 

Working as part of our Security Operations team, you will be responsible for delivering a comprehensive vulnerability management service to our customer.

 

The Cyber Delivery Team sits within a wider Managed Services function, residing in the Cloud Infrastructure Services (CIS) UK business line. You will have the opportunity to interact with our global team of security experts, from Architects to Engineers, Analysts to Compliance Managers. Outreach in CIS doesn’t just stop at security, as we actively encourage our staff to engage with other areas of the business and local communities.

 


Hybrid working: The role will be hybrid and require working onsite at the customer site in either Inverness or Preston a minimum of 2 days a week, depending on business requirements. .  

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Your role:

 Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and track vulnerabilities from identification through remediation and closure, ensuring progress meets agreed service levels and escalating high-risk or overdue issues where required.
  • Engage with suppliers to obtain, validate, and maintain accurate vulnerability data, ensuring consistent reporting standards and clear ownership.
  • Produce vulnerability reports, dashboards, and metrics that provide visibility of aging vulnerabilities, recurring issues, SLA breaches, and emerging trends.
  • Support governance and compliance by ensuring adherence to vulnerability management processes, policies, standards, and risk exception procedures.
  • Maintain audit-ready evidence and documentation, supporting assurance reviews and demonstrating the effectiveness of vulnerability management controls to stakeholders.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Experience in cyber security, information security, service management, or governance, with a solid understanding of vulnerability management principles and risk concepts (CVSS, KEV, risk ratings, and remediation tracking).
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and data interpretation skills, with the ability to produce meaningful security metrics and reporting packs.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders, suppliers, and governance forums to drive remediation and performance improvements.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management tools, reporting processes, security governance, assurance activities, and audit evidence requirements.
  • Experience in SIAM or multi-supplier environments, preferably within regulated, public sector, or defence organisations.

 

Desirable

  • Qualifications in Vulnerability Management Tooling (Qualys, Brinqa, Tenable)

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Some roles will also require an additional level of security clearance:

 


Security Check (SC) Clearance:

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

The Applied Innovation Exchange (AIE) exists to create a world where everyone can apply innovation to create a positive future. 

 

 

 

We're on a mission to create the products, services and systems that empower some of the world's largest organisations to drive meaningful change in the world. We do this through a high-impact, human centred approach, combining our expertise in collaboration with our ecosystem partners and the breadth of Capgemini to create solutions enabled by emerging technologies. 

 

 

We work with clients across the spectrum of sectors that Capgemini is involved in: Customer Products and Retail, Transport, Manufacturing, Telecom, Public Sector, Financial Services and Energy and Utilities.

 

 

 

At the AIE, you'll be part of a small team of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. 

 

 

 

You will work alongside clients, account execs, UX designers, developers and product owners to ideate, experiment, and build rapid proof of concepts and innovations for a range of clients leveraging the latest emerging technolo­gy. 

 

 

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your Role

Your primary role will be to work with Senior Innovation Consultants in supporting the shaping and selling of our innovation products and services, and working on innovation engagements which deliver value for our customers. 

 

 

You will have a passion for innovation and emerging technology and embrace working with new ideas and methods. You will be comfortable working in an ambitious, start-up style culture where you will play a part in our growth and contribute to the development of the team through a number of internal projects. 

 

 

Sell Innovation: 

  • Support the creation of proposals for innovation opportunities using structured thinking, visioning and storytelling to bring innovation opportunities to life for our customers 

Explore Innovation: 

  • Participate in and run Innovation Tours to demonstrate our culture, method and capabilities to customers and colleagues within the business 
  • Lead ‘Discovery’ engagements and workshops with customers – creating session agendas, managing the development of the session content, and co-ordinating the logistics for the sessions 
  • Co-Facilitate ‘Discover’ workshops with customer on their business problems and emerging technology topics, using a range of different facilitation, ideation and innovation methods/ techniques 

Create Innovation: 

  • Work with  Senior  Innovation  Consultants  to prove the commercial business case for an innovation opportunity, proving the business value, risks, and constraints for customers 
  • Work with Senior Product Owners to product manage the development of innovation proof of values for customers – managing a product backlog, defining user stories, and testing the product with end users 
  • Work with our customers and wider SMEs to lead concept development for innovation, coming up novel ideas and framing them in imaginative ways.

Your Skills and Experience

  • Ability to think on your feet, bring an outside in perspective and work in an emerging and fast paced environment 
  • A passion for innovation and emerging technology, a thirst for new ideas and appetite to embrace new ways of working 
  • Experience working on innovation related services at or for Corporates.
  • An understanding of project management methodology – including Agile and Design Thinking methodology – and experience in leading your own stream of work 
  • An understanding of business model methodologies and an understanding of basic financial concepts
  • Expirence with Human Centred Design / Design thinking.
  • Experience of meeting management and workshop facilitation (as a co-facilitator) both online and in person, project management tools and techniques (Trello, Notion, Mural, Miro etc) 
  • Experience of customer journey mapping and creation, innovation storytelling and concept development 

Your Security Clearence

To be successfully appointed to this role you will need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard checks.
There are no nationality or residency restrictions, although if you have resided outside of the UK within the last 3 years, further checks may be required.
There are other criteria and check required for BPSS, and throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
•    Declare they have a disability, and
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  


To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 


You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 12 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion. 
 
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the Job you are considering:

Join Capgemini's Cloud & Custom Applications (C&CA) practice as an AWS Solution Architect, where you will help clients shape and deliver future-ready digital solutions. Working within the Financial Services Business Unit, you will combine architecture leadership, stakeholder engagement, and delivery expertise to design scalable, resilient, and business-aligned solutions. Guided by our vision to Consult with Purpose. Continuously Evolve. Architect Tomorrow., you will act as a trusted advisor, champion innovation, promote AI awareness where appropriate, and help teams deliver measurable outcomes while building long-term capability and reducing technical complexity.

 

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture and delivery of complex business solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives and enterprise strategy.
  • Create high-quality solution and architecture designs that translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable outcomes.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, delivery teams, and external partners to drive successful programme delivery.
  • Design integrations and end-to-end solution approaches that support business growth, resilience, and operational efficiency.
  • Promote architectural best practices, governance standards, and consistent delivery excellence across programmes.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce technical debt, improve maintainability, and enable future business capabilities.
  • Maximise reuse of existing services, assets, and data capabilities where appropriate to accelerate delivery and reduce risk.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and guidance to delivery teams, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
  • Proactively manage delivery risks, dependencies, and issues while maintaining transparency with stakeholders.
  • Champion AI-fluent ways of working and contribute to developing a future-ready workforce across teams and client engagements.

 

Must-Have Skills

  • Strong experience in solution architecture, technical design, and software delivery across complex enterprise environments.
  • Proven ability to lead architecture decisions from concept through implementation and operational adoption.
  • Demonstrated experience designing API-led, integration-focused, and event-driven solutions.
  • Strong technical leadership with the ability to guide, mentor, and influence multidisciplinary teams.
  • Experience managing end-to-end project and delivery lifecycles in client-facing environments.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering business value.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic delivery outcomes.
  • Understanding of modern software engineering principles, architecture patterns, and integration approaches.
  • Experience within the Insurance sector, particularly Commercial Insurance or the London Market, is advantageous.

 

Good-to-Have Skills

  • AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS, and DynamoDB.
  • Node.js and TypeScript development experience.
  • Java and Spring Boot development experience.
  • PostgreSQL and data persistence technologies.
  • Apigee or comparable API management platforms.
  • REST API development and management.
  • Python development skills.
  • Agile delivery methodologies, including Scrum.
  • ServiceNow, Confluence, and Jira.
  • AWS, architecture, or cloud-related certifications.
  • Experience supporting enterprise transformation and cloud modernisation initiatives.

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer:

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

Make It Real (what does it mean for you):

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. 

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

 

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Job Title: Business Analyst

Location: Glasgow

 

About the Job you are considering:

An experienced Business Analyst with a strong Investment Banking or Capital Markets background, combining expertise in data governance, master data management, stakeholder engagement, and business analysis. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience driving enterprise data initiatives, defining data requirements and mappings, and supporting strategic transformation programs across global financial services organizations.

 

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

 Your Role

  • Strong understanding of master data and hierarchy modelling including legal entity structures client hierarchies ownership relationships business rules and data governance principles
  • Proven ability to lead requirements workshops challenge assumptions resolve ambiguities and drive stakeholder agreement across business and technology teams

 

Your Skills

  • Experience delivering data focused change initiatives within Capital Markets or Investment Banking particularly involving client data reference data CRM platforms or enterprise data management
  • Expertise in data mapping migration lineage and reconciliation including defining source to target mappings and validating implementation outcomes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into clear functional and data requirements
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills capable of explaining complex data concepts and securing alignment from senior business and technology stakeholders

 

Desirable Skills

  • Experience working on client onboarding KYC regulatory reference data or master data management programmes within Investment Banking
  • Technical familiarity with SQL and querying large complex datasets to generate insights for problem solving
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and working alongside architecture and engineering teams

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer:

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

Make It Real (what does it mean for you):

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. 
    To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

 

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

About the job you’re considering

An exciting opportunity to join Capgemini as a Major Incident Manager Lead, supporting a diverse portfolio of high-profile clients.

In this role, you will lead and oversee the end-to-end major incident management process, ensuring swift resolution and minimal business impact. You will be a confident decision-maker and analytical problem solver, thriving in high-pressure environments.
As the primary point of contact during major incidents, you will coordinate cross-functional teams, drive timely response and recovery actions, and provide clear, consistent communication to stakeholders. You will also play a key role in mentoring MIMs, continuously improving incident management practices, and ensuring adherence to best practices and procedures.

On-site working requirement:

This role is fully based on-site at our premises in Preston. You will be expected to work from the office full-time, with no hybrid or home-working arrangement. Your day-to-day work location will be consistent and primarily based at our site to meet the needs of the role and the business.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

As a Major Incident Manager Lead, you will oversee and drive excellence across Major Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes, ensuring effective coordination, rapid resolution, and continuous improvement.

  • Lead and ensure delivery against all relevant operational processes and service obligations
  • Leverage tooling and technology to manage incidents, deliver timely communications, and provide effective stakeholder engagement
  • Chair and drive all major incident bridge calls, investigations, and recovery activities
  • Collaborate with technical leads to develop structured action plans, assigning clear ownership, timelines, and accountability to meet SLA targets
  • Provide matrix management across teams, processes, and third-party suppliers, proactively resolving conflict to maintain progress towards resolution
  • Take overall accountability for restoring service through workarounds or permanent fixes, minimising business impact
  • Manage and execute timely functional and hierarchical escalations where required
  • Ensure all documentation, administrative tasks, and reporting are current and accurate, including contact details, technical artefacts, and post-incident reviews
  • Champion continual service improvement by enhancing processes, knowledge bases, and playbooks
  • Maintain and evolve tools, frameworks, and resources to optimise major incident response effectiveness
  • Produce and deliver regular major incident performance and trend reporting to stakeholders
  • Continually maintaining and developing tools and resources to manage major incidents effectively
  • Providing periodic major incident metrics reports 


At Capgemini, you can bring your whole self to work. Inclusivity is part of our everyday culture, and we strive to create a representative and welcoming environment for all.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong knowledge and practical experience across ITIL processes, with a particular focus on Major Incident Management, Change Management, Incident Management, Problem Management, and Release Management
  • ITIL Foundation certification (v4 or above) is desirable
  • Proven ability to lead, own, and drive Major Incident Management and associated processes end-to-end
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and confidently
  • Strong stakeholder management and customer communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organisation
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and driving activities to resolution within tight and high-pressure timescales
  • Ability to influence and coordinate technical teams, third parties, and business stakeholders to achieve swift outcomes
  • Strong collaboration skills, with a proactive and team-oriented approach
  • Highly organised and methodical, with strong attention to detail and a structured approach to problem-solving
  • Ability to remain calm, decisive, and solution-focused in high-pressure situations

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
 
 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 
 
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 
 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
 
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
 
 
 
Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
 
 
 
 
Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
 
 
 
 
Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is. 

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Our offer

Capgemini Engineering are looking to recruit FE/Stress Engineers with particular focus on space systems. 

Structural Analysis consultant – your role will be to deliver Finite Element studies as well as analytical stress reports applied to Space Systems (satellite payloads, panels, satellite structural assemblies, equipment, ground support equipment).

Your profile

  • Educated to degree level (or equivalent) in an engineering or scientific discipline, ideally Mechanical.
  • Experience of stress engineering in aerospace.
  • Experience using HYPERWORKS and NASTRAN for FE modelling and analysis.
  • Knowledge of aerospace manufacturing processes desirable.
  • Ability to work quickly and accurately to follow client needs.
  • Communication and customer-facing skills.
  • Team player, able to work effectively and to short timescales with others in a busy environment.
  • Proactive attitude and ability to communicate and report at different levels.
  • Excellent communication skills with a good level of verbal and written English.
  • Knowledge of FEMAP could be a plus.

Your role

  • Understand and study stress analysis workflow, as prescribed by customer. This can be static, dynamic analysis, acoustics and specific post-processing tools.
  • Finite Elements analysis, all aspects:
    • modify/adapt geometry;
    • develop or update models with appropriate level of idealisation and boundary conditions;
    • perform verification/validation activities;
    • run simulations (static, dynamic, vibrations…),
    • perform post-processing and analysis of results.
  • Perform analytical stress calculations using either textbook-based or prescribed methods and tools.
  • Present and report progress and results, internally and externally.
  • Write technical reports.

What you'll love about working here

What You'll Love About Working Here

  • Hybrid working
  • Open access to digital learning platforms
  • Active employee networks promoting diversity, equity and inclusion like OutFront, CapAbility or Women@Capgemini

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
  • Please opt in during the application process.

Need to know

  • All roles will require a level of security clearance; This role requires SC clearance
  • You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusivefuture is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We havebuilt a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

data.title: Stress Engineer

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

Capgemini Cloud Infrastructure Services (CIS) UK has the largest Projects & Consulting (P&C) practice in CIS globally - covering all of the CIS portfolio. We work on a range of exciting projects for many different clients across all sectors. The roles of the Workplace Engineer operate within the User Experience capability, focusing on consulting, architecture designing, building, migrating, and testing workplace services and solutions.

Are you passionate about helping organizations transform their work culture and productivity with Microsoft Cloud solutions? Do you have the skills and experience to design and implement modern workplace solutions that meet the needs and goals of complex enterprises? If so, we are looking for you.

 
Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

As a Workplace Engineer, you will be responsible for leading the design, planning, and delivery of modern workplace solutions for our enterprise customers. You will work closely with business stakeholders, IT leaders, and technical teams to understand the customer's vision, challenges, and requirements, and to propose innovative and scalable solutions that leverage Microsoft 365, Azure, and AI capabilities. You will also oversee the implementation and adoption of the solutions, ensuring that they align with the customer's business objectives, security policies, and compliance standards. The role will require you to:

  • Engage with enterprise customers to assess their current and desired state of modern workplace maturity, and to identify opportunities and gaps for improvement. Define and document the modern workplace strategy, roadmap, and architecture for the customer, based on best practices and industry standards.
  • Design and architect modern workplace solutions that leverage Microsoft 365, W365, and Azure with features and services, such as Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange, Intune, Entra ID, Azure Sentinel, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to the project team and the customer throughout the solution lifecycle, from pre-sales to deployment and adoption.
  • Manage and mitigate technical risks and issues, and ensure that the solutions meet the customer's expectations, requirements, and SLAs. Collaborate with Microsoft and partner resources to ensure the quality and success of the solutions and conduct workshops, training sessions, and presentations to educate and empower the customer and the end users on the benefits and usage of the modern workplace solutions.
  • Stay updated on the latest trends, technologies, and best practices in the modern workplace domain, and share insights and feedback with the Microsoft and partner communities.


You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Experienced in IT consulting, solution architecture, and project management, with a focus on modern workplace and cloud solutions along with knowledge and experience in designing and implementing Microsoft 365, Azure and AVD solutions for enterprise customers.
  • Deep knowledge and expertise in Microsoft 365, and Azure features, services, and architectures, and how they can be integrated and customized to meet the customer's needs and goals.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts and solutions to various audiences, from executives to end users. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to handle multiple and competing priorities and deliver results under pressure.
  • Strong customer focus and relationship management skills, with the ability to understand the customer's business context, challenges, and expectations, and to build trust and rapport.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience (desirable), Certifications in Microsoft 365 and Azure are highly desirable.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 
 
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
 Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.
 If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
  
Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  
Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
   
Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com
