data.title: Modern Workplace Architect

data.description:
About the job you are considering

Capgemini's Insights & Data practice helps leading organizations harness data, AI, and analytics to drive innovation, efficiency, and transformation. As part of our continued investment in building world-class engineering capabilities, we are seeking a Director, I&D Engineering Transformation & Programs to lead a strategic, multi-country Capability Build programme across the UK, France, and India. 

 

This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for driving large-scale business transformation and organizational change across the Insights & Data business. Working with senior Capgemini executives, business leaders, HR, Finance, Commercial, Sales, and external strategic partners, you will be accountable for defining and executing the roadmap that strengthens our engineering capabilities, accelerates growth, and supports our AI and Data ambitions.

 

The successful candidate will combine executive stakeholder management, programme leadership, operational excellence, and change management expertise to ensure strategic initiatives are delivered on time, within budget, and with measurable business impact across multiple geographies.
The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time. 

Your Role

As a  Director, you will act as the executive programme lead for a complex, multi-country transformation initiative designed to enhance Capgemini's engineering capability, talent strategy, operational effectiveness, and market competitiveness. You will partner with senior leaders across the organization and external stakeholders to define strategic priorities, drive execution, and ensure successful realization of business outcomes.

 

Key responsibilities include:

 

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of a strategic Capability Build programme spanning multiple countries, business units, and stakeholder groups.
  • Develop and execute the transformation roadmap, ensuring alignment with Capgemini's Insights & Data growth strategy and engineering objectives.
  • Lead a cross-functional programme involving HR, Finance, Commercial, Legal, Operations, Sales, Delivery, and Business Leadership teams.
  • Translate strategic business objectives into executable workstreams, milestones, deliverables, and measurable outcomes.
  • Establish and maintain programme governance frameworks, steering committees, executive reporting, and decision-making processes.
  • Serve as the primary interface between Capgemini executives, business leaders, account teams, and strategic technology partners.
  • Drive organizational change management activities, ensuring stakeholder engagement, adoption, and successful implementation of programme outcomes.
  • Build and manage integrated programme plans, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and resource requirements across multiple workstreams.
  • Lead executive-level communications, including board updates, steering committee materials, business cases, and investment recommendations.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations to support strategic decisions, prioritization, and issue resolution.
  • Manage programme financials, including budget oversight, forecasting, cost management, resource planning, utilization tracking, and investment governance.
  • Identify, assess, and proactively mitigate programme risks while ensuring delivery momentum is maintained.
  • Establish KPI frameworks and performance dashboards to measure programme success and business impact.
  • Drive collaboration across international teams to deliver outcomes consistently and at scale.
  • Champion continuous improvement and operational excellence across programme delivery and transformation activities.
  • Support the growth of Capgemini's AI, Data, and Engineering capabilities through strategic workforce and capability-building initiatives.

Your Skills and Experience

Required Experience:

 

  • Significant experience leading large-scale business transformation, organizational change, or strategic programme initiatives within complex global organizations.
  • Demonstrated success managing enterprise-wide programmes involving multiple business functions, geographies, and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong experience operating at executive and board level, including presenting business cases and influencing strategic decisions.

  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and rapidly changing business environments while maintaining delivery focus.
  • Experience establishing and tracking KPIs and delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

 

Leadership Competencies:

 

  • Executive presence and influencing skills.
  • Strategic thinking and transformation leadership.
  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to build consensus across senior leadership teams.
  • Strong change management and organizational leadership skills.
  • Ability to simplify complexity and drive execution.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on measurable business impact.
  • Collaborative leadership style with experience leading global and matrixed teams.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

 

  • Experience in consulting, professional services, technology, or digital transformation environments.
  • Exposure to Data, AI, Generative AI, or Engineering transformation programmes.
  • Experience working with global technology partners and ecosystem organizations.
  • Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree or MBA preferred.

We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  


By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About the job you're considering

You’ll be joining a passionate, professional and highly skilled team of developers who specialise in agile custom software development and integration at an enterprise scale. Innovation in delivery is always at the forefront of our minds, which is why we utilise a variety of Open Source and proprietary technologies to achieve the best possible outcome for the client. 
We have a world class software engineering community; we invest in doing things right and have plenty to say on the subject. We’re active on social media and for those that want to find out more, take a look at our blogs – written by engineers, for engineers: http://capgemini.github.io/

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

 

Your role

As a senior member of the AWS Engineering Team, you will work with clients to design, build, and implement cutting-edge cloud-native solutions. With a software engineering mindset, you’ll apply your expertise in AWS and related technologies to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams, taking ownership of end-to-end delivery, and acting as a trusted advisor to clients and colleagues alike.

  • Drive cloud-native solutions by leveraging AWS services, DevOps principles, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Build and manage robust, scalable infrastructure and serverless architectures using Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, and AWS serverless technologies.
  • Foster continuous improvement by embracing Agile and SCRUM methodologies and facilitating stakeholder engagement to ensure alignment on project goals.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to team members, contributing to skill-building initiatives and promoting an environment of growth and learning.

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

You should demonstrate:

  • Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS preferred), alongside knowledge of cloud-native application development.
  • Proficiency in Kubernetes and managing containerised applications at scale.
  • Strong foundation in Infrastructure as Code (such as Terraform or CloudFormation).
  • Application development skills with experience in one or more programming languages such as Java, Go, or Python.
  • A DevOps mindset, with practical experience in continuous delivery, GitOps, and Agile/SCRUM methodologies.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills to manage client relationships effectively.
  • A commitment to continuous learning and improvement, with AWS certification as a bonus. While certification is not essential, we’re looking for candidates who are proactive about pursuing it or are already on the path to certification, with training support provided where needed.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your Security Clearance

Developed Vetting (DV)

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Developed Vetting (DV) clearance.

To obtain DV clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 10 years, along with other very detailed criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process

Make it real - what does it mean?

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

Capgemini provides a service to a Private Sector organisation. You will be working as part of a Service Management delivery team.
Reporting into the Head of GSMC, the Major Incident Manager is responsible for end-to-end management of all IT major incidents

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

  • Leading, driving, and chairing all investigation activities, meetings, and conference calls and being accountable for resolving the outage via workaround or permanent fix  
  • Forming collaborative action plans via the technical lead with specific actions, roles, and deadlines, and ensuring these are completed safely and within SLA  
  • Matrix management of people, processes and resources including third parties – including resolving conflict to move forward to resolution  
  • Issue all Major Incident communication and provide key stakeholder management including performing timely functional and hierarchical escalation  
  • Supporting and nurturing process improvements and knowledge base improvements 

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone. 

Your skills and experience

  • Communication and presentation skills 
  • ITIL V3/V4 Foundation
  • Operational Major Incident Management experience
  • Able to interact with clients at all levels
  • Flexibility to work between 7am and 6pm including out of hours (on-call) coverage via a rotating shift pattern.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 
 
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 
 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
 

 

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.
 
 
If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
 
 
 
Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
 
 
 
 
Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
 
 
 
 
Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

 

Your role:

We are expanding our Secure team, with significant opportunities to work on some of the UK’s most complex and mission-critical programmes. We partner closely with our clients to help them achieve their objectives and tackle highly complex challenges. This is enabled through close collaboration with the wider Capgemini Group, allowing us to bring a truly integrated offering and draw on deep technical and domain expertise.

Our strength lies in our technical heritage and a rich ecosystem of capability, which differentiates us in the market. We are looking for individuals with strong core consulting skills, alongside experience in areas such as Strategy & Innovation, P3M, Agile and hybrid delivery, Business Technology, Data & Analytics, and Workforce & Organisational Transformation.

We are seeking pragmatic, action-oriented people with a strong drive to deliver real outcomes. As a Consultant within the Secure team, you will be primarily delivery-focused, working closely with clients to build trusted relationships and translate complexity into clear, actionable solutions that deliver measurable impact.

Our Secure portfolio spans a diverse and evolving set of high-assurance environments and critical national programmes. We are experiencing sustained growth, driven by increasing demand for digital transformation across secure government and defence-adjacent organisations. This includes accelerating the adoption of advanced digital capabilities such as secure cloud, AI-enabled solutions, and automation.

Capgemini is recognised for its heritage as a trusted delivery partner in complex, highly regulated environments. As we continue to grow, we are looking for high-calibre talent to help our clients navigate change, unlock value, and deliver on their most important missions. As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

 

Your profile:

  • You meet the UK nationality requirements for roles requiring security clearance (typically in line with sole UK nationality criteria) and are willing to undergo background screening.
  • Experience working within complex, high-assurance or highly regulated environments, either within government, consulting, or industry.
  • Proven delivery experience across large-scale programmes, such as capability development, research and innovation, digital transformation, strategic planning, or operational support.
  • The ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables, operating with a high degree of autonomy and accountability.
  • A growth mindset, with the curiosity and adaptability to take on new challenges and develop new skills.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse organisations and locations.
  • A commitment to continuous professional development and personal growth.

Desirable technical skills and experience (one or more of the following):

  • Delivery experience across Project, Programme, or Portfolio Management (P3M), including relevant professional certifications (e.g. APM, MSP or equivalent).
  • Experience supporting business case development, including structured analysis, option appraisal, and investment justification.
  • Requirements management and/or structured problem-solving approaches.
  • User-centred design, business analysis, and organisational or business change management.
  • Experience supporting training, design or capability enablement frameworks.
  • Knowledge of security, risk, or assurance practices within complex environments.
  • Exposure to Digital, Data, and Technology (DDaT) environments and transformation initiative.
  • Experience working in operational, mission-focused, or capability development environments.

 

 

What you'll love about working here:

You’ll thrive in a collaborative and diverse environment that empowers you to innovate, grow your skills, and make a real impact—whether you’re shaping solutions for clients or driving positive change in society. You will be supported by a culture that values inclusion, continuous learning, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to work every day.

 

Need to know:

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

CSR:

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London or Manchester as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

 

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

data.title: Management Consultant - Secure Government

data.description:
Role nfo

 

Join a high-profile national infrastructure programme where you'll deliver complex structural engineering solutions across reinforced concrete, steel, and civil infrastructure projects. Working within a multidisciplinary team, you'll have the opportunity to influence design decisions, ensure technical excellence, and contribute to projects of significant strategic importance.

Your role

  • Coordinate and deliver structural engineering analysis, design, and assessment for reinforced concrete, steel, and civil infrastructure projects within the GBE-N programme.
  • Produce and review structural calculations, models, drawings, specifications, and technical reports.
  • Specify and design concrete mixes for reinforced concrete structures.
  • Support the development of design substantiation and technical documentation to meet project, regulatory, and governance requirements.
  • Collaborate with civil, geotechnical, mechanical, electrical, process, construction, and safety teams to develop integrated engineering solutions.
  • Undertake assessments for normal, construction, environmental, and extreme loading conditions, including seismic loading where required.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical assurance activities, and resolution of engineering queries.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, quality requirements, and CDM 2015 obligations.

Your profile

  • Degree-qualified in Civil or Structural Engineering and working towards Chartered Engineer status (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience in the analysis and design of reinforced concrete, steel, and civil engineering structures.
  • Knowledge of relevant UK and international design codes and standards.
  • Experience supporting engineering delivery within infrastructure, energy, nuclear, or other regulated industries is desirable.
  • Understanding of structural behaviour under complex loading conditions, including construction, environmental, and accidental load cases.
  • Familiarity with design substantiation, technical reporting, and engineering assurance processes.
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams and manage technical interfaces.
  • Experience with structural analysis software and engineering digital tools.
  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Knowledge or experience using American codes and standards is desirable but not obligatory. Experience working within the Nuclear Industry and particularly on nuclear new build projects is advantageous. We also welcome applications from individuals considering a sector move, particularly those with transferable experience from other regulated or safety-critical industries.

What you'll love about working here

  • Hybrid working
  • Open access to digital learning platforms
  • Active employee networks promoting diversity, equity and inclusion like OutFront, CapAbility or Women@Capgemini

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
  • Please opt in during the application process.

Need to know

  • All roles will require a level of security clearance; This role requires BPSS check only.
  • You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusivefuture is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We havebuilt a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

data.title: Structural Engineer - Reactor Island

data.description:
THE ROLE CAN BE BASED: UK, Germany, Spain or Italy.

About the job you are considering

Capgemini's Insights & Data practice helps leading organizations harness data, AI, and analytics to drive innovation, efficiency, and transformation. As part of our global Scale Agentic Squad, the AI Solution Leader plays a critical role in helping clients design and adopt enterprise-scale Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions.

 

Working closely with an AI Growth Leader in a 'two-in-a-box' model, you will serve as the technical lead for strategic AI opportunities, shaping solution architecture, designing business-focused AI propositions, and creating the demonstrations and prototypes that bring those solutions to life. You will work directly with client technology leaders, helping organizations move from AI ambition to production-ready solutions that deliver measurable business value.

 

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role

As an AI Solution Leader, you will serve as the technical lead for Capgemini's most strategic AI transformation opportunities, helping clients move from experimentation to enterprise-scale adoption of Generative AI and Agentic AI. Working in a 'two-in-a-box' partnership with the AI Growth Leader, you will combine deep architecture expertise, consulting skills, and business acumen to define innovative solutions that address complex business challenges while delivering measurable value. You will be a trusted advisor to client executives, technology leaders, and architects, shaping AI strategies, target architectures, and implementation roadmaps that enable organizations to realize the full potential of AI.

 

You will play a pivotal role throughout the pre-sales and early delivery lifecycle, leading discovery sessions, assessing business and technical requirements, architecting scalable AI solutions, and creating compelling demonstrations and proof-of-value initiatives. By partnering with account teams, delivery leaders, and strategic technology partners, you will help clients confidently navigate the rapidly evolving AI landscape while ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise standards.

 

Key responsibilities include:

 

  • Lead discovery workshops with business and technology stakeholders to identify high-value AI use cases, business outcomes, and transformation opportunities.
  • Define end-to-end solution architectures for Generative AI and Agentic AI programmes, ensuring alignment to business objectives, technical requirements, and enterprise standards.
  • Design enterprise-scale AI architectures covering agent orchestration, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), knowledge management, integrations, governance, security, and observability.
  • Assess client technology landscapes, data estates, cloud platforms, and security frameworks to establish the foundations required for successful AI adoption.
  • Own solution design activities during strategic pursuits, including architecture, delivery approach, scope definition, effort estimation, technical risks, and governance.
  • Develop tailored demonstrations, prototypes, and proof-of-value solutions that showcase AI capabilities and accelerate client decision-making.
  • Partner closely with the AI Growth Leader to shape client opportunities, create compelling proposals, and articulate business and technical value to executive stakeholders.
  • Engage directly with CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, CDOs, and security leaders to define target-state architectures and AI adoption strategies.
  • Provide technical leadership and design authority during the early stages of programme delivery, ensuring successful transition from solution design to implementation.
  • Collaborate with strategic partners including Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI to incorporate leading technologies into client solutions.
  • Drive the development of reusable reference architectures, accelerators, demos, and solution assets that strengthen Capgemini's AI capabilities globally.
  • Mentor architects, consultants, and delivery teams, helping to build enterprise AI solutioning expertise across the wider organization.
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging AI trends, technologies, and market developments to continuously evolve Capgemini's AI offerings and architectural best practices.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor and thought leader, representing Capgemini in executive client forums, innovation workshops, industry events, and strategic transformation discussions.

Your Skills and Experience

Experience

  • Significant experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, AI Consulting, Cloud Transformation, or Technology Leadership roles.
  • Proven track record designing and implementing enterprise-scale AI, Generative AI, Data, Analytics, or Cloud solutions.
  • Experience leading technical solutioning activities for complex client pursuits and large-scale transformation programmes.
  • Strong experience engaging senior technology stakeholders including CIOs, CTOs, Chief Architects, CDOs, and Security Leaders.
  • Experience working in consulting, systems integration, hyperscaler, enterprise software, or AI-focused organizations.

 

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI orchestration frameworks, and AI application architectures.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms including Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud.
  • Experience with modern data platforms including Databricks, Snowflake, vector databases, and lakehouse architectures.
  • Understanding of data governance, responsible AI, AI security, GDPR, and AI regulatory requirements.
  • Hands-on ability to create prototypes and proof-of-value solutions using modern AI development tools and frameworks.

 

Leadership Competencies

  • Executive stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Strategic thinking and solution leadership.
  • Strong consulting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business outcomes.
  • Collaborative leadership across sales, delivery, and consulting teams.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Passion for innovation and emerging technologies.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
  • Master's degree preferred.
  • Industry certifications such as AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake, TOGAF, or equivalent AI and architecture credentials.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22.5 billion. #GetTheFutureYouWant| www.capgemini.com

THE ROLE CAN BE BASED: UK, Germany, Spain or Italy.

About the job you are considering

Capgemini's Insights & Data practice helps leading organizations harness data, AI, and analytics to drive innovation, efficiency, and transformation. As part of the Scale Agentic Squad, the AI Growth Leader will play a critical role in accelerating the adoption of Agentic AI and Generative AI across Capgemini's most strategic clients.

Working closely with an AI Solution Leader in a 'two-in-a-box' model, you will combine business strategy, executive stakeholder engagement, and commercial leadership to shape transformational AI opportunities and drive growth across strategic accounts.

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home, noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role

As an AI Growth Leader, you will be responsible for driving the commercial growth and market adoption of Capgemini's AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI offerings across strategic client accounts. Working alongside an AI Solution Leader, you will identify business opportunities, engage executive stakeholders, and help clients unlock tangible business value through AI-led transformation.

 

  • Develop and execute account-based growth strategies focused on AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data & Analytics, and Digital Transformation opportunities.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with C-suite executives, business leaders, and technology stakeholders across strategic client accounts.
  • Identify, qualify, and shape high-value AI transformation opportunities from initial client discussions through to contract signature.
  • Lead executive workshops and discovery sessions to understand client challenges, define business outcomes, and establish AI roadmaps.
  • Develop compelling business cases, value propositions, and investment justifications that demonstrate measurable business impact.
  • Partner with the AI Solution Leader to create differentiated solutions that combine Capgemini capabilities, partner technologies, and industry expertise.
  • Support proposal development, executive presentations, commercial negotiations, and strategic deal pursuits.
  • Drive AI bookings, revenue growth, pipeline generation, and sales conversion across assigned accounts.
  • Collaborate with hyperscaler and ecosystem partners including Microsoft, Google, AWS, Databricks, Snowflake, OpenAI, and Anthropic to create joint growth opportunities.
  • Act as a senior advisor to clients on AI strategy, operating models, workforce transformation, governance, and value realization.
  • Support clients in scaling AI initiatives from proof of concept to enterprise-wide adoption.
  • Provide thought leadership on market trends, emerging AI technologies, competitive developments, and industry best practices.
  • Mentor account teams and support the development of AI sales and growth capabilities across the organization.
  • Represent Capgemini at industry events, executive forums, client roundtables, and partner engagements.

Your Skills and Experience

  • Significant experience in consulting, business development, technology services, digital transformation, or AI-related leadership roles.
  • Proven track record of winning and growing large consulting or technology engagements.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales pursuits and transformation programmes.
  • Experience developing C-level relationships and influencing senior business and technology decision makers.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise operating models, transformation programmes, and value realization frameworks.
  • Experience working in global and matrixed organizations across multiple geographies.
  • track record of driving revenue growth, pipeline generation, and strategic account expansion.

 

Business & Industry Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Data & Analytics, Cloud, and Digital Transformation.
  • Ability to connect technology capabilities with business outcomes and measurable value.
  • Understanding of AI adoption challenges including governance, security, responsible AI, and organizational change.
  • Knowledge of key industry trends across Financial Services, Consumer Products, Manufacturing, Energy & Utilities, Public Sector, Telecommunications, and Life Sciences.
  • Familiarity with hyperscaler and ecosystem partner offerings, including Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Mistral AI.

 

Key Competencies

  • Executive stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Strategic thinking and market development.
  • Consultative and value-led selling.
  • Commercial and financial acumen.
  • Business case development and ROI modelling.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.
  • Relationship building and negotiation.
  • Growth mindset with an entrepreneurial approach.
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced and ambiguous environments.
  • Collaborative leadership across sales, delivery, consulting, and partner teams.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22.5 billion. #GetTheFutureYouWant| www.capgemini.com

About the Job you are considering:

Join C&CA as a Microsoft Viva Architect and help organisations create connected, engaging, and future-ready employee experiences. Guided by our vision to Consult with Purpose. Continuously Evolve. Architect Tomorrow., you will work with business, HR, security, and technology stakeholders to shape strategic employee experience solutions that drive collaboration, engagement, wellbeing, and workforce effectiveness. As a trusted, AI-fluent advisor, you will define architecture strategies, guide delivery teams, and help clients realise measurable business value through modern digital workplace transformation.

 

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise employee experience and workforce insights solutions.
  • Translate business goals into scalable, secure, and future-ready solution designs.
  • Develop architecture roadmaps, standards, and implementation approaches aligned to organisational objectives.
  • Provide architectural leadership and governance throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Collaborate with business, HR, security, data, and delivery teams to achieve successful outcomes.
  • Establish adoption frameworks, best practices, and operating models that maximise business value.
  • Enable workforce insights and organisational effectiveness through data-driven approaches and measurable outcomes.
  • Champion innovation, continuous improvement, responsible AI adoption, and future-ready workforce strategies.

 

Must-Have Skills

  • Experience designing and leading enterprise-scale employee experience or digital workplace solutions.
  • Strong enterprise and solution architecture expertise.
  • Ability to engage senior stakeholders and influence strategic decisions.
  • Experience developing architecture roadmaps, governance, and best-practice frameworks.
  • Knowledge of workforce analytics, employee engagement, and organisational effectiveness principles.
  • Strong communication, consulting, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Understanding of security, privacy, compliance, and risk management in enterprise environments.
  • Awareness of AI capabilities and their application within workplace transformation initiatives.

 

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Microsoft Viva Suite experience.
  • Microsoft 365 ecosystem knowledge.
  • Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, and Azure experience.
  • Experience integrating HR, learning, and enterprise service platforms.
  • Microsoft or enterprise architecture certifications.
  • Experience delivering large-scale digital workplace transformation programmes.

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer:

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

Make It Real (what does it mean for you):

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. 

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

 

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

The SIAM Availability Analyst will be accountable for the monitoring, governance, analysis, and continual improvement of service availability across a multi-supplier environment. The role is outcome-focused, ensuring services remain resilient, available, and aligned to business requirements while driving proactive improvement, reducing service disruption, and enhancing the end-user experience through effective supplier management and data-driven insights.

 

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.


If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

  • Own the Availability Management process across a multi-supplier environment, ensuring services meet agreed availability and resilience requirements.
  • Monitor, analyse, and report on service availability, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Drive proactive initiatives to reduce service downtime and improve service resilience.
  • Work with suppliers to investigate availability issues and implement corrective and preventative actions.
  • Manage availability governance, reviews, risk management activities, and service performance discussions.
  • Collaborate with Incident, Problem, Capacity, and Service Continuity teams while producing meaningful reporting and insights.

Your skills and experience

  • Experience in Availability Management, Service Management, or Service Performance within complex IT environments.
  • Strong understanding of SIAM principles and multi-supplier service delivery models.
  • Ability to analyse service availability data and drive continual improvement initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of ITSM practices including Incident, Problem, Change, Service Continuity, and Availability Management.
  • Experience managing service risks, resilience requirements, and critical service dependencies.
  • Strong stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 
 
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 
 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
 


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.
 
 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
 
 
 
Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
 
 
 
 
Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
 
 
 
 
Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. data.title: SIAM Availability Analyst

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

The SIAM Service Request Analyst is accountable for coordinating and supporting the end-to-end Service Request Management process across a complex multi-supplier environment. The role is outcome-focused, ensuring that service requests are managed efficiently, fulfilled within agreed service levels, and aligned to business requirements and customer expectations. The Service Request Analyst will work closely with suppliers and internal teams to oversee request fulfilment activities, monitor performance, and ensure compliance with agreed processes, standards, and service commitments. Through effective coordination, supplier engagement, performance monitoring, and continual improvement, the role contributes to enhanced end-user experience, improved operational efficiency, increased service quality, and the delivery of measurable business value.


Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.


If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

  • Coordinate and support the end-to-end Service Request Management process across a multi-supplier service environment, ensuring requests are fulfilled efficiently and within agreed service levels.
  • Work closely with suppliers, service teams, and business stakeholders to manage the lifecycle of service requests, ensuring effective prioritisation, fulfilment, communication, and closure.
  • Monitor service request performance, identifying trends, bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities to improve fulfilment times, service quality, and customer experience.
  • Ensure suppliers comply with agreed request management processes, service levels, and performance commitments, escalating issues where required to support successful outcomes.
  • Produce and analyse service request reports, dashboards, and management information, providing insights to support operational governance and decision-making.
  • Support service reviews and governance forums by providing performance data, highlighting areas for improvement, and tracking actions to drive better service outcomes across the SIAM ecosystem.
  • Contribute to continual improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to optimise request fulfilment processes, increase automation, and enhance the end-user experience.

 


You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Experience in Service Request Management, Service Management, Service Desk, or Service Integration within complex multi-supplier IT environments.
  • Strong understanding of SIAM principles, supplier governance, and the management of service requests across multiple suppliers and service towers.
  • Knowledge of ITSM best practices, including Request Management, Incident Management, Service Level Management, and Supplier Management, with a good understanding of ITIL frameworks.
  • Experience monitoring service request performance, analysing trends, producing management information, and identifying opportunities to improve service quality and customer experience.
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and ensure requests are fulfilled within agreed service levels.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with suppliers, technical teams, business stakeholders, and end users to deliver positive service outcomes.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 
 
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 
 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

 

 

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.
 
 
If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
 
 
 
Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
 
 
 
 
Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
 
 
 
 
Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

The SIAM Service Reporting and Service Level Analyst is accountable for supporting and governing service performance reporting and service level management across a complex multi-supplier environment. The role is outcome-focused, ensuring that service performance, supplier achievement, and contractual service levels are accurately measured, analysed, and reported to support effective decision-making and continual service improvement. The Service Reporting and Service Level Analyst will provide oversight of service metrics, reporting frameworks, and performance data, working collaboratively with suppliers and internal stakeholders to drive transparency, accountability, and service excellence. Through effective governance, data analysis, stakeholder engagement, and continual improvement, the role contributes to enhanced service performance, improved customer experience, increased operational efficiency, and the delivery of measurable business value.

 


Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role:

  • Support the end-to-end Service Reporting and Service Level Management (SLM) processes across a multi-supplier service environment, ensuring service performance is accurately measured, monitored, and reported against agreed targets and contractual obligations.
  • Produce, validate, and analyse service performance reports, dashboards, and management information, providing meaningful insights to operational teams, stakeholders, and governance forums.
  • Monitor supplier performance against SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and service commitments, identifying trends, risks, service breaches, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Work collaboratively with suppliers, Service Integration teams, and business stakeholders to investigate performance issues, challenge results, and drive improvement actions where targets are not achieved.
  • Support service reviews and governance meetings by preparing performance data, presenting service insights, and providing evidence-based recommendations to improve service outcomes.
  • Ensure reporting standards, data quality, and performance measurement processes are maintained, delivering accurate and consistent information across the SIAM ecosystem.
  • Contribute to continual improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance reporting, service level management processes, supplier performance, and the overall customer experience.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Experience in Service Reporting, Service Level Management, Service Management, or Service Integration within complex multi-supplier IT environments.
  • Strong understanding of SIAM principles, supplier governance, and the measurement and management of service performance across multiple suppliers and service towers.
  • Knowledge of ITSM best practices, including Service Level, Incident, Problem, Change, and Supplier Management, with a good understanding of ITIL frameworks.
  • Experience producing, analysing, and presenting service performance reports, dashboards, SLAs, KPIs, and management information for operational and business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify performance trends, service risks, improvement opportunities, and drive data-led decision-making.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with suppliers, service teams, and senior leaders to improve service performance and customer outcomes.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Some roles will also require an additional level of security clearance:

 


Security Check (SC) Clearance:

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations.
