data.description:
Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Your Role

Our Intelligent Process and Performance (IPP) consultants are at the forefront of digital process and operations transformation. You will have the opportunity to work across sector, whilst having the scope to shape your career towards a specific capability set or sector as you develop within our organisation. Intelligent Industry and more specifically IPP are often the Apollo’s of Invent. Landing first often gives more of an opportunity to test your abilities in white space and an opportunity to develop your skills in ambiguous territory. 

 

You will be working alongside some of the industry’s leading process experts, with a wealth of experience in Lean, Six Sigma, Process design and transformation, Process Mining, and Intelligent Automation technologies. Delivering through a range of different methodologies such as Agile Scrum and SAFe. 

 

Working within the Automation squad as a Managing Consultant, you will be expected to lead new/existing automation engagements, drive sales, expand accounts, develop new accounts, manage bookings, and project deliverables. Leaning both on technical acumen as well as wider strategy and transformation experience, you will act as a trusted advisor to the client(s.) You will also be responsible for engaging Partners & Vendors through sales leads, commercial frameworks, and legal agreements

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your profile

You’ll thrive in this role if you lead with impact, build trusted client relationships, and turn intelligent automation into measurable outcomes. We’re looking for a Manager who blends consulting leadership, commercial growth, strategic thinking, and hands‑on delivery.

 

Consulting Leadership & Influence

  • Previous Experience in Intelligent Automation consulting with a track record of leading hybrid teams (consulting + client) and delivering complex programmes
  • Confident with executive stakeholder management; an excellent storyteller who can influence senior decision‑making
  • Mentors and grows teams—develops technical skillsets, builds capability roadmaps, and fosters a high‑performance culture
  • Builds networks quickly—strong internal and external rapport‑building and partner engagement
  • Lead and contribute to the full lifecycle of intelligent automation solutions—from discovery through to delivery and optimisation.

 

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Hands‑on experience with Intelligent Automation technologies (e.g., RPA, AI/ML, NLP, IDP).
  • Knowledge of on‑premise and cloud architectures.
  • Understanding of business analysis methods such as BPMN and DMN.
  • Awareness of RTA legislation and automation within sustainability topics.
  • Experience developing technical capabilities within teams
  • Design solutions across IDP, NLP, ML, RPA, workflow orchestration, and low‑code platforms.
  • Assess client automation maturity and shape strategic roadmaps.

  • Hyperscience, Appian, UiPath, Dynamics365, Pega, NICE, BluePrism, ABBYY, Kofax, Automation Anywhere, ServiceNow, Power Platform

  • Background delivering within agile or scaled‑agile environments
  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, Dynamics or typical back‑office finance processes
  • IoT exposure

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Within II and specifically IPP, you will be part of a dynamic, startup-style environment within Capgemini that encourages innovation, curiosity, and co-creation. You will work on cutting-edge digital transformation projects, using the latest in automation, AI, and process intelligence to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact. You will build strong relationships across Capgemini and with external clients and technology partners to create high-value solutions. With opportunities to work across industries and capabilities, every project brings something new, giving continuous opportunities to grow both professionally and personally. Whilst you will be part of a global network, you will equally enjoy the close-knit, supportive culture of a local team that is committed to your development and success. 

Need To Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester, Newcastle or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

data.description:
Your Role

  • Deliver structural engineering analysis, design, and assessment for reinforced concrete, steel, and civil infrastructure projects within the GBE‑N programme.
  • Produce and review structural calculations, models, drawings, specifications, and technical reports.
  • Support the development of design substantiation and technical documentation to meet project, regulatory, and governance requirements.
  • Collaborate with civil, geotechnical, mechanical, electrical, process, construction, and safety teams to develop integrated engineering solutions.
  • Undertake assessments for normal, construction, environmental, and extreme loading conditions, including seismic loading where required.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical assurance activities, and resolution of engineering queries.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable codes, standards, quality requirements, and CDM 2015 obligations.
  • Support continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and mentoring of graduate and early-career engineers. 

Your Profile

  • Degree-qualified in Civil or Structural Engineering, working towards Chartered Engineer (CEng) status or offering equivalent experience.
  • Experienced in the analysis and design of reinforced concrete, steel, and civil engineering structures, with a solid understanding of UK and international design standards.
  • Knowledge of structural behaviour under complex loading conditions, including construction, environmental, and accidental load cases.
  • Familiarity with design substantiation, technical reporting, engineering assurance processes, and structural analysis software and digital engineering tools.
  • Strong communicator with excellent problem-solving skills, able to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams, manage technical interfaces, and engage with stakeholders.

Knowledge or experience using American codes and standards is desirable but not obligatory. Experience working within the Nuclear Industry and particularly on nuclear new build projects is advantageous. We also welcome applications from individuals considering a sector move, particularly those with transferable experience from other regulated or safety-critical industries.

About the Role

Capgemini’s Business Services Global Business Line is seeking an experienced Amazon Connect GTM & Solutions Lead to drive strategy, solution design, and market growth for our Contact Center transformation offerings. This role is ideal for a dynamic leader passionate about Customer Experience, digital transformation, and solving complex Contact Center challenges using Amazon Connect and next‑gen CCaaS solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Solutioning & Delivery

  • Build, design, and implement Amazon Connect CCaaS solutions for large, multi‑client environments.
  • Develop comprehensive Contact Center solutions including telephony, CRM, KM, IVR, ACD, WFM, QA, training, performance management, and workforce models.
  • Transform proposed solutions into executable delivery plans across operations, technology, and workforce domains.
  • Lead the development of end‑to‑end operational strategies aimed at enhancing customer and client experience.

Consulting & GTM Leadership

  • Serve as the strategic lead for Amazon Connect‑based pursuits during the pre sales and solutioning phases.
  • Assess client challenges and provide data-driven, outcome‑oriented recommendations.
  • Participate in shaping GTM strategies, service offerings, and transformation assets.

Team Leadership & Enablement

  • Manage consultants and transformation teams involved in Contact Center design and implementation.
  • Contribute to operating model design, service standards, staffing pyramids, and team readiness.
  • Guide and mentor teams to ensure high‑quality delivery and operational excellence.

Commercial & Technical Expertise

  • Conduct commercial modeling, effort estimation, solution sizing, and dependencies/assumption mapping.
  • Provide expert knowledge of Contact Center ecosystems including Amazon Connect, Genesys Cloud, and associated applications.
  • Apply process improvement methodologies to optimize delivery and performance.

CX & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive client CX transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline processes and enhance engagement.
  • Champion innovation and best practices within Contact Center operations and technology infrastructure

Qualifications and Experience

Must Have

  • 5 to 10 years of consulting or relevant experience delivering Contact Center technology solutions with a strong focus on Amazon Connect.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands on experience in BPO or multi‑client Contact Center operations using Amazon Connect or other cloud CCaaS platforms such as Genesys Cloud.
  • Proven experience in Contact Center solution architecture, technical design, and operational transformation.

About the job you’re considering

The SIAM Problem Analyst is accountable for identifying, analysing, and managing problems across a complex multi-supplier environment to reduce the impact and recurrence of service disruptions.

The role is outcome-focused, ensuring that underlying causes of incidents are investigated and addressed through effective supplier governance, collaboration, and service integration. The Problem Analyst will drive root cause analysis, coordinate permanent resolutions, and maintain oversight of problem records while ensuring suppliers meet their problem management obligations and performance commitments. Through proactive trend analysis, continual improvement, and data-driven insights, the role contributes to improved service stability, reduced incident volumes, enhanced end-user experience, increased operational resilience, and the delivery of measurable business value.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

  • Own the end-to-end Problem Management process across a multi-supplier service environment, ensuring problems are identified, prioritised, investigated, and managed effectively to reduce service disruption.
  • Coordinate suppliers and internal support teams to perform root cause analysis, identify permanent fixes, and drive resolution of underlying service issues.
  • Manage the lifecycle of problem records, ensuring timely investigation, escalation, communication, and governance in line with agreed processes and service levels.
  • Monitor incident and problem trends, identifying recurring issues, risks, and opportunities to improve service stability, resilience, and performance.
  • Chair problem review meetings and facilitate cross-supplier collaboration to address complex issues, remove barriers, and ensure accountability for actions and outcomes.
  • Produce meaningful problem management reports, trend analysis, and management information to support operational, governance, and strategic decision-making.
  • Lead continual improvement activities arising from problem investigations, ensuring lessons learned, corrective actions, and preventative measures are tracked and delivered.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Proven experience in Problem Management, Service Management, or Service Integration within complex multi-supplier IT environments.
  • Strong understanding of SIAM principles, supplier governance, and the coordination of services across multiple support teams and service towers.
  • Experience conducting and facilitating root cause analysis, managing problem records, and driving permanent resolutions to reduce recurring service issues.
  • Strong knowledge of ITSM practices, including Problem, Incident, Change, Service Level, and Supplier Management, with a good understanding of ITIL.
  • Ability to analyse incident, problem, and service performance data to identify trends, risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for continual improvement.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and analytical skills, with the ability to influence suppliers and engage effectively with technical teams, customers, and senior leaders.

data.title: Problem Analyst

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

We’re seeking a seasoned Managed Services Lead Architect who wants to apply their skills and experience within an exciting and vibrant Account. The client is going through a period of significant change, and digital transformation is at the forefront of their business strategy. As an Account Lead Architect, you will thrive on having responsibility for the end-to-end architecture of the contracted services as well as being the focal point for ensuring its technical integrity. Being part of an enthusiastic Business Technologist community will enable you to maintain awareness of the latest technologies and innovations within the Capgemini Portfolio and apply these to your technology landscape. You will also provide inspiration and act as a role model for a talented and enthusiastic team of Domain Architects and Engineers on the account.


On Site Requirement: This is an on-site role where you will be required to work from the client site 5-days per week, with no opportunity for hybrid or home working.

Your role

As an integral part of the Capgemini Architecture community, you’ll have fantastic opportunities to develop both yourself, and our collective capabilities. As part of the Account team, you’ll be empowered to provide:

 

  • Governance of change within, and take ownership of, the end-to-end Account Architecture within Managed Services contracts, ensuring delivery quality and adherence to standards.
  • Key stakeholder management for internal, as well as external parties.
  • Strategic mapping of the technology landscape strategy including roadmaps, and future state architectures, fully aligned with contractual commitments and client needs.
  • Trusted advice to the Client by cultivating strong symbiotic Client relationships.
  • Direction and guidance on technical aspects, ensuring adherence to standards and practices while aligning with client requirements.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

A proven track record of governing and owning the end-to-end architecture of a complex technology landscape. Can demonstrate experience of operating as a Lead Architect within the constraints and complexities of large Managed Services accounts. Able to demonstrate a knowledge of contracts and commercials as well as proven stakeholder management and client relationship skills.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

 

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Some roles will also require an additional level of security clearance:

 


Security Check (SC) Clearance:

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

The SIAM Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM) Analyst is accountable for supporting and governing the end-to-end Service Asset and Configuration Management process across a complex multi-supplier environment. The role is outcome-focused, ensuring that asset and configuration information is accurate, reliable, and maintained throughout its lifecycle to support effective service delivery and decision-making. The SACM Analyst will maintain oversight of configuration data, support CMDB governance, and work collaboratively with suppliers and internal teams to ensure adherence to SACM processes, standards, and quality requirements. Through effective data management, supplier engagement, governance, and continual improvement, the role contributes to improved service visibility, enhanced operational resilience, reduced service risk, and the delivery of measurable business value.


Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

  • Support and coordinate the end-to-end Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM) process across a multi-supplier service environment, ensuring asset and configuration data is maintained accurately and in accordance with agreed standards.
  • Manage and maintain the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), ensuring configuration items, relationships, and dependencies are correctly recorded, validated, and controlled throughout their lifecycle.
  • Work collaboratively with suppliers, technical teams, and service management functions to ensure SACM processes are followed and configuration data remains accurate, complete, and fit for purpose.
  • Monitor and report on CMDB data quality, compliance, and asset management performance, identifying risks, discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support configuration audits, verification activities, and governance forums, driving accountability for the resolution of data quality issues and non-compliance.
  • Provide asset and configuration information to support Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Service Continuity processes, enabling informed decision-making and effective service management.
  • Produce SACM reporting, metrics, and management information, while contributing to continual improvement initiatives that enhance data integrity, operational resilience, and service outcomes across the SIAM ecosystem.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Experience in Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM), Configuration Management, Service Management, or Service Integration within complex multi-supplier IT environments.
  • Strong understanding of SIAM principles, supplier governance, and the management of asset and configuration data across multiple suppliers, service towers, and technology platforms.\
  • Experience managing and maintaining CMDBs, configuration items (CIs), relationships, and data quality processes to ensure accurate and reliable configuration information.
  • Strong knowledge of ITSM practices, including SACM, Change, Incident, Problem, Release, and Service Level Management, supported by a good understanding of ITIL best practices.
  • Ability to analyse asset and configuration data, identify risks, discrepancies, and compliance issues, and drive improvements to data quality and process effectiveness.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with suppliers, technical teams, and business stakeholders to deliver strong governance and service outcomes.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Some roles will also require an additional level of security clearance:

 


Security Check (SC) Clearance:

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The role is outcome-focused, ensuring catalogue services are accurate, standardised, accessible, and aligned to business requirements while driving service transparency, enhancing the end-user experience, and supporting efficient service delivery through effective supplier management and data-driven insights.


Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

  • Owning the end-to-end Service Catalogue Management process across a multi-supplier service environment, ensuring catalogue content is accurate, current, and aligned to business requirements.
  • Maintaining and governing the service catalogue, ensuring services are clearly defined, standardised, and accessible to stakeholders and end users.
  • Work with suppliers and stakeholders to ensure catalogue information remains complete, consistent, and compliant with governance requirements.
  • Monitor catalogue quality, identify risks and data issues, and coordinate catalogue reviews and service lifecycle updates.
  • Produce catalogue reporting and insights to support operational, governance, and strategic decision-making.
  • Drive continual improvement initiatives that enhance service visibility, service transparency, and end-user experience.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Experience in Service Catalogue Management, Service Management, or Service Governance within complex multi-supplier IT environments
  • Strong understanding of SIAM principles and the management of services across multiple suppliers and service towers
  • Experience maintaining service catalogues, service definitions, ownership models, and service lifecycle activities.
  • Strong knowledge of ITSM practices including Service Catalogue Management, Request Fulfilment, Change, Configuration, and Asset Management.
  • Ability to analyse catalogue data, identify gaps and inconsistencies, and improve service visibility and user experience.
  • Strong stakeholder management, governance, analytical, and communication skills.

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

 

The SIAM Problem Manager is accountable for leading and governing the end-to-end Problem Management process across a complex multi-supplier environment. The role is outcome-focused, ensuring that the root causes of incidents and service disruptions are identified, investigated, and addressed through effective supplier management, collaboration, and service integration. The Problem Manager will oversee problem governance, drive cross-supplier accountability for permanent resolutions, and ensure that corrective and preventative actions are delivered to improve service performance and resilience. Through proactive trend analysis, continual improvement, and data-driven decision-making, the role contributes to reduced incident recurrence, improved service stability, enhanced end-user experience, increased operational resilience, and the delivery of measurable business value

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.


If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

  • Own and govern the end-to-end Problem Management process across a multi-supplier environment, ensuring problems are identified, prioritised, investigated, and managed effectively to reduce service disruption.
  • Perform and facilitate root cause analysis, driving permanent resolutions to recurring service issues and improving service stability.
  • Manage problem records throughout their lifecycle, ensuring timely investigation, escalation, communication, and governance.
  • Analyse incident and problem trends to identify recurring issues, risks, and opportunities for continual improvement.
  • Chair problem review meetings and facilitate cross-supplier collaboration to drive accountability, resolution, and service improvement.
  • Produce problem management reporting, trend analysis, and management information to support operational, governance, and strategic decision-making.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Proven experience in Problem Management, Service Management, or Service Integration within complex multi-supplier IT environments.
  • Strong understanding of SIAM principles, supplier governance, and the coordination of services across multiple support teams and service towers.
  • Experience conducting root cause analysis, managing problem records, and driving permanent resolutions to recurring service issues.
  • Strong knowledge of ITSM practices including Problem, Incident, Change, Service Level, and Supplier Management, supported by ITIL.
  • Ability to analyse incident, problem, and service performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for continual improvement.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and analytical skills, with the ability to influence suppliers and engage effectively with technical teams, customers, and senior leaders.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 
 
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 
 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
 

 

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.
 
 
If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
 
 
 
Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
 
 
 
 
Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
 
 
 
 
Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.
 

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

The SIAM Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM) Manager is accountable for leading and governing the end-to-end Service Asset and Configuration Management process across a complex multi-supplier environment. The role is outcome-focused, ensuring that asset and configuration information is accurate, reliable, and effectively managed throughout its lifecycle to support service delivery, operational decision-making, and risk management. The SACM Manager will provide strategic oversight of the CMDB and asset management practices, drive cross-supplier compliance with SACM policies and standards, and ensure configuration data integrity across the service landscape. Through effective governance, supplier management, stakeholder engagement, and continual improvement, the role contributes to enhanced service visibility, improved operational resilience, reduced service risk, and the delivery of measurable business value.

Your role

  • Own and govern the end-to-end Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM) process across a multi-supplier service environment, ensuring asset and configuration information is accurate, controlled, and aligned with business and service needs.
  • Provide strategic oversight of the CMDB and asset management practices, ensuring configuration items, relationships, and dependencies are effectively managed throughout their lifecycle.
  • Lead collaboration with suppliers, service providers, and internal teams to drive compliance with SACM policies, standards, governance controls, and contractual obligations.
  • Oversee configuration audits, data quality reviews, and compliance activities, ensuring risks, discrepancies, and control weaknesses are identified and addressed.
  • Produce and present SACM reporting, performance metrics, and management information, providing insights to support operational governance, risk management, and decision-making.
  • Drive continual improvement initiatives to enhance CMDB accuracy, asset visibility, process maturity, and supplier performance, contributing to improved service resilience and operational effectiveness across the SIAM ecosystem.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Proven experience in Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM), Configuration Management, Service Management, or Service Integration leadership roles within complex multi-supplier IT environments.
  • Strong understanding of SIAM principles, supplier governance, and the management of asset and configuration data across multiple suppliers, service towers, and technology platforms.
  • Demonstrable experience managing CMDB governance, asset lifecycle management, configuration audits, and data quality initiatives to ensure accurate and reliable configuration information.
  • Strong knowledge of ITSM best practices, including SACM, Change, Incident, Problem, Release, and Service Level Management, with a solid understanding of ITIL frameworks.
  • Ability to analyse configuration, asset, and service performance data to identify risks, compliance issues, improvement opportunities, and drive enhanced operational resilience.
  • Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to influence suppliers, drive governance compliance, and collaborate effectively with technical teams, operational stakeholders, and senior leaders.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 
 
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 
 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
 


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.
 
 
If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
 
 
 
Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
 
 
 
 
Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
 
 
 
 
Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

Job Title: Business Analyst

Location: Glasgow

 

About the Job you are considering:

Join a dynamic Investment Banking team where you'll bridge business and technology, driving process improvements and delivering Agile-based solutions. You'll collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, analyze workflows, and support end-to-end project delivery.

 

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

Your Role

  • 6 years’ experience in an investment banking environment with strong skills in analysing business processes supporting data structures and recommending improvements
  • 4 years’ experience working as part of an agile development team
  • Basic to Intermediate knowledge of the Investment Banking business products sold lifecycle of a deal’s origination and execution model
  • Knowledge of Agile framework software development processes and SDLC
  • Familiarity with workflow modelling and process flow modelling techniques using tools such as Visio PowerPoint
  • Advanced communication skills stakeholder management skills and ability to manage time on multiple priorities effectively
  • Advanced skills with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint to be able to run pivots and macros to better analyse data trends turn granular asks into high level themes for stakeholder presentations and high-level vision boards
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or equivalent field
  • Must be confident in leading discussions and requirements discovery workshops with various stakeholders within the business and It organization and should have strong presentation skills
  • Familiarity with requirements definition and management lifecycle and being adept with tools such as JIRA to manage requirements backlogs sprint boards
  • Basic familiarity with requirements prioritization techniques via appropriate tools and models and being able to effectively trace functional requirements to overlying business asks Eg MoSCoW RICE

Your Skills

  • Knowledge of SQL skills to support data analysis and mining trends
  • Master’s degree in a technical field
  • Great analytical skills and ability to use them in multiple user and IT environments globally
  • Understanding of cucumber for acceptance criteria management
  • Knowledge of Salesforce nice to have
  • Proactive team player with well-developed interpersonal skills
  • Flexibility and ability to handle multiple tasks
  • Ability to deal with high stress situations calmly

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer:

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

Make It Real (what does it mean for you):

  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

 

About Capgemini:

With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. data.title: Business Analyst

data.description:
About the job you're considering

 

As part of Capgemini’s Cloud & Custom Applications business area, you’ll join a high‑performing Business Analysis community that plays a central role in shaping digital services for some of the UK’s largest private and public sector organisations. Our teams work at the heart of transformation programmes — helping clients modernise their technology, redesign user experiences, and build solutions that make a real difference.

 

In this role, you’ll be part of multidisciplinary delivery teams where Business Analysts are trusted partners from day one. You’ll work closely with designers, engineers, product leads, and stakeholders to uncover needs, define outcomes, and guide the creation of user‑centred digital products and services. No two projects are the same, and your work will span discovery through to delivery, with opportunities to contribute your insight, creativity, and problem‑solving skills at every stage.

 

We’re looking for people who are curious, collaborative, and motivated by helping clients achieve meaningful change. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy working in fast‑moving environments, asking the right questions, shaping clarity from complexity, and building strong relationships. Whether you’re early in your career or highly experienced, you’ll join a supportive community that invests in your growth and values the impact you make.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role

 

  • Work closely with senior stakeholders and business users to understand their needs and translate them into clear, well‑defined requirements that guide digital solutions.
    Represent the voice of the user throughout delivery, helping keep teams aligned and ensuring decisions support the overall vision.

 

  • Collaborate with designers, architects, developers, and testers to shape customer journeys, solution designs, and delivery approaches.

 

  • Support project planning by contributing to estimates, resourcing discussions, and delivery timelines.

 

  • Continuously improve how we work by sharing insights, reusable assets, and good practice across the business analysis community - for senior roles: mentor and support junior colleagues, helping them grow their skills and confidence.

 

  • You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

 

 

  • Experience delivering digital and IT solutions across varied technologies — for example AI‑enabled platforms, CRM or CMS systems, mobile applications, or integrated online services.

 

  • Practical experience working through the full delivery lifecycle in Agile or iterative environments, creating high‑quality artefacts such as backlogs, user journeys, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

 

  • Confident using a range of techniques to understand user and business needs — from interviews and workshops to observation, prototyping, and using AI tools to support analysis and insight generation.

 

  • Strong ability to analyse and document functional and non‑functional requirements, ensuring solutions meet user expectations, performance needs, and operational constraints.

 

  • Experience applying systems analysis and data‑modelling approaches to support solution design, data flows, and process optimisation, particularly in complex or integrated environments.

 

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage technical and non‑technical stakeholders at all levels.

 

  • For senior roles, mentor and coach junior Business Analysts and graduates, supporting their development and strengthening the wider BA community.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

 

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
Declare they have a disability, and Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


Please opt in during the application process.

 

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 

 

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

 

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements

 

You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 12 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini

 

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

 

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering​

Commercial management role within the Capgemini Commercial Team, providing ongoing Commercial and Contractual support for Projects, Programmes and Services Teams working directly with the client. Account turnover circa £350m pa. The role will also provide commercial support to new client tenders/bids and work closely with the teams Ecosystem and Partner Relationship Management functions to build and maintain positive, value-creation relationships with suppliers.

identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent
criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role ​

•    Work across the business, supporting multiple complex commercial arrangements
•    Be a lead contributor to the structure, review and commercial approval of new bids Change Requests, Proposals and Contract Change Notes
•    Provide proactive commercial input to client proposals; deals; bids and supporting subsequent commercial negotiations
•    Assist with commercial issues escalation, investigation and resolution
•    Attendance at relevant client meetings with stakeholders
•    Maintain commercial and contract documentation to ensure currency and availability
•    Process development, commercial governance and obligation management (including advice to non-commercial teams on commercial-related processes)
•    Support the Partner Relationship Manager and Ecosystem team to build and maintain positive, value-creation relationships with suppliers
•    Build multi-category skills to support the wide range of procurement and partner relationship management requirements needed to fulfil multiple contractual engagements with our customer
•    Support delivery and the business on bid work, helping to win and maintain business, drive value and mitigate risk
•    Contract interpretation and communication of contract changes and commercial decisions as required
•    Commercial advice/awareness/contract education
•    Work closely with legal counsel

Your skills and experience

•    Relevant Commercial and Contract management experience working with UK public sector or legislation driven sectors such as energy or telecoms.
•    Experience of proposal/bid development and approvals
•    Understands the principles and needs of risk management
•    A strong consultative and stakeholder management approach
•    Works effectively in a cross-functional collaborative environment, proactively supporting others and readily embracing new challenges
•    Positive energy, strong work ethic and a track record of encouraging this in others
•    Able to work under pressure and retain composure in demanding situations
•    Demonstrates a flexible attitude and ability to identify optimisation opportunities
•    A broad business focussed ethos

​​

Please opt in during the application process.​

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role you will need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard checks. ​

There are no nationality or residency restrictions, although if you have resided outside of the UK within the last 3 years, further checks may be required.​

There are other criteria and check required for BPSS, and throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. ​

data.title: Senior Commercial Manager

data.description:
About the job you're considering

You’ll be joining a passionate, professional and highly skilled team of architects and engineers who specialise in building and integrating custom software solutions at enterprise scale.  
 
Innovation in delivery is always at the forefront of our minds, which is why we utilise a variety of cloud, open source and proprietary technologies to achieve the best possible outcome for our clients.  
 
We have world class architecture and software engineering communities; we invest in doing things right and have plenty to say on the subject.  We’re active on social media and for those that want to find out more, take a look. 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

Solution Architects shape and define solution architectures for our clients.  These architectures are used to define project plans, manage detailed design, inform technical risk analysis and support estimation. We work with a client from the earliest stages of a project through to delivery and ‘go live’.  We provide technical leadership and support to the Programme Director or Engagement manager. As a member of our solution architecture team, you will bring a mix of technical skills, industry insight, business acumen and leadership.  You will forge close working relationships not only with our architecture and engineering teams in UK and India, but also with the many other disciplines in Capgemini such as engagement managers and account executives.  You will take a leading role in both delivery and business development to shape and design innovative, custom solutions for our clients. 
  
•    Work on some of the most leading edge cloud-native architectures in development today. 
•    Take end-to-end ownership of shaping solutions & defining the right architectural approach. 
•    Collaborate closely with our engineering teams to ensure our solutions are built to reflect your solution vision and make the best use of current development practices. 
•    Be a trusted technology adviser to our clients as well as to Capgemini colleagues. 


You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

•    Excellent knowledge of AWS for delivery of cloud-native solutions. 
•    A strong background in open-source technologies and frameworks; API-centric architecture, and experience of designing scalable, resilient and secure applications. 
•    Microservice-based architectures using domain driven design, event sourcing patterns and containerisation technologies 
•    Exposure to and some experience of working with structured architecture approaches such as TOGAF or SAFe 

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your Security Clearance

Developed Vetting (DV)

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Developed Vetting (DV) clearance.

To obtain DV clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 10 years, along with other very detailed criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process

Make it real - what does it mean?

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you are considering

Capgemini’s Insights & Data practice helps leading organizations harness data and Artificial Intelligence to drive innovation, efficiency, and business transformation. As organizations accelerate adoption of Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies, we are expanding our capability to deliver intelligent, scalable, and secure AI solutions that create measurable business value. 

 

We are looking for a Senior Agentic AI Solution Specialist to join our growing AI team. In this client-facing role, you will work with business and technology stakeholders to design, develop, and implement advanced AI solutions. You will help clients translate business challenges into scalable AI architectures, leveraging Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and modern cloud technologies.  
The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home, noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role

  • Design and develop enterprise AI solutions, with a particular focus on Agentic AI, Generative AI, and RAG architectures.
  • Work with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solution designs. 
  • Build, integrate, and optimize AI applications using Python and leading AI development frameworks. 
  • Implement and enhance AI solutions through prompt engineering, embeddings, orchestration frameworks, and security controls. 
  • Develop solutions on cloud platforms including Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform, utilizing modern AI and data services.  
  • Collaborate with architects, data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. 
  • Provide technical leadership on AI solution architecture, best practices, and technical delivery.  
  • Keep pace with advancements in Large Language Models, Agentic AI, cloud technologies, and emerging AI frameworks, incorporating relevant innovations into client solutions. 
  • Support business development activities, client workshops, proof-of-concepts, and solution demonstrations where required.
  • Ensure AI solutions align with security, governance, Responsible AI, and enterprise architecture standards.

Your Skills and Experience

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related STEM discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
  • Strong experience developing AI solutions using Python and modern AI frameworks such as LangChain or similar technologies. 
  • Deep understanding of LLM architectures, Generative AI, Agentic AI concepts, RAG frameworks, embeddings, and prompt engineering.
  • Experience designing and deploying solutions on Azure, AWS, or GCP cloud platforms.  
  • Experience working in a technical client-facing role, preferably delivering AI or data-driven transformation programmes. 
  • Strong understanding of AI solution architecture, systems integration, and enterprise application development.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working in consulting or professional services environments is advantageous.  
  • Knowledge of security, privacy, governance, and Responsible AI practices.
  • Strong stakeholder management, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.


By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.  

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com
