About the job you're considering

We work closely with clients and partners to take full advantage of the opportunities of technology. We mobilize expert teams that create custom solutions from existing and emerging technology to deliver viable outcomes at speed. We call this 'Value in the making.'
Part of the Capgemini Group, Sogeti makes business value through technology for organizations that need to implement innovation at speed and want a local partner with global scale. With a hands-on culture and close proximity to its clients, Sogeti is currently looking for a Azure Databricks Architect to join our ACT Practice, ensuring alignment with business goals and driving impactful value creation for our clients.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Mandatory Skills

Enterprise Architecture

  • Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale Azure Databricks platforms
  • Platform strategy, roadmap development, and technology governance
  • Design of scalable, secure, and cost-optimised cloud data platforms

Databricks & Azure Expertise

  • Deep understanding of Databricks Serverless, SQL Warehouses, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and platform governance
  • Azure networking, identity, security, and private connectivity architecture
  • Enterprise-scale performance and workload optimisation


FinOps Leadership

  • Design and implementation of FinOps operating models
  • Cost attribution frameworks
  • Budget governance, chargeback/showback models
  • Enterprise tagging strategies and policy enforcement


Security & Governance

  • Data governance and platform security architecture
  • Secure integration patterns
  • Regulatory and compliance alignment
  • Operational guardrails, standards, and controls

Platform Transformation

  • Discovery Zone architecture and onboarding frameworks
  • Migration strategy from POSIT/RStudio and other analytical platforms
  • Technology rationalisation and reduction of platform sprawl

Essential Skills

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Leading architecture decisions across multiple delivery teams
  • Engagement with business stakeholders, security teams, and enterprise architects
  • Technical leadership and mentoring
  • Data & Analytics Architecture

End-to-end data platform design

  • Lakehouse architecture patterns
  • Data integration frameworks
  • BI, Analytics, AI/ML, and consumption-layer architecture
  • Migration & Transformation

Enterprise platform modernisation programmes

  • Cloud transformation initiatives
  • Adoption frameworks and governance models
  • Documentation & Standards

Architecture blueprints

  • Design authorities and technical standards
  • Reference architectures and implementation patterns

Desirable Skills

  • Large-scale Azure and Databricks transformation programmes
  • POSIT/RStudio consolidation programmes
  • AI/ML platform architecture
  • LLM, Model Serving, Vector Retrieval, and RAG architecture
  • Regulated industry experience (Financial Services, Insurance, Public Sector, Utilities)

We are a Disability Confident Employer:

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

Declare they have a disability, and
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

What does 'Get The Future You Want' mean for you?

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Management or, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. Job Title: Collections & Recoveries Configuration SME

Location: London

About the Job you are considering:

The Strategic Debt Manager (SDM) Configuration SME will be responsible for configuring, optimizing, and supporting Collections and Recoveries strategies within the CR Software Strategic Debt Manager (SDM) platform, supporting migration from Tallyman GRS to SDM. The role involves designing and maintaining workflow configurations, business rules, customer segmentation, and treatment strategies to ensure effective debt management and collections operations. The successful candidate will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to translate collections and recoveries requirements into SDM solutions.

Hybrid working: 

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role:

  • Configure SDM collections recoveries and communication strategies workflows and treatment paths.
  • Analyse existing Tallyman GRS configurations and map them to SDM capabilities.
  • Support requirements gathering design workshops and future state solution definition.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and optimize collections processes and strategy execution.
  • Support testing defect resolution and production readiness activities.

Your Skills:

  • Hands-on experience in configuring and supporting CR Software Strategic Debt Manager (SDM) solutions.
  • Strong understanding of Collections, Recoveries, and Debt Management processes within the banking and financial services industry.
  • Experience working with Tallyman GRS or other enterprise collections and recoveries platforms.
  • Solid knowledge of workflow configuration, business rules engines, customer segmentation, and treatment strategy management.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and optimizing collections and recovery strategies to improve operational performance.
  • Proven ability to support collections platform migrations, system upgrades, and transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end debt management lifecycle, including early arrears, collections, recoveries, and write-off processes.
  • Experience collaborating with business stakeholders to translate collections and recovery requirements into system configurations.
  • Knowledge of testing, defect management, UAT support, and production deployment activities for collections applications.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills within enterprise banking environments.

Your role

Capgemini Engineering is looking for OSS Data Architect who will be the senior technical authority responsible for designing the end-to-end data extraction, connectivity, and ingestion architecture. You will define the technical strategy and standardized patterns for integrating dozens of complex, on-premise Operations Support Systems (OSS) with the Cloud Platform preferably GCP.

 

In this role you will play a key role in:

  • Architectural Strategy & Design
  • Technical Governance & Standards
  • Stakeholder Management & Technical Leadership
  • Security & Compliance

Your profile

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Overall 12-15+ years’ experience with 8-10+ years of experience in data architecture, with a significant focus on data integration, ETL/ELT, and data warehousing in large enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing data integration solutions for a wide range of telecommunications OSS domains (e.g., Inventory, Performance, Fault, Provisioning, Ticketing etc).
  • Expert-level knowledge of multiple data ingestion patterns, including batch file processing, API integration (REST/SOAP), RDBMS querying (JDBC), and real-time data streaming (CDC, Kafka, etc.).
  • Deep understanding of hybrid cloud connectivity and security principles, including VPNs, dedicated interconnects, firewalls, and API security.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and govern reusable architectural patterns and technical standards for large-scale development teams.

 

Highly Desirable

  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, particularly BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Interconnect, and Apigee.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD principles in a data context (DataOps).
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical stakeholders and mentor other engineers.

 

If you're excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply, your unique experience could be just what we need.

Make it real - what does it mean for you?

    • Open access to digital learning platforms​
    • Active employee networks promoting diversity, equity and inclusion like OutFront, CapAbility or Women@Capgemini​

    ​

    Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:​

    • Declare they have a disability, and ​
    • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.​
    • Please opt in during the application process.​

    ​

    Capgemini. Make it real.

Need to know

  • Due to the nature of the project this role requires Sole UK National. ​
  • This is a hybrid role requires 3 days/week office presence based in Newbury.
  • You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusivefuture is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We havebuilt a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Location: London

About the Job you are considering:

The SDM Architect Technical Lead will define and lead the technical architecture for the SDM migration programme ensuring successful transition of Collections Recoveries capabilities from Tallyman GRS to SDM Configuration and design architect for various products on the CNR product platform by understanding various products needs under one platform Mult instance.

Hybrid working: 

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role:

  • Define the target-state SDM (Debt Manager) architecture and migration roadmap.
  • Lead end-to-end solution design for Collections, Recoveries, integrations, and data migration.
  • Assess current-state platforms and recommend future-state architecture strategies.
  • Provide technical leadership across design, development, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support.
  • Drive architecture governance and ensure alignment with enterprise standards.
  • Collaborate with Business SMEs, Enterprise Architects, CR Software teams, and delivery teams.
  • Oversee platform modernization and large-scale migration initiatives.
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies, and implementation challenges.
  • Ensure scalable, secure, and resilient debt management solutions.
  • Support stakeholder engagement and strategic decision-making throughout the program lifecycle.

  • Strong domain knowledge of Collections, Recoveries, and Debt Management platforms.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale collections platform migration programs.
  • Expertise in enterprise architecture and solution design.
  • Strong system integration experience using APIs, middleware, and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience designing and executing complex data migration strategies.
  • Knowledge of application modernization and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of architecture governance and solution assurance practices.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional technical and business teams.

You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

data.description:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.  

YOUR ROLE

Our Digital Business Architects put people at the heart of our work driving better business outcomes with and for our clients. We shape this future, as talented Architects delivering leading-edge digital solutions for our clients, combining a clear understanding of business value and a consultative approach to make the difference, considering the transformative potential of ethical AI to reshape the modern world in every engagement.  We embed sustainability in everything we do, acting as a force multiplier and walking the talk on the path to net zero.  Invent Digital Business Architects thrive on the intersection of consulting and architecture, being equally comfortable pitching value propositions as they are creating business capability maps.  

 

Working with leading architects, technology consultants and business sector experts, you will be instrumental in delivering profitable outcomes in business- and technology-oriented environments, helping a broad range of private- and public-sector clients to achieve their strategic goals.  Our Digital Business Architects sit within the Digital Architecture guild, part of the Business Technology practice in Capgemini Invent. We are a dynamic community that values growth, professional development, and the ability to make a real difference. We work in diverse multi-disciplinary teams, hand-in-glove with our clients. 

 

In this role you will play a key role in: 

  • Help clients define their digital strategy and build the business case for investing in ground-breaking AI and other digital technologies 
  • Define compelling customer value propositions and winning business models for the digital era, then creating and documenting solution blueprints, roadmaps, capability models, or operating models.  
  • Applying Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) to structure delivery teams around value chains and create features and epics. 
  • Applying Design Thinking to develop personas, define pain points, define MVPs and prototypes, and designing experiments to test solution hypotheses.   
  • Cultivate strong relationships among working teams and build enduring relationships with senior leadership, and work closely with SMEs to ensure design feasibility, viability, and compliance. Max 5 bullet points explaining the role 

 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories: 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events. 
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development. 
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc. 

YOUR PROFILE

Key skills and experience we’re looking for: 

  • Business architecture experience in consulting or industry (Business/Enterprise Architect, Senior Business Analyst, Product Owner, Product Manager) using recognised methods and frameworks. 
  • Wider experience and capability in technology-enabled rethinking / reengineering of business models (service design, organisational change, business strategy, financial analysis, process improvement such as Lean / Six Sigma). 
  • Demonstrable experience in holistic analysis of AI use cases within project scoping and/or delivery, including the impact on people, processes, data, and sustainability 
  • Ability to understand and engage with technical teams on highly complex technology and data projects: you won’t be designing a technology stack, and you do need to understand the implications of the stack for the rest of the solution elements while maintaining a laser focus on the business value we’re delivering through this technology. 

 

Additionally, we ask that you: 

  • Are currently working in a major Consulting firm, and/or in industry but having a Consulting background  or proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions. 
  • Have experience of proposition building and delivery.  
  • Are eligible for SC-level clearance, or previously/currently held 
  • Have experience in Business development, utilising a combination of the organisation’s broader pre-existing relationships, company relationships and your own network to support account sales strategy and wider business development activities within Capgemini. 

 

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

Our consultants are formally trained by industry experts in consulting and client delivery; examples include Agile delivery (Scrum Master, Product Owner, Scaled Agile Framework), technologies (AWS, Azure), Cybersecurity (CISSP, CISM), and TOGAF, which Capgemini’s own IAF contributes to. Capgemini Invent offers you the flexibility to develop various areas of knowledge in specialist domains aligned both to your interests and our clients’ outcomes. 

 

Client engagements give you the opportunity to work with our leadership as well as our early- and mid-career professionals in teams where diverse thought and experience are valued 

 

You’ll create compelling client propositions, structure and lead high-profile transformations, and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies, often taking an idea from a concept to a vision, to strategy and then execution. 

 

You’ll build and lead teams on client and internal work, with right-shored colleagues of all grades, to get the best results for client, consultant, and company. 

 

Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities that will help us and our clients to succeed. 

 

We hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients. 

 

We have thriving Invent communities in our three main Invent locations of London, Manchester, and Glasgow holding monthly F2F get-togethers.  We have active virtual team meetings every fortnight, as well as access to BT, Invent, and Capgemini UK groups through MS Teams as well as expanding our connections to our local Capgemini offices. 

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work. 

 

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer 

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: 

  • Declare they have a disability, and  
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. 

Please opt in during the application process. 

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing. 

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice. 

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance. 

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

Also allows you to drive a path for change, improvement, and efficiency as standard. This is an opportunity to drive your own improvements and change the landscape for end user experience

  • Quality assurance testing  
  • Document each individual application so an understanding of what the packaged application is expected to do and how this was achieved
  • Build relationships with the client, 3rd parties and vendors
  • Identifying of Automation and efficiency opportunities  
  • Problem solving and solutioning  
  • Assisting with UAT fault resolution

Please opt in during the application process.

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 
 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
 

 

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.
 
 
If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

About the job you’re considering

Our Senior SQL Server Database Administrators manage and support mission-critical database estates across some of the largest Microsoft projects on the market, spanning a wide range of industries. Working across development, test, and production environments, they ensure our clients' data platforms are secure, highly available, and performing at their best. As senior members of the team, they act as subject matter experts and trusted advisors on all things SQL Server, working closely with development, infrastructure, and production support teams to resolve issues end-to-end and to continuously refine and automate how the estate is managed. Their expertise is anchored in the Microsoft data platform - SQL Server, Azure SQL, and Power BI/Fabric - while also bringing broader awareness of the wider data platform landscape.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.
If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:
identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

  • Manage SQL Server databases across multiple environments, from development through to production, ensuring consistent standards and configuration.
  • Configure and maintain database servers and processes, including monitoring of system health and performance, to ensure high levels of performance, availability, and security.
  • Take a lead role in analysing, diagnosing, and resolving issues in real time, liaising with other teams to provide end-to-end problem resolution.
  • Feed back and liaise with development teams on issues requiring application or schema changes.
  • Identify opportunities to refine and automate regular database processes and maintenance tasks.
  • Assist production support with investigation into live issues, acting as an escalation point for complex incidents.
  • Assist developers with complex query tuning, indexing strategy, and schema refinement.
  • Provide ongoing support for production systems, including participation in on-call/out-of-hours support rotas where required.
  • Perform scheduled maintenance and support release deployments, including planning and risk assessment for high-impact changes.
  • Maintain and monitor database security, including access control, auditing, and compliance with data protection requirements.
  • Apply data modelling techniques to ensure development and implementation efforts meet integration and performance expectations.
  • Support and manage Power BI environments, including data source configuration, gateway management, and performance.
  • Share technical expertise with peers and team members, providing mentoring and guidance to junior DBAs and developers.

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Proven MS SQL Server administration experience across multiple environments, from development to production.
  • Experience with monitoring, performance tuning, and optimisation using native SQL Server tools (e.g. DMVs, Extended Events, Query Store) and other monitoring/troubleshooting tools.
  • Experience with backups, restores, and recovery models, including designing recovery strategies aligned to business RPO/RTO requirements.
  • Experience of High Availability, replication, and Disaster Recovery options for SQL Server, such as Always On Availability Groups, failover clustering, and log shipping.
  • Experience of securing data, including encryption (e.g. TDE, Always Encrypted), role-based access control, and auditing.
  • Experience working with Windows Server, including Active Directory.
  • Knowledge of Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure storage options, such as Blob Storage, Azure Files, and Managed Disks.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting for database administration and automation.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g. Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates) for provisioning database infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of DevOps/CI-CD practices for database change management (e.g. SQL Server Data Tools, Azure DevOps Pipelines, e.g. Flyway).
  • Awareness of security and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR as applicable to data handling.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate (DP-300).
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900).
  • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (DP-600), reflecting the growing use of Microsoft Fabric.
  • Knowledge of security best practices in cloud environments, such as Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500).

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

Your Security Clearance 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements. Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 12 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.
Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini 

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion. 
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

The Applied Innovation Exchange brings together a team of consultants, designers, technologists and researchers, to help some of the worlds largest organisations move from challenging problem statements to innovative real world solutions, and we'd love to hear from you!


Weʼre a team that is harnessing AI to make speech therapy more accessible, building digital experiences to raise money for vulnerable children with Action for Children, building a retail store of tomorrow in Shoreditch, London and much more.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.


If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

  • Engage as a technical expert during innovation discovery engagements - working with innovation consultants, UX/UI designers and fellow engineers to
    contribute inspiration and advisory on emerging technologies to help shape opportunities and solutions.
  • Take up the role of a technical lead on innovation projects - working with our team, wider Capgemini experts and our clients to deliver high quality
    innovative solutions from proof of value to pilot
  • Transform uncertainty into certainty, finding creative ways to apply emerging technology to drive business value and user delight - creating cutting edge
    solutions that scale and drive meaningful impact.
  • Balance speed and quality, with a focus on outcomes, and a comfort working at pace.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • An expert in Full-Stack JavaScript/Typescript, with experience across any of the modern core frameworks from frontend through to API/service development
  • An end-to-end engineer, comfortable and experienced designing and deploying to cloud environments (e.g. GCP, Azure, AWS + CI/CD)
  • Someone who takes pride in their craft and centres technical decisions around user needs.
  • Comfortable and excited about uncertainty. We start with business and end user problems, not technical specs!
  • An aspiring leader, who takes ownership of projects from early stages, and gives clear direction, support and mentorship to more junior team members
  • Strong presentation skills with the ability to engage with and understand stakeholders, working with them to create impactful solutions.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role you will need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard checks.

There are no nationality or residency restrictions, although if you have resided outside of the UK within the last 3 years, further checks may be required.

There are other criteria and check required for BPSS, and throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
Declare they have a disability, and
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

What does ‘Get The Future You Want ‘ mean for you?

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 12 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.
Capgemini. Get The Future you want

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organisations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

Job Title: PROJECT MANAGER

Location: Northampton

 

About the Job you are considering:

To manage change projects that help the organisation achieve its strategic objectives while ensuring that projects are delivered on time within budget in control and in compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies and procedures

 

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

Your Role

Project Delivery

  • Manage end-to-end delivery of change projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, and delivery roadmaps.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to agreed quality standards.
  • Monitor project progress and drive timely resolution of delivery challenges.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong relationships with senior leaders, business stakeholders, technology teams, operations, and external partners.
  • Provide regular updates on project status, risks, issues, and key decisions.
  • Facilitate effective collaboration across multiple functions and business areas.

Governance and Risk Management

  • Identify, assess, and manage project risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.
  • Ensure adherence to governance frameworks, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
  • Escalate critical risks and issues through appropriate governance channels.

Resource and Financial Management

  • Coordinate project resources to ensure successful delivery.
  • Manage project budgets and track expenditure against approved plans.
  • Support resource planning and allocation activities.

Change Management

  • Lead business readiness, communications, and training activities.
  • Support successful implementation and adoption of change initiatives.
  • Ensure new processes, products, and capabilities are effectively embedded within the organization.

Reporting and Controls

  • Prepare and present project status reports for stakeholders and governance forums.
  • Track milestones, deliverables, and benefits realization.
  • Maintain project documentation and control artefacts.



Your Skills

  • Demonstrated experience managing large-scale business or technology transformation programs.
  • Strong project management and delivery expertise.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders.
  • Excellent risk, issue, and dependency management skills.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and influencing abilities.
  • Experience managing project budgets, timelines, and resources.
  • Knowledge of change management principles and implementation practices.
  • Understanding of governance, regulatory, and compliance requirements within financial services.

 

Preferred Experience

  • Commercial cards, corporate issuing, payments, or banking experience.
  • Product simplification, product rationalization, or transformation program experience.

Location: London

 

About the Job you are considering:

We are seeking a Generative AI Data Engineer with strong experience in financial services (banking, capital markets, insurance, or fintech) to design, build, and scale GenAI-powered data solutions. The role combines modern data engineering, ML/LLM integration, and domain-specific financial knowledge to deliver enterprise-grade AI platforms.
You will lead the development of data pipelines, vector databases, retrieval systems, and LLM-driven applications to solve use cases such as risk analytics, fraud detection, regulatory compliance, document intelligence, and customer insights

  • Hands-on experience with Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques
  • Expertise in PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Keras frameworks
  • Experience developing Generative AI solutions and applications

Your role

As an IT/OT Solution Architect, you will lead the design of secure, scalable and supportable solutions that bridge operational technology, enterprise IT and cloud platforms. Working across industrial environments, you will translate business, operational and engineering requirements into end-to-end architectures spanning PLCs, RTUs, SCADA, historians, OT networks, industrial edge platforms, enterprise integration and cloud services. You will play a key role in enabling reliable industrial data flows, establishing integration standards and guiding delivery teams to implement modern IT/OT convergence solutions that balance innovation with operational resilience, cybersecurity and maintainability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define end-to-end IT/OT solution architectures that connect operational systems, industrial edge technologies, enterprise platforms and cloud services.
  • Design integration and interoperability strategies using technologies and patterns such as OPC UA, MQTT, APIs, event-driven architectures and Unified Namespace.
  • Provide technical leadership and design assurance to engineering teams, suppliers and stakeholders, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable and aligned with architectural standards.
  • Develop reusable architecture patterns, standards and industrial data models while coordinating decisions across OT, networking, cybersecurity, cloud and data domains to support consistent and resilient deployment at scale.

Your profile

You are an experienced IT/OT Solution Architect with a strong understanding of industrial automation, enterprise integration and cloud technologies. You can translate complex operational and business requirements into scalable, secure and resilient architectures that connect industrial systems with enterprise and cloud platforms. Combining technical depth with strong stakeholder engagement skills, you are comfortable leading architecture workshops, challenging design decisions and providing technical direction across multidisciplinary teams. You bring the ability to balance innovation with the operational realities of industrial environments while driving consistent, supportable and future-ready IT/OT solutions.

Key Requirements

  • Strong understanding of industrial automation and OT environments, including PLCs, RTUs, SCADA, historians, OT networking and the operational requirements of live production systems.
  • Proven solution architecture experience across OT, edge, enterprise, data and cloud environments, with expertise in integration technologies and patterns such as OPC UA, MQTT, APIs and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience designing scalable, resilient and secure industrial data solutions, including data contextualisation, transformation, store-and-forward capabilities, recovery mechanisms and other critical non-functional requirements.

Your role

The SCADA Technology & Solutions Lead owns the enterprise‑level direction for SCADA and IT/OT convergence within a consultancy and client advisory context. The role ensures that SCADA and OT integration solutions are technically coherent, secure, scalable, and operationally fit‑for‑purpose, aligned with enterprise digital transformation strategies, OT operating models, IT architecture, data, network, and cybersecurity policies. It establishes the architectural and design foundations required to enable sustainable OT‑to‑IT integration and cloud‑ready, data‑driven operational capabilities across multi‑site utility environments.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead enterprise SCADA and OT platform option assessments, defining future‑ready reference architectures across centralised, distributed, and hybrid deployment models.
  • Provide technical leadership across converged IT/OT domains, assuring alignment of requirements, architectures, standards, roadmaps, and business case inputs.
  • Define and govern vendor‑agnostic SCADA and OT platform selection criteria, covering interoperability, lifecycle management, supportability, and future‑proofing.
  • Own and shape the Unified Namespace and standardisation approach, including asset models, naming conventions, signals, events, and metadata.
  • Champion modern OT integration patterns, enabling secure, scalable and event‑driven data flows between OT, enterprise, and cloud platforms.
  • Chair architectural and technical design reviews, managing key risks, assumptions, constraints, and decisions with clear auditability.

Your profile

You’ll bring deep experience designing and delivering enterprise‑scale SCADA architectures within water or utility environments, with a strong understanding of OT systems and practical IT/OT convergence. You’re comfortable working across complex, mixed‑vendor and legacy estates, shaping modernisation and migration strategies while providing clear technical leadership and engaging confidently across operational, engineering, digital, network, and cyber teams.

data.description:
Your role

As an IT/OT Engineer, you will bridge the gap between operational technology and enterprise IT, enabling the secure and effective flow of industrial data from control systems to enterprise and cloud platforms. Working with technologies such as PLCs, RTUs, SCADA, historians, OPC UA and MQTT, you will design, configure and support integration solutions that connect operational environments with modern applications, data platforms and digital services. You will play a hands-on role in troubleshooting, automation and data engineering activities while developing expertise in IT/OT convergence, industrial edge technologies, cloud connectivity and next-generation industrial architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure and support integrations between OT systems (PLCs, RTUs, SCADA and historians) and enterprise applications, data platforms and cloud services.
  • Develop and maintain industrial data pipelines using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT and edge platforms, ensuring reliable, resilient and scalable data flows.
  • Create scripts and lightweight software solutions, primarily in Python, to support automation, data transformation, testing, diagnostics and API integrations.
  • Collaborate with OT, IT, infrastructure and data teams to troubleshoot integration issues, deliver practical solutions and contribute to emerging IT/OT convergence initiatives, including Unified Namespace, Sparkplug and industrial edge architectures.

Your profile

You are an IT/OT professional with a strong understanding of industrial automation, data integration and modern digital technologies. You can work confidently across both operational and enterprise environments, connecting control systems, applications and cloud platforms while understanding the realities of live industrial operations. Combining technical problem-solving skills with a collaborative, consultancy-focused approach, you are comfortable working with multidisciplinary teams to deliver practical, reliable and scalable integration solutions. Experience within industrial, utilities, energy or critical infrastructure environments is highly desirable.

Key Requirements

  • Strong understanding of OT environments, including PLCs, RTUs, SCADA, historians, industrial devices, networking and the communication of operational data across complex architectures.
  • Practical experience with IT/OT integration technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, industrial edge platforms and data transformation, with the ability to connect OT systems to enterprise applications, databases and cloud services.
  • Programming and automation skills, particularly in Python, with knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, Git and the development of lightweight integration, diagnostic and data-processing solutions.

About the job you’re considering

 

We’re seeking a seasoned Domain Architect who wants to apply their skills and experience within an exciting and vibrant Managed Services organisation. Our clients are going through a period of significant change, and digital transformation is at the forefront of their business strategy.

 

 

As a Domain Architect, you will thrive on having Design Authority for the relevant Service Line aligned to your domain expertise. You will enjoy being the domain focal point for ensuring its technical integrity. Being part of an enthusiastic Business Technologist community will enable you to maintain awareness of the latest technologies and innovations within the Capgemini Portfolio and apply these to your technology domains. You will also provide inspiration and act as a role model for a talented and enthusiastic team of Engineers in your Service Line.

 


Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.  This role has a requirement to be based onsite 4 days per week.

Your role

 

As an integral part of the Capgemini Architecture community, you'll provide architecture leadership and governance across the End User Computing domain, ensuring solutions align to both client strategy and operational requirements.

 

 

You will be empowered to provide:

 

 

  • Design Authority for the End User Computing (EUC) service line.
  • Ownership of EUC technology roadmaps, product lifecycle management and future-state architecture planning.
  • Strategic direction for endpoint technologies, including hardware platforms, operating systems, endpoint management and user experience tooling.
  • Key stakeholder management for internal, as well as external parties.
  • Expert strategy advisory within client facing Managed Services accounts along with new deals and transitions.
  • Trusted advice to the Client by cultivating strong symbiotic Client relationships.
  • Direction and guidance on technical aspects, ensuring adherence to Service Line strategy, standards and practices while aligning with client requirements.

 

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

 

  • Proven experience operating as a Domain Architect or Design Authority within large Managed Services environments, providing technical governance and ensuring alignment to architecture standards and strategic roadmaps.
  • Strong End User Computing (EUC) expertise, including Microsoft 365, Intune, SCCM/MECM, Windows 11, Autopilot, endpoint security and modern workplace technologies.
  • Demonstrable experience defining endpoint technology strategy, roadmaps and future-state architecture for large enterprise environments.
  • Proven ownership of endpoint product lifecycle management, including hardware refresh strategies, end-of-life planning, product evaluation, compatibility assessments and technology replacement recommendations.
  • Experience with Digital Employee Experience (DEX) platforms such as SysTrack or Nexthink.
  • Experience managing and evolving enterprise endpoint estates through device modernisation, operating system upgrades and platform transformation programmes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and client advisory skills, with the ability to influence technology decisions across both business and technical audiences.
  • Experience operating within Managed Services environments, including governance, service transitions, bids, commercials and contractual constraints.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

 

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Some roles will also require an additional level of security clearance:

 


Security Check (SC) Clearance:

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
Your role

As an OT Engineer, you will provide hands-on engineering expertise across utilities, water, wastewater and other critical infrastructure environments. Working within consulting delivery teams, you will assess and support the modernisation of PLC, RTU, SCADA, telemetry and control systems, conducting site surveys, engineering assessments and solution design activities. You will help clients understand their current OT landscape, identify opportunities for standardisation and improvement, and contribute to migration and modernisation programmes across complex brownfield environments. The role also offers the opportunity to develop expertise in IT/OT convergence, industrial data integration, edge technologies and connected operational architectures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct OT site surveys and assessments to understand control systems, field assets, communications, operational dependencies and data flows across distributed environments.
  • Evaluate existing PLC, RTU, SCADA and telemetry estates, identifying lifecycle risks, interoperability challenges, resilience improvements and standardisation opportunities.
  • Support control-system modernisation and migration programmes by providing practical engineering input into target-state architectures, solution design and implementation roadmaps.
  • Collaborate with operators, engineers, suppliers and stakeholders to produce clear technical recommendations and contribute to emerging IT/OT convergence initiatives involving technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT and edge-to-cloud connectivity.

Your profile

You are an experienced OT or Industrial Automation Engineer with a strong understanding of PLCs, RTUs, SCADA, telemetry and control systems within complex operational environments. Comfortable working across brownfield estates, you can carry out site-based assessments, identify practical engineering risks and constraints, and contribute to modernisation and migration initiatives. You bring a collaborative, consultancy-minded approach, working effectively with operators, engineers and stakeholders while providing clear technical recommendations. Experience within utilities, water or wastewater environments is highly desirable, along with an interest in emerging IT/OT convergence technologies.

Key Requirements

  • Strong practical experience of industrial automation, operational technology and control systems, including PLCs, RTUs, SCADA, telemetry, field instrumentation and OT communications.
  • Proven ability to conduct OT site surveys, engineering assessments and technical reviews across distributed operational environments, identifying risks, dependencies and improvement opportunities.
  • Understanding of brownfield modernisation challenges, including lifecycle management, resilience, availability, maintainability, system integration and standardisation across multi-vendor estates.
  • Knowledge of industrial networking and protocols such as Modbus, IEC 104 and OPC UA, combined with strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills; experience within utilities, water or wastewater sectors is highly advantageous.

Make it real - what does it mean for you?

  • Open access to digital learning platforms​
  • Active employee networks promoting diversity, equity and inclusion like OutFront, CapAbility or Women@Capgemini​

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who​

  • Declare they have a disability, and ​
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.​
  • Please opt in during the application process.​​

Capgemini. Make it real.​

Need to know

  • All roles will require a level of security clearance; BPSS OR Security Clearance OR  Developed Vetting. ​
  • You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.​

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the Job you are considering:

We are seeking a Lead Java Full Stack Developer with strong experience in building scalable enterprise applications across frontend and backend technologies The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing developing testing and deploying high quality solutions in an Agile environment

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.


Your Role:

  • Lead the development of responsive web applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Redux, Node.js, and Jest.
  • Design and develop backend microservices using Java, Spring Boot, JPA, Hibernate, REST APIs, and Microservices architecture.
  • Ensure code quality through TDD practices, writing unit and integration tests using JUnit, Mockito, Cucumber, and Selenium.
  • Work with SQL databases (MS SQL Server preferred) and optimize database performance and queries.
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, and deployment processes.

Your Skills:

  • Strong expertise in HTML CSS JavaScript React JS Redux Nodejs and Jest
  • Extensive experience with Java Spring Boot JPA Hibernate REST APIs Microservices JUnit and Mockito
  • Good knowledge of SQL MS SQL preferred cloud platforms and messaging technologies
  • Handson experience with Jira Confluence Bitbucket GitLab Nexus SonarQube Veracode Maven and NPM
  • Strong understanding of TestDriven Development TDD CICD pipelines and automated testing tools such as Cucumber and Selenium

You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. Job Title: Insurance Solution Architect

Location: London


About the Job you are considering:

We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect who is accountable for crafting end-to-end solutions for key initiatives, projects and Platform teams for Capgemini UK and Clients. Operating as part of the UK Insurance, the Solution Architects are passionate about driving, improving and promoting the process and delivery of Architecture across the organisation.


Hybrid working: 

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.


Your Role:

  • Support the creation and build of solutions for projects which meet the specified standards for technology and ensure they meet our aims for availability, security, resilience and performance.
  • You’ll support the crafting of design options with associated costs, benefits and risks to enable investment decisions.
  • Solution Architects interact and collaborate with product owners, architects, development teams and other project colleagues to agree trade-offs between long-term and short-term goals.
  • You will support the integrity of the end-to-end technical solution, including transition states used to achieve the target state.
  • Shape and estimate IT initiatives and feature team sprints, ensuring that component parts deliver against business outcomes.
  • Support on key designs to ensure the long-term strategic goals of Capgemini clients are met as well as short term project needs.

Your role

As a PLM Technical Architect, you will play a key role in translating business requirements, engineering processes and functional specifications into robust, scalable technical solutions. Working closely with consultants, architects, developers and client stakeholders, you will design and define Teamcenter and NX solutions that maximise standard product capabilities, support business objectives, and deliver long-term maintainability and value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate client requirements into detailed Teamcenter and NX technical designs, producing clear documentation for configuration and development teams.
  • Design and specify Teamcenter and NX solution components, including data models, workflows, access controls, CAD data management, templates, integrations and release processes.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, solution architects, developers and client SMEs to define solution approaches and resolve technical design challenges.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout build, test and deployment activities, reviewing solutions against agreed designs and supporting issue resolution.
  • Identify technical risks, promote best practice design standards, and contribute to reusable frameworks, accelerators and delivery methodologies across Siemens PLM projects.

Your profile

We are seeking an experienced PLM Technical Architect with a strong background in PLM solution design within engineering and manufacturing environments. You'll be able to translate complex business and technical requirements into practical, scalable solutions, combining deep product knowledge with strong stakeholder management and problem-solving skills. You will be comfortable working across multidisciplinary teams and making design decisions that balance business value, technical feasibility and long-term maintainability.

Key Requirements

  • Proven experience designing and implementing Siemens Teamcenter and/or NX solutions, with a strong understanding of engineering, manufacturing, change management and product lifecycle processes.
  • Strong knowledge of Teamcenter and NX architecture and configuration, including areas such as BMIDE, workflows, access management, classification, CAD templates, attributes, standards and Teamcenter integration.
  • Ability to interpret business requirements, process maps and functional specifications, translating them into clear technical designs, configuration specifications and implementation guidance.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and collaboration skills, with experience working alongside architects, business analysts, developers, testers and client teams in agile delivery environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the confidence to challenge unnecessary complexity and promote scalable, maintainable solutions that maximise out-of-the-box Siemens PLM functionality.

Your role

We are looking for an experienced PLM Engagement Lead to drive successful client engagements across complex digital engineering and PLM programmes. You will be responsible for building trusted client relationships, leading multidisciplinary delivery teams, ensuring commercial and delivery performance, and helping clients realise value from their PLM investments. This role requires strong leadership, stakeholder management and commercial acumen, combined with the ability to translate business priorities into successful delivery outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary senior client contact, building strong relationships with stakeholders across engineering, manufacturing, digital, IT and programme teams, while ensuring delivery remains aligned to client objectives and contractual commitments.
  • Lead the end-to-end engagement lifecycle, from mobilisation and planning through delivery and transition, providing governance, delivery assurance and proactive management of risks, dependencies and issues.
  • Own engagement commercial performance, including forecasting, resource planning, revenue, cost and margin management, ensuring compliance with Capgemini governance and contractual obligations.
  • Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable and high-performing delivery culture while providing coaching, direction and support.
  • Identify opportunities to improve services and deliver additional client value, supporting business growth, innovation and the continual development of Capgemini's PLM delivery capability.

Your profile

We are seeking a highly experienced engagement leader with a strong background in PLM, digital engineering or enterprise technology delivery. You will combine commercial awareness, delivery leadership and industry expertise to drive successful client outcomes, build trusted stakeholder relationships and lead complex programmes across engineering and manufacturing environments. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable operating at executive level, managing delivery assurance, and shaping future opportunities for growth.

Key Requirements

  • Proven experience leading complex client engagements, programmes or managed services within PLM, digital engineering or related enterprise technology environments.
  • Strong understanding of PLM-enabled engineering processes and experience with leading PLM platforms, including Siemens Teamcenter/NX, PTC Windchill and/or Dassault Systèmes 3DEXPERIENCE.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, align business and technical priorities, and successfully govern delivery across multiple teams, suppliers and workstreams.
  • Strong commercial and business development expertise, including experience with contracts, statements of work, forecasting, financial management, change control and opportunity shaping.
