Job Title: Java Kafka Engineer

Location: Northampton

 

About the Job you are considering:

Join the Financial Services Business Unit within Capgemini’s Cloud & Custom Applications (C&CA) practice, where we Consult with Purpose, Continuously Evolve, and Architect Tomorrow. As a Backend Engineer, you will help design and deliver resilient, scalable, and secure digital services that support corporate banking journeys and customer outcomes. Working alongside Product Owners, Architects, Engineers, and Platform teams, you will contribute to modern digital capabilities, drive continuous improvement, and support the delivery of future-ready solutions. This is an opportunity to shape high-quality engineering outcomes, embrace innovation and AI-enabled ways of working, and create lasting value in a complex, enterprise-scale environment.

 

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable backend solutions that support critical business and customer outcomes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business needs into effective technical solutions and measurable value.
  • Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, ensuring solutions are delivered to high quality and engineering standards.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, automate activities, and enhance delivery outcomes.
  • Drive operational excellence through proactive service ownership, performance optimisation, and effective incident resolution.
  • Support the design and evolution of modern, resilient architectures that enable long-term business growth and agility.
  • Ensure solutions align with organisational security, governance, risk, and compliance requirements.
  • Participate in peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentoring activities to strengthen engineering capability and foster a future-ready workforce.
  • Work closely with delivery and platform teams to enable efficient releases and reliable production services.
  • Champion innovation, including awareness and adoption of AI-assisted practices where appropriate to improve delivery effectiveness and customer value.

 

Must-Have Skills

  • Extensive hands-on experience delivering enterprise-scale backend application solutions.
  • Strong expertise in Java/J2EE development, object-oriented design principles, and enterprise application architecture.
  • Proven experience designing and building RESTful services and microservices-based solutions.
  • Strong experience with Java 17, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and event-driven architectures.
  • Good understanding of frontend integration patterns and experience collaborating across user interface and backend delivery teams.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Experience applying engineering quality practices, automated testing approaches, and test-driven delivery principles.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to navigate complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting business-critical applications in large-scale organisations.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and contribute to collaborative team success.
  • Awareness of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled development capabilities, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.

 

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with GitLab, GitLab CI/CD, Helm, SonarQube, Nexus, and Artifactory.
  • Experience working with cloud-native platforms and services, including AWS.
  • Knowledge of containerisation and orchestration technologies, including Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or similar solutions.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Grafana, and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of DevSecOps principles, secure software development practices, and security-focused engineering approaches.
  • Experience working within regulated Financial Services environments.
  • Understanding of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts, operational resilience, and service reliability practices.
  • Relevant cloud, DevOps, or engineering certifications.

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer:

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

Make It Real (what does it mean for you):

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. 
    To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Manage Mentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

 

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

 

 

As a Power Platform consultant, you would bring a wealth of knowledge across the whole of the PowerPlatform to our projects and clients. Utilising a cross spectrum of technical and functional skills, you will beable to build applications, advise on solutions, lead discussions and design sessions and drive adoption of thePower Platform.


Working as a team for large projects or on their own for short term engagements, a Technical Consultant willensure a solution meets the needs, goals & objectives of our clients.

 

We bring the most innovative solutions toour customers, utilising the full suite of applications of the Power Platform and beyond. Defining an end-to-endsolution that matches the requirements. This will utilise the wider Microsoft stack, including Azure andDynamics 365. Our Technical Consultants also have a strong focus on DevOps practices which is essential todeliver enterprise-grade solutions.

 

We put a lot of time and effort into the Microsoft community; we invest in doing things right and have plenty tosay on the subject. We’re active on social media and for those that want to find out more, take a look at ourblogs written by Microsoft enthusiasts, for everyone:

Your role

 

 

  • Identify user needs and create great relationships with project stakeholders.

 

  • Lead the design, development and implementation of Power Platform solutions to meet user needs withina delivery team

 

  • Be a technical specialist, producing high quality applications, both model driven and canvas, as well asenterprise scale Power Automate Cloud Flow solutions.

 

  • Understand governance principles and be able to advise on best practices for empowering every PowerPlatform maker.

 

  • Build solutions as part of an agile team using declarative tools, backed by Microsoft and using our owntechnical accelerators. You will be part of teams that follow software engineering best practices, and youwill have a say in the design of a solution.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, stiving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part ofeveryday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment,for everyone.

Your skills and experience

 

 

  • Energy and excitement about the Power Platform, the technologies and capabilities it offers, andknowledge of its limitations.

 

  • Hands on experience with Dataverse and Dataverse for Teams as part of implementing Power Platformsolutions.

 

  • Hands on experience in the setup of Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Delivery (CD), ideallyusing Azure DevOps.

 

  • A passion for and experience with industry-wide standards and best practices when designing andbuilding solutions in the Power Platform.

 

  • A focus on delivering positive outcomes to our clients, whatever their scale.

 

  • Experience delivering according to an agile methodology, working in collaborative teams in a commercialenvironment.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

 

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
Declare they have a disability, and Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

 

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 

 

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

 

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

 

 

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

 

 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements

 

You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 12 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

Capgemini. Make it real.

 

 

Why you should consider capgemini

 

 

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

 

 

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

data.description:
About the job you're considering

Capgemini are recruiting highly skilled Lead and Senior Engineers to join their dynamic team, delivering solutions for a major public sector client. This is an opportunity to work on meaningful projects that impact millions of people, in an environment that values innovation and collaboration. 

Our mature Agile environment provides a supportive space to collaborate with specialists from other disciplines. You’ll be part of a culture that encourages continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence. 

Our Senior Engineer, you’ll focus on delivering critical digital services from cradle to grave working on a variety of projects for wide reaching Public Services. 

 

Hybrid working: Your working location will vary depending on your role, personal needs, and business requirements. This will typically include a mix of company offices, client sites, and remote work from home. If your location is Telford or Worthing (please note the Worthing office will relocate to Brighton & Hove in the second half of 2026) you will be expected to work from the office between 40% and 70% of the time. For all other locations you need to be prepared to come into the Telford or Worthing office once to twice a month (Lead engineers more frequently). As we align closely with customer requirements—which may change over time—you will need to remain flexible. Please note that fully remote working (100% from home) is not permitted.

Your role

•    Develop and maintain Scala services using frameworks like Play, Akka, and functional programming principles. 
•    Write high-quality, tested code with TDD/BDD and tools such as ScalaTest. 
•    Design and optimise microservices for performance, scalability, and reliability. 
•    Manage builds and deployments using SBT, CI/CD pipelines, and containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes). 
•    Mentor junior engineers on Scala best practices and support their development. 
•    Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver solutions aligned with business needs. 
•    Ensure operational excellence through monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

 

Our culture
We’re looking for people who are learning focused, challenge the status quo and are constantly looking to shape their working environment to make it an exciting, fun and interesting place to work. 
Keeping things fresh is something we encourage in our working practices, but the culture of continuous improvement is equally as important in our technical approach to building and delivering modern digital services. Your knowledge and experience will be used to change the way we build solutions including utilising new tools and technologies to solve new problems or improve existing services. 
Working on our services means you’ll be part of a team, but you’ll also be a part of communities of interest. This means you’ll always have people on hand to share and discuss ideas and get help when needed.  The engineering organisation is engineering led, supporting each other through coaching and mentoring, so if you want to change something it’s within your power to do so. 

Your skills and experience

•    Strong professional experience with Scala and functional programming
•    Experience designing and consuming REST APIs; JSON validation/serialisation using Play JSON or Circe. 
•    Designing for and querying relational databases such as PostgreSQL and/or NoSQL databases such as MongoDB. 
•    Writing unit and integration tests using technology such as ScalaTest, Specs2 and Mockito while following TDD/BDD
•    Familiarity with SBT for build/CI/CD automation and GIT with branching strategies. 
•    Solid understanding of web/HTTP, web security best practices, and performance considerations. 
•    Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and containerisation. 

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2)   under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
Declare they have a disability, and 
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 

You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organisations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. Your role

Capgemini Engineering is looking for Rust engineers to join our High Integrity Software team. You will join a diverse team of excellent and experienced engineers who are committed to ensuring our projects meet our customers’ high expectations. Our team develops software for safety related and critical applications in the Aerospace, Defence, Rail, Automotive and Energy sectors, often related to critical national infrastructure.

Your profile

Essential

  • 5 years of working experience in software development life cycle and 2 years of experience with Rust.
  • Expertise in either requirements, development or test.
  • Experience in at least one of the following markets: aerospace, transport, defence, rail, automotive.
  • Experience of applying relevant standards such as 61508, 50128, 26262, 00-55, ED-109, DO-178 etc.
  • Organised, good time management and prioritisation
  • Methodical approach to work, with good attention to details and strong logic and reasoning skill

About the job you’re considering

We are seeking an experienced Cloud Architect to join Capgemini's Managed Services business, supporting clients through cloud transformation and the ongoing evolution of complex cloud platforms.

Working within Capgemini's pod-based delivery model, you will act as the Design Authority for your technology domain, providing architectural leadership across live services and strategic initiatives. You'll work closely with engineers, operational teams, and clients to ensure cloud platforms remain secure, resilient, scalable, and aligned to business objectives.

Onsite working requirement: This role will require you to work onsite 5-days per week, without any opportunity for hybrid or home working.

Your role:

As a senior technical authority for cloud platform, you will contribute to both operational and project-based activities alongside fellow Consultants, Engineers, and Analysts. You will be empowered to:

  • Own end-to-end technical delivery of cloud managed services, meeting SLAs and customer outcomes, and acting as authority for change and acceptance into service.
  • Provide technical thought-leadership and authority for the service line aligned to your expertise, ensuring architectural integrity, governance, and standards adherence.
  • Define, maintain, and govern cloud blueprints, reference architectures, roadmaps, and lifecycle standards.
  • Improve platform reliability and performance through SRE principles, automation, and continuous service optimisation.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to clients across live services, service improvements, transitions, and projects.
  • Contribute to bids, proposals, and service shaping, ensuring solutions are viable, scalable, and operable.
  • Influence, mentor, and guide engineers and stakeholders without formal line management responsibility.
  • Ensure services meet security, compliance, resilience, and contractual requirements.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

A proven track record of acting as a Cloud Architect within a Managed Services environment.

  • Experience operating as a Service Line Design Authority within large Managed Services environments, including bids, transitions, and live services, with strong commercial awareness, stakeholder management, and client relationship skills.
  • Strong understanding of Azure cloud services and how business applications are hosted, integrated, and supported within enterprise environments.
  • Broad infrastructure knowledge spanning databases (particularly SQL), identity and access management, Single Sign-On (SSO), Windows operating systems, end-user computing technologies, and SaaS platforms.
  • Understanding of application deployment and packaging technologies, including Intune and modern endpoint management concepts.
  • Strong DevOps and automation expertise including Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud-native technologies such as Kubernetes and containerised workloads.
  • Experience improving reliability, performance and resilience through SRE principles, observability and automation.
  • Proven technical leadership with the ability to influence engineers, architects, and stakeholders, alongside experience working within Agile, collaborative, and product-aligned delivery models.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Some roles will also require an additional level of security clearance:

 


Security Check (SC) Clearance:

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Internal info

Local grade: B2

Location: Manchester

Our offer

The Opportunity

Aerospace and defence organisations are investing heavily in PLM and CAD technologies to accelerate engineering delivery, improve productivity, and maintain compliance in highly regulated environments. Realising these benefits requires effective configuration and adoption that supports day-to-day engineering activities.

As a PLM Configurator, you will configure Teamcenter and/or NX solutions based on approved technical designs, including workflows, data models, access controls, templates, and system settings. Working within a multidisciplinary team, you will ensure solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to engineering processes, supporting testing, deployment, and controlled configuration changes across environments.

 

Your role

  • Configure Siemens Teamcenter and/or Siemens NX in line with approved technical designs, functional requirements and delivery standards.
  • Translate configuration specifications, design documents and configuration workbooks into working PLM/CAD system behaviours.
  • Configure Teamcenter objects, item types, attributes, relationships, naming rules, revision rules, workflows, access controls, preferences and classifications as required.
  • Support Teamcenter BMIDE configuration activities, including data model updates, business objects, properties, rules and deployment packages where relevant.
  • Configure Active Workspace behaviours, stylesheets, tiles, commands, preferences and user-facing elements where required.
  • Support NX configuration activities, including templates, managed mode settings, CAD data structures, attributes, user preferences and integration with Teamcenter.

Your profile

  • Hands-on experience configuring Siemens Teamcenter and/or Siemens NX in a delivery, project or support environment.
  • Practical understanding of PLM concepts such as items, revisions, datasets, product structures, BOMs, effectivity, workflows, access control, change management and release processes.
  • Experience working from technical designs, solution specifications, functional requirements or configuration workbooks and turning them into working system configuration.
  • Knowledge of Teamcenter configuration areas such as BMIDE, organisation structures, preferences, workflows, access manager, query builder, classification, stylesheets or Active Workspace configuration.
  • Familiarity with NX configuration in a managed Teamcenter environment, including CAD data management, templates, attributes, preferences and user settings.

What you'll love about working here

  • Hybrid working
  • Open access to digital learning platforms
  • Active employee networks promoting diversity, equity and inclusion like OutFront, CapAbility or Women@Capgemini

  • Declare they have a disability, and

  • Please opt in during the application process.

  • All roles will require a level of security clearance; This role requires SC clearance

data.title: PLM Configuration Engineer

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

We have an exciting opportunity to join Capgemini as a Workplace Engineer in our End User Experience (EUE) department, supporting a broad span of high-profile clients in our vast portfolio. At Capgemini we pride ourselves on our people because we know they are the heart of what we do. Embodying this in the day-to-day, our EUE Workplace Engineers are encouraged to grow and develop in the role’s fast paced environment, thriving as you build on your existing experience and bringing that knowledge to the fore


This role requires you to be onsite in Manchester 5 days per week



Your role

  • Design and build SharePoint solutions using SPFx
  • Develop using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, REST APIs, Microsoft Graph
  • Integrate SharePoint with 3rd party systems (e.g. ServiceNow, CRM, HR systems, APIs)
  • Build automations using Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps)

 

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong SharePoint development experience (SPFx mandatory)
  • Proven experience with 3rd party integrations and external APIs
  • Experience with SharePoint Server 2019 / Subscription Edition
  • Experience with SharePoint Online (M365)
  • Strong troubleshooting skills at 3rd line level
  • Experience with REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, and authentication (OAuth / Azure AD)
  • Proven experience in SharePoint development and support roles, strong background in integration and migration projects, and ability to operate as a technical SME.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 
 
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.
 
 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
 

 

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.
 
 
If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
 
 
 
Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
 
 
 
 
Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
 
 
 
 
Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.
 

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you're considering

We require AI focused solution architects who have the experience & ability to operate across multiple technology and business domains with a passion for solving business challenges with Generative AI solutions. You should thrive on variety and enjoy working across the full lifecycle of a project. Our AI solution architects generally operate as technical leads within a project or programme team from the onset of solution design and development through to final delivery and implementation into Live Service. As part of the overall end to end delivery, our AI solution architects often support the development of commercial proposals and additionally will own the technical solution governance at all stages.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

As an AI solution architect, you will have responsibility for the ownership of the AI solution design through the inception and delivery phases, be responsible for working through the technical challenges and decisions in partnership with the project and engagement management communities to safely deliver the solution into Live operation.
We expect our AI solution architects to have experience of a wide range of technologies with a strong focus on Generative AI business solutions, best practices and general ways of working. Passion and drive to keep learning in this ever changing and exciting technology is also a key requirement. This experience is essential to influence and advise of the most appropriate AI solution options and to be highly credible with both our clients and senior internal stakeholders.

Here are some of the key activities of the role:
• Take ownership of the client requirements, deliverables and accountabilities to ensure adherence to Architecture Governance processes, industry best practices and to maintain consistency with clients’ Architecture vision.
• Drive the AI solution development and documentation of solution designs ensuring good architectural practices are observed through the lifecycle of the solution development.
• Provide oversight of architectural direction for and on behalf of our clients.
• Working with agile development teams and delivery architects through all phases of the solution lifecycle.
• Take ownership of the solutions and be the face off to our internal and external senior stakeholders.
You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, stiving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

• Solution architecture experience
• Generative AI technology experience such as Resource Augmented Generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, advanced prompting, cloud based AI services such as Azure OpenAI, agent frameworks e.g. CrewAI, MCP
• Software engineering experience. A lot of AI solutions are built in Python so a background in software engineering would be advantageous
• Working with agile development teams and delivery architects through all phases of the solution lifecycle.
• Take ownership of the solutions and be the face off to our internal and external senior stakeholders.
• Develop excellent working relationships with our clients to become their trusted advisors through boldness and honesty.
• Relationship management of the technical relationships with vendors, third parties and the wider Capgemini.
• Ensure solution delivery is performed according to agreed specification.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
- Declare they have a disability, and
- Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

Make it real - What does it mean for you?

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

Job Title: Guidewire Integration Lead (London Market Insurance)

Location: London

 

About the Job you are considering:

We are seeking an experienced Guidewire Integration Lead with 10+ years of experience in designing, developing, and leading enterprise-scale integration solutions across the Guidewire InsuranceSuite ecosystem, including PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter.

 

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

Your Role:

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise integration solutions across Guidewire PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, and ClaimCenter.
  • Define integration architecture, patterns, standards, and best practices for Guidewire implementations and transformation programs.
  • Design and develop integrations using the Guidewire Integration Framework, Web Services, Messaging Framework, and Plugins.
  • Drive API-led integration strategies leveraging REST and SOAP services.
  • Design event-driven and asynchronous integration solutions using Guidewire messaging capabilities.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, and development teams to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to integration developers and engineering teams.
  • Review solution designs, code quality, performance, security, and operational readiness.
  • Support Guidewire Cloud migration, modernization, and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Troubleshoot complex integration issues and ensure optimal system performance, resilience, and scalability.
  • Establish CI/CD, DevOps, testing, and deployment best practices for integration solutions.
  • Support architecture reviews, technical governance, estimation activities, and client-facing engagements.

 

Your Skills

  • Strong hands-on experience with Guidewire InsuranceSuite: PolicyCenter, BillingCenter and ClaimCenter.
  • The ideal candidate will have strong experience within the London Market Insurance domain and a proven track record of designing and leading complex integrations across underwriting, policy administration, claims, delegated authority, bordereaux processing, reinsurance, and third-party market systems.
  • Deep understanding of the Guidewire Integration Framework.
  • Expertise in GOSU Programming, Plugin Development, Messaging Framework, Event-Based Integrations, Batch Integrations and Guidewire APIs
  • Experience designing and developing REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, Enterprise Integrations, Service-Oriented Architectures (SOA) and Event-Driven Architectures
  • Experience with middleware and integration platforms.

 

We are a Disability Confident Employer:

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

 

Make It Real (what does it mean for you):

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. 
    To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

 

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Defines the methods and the business analysis framework for the business analysis work to be carried out in their projectorprogram together with the client.Additionally performs requirements elicitation and modelling. Performs leadership activities within the project and beyond.

About the job you're considering

We work closely with clients and partners to take full advantage of the opportunities of technology. We mobilize expert teams that create custom solutions from existing and emerging technology to deliver viable outcomes at speed. We call this 'Value in the making.'

Part of the Capgemini Group, Sogeti makes business value through technology for organizations that need to implement innovation at speed and want a local partner with global scale. With a hands-on culture and close proximity to its clients, Sogeti is currently looking for an SAP Lead Automation Test Engineer to join our Quality Engineering and Test Practice, ensuring alignment with business goals and driving impactful value creation for our clients.

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: 
identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Your role

Essential Skills

  • Good experience in SAP SuccessFactors and SAP S/4HANA testing, with understanding of HR, procurement, or related SAP business processes.
  • Design and implement effective automation test strategies and plans for SAP applications and integrations.
  • Good knowledge of automation testing with relevant tools such as Tricentis Tosca, Selenium, Worksoft Certify, UFT, TestComplete, or similar automation platforms.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining automation frameworks for SAP SuccessFactors and SAP S/4HANA using suitable automation tools and frameworks.
  • Manage a team of automation engineers, foster collaborative work environment, and enhance team performance
  • Collaborate with developers, analysts, and other team members to integrate automation assets into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or similar.
  • Manage versions of test automation assets in code repositories like GIT.
  • Ensure proper defect management processes and adherence to test life cycles for automated testing
  • Knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM/Quality Center, qTest, or similar, ensuring testing remains on track against the project plan.
  • Lead the Automation Testing and produce necessary documentation and reports for various testing phases, including System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), through automation reporting into the Test Manager.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders at all levels, providing guidance and expertise in SAP test automation.
  • The candidate must be eligible for Security Clearance (SC) for this project. This requires a minimum of five consecutive years of residency in the UK, with no single period of absence from the country exceeding 28 days during that time.
     

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Good experience of leading SAP E2E Automation testing (internal to SAP and externally to non-SAP Systems)
  • Good knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors and SAP S/4HANA modules, including Employee Central, Recruitment, Onboarding, Finance, Procurement, Materials Management, or Supply Chain.
  • Expertise in automation testing tools such as Tricentis Tosca, Selenium, Worksoft Certify, UFT, TestComplete, or similar.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and integrating automation assets with tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, or similar.
  • Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM/Quality Center, qTest, or similar, with the ability to produce clear reports for stakeholders.
  • Ability to work in a problem-solving environment, with attention to detail and Experience in mentoring team members
  • Knowledge of test life cycles, defect management processes, risk/issue identification and Test reports/metrics
  • ISTQB/ISEB certification in software testing (Foundation level or above) or willingness to obtain one.
  • Flexibility to travel and work at various locations during the project.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

We are a Disability Confident Employer:

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

vWhat does 'Get The Future You Want' mean for you?

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard Management or, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

About the job you’re considering

As a Solution Architect in Strategic Business Solutions (SBS), you will work on pre-sales through to execution, working on the conversion of our most exciting and high-profile opportunities into iconic wins, and then working on programmes to deliver the solution. Your work will centre on large or strategic business transformation programmes, underpinned by ERP, that require cross-Capgemini capability. 


You will work on UK opportunities or global opportunities with a UK component and will collaborate with colleagues across business lines and geographies to build solutions for our clients. 

 

Capgemini UK Applications focuses on helping our clients achieve business value though digital transformation and the application of social, mobile, analytics and cloud technologies. We are an Agile cloud-first organisation delivering API enabled digital solutions that scale, using on and offshore capabilities. 


We are experts in navigating our clients through the complexities of large-scale, technology enabled business transformation programmes, using our skills to drive outstanding delivery and business outcomes. Having the right people using the right methodology and following the right process is key to ensuring every client gets the right outcome.


Strategic Business Solutions (SBS) sits within Applications and has been highly successful in winning work in multiple major accounts. 

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work day to day will vary according to your role, your needs and that of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client site and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home for 100% of the time.

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual), or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

 

Your role

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build, contribute and lead solutions underpinned by AI using the “best of Capgemini” from across Capgemini UK and our global business.
  • Build SBS’s internal reputation through collaborative and focused working that results in compelling solutions for our clients.
  • Work closely with the rest of the other Capgemini practices and external partners to create compelling solutions for our clients, ensuring our work is reusable in other pursuits.
  • Innovate and devise compelling propositions for existing clients.
  • Build a thorough knowledge of Capgemini’s internal assets.  Work with a world-class and continuous improvement mindset to identify, or where appropriate build/or oversee the building of, innovative offers, methods and tools that can become part of our standard delivery approach.
  • Post award, work with, or in, delivery teams to help ensure they are set up for success and that the solution is well delivered.
  • Represent Capgemini to our clients’ organisations, building personal and corporate credibility and confidence.
  • Represent Capgemini externally with an active industry profile. 
    Deliver specific delivery work or provide expertise on projects in billable work.

Your skills and experience:

  • Your deep solution experience should include partnering with other experts, both within and outside your organisation, to design winning end-to-end solutions.
  • You will possess excellent client facing skills and be fluent presenting to, and forming relationships with, our clients and being seen as a trusted advisor.
  • You will be experienced in participating in challenging or large-scale bids and responses from first engagement to starting delivery.
  • You will be adept at using AI and continuously curious about leveraging emerging agentic and leading technologies.
  • You will have a strong understanding of solving client business problems using technology.
  • You will design solutions reaching across the Capgemini ecosystem and our partners, to build unique and compelling offers.
  • Your long history of delivery excellence will mean you bring strong client and partner relationships and you will be a magnet for talent within the consulting market.
  • You will likely have experience in multiple industries and will have a deep knowledge of their value chains and pain points. 

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.


As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Your wellbeing 
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 

 

Impactful Experiences
You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  But when you join Capgemini, you join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  A powerful source of energy that drives us all to find new ways technology  can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses. And it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.   By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. And you’ll use them to help our clients leverage technology to grow their business and give innovation that human touch the world needs. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.  

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. 


Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

The Legal Governance and Risk Control Process Outsourcing (LPO) Lead is a Senior leadership role responsible for driving the overall strategy, growth, and performance of LPO services within the organization. This position serves as the primary executive liaison for key clients and internal stakeholders, ensuring delivery excellence, revenue optimization, and strategic alignment with business objectives. The Account Executive oversees multiple engagement managers and leads initiatives that enhance client satisfaction, operational efficiency, and profitability.  You will support our clients through large scale transformation projects and been seen as a transformation / transition subject matter expert.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Your role

Strategic Leadership: 

  • Define and execute the vision and roadmap for LPO services across accounts.
  • Drive business development initiatives to expand service offerings and client relationships.
  • Ensure alignment of legal operations with organizational goals and compliance standards.

Client Relationship Management:

  • Act as the senior point of contact for executive-level client interactions.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders to foster trust and long-term partnerships.
  • Identify and capitalize on opportunities for revenue growth and service improvement.

Operational Oversight:

  • Provide leadership and guidance to Legal, Risk, Audit Engagement Managers and their teams.
  • Monitor performance metrics, financial targets, and contractual obligations across engagements.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices and continuous improvement in LPO delivery.

Risk and Compliance:

  • Oversee risk management strategies related to legal, regulatory, risk operations and contractual commitments.
  • Escalate critical issues and opportunities to senior leadership and ensure timely resolution.

Thought Leadership and Innovation:

  • Champion initiatives to streamline processes, leverage technology, and enhance efficiency.
  • Represent the organization in industry forums and contribute to shaping legal outsourcing trends.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Proven ability to lead large-scale legal operations and manage complex client portfolios.
  • Strong business acumen with expertise in contract management, compliance, and risk mitigation.
  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills for executive-level engagement.
  • Strategic thinker with a track record of driving growth and operational excellence.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate across diverse teams and geographies.
  • Proven experience in large scale transformtion programmes. 

 

Qualifications

  • Degree in Law, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Proven experience in legal operations, risk, audit, contract management, or LPO leadership roles.
  • Industry cross functional knowledge, regulated industry being a plus
  • Demonstrated success in managing multi-million-dollar accounts and global teams.
  • Proficiency in legal technology platforms and advanced MS Office skills.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.


As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

 

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role you will need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard checks.

There are no nationality or residency restrictions, although if you have resided outside of the UK within the last 3 years, further checks may be required.

There are other criteria and check required for BPSS, and throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Your wellbeing 
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  


To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 


Impactful Experiences
You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI.  We help organsations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.
