The Opportunity

The AI-led Growth Leader will be the commercial growth driver for AI-enabled Intelligent Industry opportunities across Northern & Central Europe. Working closely with the Head of Intelligent Industry, CTO / Architecture, Play Leaders and country teams, the role will identify, shape and accelerate AI-led lighthouse opportunities, translate AI capabilities into compelling client value cases and convert selected opportunities into repeatable, scalable business impact. Success will be measured by the conversion of selected AI-led opportunities into lighthouse wins, qualified pipeline impact, repeatable proof points and scalable revenue contribution.

 

Main responsibilities:

AI-led Lighthouse Deals: Own and drive the AI contribution to lighthouse deals and II-accelerated opportunities, shaping complex AI-enabled pursuits end-to-end and engaging at CxO level around business value, productivity, resilience and new operating models.

Client AI Value Cases: Build the commercial narrative for AI in Intelligent Industry, translating industrial AI capabilities into clear value cases, outcome logic and executive-level propositions for priority clients and sectors.

Priority Growth Bets: Identify, qualify and actively drive a focused set of AI-led growth bets, prioritizing, accelerating or stopping initiatives based on commercial scale, repeatability and measurable business impact.

Commercialization of Proven AI Use Cases: Turn proven AI use cases, assets and delivery experience into repeatable propositions, credentials and proof points that strengthen win rates and enable scalable revenue across BUs and business lines.

Partner and Ecosystem Activation: Leverage hyperscalers, industrial software vendors and AI ecosystem partners where they accelerate lighthouse opportunities, strengthen propositions or support repeatable AI-enabled solutions.

Cross-BU Orchestration: Pull the right expertise from BUs, business lines, delivery hubs and the wider Intelligent Industry ecosystem into selected opportunities, ensuring fast mobilization, clear ownership and transition from incubation into BU-led scale.

Our Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a commercially minded AI growth executive with a strong track record in shaping complex client opportunities at the intersection of AI, industrial operations, engineering and business transformation. The ideal candidate combines CxO-level credibility, commercial judgment and enough AI fluency to translate technology potential into concrete client value and scalable growth.

  • Director / Vice-President profile with strong CxO-level consulting credibility, commercial ownership and a clear business-growth mindset.
  • Proven track record in shaping large, complex AI-enabled pursuits and converting them into measurable client outcomes, lighthouse wins and revenue impact.
  • Strong understanding of AI at scale, including data, platforms, AI products, operating models and industrial value-chain applications.
  • Deep understanding of Intelligent Industry value chains across engineering, manufacturing, operations and asset-intensive businesses.
  • Ability to align senior stakeholders across BUs, business lines, countries, partners and delivery organizations without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong execution discipline: prioritization, commercial judgment, decision-making and relentless focus on scale, repeatability, qualified pipeline and business outcomes.

Your role

This opportunity sits within the Capgemini Engineering Stress Engineering team, supporting the assessment and resolution of non-conformances on critical aerospace engine components. You will use structural analysis, engineering judgement, and finite element methods to evaluate manufacturing and in-service deviations, develop technically robust repair and concession solutions, and ensure continued compliance with airworthiness and customer requirements.


•    Assess the structural impact of non-conformances on turbine blades, vanes, segment liners, and other engine components using analytical calculations and finite element analysis.
•    Develop and approve repair and concession solutions, ensuring compliance with engineering standards, certification requirements, and customer specifications.
•    Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Design, Manufacturing, Quality, and Materials Engineering to deliver practical, cost-effective solutions and technical justifications.

This role is suited to a degree-qualified Mechanical or Aerospace Engineer with proven experience in aerospace stress analysis and structural assessment. About the Job you are considering:

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to provide technical leadership for a mature enterprise application landscape supporting ongoing operations maintenance enhancements and modernization initiatives

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role:

The role will be responsible for ensuring platform stability driving continuous improvement governing architecture decisions supporting production operations and enabling delivery teams to implement business and technical changes efficiently and securely
The successful candidate will act as the technology leader across application support enhancement delivery cloud operations DevSecOps practices and longterm technology roadmap planning.

Your Skills:

AWS and microservices experience in Mandatory

Technical Leadership Architecture Governance
Own the overall application architecture and technical roadmap
Ensure architectural integrity across production nonproduction and integration environments
Review and approve solution designs for enhancements change requests and platform upgrades
Drive technology simplification standardization and technical debt reduction
Establish and enforce architecture principles standards and engineering best practices
Provide technical guidance to delivery and support teams

Application Maintenance Continuous Improvement
Support stable operation of businesscritical applications
Lead analysis of recurring production issues and identify strategic remediation opportunities
Drive platform improvements focused on reliability performance maintainability and operational efficiency
Evaluate and recommend modernization opportunities for legacy components
Ensure sustainable support models and operational readiness across environments

Production Support Operational Excellence
Provide architectural guidance during major incidents and problem investigations
Review root cause analyses and ensure implementation of permanent fixes
Support incident problem and change management processes
Ensure application availability resilience disaster recovery and business continuity requirements are met
Drive proactive monitoring observability alerting and operational automation initiatives

Enhancement Delivery
Partner with business and product stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions
Support estimation impact assessments and solution planning for enhancements
Ensure new functionality aligns with architectural standards and nonfunctional requirements
Govern release readiness and deployment strategies

Cloud Platform Engineering
Lead cloud architecture reviews and platform optimization initiatives
Guide infrastructure upgrades platform migrations and service improvements
Drive implementation of cloudnative practices where appropriate
Ensure platforms are secure scalable resilient and costefficient

DevSecOps Engineering Excellence
Champion DevSecOps culture and automationfirst practices
Improve CICD maturity deployment reliability and release automation
Promote secure software development practices
Drive adoption of automated testing code quality controls and engineering metrics
Enable continuous improvement through measurable engineering outcomes

Security Compliance
Ensure architecture complies with organizational security and compliance standards
Participate in security reviews threat assessments and vulnerability remediation planning
Support audit governance and regulatory requirements
Establish securitybydesign principles across the application lifecycle

We are a Disability Confident Employer:

  • Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
  • Please opt in during the application process.

Make It Real (what does it mean for you):

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. 
    To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

data.description:
About the job you're considering

We’re excited to announce that our Worthing office will be closing as we move to our brand new office in Hove!

As an Interaction Designer, you will play a critical role in delivering user-centered designs that meets the needs of our public sector client This role will help create the conditions for teams to adopt and embed user-centred, iterative design approaches within a complex enterprise technology environment. You will also have the opportunity to work for other clients in government and the private sector. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design and deliver designs that are accessible, understandable, and aligned with the Government Digital Service (GDS) standards. Your work will span various projects within the UK Government, requiring a strong understanding of agile methodologies and the ability to work in a fast-paced, iterative environment.

Hybrid Working - The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home. You will be unable to work at home 100% of the time and will be expected to work from a Capgemini office a minimum of 2-days a week, and willing to travel as required by the role. 

 
To be considered candidates must be based in the UK and have existing permission to work in the UK. Sponsorship will not be provided. If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

 

Your role

The services we co-create within our clients are often transformational – the solution may not be obvious and the landscape is complex, so we are looking for individuals who can make sense where there is very little framework or direction.  

 
You will be expected to design and present concepts and user interfaces – including annotations for best practice in information architecture, navigation, and user flows. Use different techniques to identify and understand users and their needs, so that you can translate user stories and propose user-focused, evidence-based design approaches to meet these needs. Design accessible and impactful products and services. Employ a wide range of skills, interviewing users, creating detailed plans, understanding data, facilitating workshops, presenting research findings and more. Visualise, articulate, and solve complex problems and concepts, and make disciplined decisions based on available information and research evidence. Apply technical knowledge and experience to create or design interactive prototypes, for both products and services.  

In addition, you can work with product, business and technology teams to introduce user-centred interaction design practices into environments that have traditionally relied on waterfall delivery approaches. You can understand and resolve design-centric disputes across varying levels of complexity and risk. You can work in a fast-paced, evolving environment and use an iterative method and flexible approach to enable rapid Agile delivery. You can communicate effectively across organisational and technical boundaries. You can identify opportunities to create business value and improve the user experience. You will also contribute to the wider XD community – and wider Capgemini. 

Your skills and experience

Essential 

Experience working with Government Digital Service (GDS) service standards, or equivalent enterprise digital design standards 

Experience applying user-centred interaction design methods within complex technology, platform or transformation programmes. 

Excellence in analytical thinking, process-oriented skills, verbal, and written skills 

Grounding in user-centred design, from concept to final delivery 

Knowledge of which tools, process, or methods to use and how to bring an agile delivery team along with you 

Ability to engage with development teams and architects to ensure data and technical considerations are accommodated within the design 

Evidence of working with user centred design colleagues to synthesise insights and act on the outcomes 

Experience of working with senior stakeholders to get their input and buy-in 

Experience using a range of design tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Invision, etc. and the ability to quickly learn new design tools as required.  

An empathetic approach and ability to listen to the needs of technical and business stakeholders and interpret them in a way that is clear for both audiences 

Ability to present designs and justify decisions you've made using an evidence-based approach  

Proven ability to create high-quality, compelling design concepts and artefacts such user flows, journey mapping, service maps and wireframes  

Understanding of what good digital services look like and how to design in an inclusive, accessible way 

Experienced in rapid paper and digital prototyping 

Ability to build prototypes using code to create dynamic prototypes using HTML, CSS, basic Javascript and the GOV.UK prototyping toolkit. 

Knowledge in GitHub, Heroku and node.js 

Experience facilitating workshops, managing, and undertaking research with users and communicate using personas, interactive prototypes, and user journeys 

Experience of managing, mentoring and supporting junior colleagues 

You will be eligible or have BPSS level Clearance 

 

Desirable 

Experience designing government, enterprise applications, SaaS products or platform-based services. 

Experience working with SAP products or SAP-enabled business processes. 

Experience designing complex workflows, operational tools or colleague-facing products. 

Experience designing services within SaaS, ERP or enterprise platform environments. 

Experience helping organisations transition from waterfall approaches to more iterative and user-centred ways of working. 

Experience of leading design sessions and integrating diverse perspectives 

Understand the strategic context of your work and how it aligns with broader project goals. 

Experience of working in other sectors 

Consultancy experience and demonstrable experience of opening-up new account spaces 

Multi-disciplinary design skills set 

SC clearance 

Qualifications 

Relevant interaction design qualification is desirable 

Relevant professional certifications or equivalent experience 

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.​
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:​

Declare they have a disability, and ​

Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.​

Please opt in during the application process.​

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to be eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. ​

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.​

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.​

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.​

Make it real – what does it mean for you?​

We realise a Total Reward package should be more than just compensation. At Capgemini we offer range of core and flexible benefits and have a Peer Recognition Portal called Applaud. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. But when you join Capgemini, you join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. A powerful source of energy that drives us all to find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses. And it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. And you’ll use them to help our clients leverage technology to grow their business and give innovation that human touch the world needs. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.  

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.​
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
CAPGEMINI INVENT

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing and fast evolving Agile Transformation team that is spearheading Agile and Scaled Agile transformations across a number of our strategic clients. This team has helped organisations improve their ability to deliver iterative change at the pace they need to succeed. As the market shifts, our focus is evolving from delivery agility to systemic adaptability - helping large enterprises redesign their operating models, portfolio governance and decision rights so they can respond to volatility and become genuinely AI-native. We see agility as the structural foundation for AI-enabled ways of working, and AI as a force that reshapes how organisations coordinate, decide and create value - not simply a tooling layer bolted onto existing delivery. The team consists of consultants who specialise in operating model design, culture change, Agile tooling, training and coaching to blend the right Agile, Lean, Design Thinking, DevOps and Kanban practices to address organisations’ business objectives.

 

We take our clients on a journey from strategy through to execution that enables them to: 


•    Redesign portfolio governance, decision rights and funding models for adaptive, outcome-led decision-making
•    Build the operating model foundations - persistent teams, value streams, adaptive governance - required for AI-native ways of working
•    Shift from delivery agility to systemic adaptability, so AI creates genuine structural advantage rather than incremental efficiency
•    Embed AI as a structural capability across the operating model, not a tooling layer bolted onto legacy delivery

 

We are looking for talented candidates to join the team - people who can hold their own in front of a CIO, COO or Head of Transformation, who have earned the right to talk to delivery teams by actually doing the work, and who are genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping what enterprise agility needs to mean. 

 

As part of your role, you will help shape client engagements, develop our evolving AI-Empowered Agile Transformation propositions, and contribute to the practice and your own growth through:
•    Business development: Leading and contributing to proposals, bids and client pitches; shaping new propositions; and building relationships with senior buyers at industry events.
•    Practice building: Contributing to the design of our AI-Empowered Agility offering, thought leadership (whitepapers, points of view, LinkedIn content), and the ongoing development of our team through hiring, mentoring and internal community.
•    Continuous development: Deepening your own expertise through advanced certifications, exposure to complex enterprise engagements, and direct collaboration with senior practitioners shaping the future of the practice.

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for people with skills and experience in some or all of the following areas: 


The strongest candidates will combine three pillars: (1) a strong consulting and advisory toolkit, (2) depth in scaled agile and enterprise agility, and (3) a clear point of view on how AI can be leveraged in agile transformation - and how agility itself is an enabler of AI-native organisations. We recognise this combination is rare; we expect candidates to demonstrate strength in at least two of these three pillars, with genuine curiosity and a developing perspective on the third. 
•    Strong consulting and advisory toolkit, including diagnostic design, structured problem-solving from ambiguous inputs, executive stakeholder engagement at CIO, COO and Head of Transformation level, and the ability to hold a room of senior sceptics and shift the frame of the conversation
•    Demonstrable experience in proposition development, proposal and bid leadership, and offering design - not only delivery execution
•    Experience of working with business and IT teams in shaping and undertaking Agile transformation programmes; creating Agile transformation Blueprints and Roadmaps, while linking technology to business outcomes
•    A clear and evolving point of view on how AI and agentic capabilities change coordination cost, decision latency and operating model design - and the implications for governance, funding and team topology
•    Ability to frame AI adoption as an operating model and governance problem, not a tooling problem - and to articulate why systemic agility is the structural prerequisite for becoming AI-native
•    Comfort designing human–AI ways of working, where agents function as team members for defined work and humans retain judgment, accountability and organisational context — and the ability to embed this thinking into agile ceremonies, team design and value stream operation
•    Awareness of the structural barriers to enterprise AI adoption - capitalisation rules, audit and risk constraints, annual funding cycles, fragmented decision rights - and how these interact with transformation design in regulated sectors
•    Experience or strong interest in using AI to augment the consultant’s own craft — synthesis, client diagnostics, proposal generation, market intelligence — and a curiosity about how this reshapes how we work with clients
•    Experience in designing Agile Value Stream operating models for large, complex organisations, including Lean Portfolio Management, persistent team funding, participatory budgeting and decision rights design at enterprise level
•    Hands-on experience of introducing and embedding scaled Agile practices, such as Scrum of Scrums and PI Planning and assessment agile maturity.
•    Knowledge of how to scale Agile practices and manage the cultural, governance, environmental and organisational changes involved in accelerating Agile adoption
•    A proven coaching, training and mentoring skillset in Agile delivery and Agile rollout, being able to show a Lean-Agile mindset and customer centricity
•    Ability to manage client relationships, effective reporting to secure client satisfaction throughout your project delivery.
•    Proven experience in applying strategy and innovation approaches to solve complex, analytical, and technical problems and ability to take the lead to drive performance and continuous improvements.

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE

Business Technology (BT) is the largest and fastest growing practice at Capgemini Invent. We are a trusted technology consulting & transformation business partner to our clients' Chief Digital Information Officers (CDIOs) and the global Capgemini Group. We combine emotional intelligence, human-centric design, and technology expertise to digitally transform our clients’ web and workplace experiences. We are successful in achieving this through our end-to-end portfolio of digital transformation service offers – Strategy, Design, Delivery, Architecture, Security and Change Management

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about. In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

About the job you're considering

We’re excited to announce that our Worthing office will be closing as we move to our brand new office in Hove!

As a Service Designer, you will drive the design of complex, user-centred services for our prestigious public sector client. This role will help create the conditions for teams to adopt and embed user-centred, iterative design approaches within a complex enterprise technology environment. You will also have the opportunity to work for other clients in government and the private sector. You will contribute to and help set the vision for service design, ensuring that iterative processes lead to successful outcomes. You will champion and facilitate collaboration across diverse multidisciplinary teams, fostering a culture of co-design and shared ownership of the design process. 
 
These are important and challenging roles within the Experience Design Team. You will not only shape meaningful services that impact millions, but also grow as a practitioner - deepening your expertise through diverse and stretching challenges, new and varied opportunities, and access to a vibrant community of experienced professionals. 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

Your role

The services we co-create with our client are often transformational – the solution may not be obvious and the landscape is complex, so we are looking for individuals who can make sense where there is very little framework or direction.  

 
You will support design decisions, communicate strategies, and coach others. Your role involves improving inclusive, accessible, and sustainable design practices, aligning user needs with organizational goals. You’ll be planning and running design sessions. You will also embed hypothesis-driven and iterative design practices, and work with product, business and technology teams to introduce user-centred design practices into environments that have traditionally relied on waterfall delivery approaches. 
 

Additionally, you will lead and coordinate design work, advocate for user-centred design, and create an inclusive environment for designers. In doing so you will help shape end-to-end user and colleague experiences across SaaS-enabled services and business processes. 

 

 

Your skills and experience

Essential: 

Proven ability to lead complex, user-centred design projects from initial concept to final implementation. 

Experience in designing government or public services 

Experience applying user-centred design methods within complex technology, platform or transformation programmes. 

Strong knowledge of the GOV.UK service standard 

Strong skills in mentoring and coaching teams in iterative design practices. 

Expertise in integrating data-driven insights into service design. 

Experience in creating accessible and inclusive services. 

Ability to build and maintain strong, strategic relationships with key stakeholders. 

Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate and champion design concepts and strategies at the highest levels of the organization. 

 

Desirable: 

Experience designing government, enterprise or large-scale business services. 

Experience working with SAP products or SAP-enabled business processes. 

Experience designing services within SaaS, ERP or enterprise platform environments. 

Experience helping organisations transition from waterfall approaches to more iterative and user-centred ways of working. 

Ability to define and lead the strategic direction of service design within the business area. 

Expertise in, or the ability to lead user research projects and activities  

Experience of leading design sessions and integrating diverse perspectives 

Understand the strategic context of your work and how it aligns with broader project goals. 

Experience of working in other sectors 

Consultancy experience and demonstrable experience of opening-up new account spaces 

Multi-disciplinary design skills set 

 

SC clearance 

 

Qualifications: 

Degree in Service Design, Interaction Design, User Experience Design, or a related field or equivalent experience. 

Relevant professional certifications or equivalent experience. 

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.​
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:​

Declare they have a disability, and ​

Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.​

Please opt in during the application process.​

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to be eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. ​

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.​

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.​

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.​

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

We realise a Total Reward package should be more than just compensation. At Capgemini we offer range of core and flexible benefits and have a Peer Recognition Portal called Applaud. 

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
 

 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. But when you join Capgemini, you join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. A powerful source of energy that drives us all to find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses. And it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. And you’ll use them to help our clients leverage technology to grow their business and give innovation that human touch the world needs. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.  

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.​
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

We have an exciting opportunity for an IT Capacity Manager to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the Capacity and Performance Management practice, ensuring that IT services, infrastructure, and supporting resources deliver agreed levels of performance in a cost-effective and sustainable manner. You will establish and maintain capacity management processes, monitor service and resource utilisation, produce forecasts and trend analysis, and collaborate with internal teams and third-party suppliers to ensure future capacity requirements are identified and planned effectively. 

You will play a key role in safeguarding service availability and performance, minimising the risk of capacity-related incidents, optimising investment in technology resources, and supporting the delivery of business and digital transformation initiatives.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

  • Develop, maintain, and implement Capacity Management policies, processes, standards, and reporting across the IT estate.
  • Analyse business, service, and component capacity requirements, ensuring sufficient resources are available to support current and anticipated demand.
  • Track and manage any issues & risks that are potentially due to capacity and manage the remediation plans with the customer and technical support teams.
  • Work closely with Service Owners, Architecture, Engineering, Operations, and suppliers to forecast demand and develop cost-effective capacity plans.
  • Monitor service performance and capacity thresholds, identifying trends, risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for optimisation.
  • Drive continual service improvement through proactive capacity planning, performance analysis, and recommendations that enhance service availability, reliability, and user experience

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini, striving for equity, diversity and inclusion is part of everyday life, and will be part of your working reality. We have built an inclusive and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Proven experience in IT Service Management, with significant expertise in Capacity and Performance Management within complex enterprise IT environments.
  • Strong understanding of ITIL best practices, particularly Capacity and Performance Management, Service Level Management, Availability Management, and Continual Improvement, with ITIL Foundation certification essential.
  • Experience in capacity planning, performance monitoring, trend analysis, forecasting, and demand management, ensuring IT services and infrastructure can meet current and future business requirements.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify capacity risks, performance bottlenecks, service constraints, and opportunities for optimisation across infrastructure, applications, and services.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, service owners, suppliers, and business stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience using ServiceNow and performance monitoring, reporting, and analytics tools to produce capacity reports, support decision-making, manage risks, and drive continual service improvement initiatives that enhance service performance, resilience, and resource utilisation.
  • Experience using tools utilised for monitoring capacity and familiarisation with network devices, virtualised and cloud platforms.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2023. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the Job you are considering:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Mobile Solution Lead (iOS and Android) to join our Experience Design & Engineering Capability Unit. In this role, you will lead the development of innovative mobile applications, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability. You will work with leading organisations across financial services industry to design, build, and deliver cutting-edge mobile applications that transform customer experiences. You’ll bring expertise in native mobile development (Swift, Kotlin/Java) as well as cross-platform frameworks where relevant (Flutter, React Native), and collaborate with architects, UX designers, and product teams to deliver secure, scalable, and high-performing mobile solutions for enterprise clients. You will act as a trusted advisor and technology leader, responsible for designing and delivering digital solutions for clients across banking, insurance, wealth, and capital markets. This role requires Mobile solutioning and Engineering skills with deep FSI industry knowledge and hands-on experience in designing complex enterprise and customer-facing solutions—leveraging cloud platforms, APIs, microservices, data, and emerging GenAI & Agentic AI technologies. You’ll also play a leading role in pre-sales initiatives, architecture governance, and end-to-end solution delivery within the practice and with clients. 

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role:

Key Responsibilities

Client engagement and co-creation

  • Partner with client stakeholders to understand business ambition, customer journeys, operating constraints and measurable outcomes.
  • Plan and facilitate discovery, ideation and architecture workshops that turn ambiguous challenges into a shared solution vision and actionable roadmap.
  • Act as a trusted adviser to client technology, product and business leaders, constructively challenging assumptions and creating alignment across stakeholders.
  • Create and deliver concise, compelling architecture narratives, executive presentations and solution demonstrations for CXO and senior governance forums.
  • Explain complex technical choices in business language, including benefits, risks, dependencies, cost drivers and delivery implications.

Solution Architecture and Delivery

  • Lead the design, solution definition and delivery of mobile solutions (iOS and Android) for enterprise clients.
  • Own end-to-end architecture for enterprise iOS and Android solutions across native and cross-platform approaches. 
  • Define solution context, target architecture, integration patterns, data flows, non-functional requirements and transition roadmaps. 
  • Evaluate and recommend technology choices across Swift and SwiftUI, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, React Native, Flutter and Kotlin Multiplatform where appropriate. 
  • Design secure integration with APIs, microservices, identity platforms, mobile backends, cloud services and enterprise systems. 
  • Apply appropriate architectural patterns, including Clean Architecture, modularisation, MVVM and platform-specific patterns, to support maintainability and scale. 
  • Architect for resilience, performance, observability, accessibility, privacy, offline capability and secure mobile lifecycle management. 
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, regulatory expectations and App Store / Google Play requirements. 

Architecture governance and delivery assurance 

  • Provide architecture leadership from mobilisation through build, test, release and production operation. 
  • Run design reviews, manage architecture decisions and technical risks, and ensure traceability from requirements to implementation. 
  • Guide engineering teams on mobile standards, DevSecOps, automated testing, CI/CD, telemetry and release management. 
  • Mentor architects and senior engineers while contributing to mobile capability development, thought leadership and community growth. 

Market Development

  • Lead mobile solution shaping for RFIs, RFPs, proposals, propositions and bid-defence presentations. 
  • Develop solution options, estimates, assumptions, delivery models, architecture artefacts and differentiated value propositions. 
  • Collaborate with sales, account management, practice and COE teams to identify and pursue digital transformation opportunities and create joined-up solutions
  • Articulate complex technical concepts and solution value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including C-level executives.
  • Identify opportunities for accelerators, reusable assets, partnerships and AI-assisted engineering to improve speed, quality and client value. 

 

Your Skills:

Essential experience 

  • Proven experience as a Mobile Solution Architect, Mobile Architect or senior mobile technology leader within complex enterprise environments. 
  • Proven experience in leading technical teams delivering mobile solutions
  • Demonstrable success working directly with clients to co-create solutions, lead workshops and gain agreement across business and technology stakeholders. 
  • Strong track record presenting architecture, solution value and recommendations to CXO and senior decision-making audiences. 
  • Deep expertise in native iOS and Android architecture, with practical knowledge of Swift / SwiftUI and Kotlin / Jetpack Compose. 
  • Strong understanding of cross-platform frameworks such as React Native and Flutter, with the ability to advise when native, cross-platform or hybrid strategies are appropriate. 
  • Experience designing API-led and cloud-enabled mobile ecosystems, including REST, GraphQL, microservices, event-driven integration and mobile backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of mobile security, including OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, encryption, certificate pinning, secure storage, threat modelling and privacy-by-design. 
  • Experience with mobile DevSecOps, automated testing, CI/CD, code quality, application monitoring and release governance. 
  • Ability to create clear architecture artefacts, including context and container views, sequence diagrams, integration designs, non-functional requirements and decision records. 
  • Commercial and delivery awareness, with experience of scope definition, estimation, assumptions, dependencies, risks and distributed delivery models. 

Financial services context 

  • Experience delivering or shaping customer-facing solutions in banking, insurance, wealth or capital markets is strongly preferred. 
  • Understanding of the security, resilience, accessibility, data protection and regulatory expectations that influence mobile solutions in financial services. 
  • Ability to balance customer experience, engineering quality, risk management and commercial outcomes. 

Leadership and communication 

  • Executive presence with confident, credible and adaptable communication. 
  • Excellent storytelling and presentation skills, supported by structured thinking and visually clear architecture material. 
  • Facilitation and negotiation skills that create alignment while handling challenge and competing priorities. 
  • Collaborative leadership style, with the ability to influence without authority across disciplines and geographies. 
  • Curiosity, pragmatism, integrity and resilience in fast-moving client environments. 

Desirable 

  • Architecture or cloud certification, such as TOGAF, AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud. 
  • Experience with mobile platform services such as Firebase, AWS Amplify or equivalent Azure / Google Cloud capabilities. 
  • Knowledge of mobile analytics, experimentation, feature management, design systems and digital accessibility standards. 
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools, including GitHub Copilot, and awareness of GenAI and agentic AI opportunities within mobile customer journeys.


We are a Disability Confident Employer:

  • Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
  • Please opt in during the application process.

Make It Real (what does it mean for you):

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. 
    To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Your Role

As a DevEx consultant at Capgemini Invent you will be part of our Cloud Advisory capability within the wider Business Technology capability unit. We are seeking Developer Experience Consultants and Senior Consultants who can lead initiatives that improve developer workflows and productivity. You’ll combine technical expertise with developer advocacy, applying best practices in tooling, automation, and process optimization. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying pain points and implementing solutions.

 

In this role you will play a key role in: 

 

  • Lead efforts to streamline developer workflows, reduce friction, and improve overall experience.  
  • Apply Lean principles and Value Stream Mapping to optimize processes and eliminate waste.  
  • Implement and enhance CI/CD pipelines and automation with a developer-first mindset.  
  • Support onboarding processes to create frictionless environments for developers, ensuring smooth setup and minimal delays.  
  • Drive implementation of developer productivity tools such as IDEs, code repositories, build systems, and artifact management solutions.  
  • Define and track developer experience metrics (DORA, SPACE) and use insights to drive improvements.  
  • Introduce and integrate AI-powered tools for code assistance, automated testing, and intelligent workflows.  
  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and platform teams to deliver cohesive solutions that prioritize developer needs. 

Key expectations from this role include:

 

  • As a Consultant: lead a stream of work and produce high quality deliverables, providing key input to shape the strategic direction and support the design of propositions.
  • As a Senior Consultant: design and lead projects / multiple streams taking ownership for elements of the proposition. 
  • As a Managing Consultant: desire to contribute to the growth and success of a top-tier consulting practice. Contribute to our market offers, knowledge and the overall strategic goals of the practice.  In delivery and leadership, you will contribute to consulting sales in excess of £500,000 per annum.

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities),  offering development.
  • Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your Profile

You’re a strategic thinker and hands-on problem solver who excels at bridging business and technology. and you thrive in client-facing environments and have a combination of the following:

 

  • Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and developer tooling ecosystems, common developer tools and version control systems.  
  • Experience in developer onboarding and enablement programs, ensuring smooth and efficient setup.  
  • Familiarity with developer experience metrics and ability to act on insights for measurable improvements.  
  • Exposure to AI tools for DevEx and emerging trends in developer productivity.  
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills to influence engineering culture and advocate for developer needs.  
  • Ability to work independently on small projects and contribute to larger transformation programs. 

Security Check (SC) Clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. (https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant#levels-of-national-security-clearance)

 

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

What You'll Love About Working Here

You'll be part of a team where people can thrive professionally and personally. Here are just a few of the things our team values and enjoys:

 

  • Client engagements give you the opportunity to work with our leadership and experienced consulting management, where you can learn from them, challenge them and accelerate your hands-on experience, delivery capability and industry insights.
  • You’ll learn how we write compelling client propositions, structure and lead high-profile transformation, and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies, often taking an idea from a concept to a vision, to strategy and then execution
  • Our consultants are formally trained from industry experts on management consulting and client delivery.
  • We provide a host of opportunities for learning and certification through internal and partner led programmes from AWS, Google, ServiceNow and Microsoft.
  • Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities which will help us and our clients to succeed.
  • We hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
  • There are many opportunities like monthly team drinks to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city.
  • There are regular leadership connect sessions that will give you a different, more relaxed setting to meet up in the office to hear from the leadership, meet colleagues and discuss the trends and insights within the market. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.

Need to Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.


We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.


Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: 

Declare they have a disability, and  Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. 

Please opt in during the application process.

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

 

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

data.description:
Why Join frog?

Since June 2021, frog is part of Capgemini Invent. frog partners with customer-centric enterprises to drive sustainable growth, by building and orchestrating experiences at scale, while harnessing the power of data and technology.  We’re inventing the future of customer experiences by delivering market-defining business models, products, services, brand engagements and communications. 


Joining frog means you’ll be joining the “pond,” a global network of studios, each with a thriving in-person and vibrant virtual culture. frogs are curious, collaborative, and courageous, united by our passion for improving the human experience across our areas of expertise, while each bringing our unique and diverse skills and experiences to the table. We draw on our global reach and local knowledge to solve complex problems and create innovative, sustainable solutions that touch hearts and move markets. frogs prize humour, positivity, and community just as highly as performance and outcomes. Our culture is open, flexible, inclusive, and engaging. Working at frog means being empowered to meet the moment, and Make Your Mark on every project, in your studio, your community—and the world at large.

What you will be doing

We are looking to hire a Senior Manager to help grow and develop our customer engagement and loyalty capability. In this role, you will drive client engagements and business development, setting direction, guiding teams and ensuring outcomes are realised for our business, our customers and end consumers. 

 

You will set clear direction on customer engagement and loyalty, leading high‑performing teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. You will be accountable for loyalty‑led, CRM‑enabled customer engagements across strategy, experience and business transformation, enabled by data and technology. You will support clients through proposition and programme design, launch, evolution and optimisation at global or multi‑market scale. 

 

You will be responsible for identifying and shaping new opportunities to grow our business, leveraging your knowledge, network and experience to develop compelling engagement and loyalty‑led offers and proposals for clients. 

 

With one eye on the future, you will thrive in a fast‑changing customer engagement and loyalty landscape, shaping thought leadership and actively developing the capabilities of our people and craft. You can balance designing the experiences of today, whilst looking at how AI and innovative technologies can reinvent the business of tomorrow. 

An Overview Of The Role

This role is an exciting leadership position focused on customer engagement and loyalty, enabled by CRM, marketing transformation, data and technology. 

 

 

Client delivery 

You will lead loyalty and CRM client engagements across various stages of customer engagement and loyalty transformation - defining propositions and future‑state visions, business casing, loyalty and CRM-enabled programme design, transformation roadmap development and launch planning. 
 

You will help clients embed deeper customer engagement across their wider loyalty, marketing and customer ecosystem, ensuring programmes are tightly connected to data, platforms, journeys and operating models. 
 

You will work collaboratively with technology and data teams to provide guidance on platform selection, strategy, enablement, optimisation and governance. 
 

You will be responsible for delivery excellence, commercial robustness and governance across your engagements. 
 

You will work with clients to identify challenges and opportunities for innovation that will enable them to deliver on their goals with a focus on customer centricity and business outcomes. 

 

 

Business Growth 

You will build client relationships within our existing accounts and leverage your own external network to identify new opportunities to grow our loyalty client base and pipeline. 
 

You will develop internal relationships across frog and wider Capgemini to build understanding of our loyalty offering and win loyalty work with existing clients. 
 

You will lead and design relevant solutions proposals and bid responses to engage key stakeholders and win new business. 
 

You will contribute to thought leadership and propose go-to-market activities to raise awareness of frog’s customer engagement and loyalty capabilities across industries. You can push the boundaries of what elevating loyalty experiences means for brands and consumers, leveraging advances in AI to deliver exceptional outcomes. 

 

 

Coach and Role Model 

Both on client projects and internal work, you will lead and coach colleagues to achieve their potential and deliver their best work 
 

You will role model frog and Capgemini values and behaviours. 

What We Look For

You will  have some of the following experience: 

 

  • Extensive previuos experience in consulting, industry or agency roles focused on customer engagement and loyalty, with strong CRM and marketing activation experience. 
     
  • A proven track record of launching or materially evolving customer engagement strategies, initiatives and loyalty programmes, including defining propositions, loyalty mechanics, CRM and marketing enablement, operating models and activation strategies. 
     
  • Experience working on large‑scale or global CX, customer engagement, CRM and loyalty programmes, including multi‑market rollout, governance, localisation and ongoing optimisation. 
     
  • Strong experience shaping and delivering customer engagement, loyalty and CRM strategies, including member lifecycle management, personalisation, campaign orchestration and measurement, driving strong commercial outcomes aligned to business objectives. 
     
  • Knowledge of loyalty and CRM technology ecosystems (e.g. Salesforce, Adobe, Antavo, Talon.One, Eagle Eye etc.) and how these enable loyalty capabilities at scale. 
     
  • Experience leading multi‑disciplinary teams and engaging senior stakeholders, balancing strategic intent with pragmatic delivery realities. 
     
  • Passion for shaping organisations to adapt to new trends in loyalty, including the role of Generative and Agentic AI in transforming loyalty operations and customer-facing experiences. 
     
  • Leading and coaching colleagues both individually and in teams, developing capabilities and creating an ethos of delivery excellence. 

 

A good fit for this role will bring many of the skills, experience, and attributes below, applying them in the context of customer engagement and loyalty-led transformation 

 

Strategic Leader - Capable of managing high-performing teams while delivering impactful approaches that drive measurable results for our clients 

Experienced seller - A keen interest to identity and drive potential opportunities with clients that will open up areas for frog to expand 

Pragmatic problem-solver – Focuses on finding practical solutions and reducing complexity to drive results.  

Proactive and flexible – Adopts a hands-on approach to solving problems and adjusts to shifting priorities with ease. 

Collaborative team player – Builds strong relationships and works effectively across diverse stakeholders. 

Excellent interpersonal skills – Builds trust and fosters strong connections with colleagues, clients, and stakeholders. 

Adaptable and agile – Thrives in dynamic environments and embraces modern, agile ways of working 

Intellectually curious – seeks new and different ways of doing things and applies intellectual rigour to developing points of view and proposals 
 

Storyteller - can engage and excite across colleagues and clients alike through well-crafted stories and messaging

It would be a bonus if you have

Direct experience working with several loyalty/membership and CX platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Adobe, Antavo, Talon.One, Eagle Eye etc). 

Need To Know

We don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.


We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

 

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

 

Whilst you will have London as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.


We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

About Capgemini Invent

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2023 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

 

More information is at available at: https://www.capgemini.com/gb-en/service/invent

Role Purpose

Client facing role shaping and leading strategic Tech Ops and Manufacturing transformations, enabling resilient, compliant, and future-ready Pharma operations in Capgemini NCE SBU. The role anchors Capgemini’s credibility in regulated manufacturing, quality, and supply chain environments. In this bringing together the capabilities from across Capgemini business lines and leveraging latest technologies, incl. Agentic AI 

Domain Scope

    • Drug Substance and Drug Product Manufacturing 
    • Quality, Validation, and Compliance 
    • Digital Manufacturing, MES, Automation 
    • Data and AI in Operations 

Requirements

    • 15+ years of experience in the Life Sciences industry and/or Life Sciences consulting with focus in domain scope 
    • Proven track record in shaping and supporting large, complex, multi-year transformation deals 
    • Strong Life Sciences domain credibility with senior business and IT stakeholders 
    • Experience translating business strategy into compelling solution visions and architectures 
    • Deep expertise in AI and Agentic AI application in domain scope 
    • Ability to engage credibly at C-suite and senior executive level 
    • Strong understanding of regulated environments and compliance expectations

Job Role: Salesforce developer

Location: London, UK

About the Job you are considering:

We are seeking experienced Salesforce developer with strong expertise in Banking domain who will overseeing the planning, execution, and successful delivery of projects

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role:

We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Developer with deep expertise in Financial Services Cloud (FSC) to design, develop, and implement complex Salesforce solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and FSC-specific features, along with experience in integrating Salesforce with external systems.
Key Responsibilities

  • Custom Development: Build and maintain custom solutions using Apex, LWC, Visualforce, and Flows.
  • FSC Expertise: Implement FSC features such as Client 360, Action Plans, Financial Accounts, Relationship Groups, and Interaction Summaries.
  • Integration: Develop and manage integrations with banking, wealth management, and third-party systems using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware tools.
  • Data Management: Handle complex data models, Person Accounts, and data migration strategies.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Solution Architects, Functional Consultants, and QA teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Troubleshooting: Provide advanced technical support and resolve complex issues

Secondary Skills:
