About the job you’re considering

We are looking for an experienced Workday Technical Consultant to join our Workday Practice, with a specific focus on Workday Integrations, Workday Extend, Application Managed Services (AMS), optimisation and continuous improvement for live Workday environments. This is an office-based role in Manchester for someone who combines strong Workday technical knowledge, hands-on delivery experience, service discipline and consulting skills.
You will support global clients across Workday technical services, helping them keep integrations, Extend applications and related platform components stable, supportable and continuously improving. You will collaborate with client stakeholders, service teams, functional consultants, integration specialists, security and reporting colleagues and delivery leads to resolve issues, deliver enhancements and identify opportunities to improve automation, integration resilience and user experience.

Your Role

As a Workday Technical Consultant focused on Workday Integrations and Workday Extend, you will support the delivery of high-quality Workday managed services, enhancements and optimisation initiatives across live Workday environments. You will analyse technical requirements, design and support integrations, develop and maintain Extend applications, troubleshoot production issues, support service requests and contribute to continuous improvement activity.
You will be expected to bring a modern consulting mindset: practical, service-focused, outcome-led and comfortable helping clients understand how to use Workday technology, data, automation and emerging AI-enabled functionality responsibly and effectively. You will also support knowledge transfer, documentation and reusable technical assets that help build a scalable AMS capability from the Manchester office.

 

AMS service delivery and technical support

  • Support the delivery of Workday AMS services by managing technical incidents for Workday Integrations and Workday Extend applications as well as service requests, change requests and enhancement activity through ServiceNow or other ITIL-aligned service management platforms.
  • Analyse integration, Extend, reporting and security-related issues, identify root causes, propose practical resolutions and work with client and internal teams to deliver timely, high-quality outcomes.
  • Support service operations across defined hours of service, including shift-based coverage between 07:00 and 19:00 and shared on-call support for P1 incidents as required.

 

Integration and Extend delivery

  • Design, build, test, validate, deploy and document Workday integrations using appropriate Workday tools and patterns, including Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect and APIs.
  • Develop, support and enhance Workday Extend applications, ensuring solutions are secure, maintainable, user-focused and aligned to agreed design principles.
  • Support integration monitoring, error handling, data validation, defect resolution and production support activity across Workday and connected systems.
  • Produce and maintain high-quality technical deliverables, including integration design documents, mapping specifications, test evidence, deployment notes, run books and support playbooks.

 

Optimisation and continuous improvement

  • Review existing integrations, Extend applications and technical processes to identify opportunities for simplification, standardisation, automation and improved resilience.
  • Support enhancement and optimisation initiatives from requirement analysis through design, build, testing, deployment and transition into support.
  • Support regression testing, release assessment and bi-annual Workday release activity, helping clients understand technical impacts and adopt relevant new capabilities.
  • Promote reusable patterns, technical standards and automation where they improve quality, speed and consistency across the AMS service.

Your skills and experience

  • Experience supporting and/or delivering Workday Integrations and Workday Extend solutions, ideally including implementation, post go-live support, optimisation or AMS service delivery experience.
  • Workday Integration certification and/or Workday Extend certification.  
  • Hands-on experience with Workday integration tools and patterns such as Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, XML, XSLT, JSON or related integration technologies.
  • Experience developing, supporting or enhancing Workday Extend applications, including understanding of app design, security, data access and user experience considerations.
  • Good understanding of Workday technical architecture, integration dependencies and how technical solutions support end-to-end HR processes.
  • Experience analysing technical requirements, documenting solutions, supporting testing and translating business needs into practical Workday technical outcomes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex technical issues, manage priorities and communicate recommendations clearly.
  • Experience working with stakeholders, participating in technical workshops and supporting solution design decisions in a client-facing environment.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with a proactive, inclusive and knowledge-sharing mindset.
  • Availability to work from the Capgemini Manchester office as part of an office-based AMS team.

 


Desirable experience

  • Experience using ServiceNow or another ITIL-aligned service management platform to manage incidents, service requests, changes, problems or enhancement backlogs.
  • Experience with post-production optimisation, service transition, knowledge acquisition or continuous improvement roadmaps.
  • Awareness of Workday Reporting, calculated fields, Security, Prism Analytics, Orchestrate, Peakon, Journeys or broader enterprise architecture considerations.
  • ITIL, cloud integration, software engineering or equivalent practical experience in managed services, technical delivery or enterprise application support.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

Declare they have a disability, and 
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service) 
To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Shape Your Path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

data.title: Workday Technical Consultant - Integrations and Extend

data.description:
About the job you’re considering

We are looking for an experienced Workday Functional Consultant to join our Workday Practice, with a specific focus on Application Managed Services (AMS), optimisation and continuous improvement for live Workday environments. This is an office-based role in Manchester for someone who combines Workday functional knowledge, hands-on configuration experience, service delivery discipline and strong consulting skills.
You will collaborate with client stakeholders, service teams, functional specialists, technical colleagues, integration teams and delivery leads to resolve issues, deliver enhancements and identify opportunities to improve HR processes and Workday adoption.

Your Role

As a Workday Functional Consultant focused on AMS and Optimisation, you will support the delivery of high-quality Workday managed services, enhancements and optimisation initiatives. You will analyse client requirements, configure and test Workday changes, resolve functional issues, support service requests and contribute to continuous improvement activity across live Workday environments.
You will be expected to bring a modern consulting mindset: practical, service-focused, outcome-led and comfortable helping clients understand how to use Workday capabilities, data, automation and emerging AI-enabled functionality responsibly and effectively. You will also support knowledge transfer, documentation and reusable service assets that help build a scalable AMS capability from the Manchester office.

 

 

AMS service delivery and functional support

  • Support the delivery of Workday AMS services by managing functional incidents, service requests, change requests and enhancement activity through ServiceNow or other ITIL-aligned service management platforms.
  • Analyse functional issues, identify root causes, propose practical resolutions and work with client and internal teams to deliver timely, high-quality outcomes.
  • Support service operations across defined hours of service, including shift-based coverage between 07:00 and 19:00 and shared on-call support for P1 incidents as required.
  • Maintain clear communication with service leads, clients and internal teams on priorities, blockers, risks, progress and resolution plans.
  • Contribute to service governance through accurate updates, documentation, knowledge articles, trend analysis and continuous improvement recommendations.

 


Configuration, testing and optimisation

  • Configure, test, validate and document Workday solutions across multiple functional areas, ensuring changes are accurate, supportable and aligned to agreed design principles.
  • Support enhancement and optimisation initiatives from requirement analysis through design, configuration, testing, deployment and transition into support.
  • Review HR processes and Workday configuration to identify opportunities for simplification, standardisation, automation and improved adoption.
  • Support regression testing, release assessment and bi-annual Workday release activity, helping clients understand impacts and adopt relevant new capabilities.
  • Produce and maintain high-quality deliverables, including configuration documentation, test evidence, knowledge-transfer materials, work instructions and service playbooks.

Your skills and experience

  • Minimum of three years’ experience as a Workday Consultant, ideally including implementation, post go-live support, optimisation or AMS service delivery experience.
  • Mandatory Workday Core HCM certification, with additional Workday certifications highly desirable.
  • Hands-on experience configuring Workday or supporting functional activity across one or more areas such as Learning, Talent, Performance, Absence, Compensation, Recruiting, Peakon, Journeys, Extend, Security, Reporting or Integrations.
  • Good understanding of end-to-end HR processes and how they are enabled, supported and improved through Workday.
  • Experience analysing requirements, documenting solutions, supporting testing and translating business needs into practical Workday configuration and service outcomes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to handle complex requirements, diagnose issues and communicate recommendations clearly.
  • Experience working with stakeholders, facilitating workshops and supporting solution design decisions in a client-facing environment.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with global teams and providing guidance to junior colleagues.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with a proactive, inclusive and knowledge-sharing mindset.
  • Availability to work from the Capgemini Manchester office as part of an office-based AMS team.

 

Desirable experience

  • Experience using ServiceNow or another ITIL-aligned service management platform to manage incidents, service requests, changes, problems or enhancement backlogs.
  • Experience supporting Workday bi-annual releases, regression testing, release impact assessment and adoption planning.
  • Experience with post-production optimisation, tenant assessments, service transition, knowledge acquisition or continuous improvement roadmaps.
  • Awareness of Workday Extend, Peakon, Journeys, Reporting, Security, Integrations or broader enterprise architecture considerations.
  • Understanding of responsible AI adoption in HR technology, including data readiness, governance, explainability, adoption and change considerations.
  • ITIL, HR qualification or equivalent practical experience in managed services, HR transformation or cloud application support.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

Declare they have a disability, and 
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service) 
To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Shape Your Path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

About Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About the job you're considering

Capgemini helps Financial Services (Banking & Capital Markets and Insurance) companies address their innovation needs, identify key emerging technologies for investments, and realise benefits faster.  Our proven expertise in delivering high-quality IT services to healthcare payer, property and casualty, and life and annuities businesses have helped insurers become more innovative to meet the evolving demands of today’s consumers.

 

Our capabilities in technologies like Core Banking, Payments, Pegasystems, Duck Creek, Guidewire, Salesforce & Smart Communications combine the strength and agility to traverse industry disruptions smoothly.

 

We are seeking a top-performing Sales Executive to pursue new Cloud Infrastructure Services (CIS) opportunities in the Banking & Capital Markets clients within the Capgemini Financial Services Strategic Business Unit (FS SBU).  The ideal candidate must have an entrepreneurial spirit, relevant industry experience and demonstrate strong selling attributes & techniques.  

 

This role is responsible for creating strategic and tactical plans to uncover and close a range of new business/logo opportunities for the Cloud Infrastructure Services business line.  The task includes infiltrating and influencing decision makers at the highest levels within the account.  It will leverage these relationships to introduce the Capgemini Cloud Infrastructure capabilities and create & pursue selling opportunities.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your role

  • You will be focused on new business acquisition and driving growth into both new name logos and existing clients in the Banking & Capital Markets industries and will have the ability to both create and drive opportunities to closure (including cold calling where necessary).
  • You will be familiar with the various sources of demand – how to identify them, nurture them and be responsible for building an active pipeline of prospective deals.
  • You will develop a deep understanding of Capgemini’s Cloud Infrastructure Services offerings and value proposition to define a compelling proposition and vision for each sales opportunity.
  • You will Build and nurture relationships with the Clients in the Banking & Capital Markets Market Units, lead the sales process by working closely with various stakeholders to win business.
  • You’ll qualify the opportunities and drive the deals to successful contracting

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • You have experience in selling Cloud Infrastructure Services into the Banking & Capital Markets clients and understand the market and technology trends, behaviours and high business requirements of such clients.
  • With a strong background in Cloud Infrastructure Services in the Financial Services sector, you will be expert in demand generation activities and in devising strategies to promote Capgemini with tangible business results.
  • You will have clear and unambiguous accountability for improving Capgemini’s credibility within target clients in the market.
  • You will both frame and drive business opportunities, leveraging the Capgemini offerings. This will also involve the shaping and framing of propositions to meet client requirements.
  • You will be a true hunter with a broad network within the Financial Services sector with a proven track record of sourcing leads, selling technology solutions, developing new logos and be a self-starter and have a solid work experience in the Financial Services sector.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: 
identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)


To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 

 

You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.
Capgemini. Make it real.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Capgemini Invent; Why Join us

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

As a Director in our Insurance practice, you will have proven your delivery track record across Insurance ( Commercial/Specialty or London Markets), and be driven to build steady relationships across to provide value to our current and new clients.

 

You will be ready for the challenge of helping to build a Insurance portfolio for the Invent brand, bringing your network and content credibility to bear.  You will be typically partnering across one or more accounts and will lead on one or two.

 

As a leader in the Invent Insurance team, you will form a team and provide that thought leadership to drive and grow the team.

As a Director in the business you’ll help set the direction, driving forward the business, model our values and behaviours, and coach and develop junior members of the team.  Key expectations from this role include:

 

  • Manage and grow one or more Invent Insurance accounts across the entire Invent offering portfolio
  • Pro-actively open new connections and bring the team with you to maximise impact on client
  • Pick up a specific area of Insurance know-how and become the go to focal point for it
  • Help the Insurance leadership tor drive aggressive recruitment in the marketplace
  • Balance optimally sales and delivery – be hands-on as needed in support of the teams

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
  • Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions.
  • Experience of proposition building and delivery within the Insurance sector
  • Currently working in a major Consulting firm, and/or in industry but having a Consulting background.

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

CSR:

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

ABOUT CAPGEMINI

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

Role Overview:

Principal Commercial and Contract Manager is responsible for independently leading Commercial and Contract Management (CCM) activities across strategic and platinum client accounts. The role provides end-to-end commercial and contractual support throughout the sales lifecycle, including bid and proposal development, contract drafting and negotiation, contract execution, and post-signature contract management.

Working closely with account teams, delivery leaders, legal counsel, finance, and subject matter experts, the successful candidate will help maximize commercial outcomes, mitigate contractual and operational risks, and support profitable growth. The role requires strong commercial acumen, contractual expertise, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a complex global environment.
This position combines individual contributor responsibilities with leadership and coordination of virtual team members through a dotted-line reporting structure. Occasional international travel may be required.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial & Contract Leadership

  • Lead and own commercial and contract management support for strategic client accounts and pursuits
  • Manage contractual and commercial aspects of bids, proposals, and RFP responses from qualification through contract signature.
  • Lead or support commercial and contractual negotiations with clients and external stakeholders.
  • Provide post-sales contract management support to account and delivery teams throughout the contract lifecycle.

Risk Management & Commercial Governance

  • Identify, assess, and manage commercial, contractual, operational, legal, financial, and delivery risks.
  • Collaborate with internal subject matter experts to evaluate risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure commercial risks are accurately reflected within solution designs, pricing models, and contractual commitments.

Contract Structuring & Commercial Optimization

  • Contribute to the development of commercially sound solutions that enhance profitability, improve margin performance, and reduce delivery risk.Identify contractual mechanisms that protect financial performance.
  • Work with finance, delivery, and commercial teams to identify advantageous commercial and financial structures

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build trusted relationships across sales, delivery, legal, finance, procurement, security, and executive leadership teams.
  • Support and lead client presentations, commercial discussions, and negotiation sessions.

Compliance, Data, AI & Intellectual Property

  • Evaluate proposals and contracts involving: Artificial Intelligence (AI),Data Protection and Privacy,Information Security
  • Support identification and management of personal data processing activities and contractual obligations

Contract Finalisation & Contract Lifecycle Management

  • Support contract completion, approvals, execution, and handover to delivery teams..
  • Provide ongoing contractual support, issue resolution, interpretation guidance, change management support, 

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Law, Business, Economics, Finance, Information Technology, Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years' experience in Commercial and Contract Management, preferably within IT Services, Managed Services, Outsourcing, Consulting, or Technology environments.
  • Extensive experience drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing complex technology and services contracts.
  • Strong understanding of commercial models, pricing mechanisms, risk allocation, liability frameworks, and contract governance
  • Demonstrated experience leading commercial and contractual negotiations with senior client stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of legal and commercial principles within technology and outsourcing contracts.

Your Security Clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role you will need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standardchecks.
There are no nationality or residency restrictions, although if you have resided outside of the UK within the last3 years, further checks may be required.
There are other criteria and check required for BPSS, and throughout the recruitment process, you will beasked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

What does 'Get the future you want' mean to you?

You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2023. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. Capgemini. Get the Future You Want 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. But when you join Capgemini, you join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. A powerful source of energy that drives us all to find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses. And it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge and always pushing yourself to-do better, you’ll build the skills you want. And you’ll use them to help our clients leverage technology to grow their business and give innovation that human touch the world needs. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organisations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion. 

Get The Future You Want | www.capgemini.com

Capgemini Invent: Why Join Us?

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

YOUR ROLE

As part of Capgemini Invent’s Intelligent Industry team, you will play a pivotal role in leading complex business transformation initiatives across industries such as Energy & Utilities, Aerospace & Defense, Capital Projects, and Life Sciences. Leveraging advanced technologies—including AI, digital twins, digital continuity, software‑driven transformation, IoT, and edge computing—you will guide clients through their most critical strategic and operational shifts.

As a Director in our business, you’ll lead business development, oversee program delivery, building high performing teams, advance thought ledership, support global offer development.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead Business Development: Drive proposals, RFPs, and bids; develop market propositions; and support events and go‑to‑market initiatives.
  • Oversee Program Delivery: Design and deliver complex transformation programs from strategy to implementation.
  • Build High‑Performing Teams: Develop and lead teams recognized for deep industry expertise and exceptional client outcomes.
  • Advance Thought Leadership: Shape our market position through campaigns, think‑tanks, whitepapers, and external presentations.
  • Support Global Offer Development: Contribute to global portfolio strategy and offer management.
  • Enable Business Operations: Work with senior executives to shape and run the business effectively.

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.

Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.

Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE

You will bring:

  • A naturally curious mindset and the ability to explore and interpret a rapidly evolving intelligent‑industry landscape.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, or a STEM‑related field.
  • Strong understanding of operations and product development, asset management across industries such as Automotive, Aerospace & Defence, Industrial Engineering, FMCG, and Life Sciences.
  • Proven experience—either in a major consulting firm or industry—across Intelligent Industry, Industry 4.0, AI, digital twins, digital continuity, software‑driven transformation, IoT/edge, data and information management, common data environments, PLM, manufacturing design, and digital construction.

  • Skills in business strategy, digital transformation, target operating model development, product management, business case definition, change management, and agile delivery.
  • Experience with solutions such as Aveva, Dassault, Siemens, Autodesk, Maximo, and SAP.
  • Strong awareness of AI applications and emerging industry trends.
  • Demonstrated success in business development with Tier‑1 organizations.

NEED TO KNOW

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect to lead business and technology transformation initiatives across Customer Operations, Marketing Operations and AI-enabled business processes.
The role requires a strategic technology leader capable of working directly with senior client stakeholders, enterprise architecture teams, business leaders and delivery organizations to define future-state architectures, transformation roadmaps and technology strategies.
The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor, helping shape both current and future initiatives while ensuring alignment between business objectives, AI innovation and technology investments.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Architecture & Strategy

  • Define and maintain target architecture, technology roadmaps and transformation strategy.
  • Provide architectural leadership across multiple initiatives and programs.
  • Ensure alignment between business priorities, technology investments and delivery plans.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner directly with client leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Translate business objectives into technology and transformation strategies.
  • Support governance, architecture reviews and executive decision making.

AI & Innovation Leadership

  • Drive adoption of Agentic AI, Generative AI and Hyperautomation solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business outcomes through AI-led transformation.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and define practical adoption roadmaps.
  • Act as a thought leader for AI innovation and enterprise-scale adoption.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide architectural guidance to delivery and engineering teams.
  • Ensure scalable, secure and maintainable solutions.
  • Mentor architects and technical leads across the program

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture or Technology Transformation.
  • Proven experience delivering large-scale business and technology transformation programs.
  • Strong experience working directly with senior business and technology stakeholders.
  • Experience operating in complex multi-vendor environments.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and leadership skills.

Required Expertise

AI & Cloud:

  • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Vertex AI
  • Gemini
  • Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions

Business & Operations

  • Customer Support / Contact Centre Operations (mandatory)
  • Marketing Operations (preferred)
  • Hyper automation and process transformation

Platforms

  • Good understanding of Salesforce ecosystem (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce and Data Cloud experience is an advantage)
  • Experience with enterprise integrations and API-based architectures

Preferred Certifications

  • TOGAF
  • Google Professional Cloud Architect
  • Salesforce Architect certifications (nice to have)

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role you will need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard checks.

There are no nationality or residency restrictions, although if you have resided outside of the UK within the last 3 years, further checks may be required.

There are other criteria and check required for BPSS, and throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 12 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

Capgemini. Make it real

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion. 

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About Role

As a Supply Chain Transformation SME, you will play a pivotal role in helping organizations transform and modernize their supply chain operations through AI-enabled, outcome-driven operating models and innovative business solutions.

You will work with senior client executives to shape, sell, design, and deliver large-scale supply chain transformation initiatives that drive operational excellence, commercial value, and business growth. This role combines strategic advisory, transformation leadership, and business development responsibilities within Capgemini's Intelligent Business Operations practice

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead end-to-end supply chain and Intelligent Business Operations transformation programs.
  • Define transformation strategies, business cases, operating models, transition plans, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Advise clients on supply chain planning, customer operations, logistics, inventory management, AI-enabled operations, and performance management.
  • Drive the design and deployment of next-generation intelligent supply chain operating models.
  • Partner with client executives to establish Global Business Services (GBS), Shared Services, and outsourcing solutions.
  • Lead organizational, process, and technology transformation initiatives.
  • Support business development, pursuit activities, solution shaping, and revenue growth opportunities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and executive leadership teams.
  • Mentor and develop consulting teams while contributing to practice development, recruitment, and capability building.
  • Ensure successful delivery of transformation engagements, managing timelines, budgets, quality standards, and stakeholder expectations

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • 15+ years of experience across management consulting, supply chain operations, outsourcing transformation, or technology-enabled business transformation.
  • Proven track record of leading large-scale supply chain transformation and managed services programs.
  • Strong client-facing consulting experience with the ability to shape, sell, and deliver complex transformation initiatives.
  • Experience working within one or more of the following industries:
    • Consumer Products
    • Retail
    • Life Sciences
    • Automotive
  • Experience designing and implementing GBS, Shared Services, or outsourcing operating models

Domain Expertise

  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following supply chain domains:
    • Supply Chain Planning
    • Customer Operations
    • Procurement
    • Fulfilment & Logistics
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Intelligent Business Operations (IBO)
    • AI-enabled operating models
    • Global Process Ownership
    • Service Delivery Models
    • Outcome-based commercial models
    • Shared Services and Global Business Services frameworks

Essential Requirements

  • Extensive experience leading large-scale outsourcing and transformation programs.
  • Deep knowledge of supply chain business processes within GBS/SSC environments.
  • Demonstrated experience designing future-state operating models and transformation roadmaps.
  • Strong understanding of digital, AI, and technology-led business transformation.
  • Experience engaging and influencing senior client stakeholders and executives

Your Security Clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role you will need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standardchecks.
There are no nationality or residency restrictions, although if you have resided outside of the UK within the last3 years, further checks may be required.
There are other criteria and check required for BPSS, and throughout the recruitment process, you will beasked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

What does 'Get the future you want' mean to you?

You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts,who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2023. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, andwe have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. Capgemini.Get the Future You Want 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. But when you join Capgemini, you join a thriving company and become part of a diverse collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. A powerful source of energy that drives us all to find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses. And it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge and always pushing yourself to-do better, you’ll build the skills you want. And you’ll use them to help our clients leverage technology to grow their business and give innovation that human touch the world needs. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organisations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. Role Overview:

As an integral part of Capgemini’s Intelligent Finance and Accounting Operation  (IFAO) Team, you will help guide our Clients towards large-scale transformations using automation and technology solutions at the very forefront of innovation. 

We seek individuals with a track record in building close and trusting relationships with FP&A stakeholders.You will have expertise in best-in-class Finance & Accounting  processes facilitated by automation/technologies.You will be part of a talented team responsible for designing, selling and delivering end-to-end solutions

Key Responsibilities

The FP&A Transformation Consultant supports clients across UK and Globally in managing and improving FP&A (Financial Planning & Analysis) processes and business outcomes. Using strong Finance knowledge, this role contributes to Strategic Planning, Budgeting, Forecasting, Analytics and Commercial Decision Support improvement initiatives enabled by technology.

The consultant works closely with client finance and controllership teams to ensure accuracy, efficiency, in planning, budgeting, forecasting and analytics while contributing to transformation and digital enablement initiatives

Key responsibilities:

FP&A Process Improvement & Transformation

  • Be part of a team managing FP&A process assessments, design and implementation projects and identify and implement opportunities for modernization and simplification
  • Manage the assessment, design and implementation of future state FP&A processes, controls, and operating model enhancements
  • Prepare the documentation of processes, SOP updates, and preparation of improvement roadmaps.

Technology-Enabled FP&A 

  • Work with the team leadership to build strong partnerships and work with FP&A technology solutions (ERP analytic modules, and enabling technology vendors (e.g. OneStream, Board, Anaplan) reporting tools, data extraction) to support automation and efficiency.
  • Maintain good knowledge of technological products and solutions, with strong awareness of their strengths and weaknesses to drive innovation
  • Leverage AI in transformation programmes.

FP&A business development and sales

  • Support the team leadership to build, maintain and grow the sales pipeline for FP&A solutions
  • Support pre‑sales activities, including proposal development, preparing materials for client pitches, and presenting at client pitches

FP&A practice development

  • Support the team leadership in the proposition development for FP&A
  • Support internal initiatives to build tools, templates, and FP&A accelerators within the P&C team.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Economics, Business, or related field.
  • ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA certification
  • Five plus years of FP&A experience
  • Hands on experience with analytic tools, ERPs and platforms such as SAP, OneStream, Board, Anaplan etc.
  • Proven track record of delivering transformation across FP&A and Finance process
  • Experience of FP&A in Consumer Products, Retail, Manufacturing, Life Sciences, Telecomm or Media industries

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role you will need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard checks.

There are no nationality or residency restrictions, although if you have resided outside of the UK within the last 3 years, further checks may be required.

There are other criteria and check required for BPSS, and throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  •  Declare they have a disability, and

Please opt in during the application process.

About the job you’re considering

Capgemini is seeking a Managing Transition Lead, supporting the Cloud and Infrastructure business in the UK

 

Transition at Capgemini refers specifically to activities associated with the Transition of client services from an incumbent provider(s) to another provider(s). This role is not for candidates with Transition experience related to Acceptance into Service where products/projects are introduced into service. A Managing Transition Manager must be able to demonstrate extensive experience of managing enterprise multilayer contract/service transitions through the full cycle. 

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

 

Your role

Primary Skills

The ideal candidate will have 20+ years of experience in Business Process Transitions, with a proven track record of project management excellence and demonstrated contributions to P&L growth through sales and project execution. A bachelor’s degree is required, with an MBA strongly preferred.

 

Key Responsibilities:

Portfolio Leadership: Lead and manage a diverse portfolio of transition programs, including but not limited to:

  • Transformation-led transitions
  • Lift-and-shift transitions
  • Incumbent vendor transitions
  • Staff augmentation initiatives
  • Build-Transfer-Operate (BTO) models
  • Transition as a Service (TaaS)

 

  • All transitions will be executed within a structured project management framework.
  • Collaborate with Transformation teams to develop implementation plans and timelines for initiatives arising from Global design alignment and Impact Assessment workshops, ensuring Day 1 transformation initiatives are executed seamlessly.
  • Program Governance: Establish and maintain robust program governance structures at strategic, operational, and tactical levels, ensuring compliance with methodologies and tollgates.
  • Transition Excellence: Deliver high-quality transition programs within defined parameters of time, cost, and quality, while proactively managing risks and resolving issues.
  • Knowledge Transfer & Ramp-up: Demonstrate a solid understanding of business processes within scope and expertise in Knowledge Transfer (KT) and ramp-up methodologies.
  • Status Reporting & Escalation Management: Provide comprehensive transition status reporting and manage escalations to ensure seamless execution and stakeholder alignment.
  • Multi-Country and Multi-Tower Rollouts: Manage complex, large-scale transitions across multiple countries and business towers, involving significant scope, FTEs, and parallel transformation opportunities.

 

Secondary Skills

 

  • Program & Project Management Expertise: Demonstrated ability to lead complex programs and projects with industry specialization in at least one domain.
  • Transition & Transformation Leadership: Independent Proven experience managing large-scale transitions, including those involving transformation and standardization, with 200+ FTEs or more.
  • Business Process Expertise: Strong understanding of business process solutions with extensive experience in transition design and execution.
  • Leadership & Talent Development: Exceptional leadership skills with the ability to mentor, develop, and lead high-performing teams.
  • Risk Management & Problem-Solving: Proficient in proactive risk management and issue resolution, ensuring successful project outcomes.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.

 

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.
You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.
Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend strategic, creative, scientific and technology capabilities to help clients address the challenges of today and tomorrow. Our work is informed by data and science, superpowered by creativity and design, and underpinned by technology created with purpose.  

This is an opportunity to play a senior leadership role in our growing UK Procurement capability, working with industry-leading clients to shape and deliver ambitious procurement transformation programmes across strategy, operating model, digital enablement, cost reduction and sustainable value creation. 

Your Role

As a Senior Manager in our Procurement Transformation practice, you will play a leading role in growth, shape and delivery of a broad portfolio of procurement transformation programmes. You will work with Directors and CPOs and other senior client stakeholders to build compelling transformation cases, and deliver measurable business outcomes across cost, service, resilience, sustainability and technology-enabled performance. 

 

You will lead teams to deliver complex, multi-disciplinary consulting engagements across the full procurement lifecycle. This will include pure procurement management consulting projects, large-scale cost reduction programmes, procurement transformation, Source-to-Pay optimisation, operating model redesign, Global Business Services (GBS) constructs, digital procurement enablement and emerging AI/agent-led procurement innovation. 

 

In this role, you will be responsible for: 

 

  • Leading the design and delivery of major procurement transformation programmes such as cost reduction, operating model redesign, process optimisation, value creation and procurement capability development
  • Delivering a £1m yearly sales target by driving business development through account management, proposal leadership, RFP responses, client pitches and proposition development 
  • Advising clients across the full Source-to-Pay lifecycle, including category management, sourcing, supplier management, contracting, purchasing, invoice processing and supplier performance.
  • Bringing a broad understanding of procurement technology, data and digital enablement, including the underpinning IT landscape across Source-to-Contract, Purchase-to-Pay and invoice processing
  • Contributing to the Practices' informed point of view on the use of AI and agents across procurement, from category strategy and market intelligence through to sourcing, supplier performance, buying channels, invoicing and exception management
  • Leading complex delivery teams, ensuring effective project mobilisation, governance, quality, commercials and on-time delivery in line with client outcomes and Capgemini Invent delivery standards.

 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities),  offering development.
  • Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your Profile

You will bring significant procurement transformation experience, strong consulting credentials and the ability to operate credibly with senior stakeholders. 

 

You will have demonstrable experience across a strong mix of the following: 

 

  • Previous consulting experience, ideally gained within major consulting firms, ideally working at a similar level to this role
  • Ability to lead complex procurement transformation programmes across a variety of client environments
  • Previous experience of generating consulting revenue through business development activities
  • Multi-sector experience across public sector, aerospace and defence, consumer products, retail and life sciences
  • Deep experience in procurement strategy, transformation, process design and optimisation
  • Expertise in designing procurement operating models, including Global Business Services (GBS), shared services, process ownership, governance, capability models and transition roadmaps
  • Broad understanding of procurement processes across Source-to-Contract, Purchase-to-Pay and invoice processing
  • Strong understanding of procurement technology and leading procurement solutions, including their capabilities, implementation considerations and role within wider enterprise architecture
  • A developing perspective on AI, automation and agent-led procurement transformation, including how agents may reshape category management, sourcing, supplier management, operational buying, invoicing and compliance
  • Experience using digital technologies, data-led insight and automation to support procurement transformation and benefits realisation
  • Strong people and team leadership experience, with a passion for coaching, developing teams and building internal capability. 

 

Advantageous experience:

 

  • Designing procurement category strategies across direct or indirect spend
  • Supplier relationship management, supplier risk, sustainability-led procurement, supplier performance and third-party resilience
  • Contributing to market-facing propositions around procurement transformation, GBS, digital procurement, AI-enabled procurement or Source-to-Pay optimisation
  • Manufacturing, automotive and other complex operational environments
  • CIPS or equivalent professional accreditation would be valued. 

What You'll Love About Working Here

You will be part of a team that is actively shaping thinking around the changing procurement landscape in a digitally enabled world. You will play a senior role in developing and scaling our Procurement Centre of Excellence, blending deep industry knowledge with practical consulting expertise to create propositions that help clients deliver tangible change.  

You will join an agile and supportive team that believes in the purpose of the work we do and the value we create for clients, colleagues and society.  

Need to Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in Diversity & Inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Active Inclusion Campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester, Newcastle or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

We are a Disability Confident Emplyer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:


•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organisations accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group with 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries, combining capabilities across strategy, design, engineering, AI, cloud, data, industry expertise and partner ecosystems.
