data.title: Procurement Transformation - Senior Manager

data.description:
Working at Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Your Role

The Digital Operating Model team is part of Capgemini Invent’s growing Business Technology practice, one of the leading CIO & CTO advisory and technology innovation teams in the UK and Europe. Our high calibre management consultants deliver profitable outcomes in business and IT-oriented environments, working collaboratively with major FTSE 100 and Government clients to help them achieve their strategic goals and further enhance the delivery of business value from the IT estate.
We are looking for talented individuals to join the team, and to support our clients to make the best choices about their digital operating models as well as get the best advice to make these come to life. 

 

 

In this role you will play a key role in:

 


•    Shaping and influencing operating model choices made by some of the largest Private and Public Sector organisations in the UK
•    Advising C-suite and senior leadership teams on unlocking value from IT and technology investments, embedding AI and Agentic AI in their IT operating models in a controlled way, creating new collaboration opportunities between Business and IT, and driving efficiencies and cost savings.
•    Challenging status quo and perceived barriers, and leveraging your past experiences with similar clients and industries
•    Leading and coaching teams of Digital operating model practitioners to deliver the best possible outcomes for clients

 

 

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

 

•    Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
•    Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities), offering development.
•    Learning & development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your Profile

•    Experience delivering strategic digital technology advisory engagements and building trusting relationships with CIOs, CTOs and their leadership teams
•    Experience working in complex FTSE100 environments and large Government organisations
•    Experience designing digital, product-led operating and/or Agentic AI-driven operating models across the core dimensions of an operating model (i.e. leadership and culture, processes and tooling, organisational structure, accountability and decision-making, performance management)
•    Experience of using AI tooling to enhance delivery of digital operating model design projects, while tailoring solutions to client objectives.
•    Experience of delivering an end-to-end digital operating model design project, incl. AS-IS assessment, options development, high level and detailed design, evidence-based business-cases and transition roadmaps
•    Good knowledge of digital technology industry trends, including but not limited to: AI, 
•    Agentic AI, Agile at Scale, DevSecOps delivery, journey-to-cloud, edge computing, low code/no-code solution development, etc. 

 

Preferred but optional: 


•    ITIL foundations or higher
•    Proven ability to be successful in a matrixed organisation, and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering consulting solutions.
•    Experience of proposition building and delivery. 

What You'll Love About Working Here?

You’ll be free to make your role and your career what you want it to be.  Proactivity and ambition flourish at Capgemini Invent. There are countless opportunities available to propel your development forward: seek out those that suit you, and we will back you all the way. You’ll also be working in a company investing heavily in AI-first and supporting its employees on the journey.  In summary, we believe the following make this a great place to work:
•    Show how single minds make for better teams: Work alongside fierce intellects who love to collaborate.
•    Be comfortable outside your comfort zone: Self-stretchers thrive in our environment.
•    Build momentum in your career: Make your role and your career what you want it to be.
•    Stay true to who you are: Play to your strengths and bring your individuality.
•    Aim for nothing less than leading edge: We thrive on the knowledge that the Digital work we do has real impact.
•    Give your curiosity freedom and focus: A place where inquisitiveness and entrepreneurial thinking are encouraged.

Need to Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.
We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.
Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

We are a Disability Confident Employer
Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
•    Declare they have a disability, and 
•    Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.
Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.
We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

data.title: IT Digital Operating Model Managing Consultant

data.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

About the job you’re considering

Capgemini is looking for an experienced SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) & Project Systems (PS) Support Consultant to join our Application Development & Maintenance (ADM) team, supporting a highly secure and business-critical SAP S/4HANA environment. This is an exciting opportunity to work on complex asset management and project delivery processes that underpin critical operational capabilities within a secure Defence setting.
As part of Capgemini's ADM practice, you'll join a team responsible for maintaining, supporting, and continuously improving enterprise SAP applications. Our ADM teams play a vital role in ensuring operational stability, service excellence, and ongoing optimisation across large-scale SAP landscapes, partnering closely with clients to deliver long-term business value.

Your Role

  • Providing functional support across SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) and Project Systems (PS)
  • Managing maintenance notifications, work orders, maintenance plans, and asset-related processes
  • Supporting project planning and execution activities, including WBS elements, networks, and project tracking
  • Monitoring maintenance execution, resource utilisation, and cost performance
  • Ensuring seamless integration between maintenance and project processes across the SAP landscape
  • Investigating and resolving incidents, service requests, and process issues within agreed service levels
  • Working closely with business stakeholders to improve operational efficiency and system performance
  • Supporting enhancements, testing activities, and continuous service improvement initiatives

Your skills and experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP PM and PS modules
  • Solid understanding of maintenance management, asset lifecycles, and project delivery processes
  • Experience working within asset-intensive industries such as Defence, Aerospace, Utilities, Engineering, or Manufacturing
  • Knowledge of work management, maintenance planning, project costing, and asset performance processes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex business issues
  • Experience within an Application Management Services (AMS) or support environment is highly desirable

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

Declare they have a disability, and 
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

Active UK Developed Vetting (DV) clearance is a mandatory requirement for this role. Due to the highly sensitive nature of the programme, only candidates who currently hold valid DV clearance can be considered. Unfortunately, applications from candidates without active DV clearance cannot be progressed.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Shape Your Path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

data.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

About the job you’re considering

Capgemini is looking for an experienced SAP Logistics Support Consultant to join our Application Development & Maintenance (ADM) team, supporting a secure and complex SAP landscape within a high-profile Defence programme. This role offers the opportunity to work across critical supply chain, warehouse, and logistics processes that support essential operational activities.
As part of Capgemini's ADM practice, you'll join a team responsible for delivering reliable application support, continuous service improvement, and operational excellence. Working closely with both business and technical stakeholders, you'll help ensure SAP logistics solutions remain stable, efficient, and aligned to evolving business needs.

Your Role

  • Providing functional support across SAP Materials Management (MM), Extended Warehouse Management (EWM), and related logistics processes
  • Supporting procurement, inventory management, goods movements, and warehouse operations
  • Investigating and resolving incidents, service requests, and process issues within agreed service levels
  • Supporting PLM and logistics integration scenarios to ensure seamless end-to-end business processes
  • Working with technical teams to diagnose cross-functional and cross-system issues
  • Contributing to enhancements, process improvements, and service optimisation initiatives
  • Supporting change management and testing activities for system updates and new functionality
  • Ensuring operational processes remain compliant, controlled, and effective within a secure environment

Your skills and experience

  • Strong SAP MM knowledge with experience supporting procurement and inventory processes
  • Understanding of SAP EWM and warehouse management operations
  • Experience supporting logistics and supply chain business processes within SAP environments
  • Knowledge of cross-module integrations and end-to-end supply chain flows
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to manage issues through to resolution
  • Experience working within an Application Management Services (AMS) or support environment is highly desirable

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

Declare they have a disability, and 
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

Active UK Developed Vetting (DV) clearance is a mandatory requirement for this role. Due to the highly sensitive nature of the programme, only candidates who currently hold valid DV clearance can be considered. Unfortunately, applications from candidates without active DV clearance cannot be progressed.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Shape Your Path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

About the job you're considering

Capgemini is looking for an experienced SAP Basis & Solution Manager Consultant to join our Application Development & Maintenance (ADM) team, supporting a highly secure and business-critical SAP landscape. This is a fantastic opportunity to play a key role in maintaining the stability, performance, and security of a complex SAP S/4HANA environment that underpins vital operational services.

As part of Capgemini's ADM practice, you will work within a collaborative team responsible for delivering exceptional application support and continuous service improvement. Our ADM teams ensure enterprise platforms remain resilient, compliant, and high-performing, while partnering closely with clients to drive operational excellence and long-term value.

Your Role

  • Managing the day-to-day administration and support of SAP S/4HANA environments
  • Monitoring system health, performance, and capacity, proactively identifying and resolving issues
  • Overseeing transport management and ensuring controlled movement of changes across environments
  • Managing SAP landscapes across Development, Test, and Production environments
  • Planning and executing system upgrades, patching activities, refreshes, and technical maintenance
  • Configuring, maintaining, and optimising SAP Solution Manager (SolMan)
  • Supporting platform-level security, compliance, and audit requirements within a highly governed environment
  • Working closely with functional, development, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform stability and service continuity

Your skills and experience

  • Strong hands-on experience in SAP Basis administration within SAP S/4HANA environments
  • Expertise in SAP Solution Manager (SolMan) configuration and support
  • Good understanding of SAP HANA database administration and performance considerations
  • Experience managing secure, on-premise SAP environments
  • Knowledge of system monitoring, transport management, patching, upgrades, and landscape management
  • Strong troubleshooting, stakeholder engagement, and service delivery skills

Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

About the job you’re considering

Capgemini is seeking an experienced SAP PP/QM Support Consultant to join our Application Development & Maintenance (ADM) team, supporting a highly secure and business-critical SAP environment. This is an excellent opportunity to work at the heart of manufacturing and quality management operations, helping ensure that production processes run efficiently, issues are resolved quickly, and continuous improvements are delivered across the SAP landscape.


As part of Capgemini's ADM practice, you'll work alongside experienced SAP professionals responsible for maintaining, supporting, and enhancing enterprise applications that underpin key operational capabilities. Our ADM teams focus on delivering service excellence, operational stability, and ongoing optimisation for some of the UK's most important programmes.

Your Role

  • Providing functional support for SAP Production Planning (PP) and Quality Management (QM) processes
  • Managing and supporting production planning activities, including MRP, production orders, and manufacturing execution processes
  • Supporting quality inspections, defect management, notifications, and quality-related master data
  • Investigating and resolving shopfloor and manufacturing process issues to minimise operational disruption
  • Working closely with business users and other SAP functional teams to ensure smooth end-to-end process execution
  • Supporting incidents, service requests, problem management, and system enhancements
  • Identifying opportunities to improve planning efficiency, quality controls, and process integration
  • Supporting integration between PP, QM, Materials Management (MM), and Plant Maintenance (PM)

Your skills and experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP PP and QM modules
  • Good understanding of manufacturing, production planning, and shopfloor operations
  • Knowledge of quality management processes and quality assurance controls
  • Experience working with integrated SAP processes, particularly across MM and PM
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex business issues
  • Experience within an Application Management Services (AMS) or support environment is highly desirable

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

Declare they have a disability, and 
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

Active UK Developed Vetting (DV) clearance is a mandatory requirement for this role. Due to the highly sensitive nature of the programme, only candidates who currently hold valid DV clearance can be considered. Unfortunately, applications from candidates without active DV clearance cannot be progressed.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Shape Your Path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

Capgemini is looking for an experienced SAP Supply Chain Planning & Logistics Support Consultant to join our Application Development & Maintenance (ADM) team, supporting a highly secure and business-critical SAP environment.   • Monitoring inventory levels, stock movements, and planning accuracy across the supply chain
  • Investigating and resolving logistics and fulfilment issues to minimise operational disruption
  • Handling incidents, service requests, and system enhancements within agreed service levels

data.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

About the job you're considering

Capgemini is seeking a talented SAP ABAP Developer to join our Application Development & Maintenance (ADM) team, supporting a highly secure and business-critical SAP S/4HANA environment. This is an opportunity to work on a complex enterprise platform where your technical expertise will directly contribute to the stability, enhancement, and evolution of mission-critical SAP services.

As part of Capgemini's ADM practice, you'll work alongside experienced SAP functional and technical specialists responsible for supporting, maintaining, and continually improving business applications. Our ADM teams provide more than traditional support, partnering closely with clients to deliver innovation, technical excellence, and ongoing optimisation across their SAP landscapes.

Your Role

  • Developing and enhancing SAP S/4HANA solutions, including custom reports, interfaces, forms, and enhancements
  • Investigating, debugging, and resolving technical defects across the SAP landscape
  • Working closely with functional consultants to design and implement effective technical solutions
  • Developing and supporting CDS Views, enhancements, user exits, BAdIs, and other S/4HANA development objects
  • Supporting integration activities and interface development where required
  • Ensuring development activities adhere to established coding, quality, and transport management standards
  • Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives and technical optimisation opportunities

Your skills and experience

  • Strong hands-on SAP ABAP development experience within S/4HANA environments
  • Experience with CDS Views, enhancements, user exits, and modern SAP development practices
  • Excellent debugging and problem-solving capabilities
  • Understanding of SAP transport management and development lifecycle processes
  • Experience working with functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • A proactive and collaborative approach to working in a support and enhancement environment

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

 

Active UK Developed Vetting (DV) clearance is a mandatory requirement for this role. Due to the highly sensitive nature of the programme, we can only consider applicants who currently hold valid DV clearance. Candidates without active DV clearance will not be eligible for consideration.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.   To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

About the job you’re considering

Are you an experienced SAP Finance professional looking to work on a high-profile, secure programme where your expertise has a real impact? Capgemini is seeking an SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI/CO) Application Support Consultant to join our growing Application Development & Maintenance (ADM) team, supporting mission-critical SAP services within a secure Defence environment.
As part of Capgemini's ADM practice, you will work alongside a highly skilled team responsible for keeping complex SAP landscapes running smoothly, delivering operational excellence, continuous improvement, and trusted support to our clients. This role offers the opportunity to combine deep functional expertise with stakeholder engagement, problem-solving, and process optimisation in a collaborative and supportive environment.

Your Role

Providing functional support across SAP S/4HANA Finance, including General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting, and Controlling (CO)

 

  • Managing incidents, service requests, problems, and changes in line with ITIL best practices
  • Supporting financial close activities, reconciliations, and period-end processing
  • Investigating and resolving complex business and system issues
  • Working closely with technical and functional teams to ensure seamless integration with related SAP modules, particularly MM and PS
  • Supporting audit, compliance, and regulatory requirements within a highly governed environment
  • Identifying opportunities for process optimisation, automation, and service improvement

Your skills and experience

  • Strong functional expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI/CO)
  • Experience supporting period-end and financial close processes
  • Understanding of integration points with Materials Management (MM) and Project Systems (PS)
  • Experience working within an Application Management Services (AMS) or support environment
  • Knowledge of ITIL-aligned service delivery
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

data.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

About the job you’re considering

Capgemini is seeking an experienced SAP Product Engineering & PLM Integration Consultant to join our Application Development & Maintenance (ADM) team, supporting a highly secure and business-critical SAP S/4HANA environment. This role is ideal for someone with a strong understanding of engineering, manufacturing, and product lifecycle processes who enjoys working at the intersection of design, production, and enterprise technology.
As part of Capgemini's ADM practice, you'll help support and continuously improve SAP applications that are critical to delivering operational capability. Working closely with engineering, manufacturing, and technical teams, you'll play a key role in ensuring product data, documentation, and engineering changes flow seamlessly throughout the organisation.

Your Role

  • Supporting SAP Production Engineering and Operations (PEO) processes, including the transition from Engineering Bill of Materials (EBOM) to Manufacturing Bill of Materials (MBOM)
  • Managing engineering change control processes, version management, and configuration traceability
  • Maintaining SAP Document Management System (DMS) content, including technical documentation, CAD files, 3D models, and manufacturing instructions
  • Supporting integrations between SAP and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems using PLMSI
  • Investigating and resolving incidents, service requests, and process issues across engineering and manufacturing functions
  • Ensuring end-to-end traceability from product design through to manufacturing and operational delivery
  • Collaborating with business and technical stakeholders to improve engineering and production processes
  • Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the SAP landscape

Your skills and experience

  • Experience supporting SAP PEO, DMS, and PLMSI solutions
  • Strong understanding of engineering-to-manufacturing lifecycle processes
  • Knowledge of engineering change management, product structures, and document control
  • Experience working within complex manufacturing, aerospace, defence, or engineering-driven environments
  • Understanding of BOM management, configuration control, and product data governance
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder engagement skills

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

Declare they have a disability, and 
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

Active UK Developed Vetting (DV) clearance is a mandatory requirement for this role. Due to the highly sensitive nature of the programme, only candidates who currently hold valid DV clearance can be considered. Unfortunately, applications from candidates without active DV clearance cannot be progressed.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Shape Your Path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. Your role

As an Account Director, you'll be responsible for growing and strengthening Capgemini's presence within the UK Energy Networks sector. Working closely with customers and internal teams, you'll build strategic relationships, identify new opportunities, and help deliver solutions that create long-term value for clients. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Developing account growth strategies and identifying new business opportunities. 
  • Building trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and key decision-makers. 
  • Shaping and converting opportunities into secured work by aligning customer needs with Capgemini's capabilities. 
  • Working collaboratively across teams to deliver successful outcomes and maximise customer satisfaction. 

Your profile

You are an experienced account leader with a strong track record of growing strategic customer relationships within engineering, digital or transformation services. You thrive in a relationship-based sales environment, enjoy building networks and influencing stakeholders, and have a proven ability to turn customer demand into commercial success. 

We're looking for someone with: 

  • Demonstrable experience in account management, business development or framework management within engineering, technology, digital or transformation services. 
  • Strong relationships and industry knowledge within the UK Energy Networks sector. 
  • A proven track record of identifying opportunities, shaping propositions and securing new business within complex customer environments. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage confidently at senior levels. 
  • Strong commercial awareness, coupled with a proactive, customer-centric approach and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Please opt in during the application process.​​

Capgemini. Make it real.​

About the job you’re considering

We’re seeking a seasoned Managed Services Lead Architect who wants to apply their skills and experience within an exciting and vibrant Account. The client is going through a period of significant change, and digital transformation is at the forefront of their business strategy. As an Account Lead Architect, you will thrive on having responsibility for the end-to-end architecture of the contracted services as well as being the focal point for ensuring its technical integrity. Being part of an enthusiastic Business Technologist community will enable you to maintain awareness of the latest technologies and innovations within the Capgemini Portfolio and apply these to your technology landscape. You will also provide inspiration and act as a role model for a talented and enthusiastic team of Domain Architects and Engineers on the account.


Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.  This role does require some regular travel to the Client site in Salisbury

Your role

As an integral part of the Capgemini Architecture community, you’ll have fantastic opportunities to develop both yourself, and our collective capabilities. As part of the Account team, you’ll be empowered to provide:

 

  • Governance of change within, and take ownership of, the end-to-end Account Architecture within Managed Services contracts, ensuring delivery quality and adherence to standards.
  • Key stakeholder management for internal, as well as external parties.
  • Strategic mapping of the technology landscape strategy including roadmaps, and future state architectures, fully aligned with contractual commitments and client needs.
  • Trusted advice to the Client by cultivating strong symbiotic Client relationships.
  • Direction and guidance on technical aspects, ensuring adherence to standards and practices while aligning with client requirements.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

A proven track record of governing and owning the end-to-end architecture of a complex technology landscape. Can demonstrate experience of operating as a Lead Architect within the constraints and complexities of large Managed Services accounts. Able to demonstrate a knowledge of contracts and commercials as well as proven stakeholder management and client relationship skills.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

Some roles will also require an additional level of security clearance:

 


Security Check (SC) Clearance:

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.


Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.

To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Our Offer

Capgemini Engineering is seeking a proactive and highly organized Non‑conformance Coordinator to join our fast‑paced aerospace engineering team. This role requires strong coordination skills, the ability to work with multiple stakeholder groups, and confidence operating in both remote and onsite environments. The successful candidate will manage and analyze data related to manufacturing concessions and support the production of metrics and KPI reports from our management tools. Responsibilities include liaising with on‑site Capgemini Engineering and client engineers, monitoring the client Businessmap tool, and allocating work across the permanent and subcontract teams.

This is a dynamic role where priorities can shift quickly, so the ability to adapt, communicate clearly, and manage your own workload is essential.

Your role

The Non‑conformance Coordinator is responsible for ensuring timely communication, document progression, and closure of non‑conformance submissions through effective liaison with the wider team. The role requires managing technical information and applying a solid understanding of the associated processes and tools, including Businessmap to support metric generation and produce analytical reports for client technical leadership. The coordinator will work closely with both Capgemini and client engineers and will oversee the workflow of non‑conformance items across internal management tools.

Responsibilities

  • Accountable for disposition and turnaround time for all non-conformance submissions (Concessions, Deviation Permits, DARs, TADs, FPAs, and other QNs).
  • Ensure all submissions are progressed efficiently through completion, maintaining momentum and visibility.
  • Lead and facilitate daily stand-ups, escalation reviews, and concession flow sessions with Capability Leads; escalate issues to Coordinator Team Leader and Client Tech Leads when required.
  • Produce and maintain weekly metrics, quantity and age data, and report status updates.
  • Support the monitoring of TADs that require safety review within 48 hours and liaise with the NCA teams to ensure timely completion of safety assessments.

Your profile

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to take accountability, drive progress, and direct resources to meet objectives.
  • Previous programme, operations, or coordination experience with a proven track record of delivering improvements.
  • Strong teamwork skills, with the ability to work independently and take initiative when required.
  • Proficiency in Excel and Power BI, with the ability to manage data, generate reports, and produce clear metrics and dashboards.
  • Understanding of engineering and manufacturing drawings, processes, and terminology.
  • Excellent organisation, communication, and interpersonal skills, including confidence in meetings and stakeholder interactions.
  • Highly methodical, logical, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

data.description:
Your role

As an integral part of our Service Delivery Team, you’ll have fantastic opportunities to develop both yourself and our collective. As part of the team, you’ll be empowered to:

  • Service Management.  Support activities across all ITIL processes engaging with your customer as required and collaborating with operational & technical teams to determine effectiveness of solutions, change windows, operational readiness etc.
  • Continuous Improvement.  Identify opportunities to improve IT service delivery processes and implementation of best practices.
  • Communication and Collaboration.  Acting as the voice of the client for live service with an understanding of business priorities and challenges, effectively communicate with key stakeholders, keeping them informed of IT service performance and any planned Service changes. Collaborate with Partner Supplier IT teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
  • Manage Business expectations.  Champion IT initiatives and their benefits to business stakeholders Act as an advocate for the business within the IT organisation and vice versa.
  • Business Systems Focus.  Develop a deep understanding of the IT systems that are critical to business operations, providing input that aligns services to business requirements, representing those business requirements into the SIAM to support the business receiving the highest level of service.
  • Manages the internal reporting of services and the financial cycle to include forecasting, invoicing and cost management; controls the billing and accuracy of all financials.  
  • Innovation and Technology Awareness: Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends within the relevant business sector. Identify opportunities to leverage new technologies to improve processes, enhance product development, and drive innovation.

 

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

  • Executive level communication skills with a track record of building relationships at CxO and CxO -1 levels.
  •  Abreast of the latest trends in transforming the experiences of customers and the use of GenAI tolling.
  • Experience in service delivery with a focus on client satisfaction and cost efficiency.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex customer interactions with confidence, and maintain strong, trust‑based relationships with challenging clients.
  • A good understanding of ITIL (V3/V4) processes and service management best practices.
  • Awareness of cloud and end-user services, and how they contribute to operational success.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a  Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

 

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
     


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance.


To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.

Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.


If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

Flexibility to work your way
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 

 

Your wellbeing
You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


 

Shape your path
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.


 

Shared energy
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.

Why should you consider Capgemini?

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com

Job Title

Industrial Sparring Partner (ISP) – Defense & Industry

Positioning & Key Role

The Industrial Sparring Partner (ISP) is a senior profile with strong experience and industrial legitimacy. They act as a sparring partner for our Defense clients, particularly for the plant manager, industrial director, or COO (Chief Operations Officer).

To do this, they rely on a close relationship with the operational teams on the production sites and the missions they deliver or supervise. Their goal is to support and accelerate the industrial ramp-up of our clients, with the support of the Business Lines (notably ERD and Invent). They are dedicated to one or two accounts and focus on high-potential production sites.

The ISP has a strategic role with the GCP (Global Client Partner), is integrated into account teams (functional reporting), and supervises commitments related to their client's industrial issues. Together with the GCP, they define and execute an engagement model (“Skin in the game”) tailored to their client, with the goal of sharing KPIs. The ISP also participates in identifying and selling digital, engineering, and consulting projects in connection with their clients. The ISP is independent hierarchically but a privileged partner of the Business Lines. Deployment on one or two sites of one of the strategic priority accounts is carried out as part of a global European approach: in France, Germany, and the United Kingdom. Member of the ISP community, driven by the Intelligent Industry Accelerator.

Your missions:

  • Operational sparring partner for industrial leadership: on-site presence 2 to 4 days/week, support for industrial decisions, sharing of KPIs
  • Delivery orchestration: end-to-end management of multi-expertise frameworks, risk management, arbitration, and performance
  • Business acceleration: identification of opportunities, support for deal shaping, structuring of results-oriented proposals
  • Contribution to the Defense growth platform: capitalizing on knowledge, developing assets, and driving the industrial ecosystem
  • Cross-selling of the Group’s industrial offerings

Your perimeter:

  • Supervises, orchestrates, and grows all industrial services from all BLs (Apps, Sogeti, Invent, Engineering, CIS, …) for the account
    • Production development,
    • Supply chain management,
    • Quality & compliance,
    • Workforce management,
    • Tech, Data and AI
  • Defines strategy with the sponsor and the GCP, supports the CXO play
  • Validates commitments, must build trust with clients

Your profile:

The ISP brings significant industrial experience (15+ years) in complex industrial environments, ideally in the Defense, Aeronautics, Automotive, or Advanced Manufacturing sectors. Experience in consulting (as part of a firm or freelance) enables them to approach the consulting profession with account knowledge.

1 - Their expertise in industrial strategy and performance covers:

  • Operational experience in leading or transforming an industrial site (Plant Manager, COO, Operations Director, or similar field role): overall cycle time reduction, review of industrial organizations, management/planning methods, redesign of make or buy policies, industrial transfers, supply chain redesign
  • A broad functional expertise in organization and industrial performance: industrial strategy, industrial reorganization or redesign of operating models, Lean/6 Sigma, QRQC, continuous improvement, flow optimization, Quality, Maintenance, In/outbound logistics
  • Proven expertise in ramp-up in critical contexts: launching new lines/products, industrializing complex programs, managing industrial crises (delays, quality, supply chain)
  • Experienced in industrial digitalization / Industry 4.0: MES, IoT, data, AI, automation)
  • Industrial experience across multiple sectors , enabling cross-fertilization and leveraging best practices from different industries
  • In-depth knowledge of the Defense sector and the challenges of industrial ramp-up.


2 – Credibility gained through in-depth and recognized account knowledge

  • Knowledge of the industrial system acquired (and continuously developed) through operational assignments visible at the CXO/COO/Head of Plants level
  • Closeness developed with the account's CXOs: COO, Head of Plants, Program Directors, CIO, Digital Transformation Director, Supply Chain Director, Technical Directors, Support Management (…) and their middle management network (Business Unit Managers, Head of Planning, Production, Maintenance, Quality Directors…)
  • The ability to deliver a vision : transformation or ramp-up roadmap, sharing strategic challenges, providing innovation, shared vision of the future.


3 – Credibility gained through in-depth and recognized account knowledge

  • Operational experience in leading or transforming an industrial site (Plant Manager, COO, Operations Director, or similar field role): overall cycle time reduction, review of industrial organizations, management/planning methods, redesign of make or buy policies, industrial transfers, supply chain redesign.
  • A broad functional expertise in organization and industrial performance: industrial strategy, industrial reorganization or redesign of operating models, Lean/6 Sigma, QRQC, continuous improvement, flow optimization, Quality, Maintenance, In/outbound logistics
  • Proven expertise in ramp-up in critical contexts: launching new lines/products, industrializing complex programs, managing industrial crises (delays, quality, supply chain).

  • Seniority level: E/F
  • Industrial leadership & executive credibility: manufacturing excellence, smart manufacturing, supply chain, industrial ramp-up
  • Previous experience in consulting is valued
  • Field leadership, complex management, results orientation, executive credibility
  • Excellent listening skills and understanding of field issues
  • Sparring partner role
  • Strong autonomy and sense of responsibility
  • Ability to navigate complex client environments with commercial challenges

Job title: GenAI Architect

Location: London, UK

About the Job you are considering:

Lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale generative AI solutions on AWS. Translate business problems into secure, scalable, production-grade AI systems using Amazon Bedrock, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, and cloud-native AWS services. Drive architecture standards, model orchestration, governance, observability, and operational excellence across the GenAI lifecycle while collaborating with engineering, security, compliance, and business stakeholders

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role:

  • Lead architecture and implementation of GenAI applications using AWS services, especially large language model capabilities such as Amazon Bedrock
  • Define reusable architecture patterns for model customization, prompt orchestration, retrieval pipelines, and agentic workflows
  • Design agentic AI systems incorporating tool use, workflow orchestration, memory management, and autonomous decision flows
  • Implement observability for prompts, model responses, vector retrieval quality, and agent execution workflows
  • Integrate GenAI capabilities into enterprise applications, APIs, workflow platforms, and data ecosystems
  • Work with security, risk, compliance, engineering, and business teams to enable LLMOps and AgenticOps capabilities - prompt lifecycle management, model observability, caching, evaluation and governance.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise governance, model risk, auditability, data privacy, and regulatory requirements in highly regulated environments
  • Produce solution documentation, technical standards, and deployment approaches, and support delivery from concept through production.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Architecture Governance
  • Establish reference architectures, reusable patterns, security standards, and engineering best practices for GenAI adoption across the organization.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams implementing GenAI solutions.
  • AI Strategy Alignment
  • Partner with business and product stakeholders to identify high-value GenAI use cases and define measurable outcomes.
  • Vendor / Model Evaluation
  • Evaluate foundation models, embedding models, vector databases, and AI tooling for enterprise suitability.
  • Cost Optimization
  • Optimize inference cost, latency, throughput, and scalability across GenAI workloads.


Your Skills:

  • Experience designing cloud-native GenAI architectures using AWS services such as Bedrock, Lambda, SageMaker, OpenSearch, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, Step Functions, S3, IAM, KMS, and CloudWatch
  • Knowledge of scalable, secure, event-driven, and distributed system architectures
  • Experience integrating structured and unstructured enterprise data sources
  • Experience with RAG, fine-tuning, model evaluation, data privacy, ethical AI, and cross-functional stakeholder management is expected
  • Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture, IAM, encryption, and secure AI deployment practices
  • Experience implementing AI governance, auditability, data privacy, and compliance controls
  • Banking or regulated-industry experience is highly relevant
  • Hands-on Python development experience for building GenAI applications, APIs, orchestration pipelines, and automation workflows is preferred


We are a Disability Confident Employer:

  • Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
  • Please opt in during the application process.

Make It Real (what does it mean for you):

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. 
    To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

This role involves the development and application of engineering practice and knowledge in the following technologies: Design of mechanical systems, devices, equipment and machines; installing and maintaining mechanically functioning equipment; simulating a wide range of interactions and evaluate performance in real world scenarios; and develop prototype for manufacturability, testing and validation.

Your role

Activities to be carried out as part of the service:

Ensures the production and monitoring of the civil engineering of the buildings on the nuclear island and proposes technical solutions. They will directly receive work assignments from and report to the team Leader.

• Coordinate the work of CAD Design in conjunction with the Design Office Manager.

• Perform technical verifications of civil engineering documents for their building.

• 10 - 15 years of experience

• Knows how to deal with the design and layout constraints
