About the job you are considering

 

Capgemini Business Services is seeking an executive-level FP&A Business Transformation Director to help shape, grow and lead our UK FP&A transformation capability within the Intelligent Finance and Accounting Operations practice.
This is a senior market-facing role for a recognised finance transformation leader who can engage credibly with CFOs, controllership leaders and senior FP&A stakeholders. You will help clients reimagine planning, forecasting, performance management and decision support through modern operating models, data, automation and leading Enterprise Performance Management technologies.

 

You’ll join a growing Projects & Consulting practice where you can combine strategic advisory, commercial leadership and delivery excellence: building trusted executive relationships, shaping major transformation opportunities, leading high-impact programmes and developing the FP&A proposition that will support the continued growth of Capgemini’s finance transformation business.

Your role

 

As FP&A Business Transformation Director, you will take a visible leadership role in the market, helping clients respond to increasing pressure for faster planning cycles, more accurate forecasting, stronger performance insight and better use of data, automation and EPM platforms.


•    Lead the growth of Capgemini’s FP&A transformation capability, shaping our market proposition, points of view, methods and accelerators.
•    Build trusted advisor relationships with CFOs, finance transformation leaders, controllership teams and senior FP&A stakeholders.
•    Originate, shape and support the conversion of high-value consulting and transformation opportunities across existing and new clients.
•    Lead complex FP&A transformation engagements, from strategy and business case through to design, implementation and adoption.
•    Advise clients on modern planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, analytics and decision-support models enabled by platforms such as Anaplan, OneStream, Board, SAP, Oracle and Power BI.

Your skills and experience

 

You are an established finance transformation leader with the executive presence, commercial judgement and consulting credibility to influence senior clients and grow a differentiated FP&A transformation business. You will be comfortable moving from board-level conversations to proposition shaping and delivery leadership, bringing both strategic perspective and practical execution discipline.


•    Significant senior-level experience in FP&A, finance transformation, controllership, EPM consulting or a closely related advisory discipline.
•    Experience advising CFOs and senior finance leaders on planning, forecasting, performance management, reporting, analytics and operating model transformation.
•    Commercial experience identifying, shaping and winning transformation opportunities, including proposal leadership and executive-level client presentations.
•    Credibility in technology-enabled finance transformation, with familiarity across EPM, ERP, analytics, automation and AI-enabled finance solutions.
•    Leadership experience building teams, developing capability and creating reusable consulting assets, methods or propositions.
•    A degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting or a related field; ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or equivalent qualification would be beneficial.

Hybrid working

 

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs and those of the business. It will be a blend of Capgemini offices, client sites and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Why you should consider Capgemini

 

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to create visible impact with senior clients, shape a growing consulting capability and work with a professional community of experts across finance transformation, business services, data, AI, cloud and technology. You will be empowered to explore, innovate and progress, supported by Capgemini’s learning culture and broad development opportunities.
At Capgemini, building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment for everyone, where you can bring your whole self to work.

About Capgemini

 

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organisations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries.


With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market-leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. 

About the job you’re considering

We are looking for an experienced Workday Lead to join our Workday Practice and strengthen our Application Managed Services capability. This is an office-based role in Manchester for someone who can combine deep Workday functional knowledge, service delivery discipline and people leadership to deliver a critical service for our clients.
You will lead a global team supporting and enhancing live Workday environments, working closely with client stakeholders, service managers, functional specialists, technical teams, integration teams and delivery leaders. You will help clients keep their Workday platforms stable, compliant and continuously improving, while supporting the growth of a scalable, high-quality AMS capability.

Your Role

As a Workday Lead (AMS Specialist), you will act as a trusted advisor and service lead for clients using Workday as a business-critical HR platform. You will take ownership of complex functional and service topics, guide consultants across geographies, oversee incident, request and enhancement activity, and ensure that work is delivered to agreed quality, service and client expectations.
You will be expected to bring a modern AMS mindset: proactive, service-focused, outcome-led and comfortable helping clients improve stability, adoption, data quality, automation, reporting and responsible use of emerging Workday capabilities. You will also help shape the ways of working, assets and standards that support a mature global Workday AMS service.

 

Key responsibilities:

 

AMS service leadership and client delivery

  • Lead the day-to-day delivery of the Workday AMS service, ensuring incidents, service requests, enhancements and advisory activities are managed effectively and to agreed service expectations.

 

Workday functional leadership and solution quality

  • Lead analysis, configuration, testing, validation and documentation of Workday changes across HCM and related functional areas such as Learning, Talent, Performance, Absence, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Compensation, Payroll, Security and Reporting.

  • Experience as a Workday professional working across implementation, post go-live support, optimisation or AMS services, with the confidence to take ownership of complex functional and service topics.
  • Strong hands-on Workday configuration experience, ideally across Workday HCM and one or more areas such as Learning, Talent, Performance, Absence, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Compensation, Payroll, Security or Reporting.

About the job your considering

 

This is a mid to senior-level ‘360 sales’ role: driving lead generation, qualifying clients, and supporting proposal development by understanding client-specific requirements. You will own the entire sales cycle from opportunity identification and qualification through to closing new business.

 

This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a team focused on one of the fastest-growing opportunities in the technology market. In this role, you will leverage your industry insight, proven track record, and knowledge of Google Cloud technologies. In particular, driving, digital transformation, modern infrastructure, and cutting-edge Data/AI solutions across our high-growth Mid-Market account portfolio.  Using the wider technology consulting market to acquire new customers, the ideal candidate will  utilize Sogeti’s market-leading offerings and global delivery capability.

 

The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of navigating mid-market cycles, characterised by high velocity, multifaceted stakeholders, and rapid scaling needs. Crucially, you must possess strong, active relationships and hands-on experience co-selling directly with Google Cloud’s internal sales organization (Field Sales Representatives, Partner Sales Managers, and Customer Engineers) to successfully co-sell, leverage Google funds, and maximise marketplace value.

 

Hybrid working: Your work location will vary between company offices, client sites, and home (not 100% remote).

Your Role

 

 

•    .Execute Mid-Market Growth: Own the end-to-end sales lifecycle for mid-market accounts, driving new logo acquisition and expanding existing GCP footprints to consistently meet or exceed annual recurring revenue (ARR) targets.


•    Navigate the Google Cloud Ecosystem: Act as the primary interface to Google Cloud's internal Mid-Market sales teams. Coordinate joint go-to-market strategies, align account plans with Google’s territory maps, and drive co-selling velocity. 


•    Leverage Google Programs & Marketplace: Masterfully utilize Google Cloud partner incentives, funding programs (e.g., funding for POCs/assessments), and the Google Cloud Marketplace to accelerate deal closures and optimize client spend.


•    Deliver Consultative Value: Position Google Cloud's core pillars—including Infrastructure Modernization, Data Analytics, Security, and Gemini Enterprise as strategic business enablers rather than just IT commodities.


•    C-Suite Engagement: Build trusted relationships with mid-market executives (CEOs, CFOs, CIOs, and CTOs), aligning cloud adoption strategies with their immediate business goals and long-term financial scaling. 


•    Cross-Functional Orchestration: Lead internal matrixed pursuit teams consisting of Cloud Architects, Solution Engineers, and Delivery Managers to deliver compelling, technically sound proposals.

Your Skills and experience

 

 

•    .CRM Knowledge: Familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) is an advantage.


•    Experience: Experience of B2B technology sales experience, with dedication  to selling Google Cloud Platform (GCP) solutions or related technology consulting services.


•    Mid-Market Mastery: A proven track record of managing a high-volume, mid-market territory, demonstrating the agility to balance velocity with strategic, complex deal structuring (typically £250k–£1M+ ARR deals).


•    The Google Network: Deep, verifiable experience working directly alongside Google Cloud internal personnel. You know how Google sells, how their internal sales compensation models function, and how to successfully navigate their internal ecosystem to unlock resources.


•    Sales Acumen: Exceptional proficiency in modern sales methodologies with a strong discipline in pipeline hygiene and accurate forecasting.


•    Technical Literacy: Strong foundational knowledge of Google cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and AI/ML capabilities, allowing you to speak credibly with both technical engineers and business stakeholders.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

 

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
Declare they have a disability, and Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.


Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

 

 

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)

 

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 

 

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

 

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

 

 

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements

 

You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 12 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

 

Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider capgemini

 

 

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

 

 

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

data.description:
Internal Job Info:

Location:  London, Manchester, Glasgow
Global Grade: E1

About the job you're considering

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. 

Our Enterprise Data & Analytics team partners with leading organisations across the Energy & Utilities sector - including electricity and gas transmission and distribution, energy retail, central market bodies, water and nuclear- to harness the power of data and AI. Our work spans strategy through to implementation, helping clients modernise data foundations, unlock insight, transform operations and accelerate AI adoption at scale. 

We're looking for an experienced leader to help grow our business, strengthen senior client relationships and shape the future of Enterprise Data & Analytics across the Energy & Utilities sector. 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role

Our Enterprise Data & Analytics capability brings together experts in enterprise data strategy, modern data platforms, analytics, AI and information management. We help organisations harness data and AI to transform operations, improve decision-making and deliver measurable business outcomes. 

As a Director, you'll play a leading role in growing our Enterprise Data & Analytics business across the Energy & Utilities sector, with responsibility for originating and securing consulting opportunities in excess of £2m per annum. You'll combine commercial leadership, client delivery and people leadership to build trusted client relationships, win strategic programmes and grow our capability. 

Alongside client work, you'll help shape the direction of our practice by developing new propositions, strengthening our market profile and building the next generation of Enterprise Data & Analytics consultants.  

Key Responsibilites

  • Originate and grow Enterprise Data & Analytics opportunities through strategic account development, new client relationships and major pursuits.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and become a recognised advisor on enterprise data and AI transformation.
  • Lead complex transformation programmes, from strategy through to implementation.
  • Help clients realise measurable business value through enterprise data, analytics and AI.
  • Develop new propositions that respond to evolving client needs and strengthen our market position through thought leadership.
  • Identify emerging trends in data and AI, translating them into new client offerings and market opportunities.
  • Work across Capgemini Invent and the wider Capgemini Group to bring together multidisciplinary teams that solve complex client challenges.
  • Coach, mentor and develop consultants, building a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing capability. 

Your skills and experience

You'll be an established leader in Enterprise Data & Analytics, with experience gained in consulting or a combination of industry and consulting. You'll have a track record of helping organisations use data and AI to solve complex business challenges, while building lasting client relationships and growing consulting opportunities. 

You'll bring experience in many of the following areas: 

  • Enterprise Data & AI strategy and transformation
  • Modern data platforms and data foundations
  • Data management, governance and information architecture
  • Advanced analytics, AI and Generative AI
  • Intelligent operations and operational analytics
  • Data-led business transformation 

You'll also demonstrate: 

  • Experience working with organisations across Energy & Utilities or other asset-intensive industries.
  • The ability to build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and develop strategic accounts.
  • A strong track record of originating, shaping and delivering complex consulting engagements.
  • Experience developing propositions and bringing together multidisciplinary teams to solve client challenges.
  • A collaborative leadership style, with a passion for developing people and growing high-performing teams. 

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

-Declare they have a disability, and 
-Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process.

Your pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including:  identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service).

 

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.   To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is

Job Role: DevOps AI Platform Architecture

Location: London, UK

About the Job you are considering:

As a DevOps AI Platform Architect, you will be designing, building, and optimizing scalable AI platforms that enable organizations to develop, deploy, and manage AI/ML solutions efficiently and securely. This role aligns with my passion for cloud computing, DevOps practices, automation, and artificial intelligence, allowing me to create robust platforms that accelerate innovation and business value.

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role:

  • Designing and implementing AI platform architectures using cloud services such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
  • Establishing CI/CD and MLOps pipelines to automate model training, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Managing containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes for scalability and reliability.
  • Ensuring platform security, compliance, governance, and cost optimization through best practices and automation.
  • Collaborating with data scientists, developers, security teams, and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise-grade AI solutions.
  • Implementing observability, monitoring, and incident management processes to maintain platform performance and availability.
  • Evaluating and integrating emerging technologies in Generative AI, platform engineering, and cloud-native ecosystems to drive innovation.

Your Skills:

  • Define and document global AI platform patterns Discovery Zone BYOD end-to-end ML lifecycle reference architectures and obtain approvals through architecture forums
  • Design Model Serving Architecture
  • Partner with the AI Tech Lead on the Model Serving PoC and define the end-to-end architecture for scalable and secure model deployment
  • Define MLOps Architecture
  • Define and document MLOps architecture using learnings from the Model
  • Serving PoC and drive approvals for standardization
  • Enable LLM Strategic Capabilities
  • Assess different capabilities for LLM Azure AI foundry Bedrock and Databricks and take design decisions for approval
  • Work with security Data protection office other architecture teams to align them with the decision and secure approvals for roll out
  • Document the low level design for LLM roll out to different use case
  • Evolve Platform Capabilities
  • Drive incremental platform capabilities Responsible AI GenAI Data Governance etc aligned with the approved L2 architecture


We are a Disability Confident Employer:

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and 
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
  • Please opt in during the application process.

Make It Real (what does it mean for you):

  • You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. 
    To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.
  • You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
  • You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 13 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

Why you should consider Capgemini:

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini:

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

Make it real. | www.capgemini.com

Job Role: Google Cloud Champion (Pre-Sales & Delivery Leadership)

Location: London, UK

About the Job you are considering:

Are you a Google Cloud leader who can inspire a client during a pitch and successfully guide them through implementation?

Capgemini Financial Services is looking for a high-impact GCP Cloud Champion to join our Google Cloud Center of Excellence (CoE) in London, UK. This is a comprehensive, client-facing role that spans the entire lifecycle of client engagement. You will act as the face of Capgemini’s GCP capabilities—interfacing directly with marquee Financial Services clients to pitch and win new services business, and subsequently leading the high-level architecture and technical delivery of those solutions.

This role requires a rare blend of commercial acumen, strategic advisory, and hands-on delivery oversight. You will bridge the gap between what is promised in the sales cycle and what is successfully deployed in production for major banking, capital markets, and insurance clients.

Hybrid working:

The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the time.

Your Role:

  • Pre-Sales & Origination: Partner with account teams to lead pre-sales technical discoveries, author compelling proposals (RFPs), and pitch innovative GCP solutions that drive new revenue streams.
  • Architectural Delivery Leadership: Serve as the Lead/Principal Architect on strategic accounts, overseeing the high-level design, migration strategy, and successful implementation of complex GCP environments.
  • Executive Advisory: Act as a trusted, long-term advisor to client CIOs, CTOs, and Cloud Directors, seamlessly shifting from high-level roadmap strategy to delivery health reviews.
  • Commercial Asset Creation: Design and productize reusable GCP solution offerings tailored to Retail Banking, Commercial Banking, Payments, Capital Markets, and Insurance verticals.
  • CoE Strategy & Investment: Provide strategic direction for Capgemini’s internal financial investments into GCP solutions, ensuring they align with actual client delivery trends.
  • Team Governance: Guide, mentor, and structurally lead a diverse, global team of GCP architects and engineers from initial blueprint through to production go-live.

Your Skills:

  • The 'Full Lifecycle' Track Record: Proven experience working within an IT Services/Consulting firm or Cloud CoE, with a demonstrated history of both winning new client business and leading its technical delivery.
  • Financial Services Domain Depth: Deep knowledge of the financial services ecosystem, including regulatory compliance, security standards, and legacy application modernization.
  • C-Suite Influence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills; mandatory experience interacting with and influencing client CIOs and CTOs.
  • GCP Technical Mastery: Seasoned background as a GCP Solutions Architect with a proven track record of bringing complex cloud-native architectures and migrations across the finish line.
  • Modern Tech Stack: Familiarity with modern DevOps and containerization tools (e.g., Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Ansible, Terraform) is highly preferred.
  • Global Delivery Models: Strong leadership skills with experience managing and mentoring cross-functional, global (onshore/offshore) delivery teams.
  • Preferred GCP Certifications
  • GCP Professional Cloud Architect (Highly Preferred)
  • GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer or Professional Cloud Network Engineer

About the job you're considering

Capgemini UK is seeking an exceptional leader to join as a Presales Director within Cloud Infrastructure Services (CIS). In this senior role, you will lead the strategic direction and growth of CIS services across one or more industry sectors in the UK. These deals may span multiple technology domains including Cloud and Infrastructure Transformation, Platform Engineering, End User Experience/Digital Workplace, Enterprise Service Management, Data Centre & Infrastructure Services and Cybersecurity. In addition, the role will act as an AI value champion, working across technology domains to identify, orchestrate and position AI capabilities that create measurable business outcomes for clients.
Orchestrating deals, solutions and capabilities from across Capgemini, our alliance partners and the wider Group, this role requires a C-suite influencer with proven experience in proactive deal shaping, strategic pursuit leadership, executive presentations and complex transformation programmes. The successful candidate will partner with industry and account teams to translate technology capabilities into business value propositions that resonate with client priorities.
Whilst experience within Consumer Products and Retail is desirable and beneficial, the role is not exclusively focused on CPR. Candidates may bring experience from any major sector including Financial Services, Public Sector, Manufacturing, Utilities, Transport, Telecommunications or Retail, with the ability to understand sector challenges and connect technology and AI-enabled transformation to business outcomes.

Your Role

  • Grow the CIS business in alignment with UK strategic growth ambitions through proactive opportunity identification, deal origination and pursuit shaping.
  • Understand client business priorities and develop value-led propositions working closely with Industry, Account and Portfolio teams.
  • Build and maintain CxO-level relationships with clients, partners and advisors.
  • Develop relationships across all parts of Capgemini to bring the best of the Group to client opportunities.
  • Lead strategic pursuits and shape complex solutions spanning Cloud, Workplace, Infrastructure, Service Management and Cybersecurity.
  • Act as an AI Offering Orchestrator by identifying AI building blocks across CIS technology domains and translating them into differentiated client value propositions.
  • Work with sector teams to map AI capabilities to industry-specific business outcomes including productivity, resilience, customer experience, operational efficiency and growth.
  • Shape AI-infused propositions by combining capabilities across cloud, workplace, service management, cyber and infrastructure portfolios.
  • Provide executive-level AI thought leadership and help position Capgemini as a trusted advisor in AI-enabled business transformation.
  • Develop value-based sales propositions, competitive strategies and financially robust solution approaches.
  • Success will be measured through contribution to CIS brand growth, active pipeline development, strategic deal shaping, AI proposition development, C-suite engagement, market-facing thought leadership, proposition quality, people empowerment.

Your Skills and Experience

  • Strong understanding of one or more industry sectors. Experience within Consumer Products and Retail is advantageous but not essential.
  • Proven ability to build influential relationships and shape complex opportunities.
  • Minimum 5 years in Solution Sales, Presales, Consulting or Technical Sales roles.
  • Strong techno-functional background with understanding of modern cloud, infrastructure, workplace, service management and cybersecurity architectures.
  • Experience originating, structuring and winning significant transformation opportunities.
  • Experience of cloud-enabled and digital transformation programmes.
  • Knowledge of RFPs, ITTs and advisor-led procurement processes.
  • Understanding of emerging AI, Generative AI, Copilot, Agentic AI and automation capabilities and their application to enterprise transformation.
  • Experience translating technology capabilities into business-value outcomes for executive stakeholders.
  • Demonstrable experience operating within large matrixed System Integrator, Consulting or Technology organisations.

Key skills

  • Executive stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Ability to orchestrate cross-domain capabilities into coherent business propositions.
  • Strong understanding of AI-enabled business transformation and AI adoption patterns.
  • Strong knowledge of Hyperscalers and underpinning technology stacks that typically support large enterprise clients.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey technical and AI concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to develop compelling value-based presentations and executive narratives.
  • Strong problem-solving and solution-shaping capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across complex stakeholder landscapes.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and uncertainty, with the confidence to shape direction, make progress and lead others where the path is not yet fully defined.

We are a disability confident employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
Declare they have a disability, and 
Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service). To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements. Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality. Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real - what does it mean for you?

We realise a Total Reward package should be more than just compensation.  At Capgemini we offer range of core and flexible benefits and have a Peer Recognition Portal called Applaud. 
You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance.  Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people.  All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. 
You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more.
You’ll be bringing your unique skills and perspectives to the team, inspiring and taking inspiration from your teammates as you unlock value in everything you do. You’ll be joining a professional community of experts, who have got your back and will support you, every step of the way.
Capgemini. Make it real.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.
Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

Reports To: The CIS Head of L&D is accountable for the development of the CIS learning and upskilling strategy and the reach of the outcomes expected by the CIS leaders, under the leadership of the Global Head of GBLs Learning and the CIS CHRO.

 

Hybrid working: The places that you work from day to day will vary according to your role, your needs, and those of the business; 
it will be a blend of Company offices, client sites, and your home; noting that you will be unable to work at home 100% of the 
time.

Your role

Job Summary: The Head of L&D CIS is accountable to define the relevant learning & development and upskilling strategy across all the countries the CIS Business Line operates. He/ she is accountable to propose and run the relevant initiatives that foster the “one Capgemini mindset” across the CIS GBL:  on boarding programs, Specific CIS methodologies and specific CIS technology upskilling / reskilling programs. He/She is accountable to leverage and adapt for relevance to CIS the global assets and learning solutions for all the global and transversal needs across the company: Leadership development, Compliance, Industry upskilling, Key Audiences that need global professional enablement:  Client Managers, Sales, Engagement managers, Architects, Delivery Heads.

 

The job offers the opportunity to lead a dual transformation agenda: 

Support a massive business transformation with AI
Support the highest transformation opportunity for the learning function through the implementation of a new operating model and the leverage of GenAI tools opportunities, with high expectations on increased global alignment and efficiency.

 

 

Key Responsibilities:

Definition of a cohesive learning strategy based on CIS capability building plan. Define the outcomes that the capability building plans need to deliver each year. Shape a coherent learning approach co-designed with the CHRO and business leaders within CIS to reach those outcomes. Accountable to foster a continuous learning and professional growth culture within CIS. Active promoter of all Group learning initiative, proactive actor in shaping and localizing them for the GBL. Accountable for the GBL based initiatives outcomes.

 

Contribution to Learning transformation agenda: Actively contribute and inputs into Groupwide initiatives: initiatives range from global offer design of experiences, the evolution of our digital learning technology stack through active watch and lead of pilots for new tools, the evolution of our learning insights and reporting needs.

 

Aligned Approach to learning design and delivery: Accountable for end-to-end development and delivery (from business requirements to performance assessment) of programs needed by CIS.  Learning design is a group enabled function and delivery of program is managed either at group level or within countries.  The role of the GBLs is to leverage at best the design and delivery functions to ensure outcomes are met, not to design and deliver programs.

 

“One Capgemini” ambassador: Guarantee collaboration and integration with others functions and entities in Group L&D promoting a unified 'One Capgemini' mindset, beyond CIS. 

 

Budget optimization and efficiency management: Consolidation of the CIS learning budget, and orchestration of the learning teams to build a ONE Capgemini approach to learning. Optimize CIS budget allocation and ensure efficiency of delivery.

About 15-20 years of Business experience ideally in technology Industry, with a minimum of 10 years’ experience years in Learning & Development at Scale or in HR and talent development.

Experience presenting to Business executive boards

Skills and Attributes needed to be successful in our transformation context:

 

Business Acumen
Cloud and Cyber tech savyness
Strategic Thinking
Stakeholder Management
Change Management
Collaboration and Influence
Agile Mindset
Data-Driven Decision making
Drive and Resilience
Problem Solving

We are a Disability Confident Employer

As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
- Declare they have a disability, and
- Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process.

Your security clearance and pre-employment checks

If you are successfully offered this position, you will go through a series of pre-employment checks, including: identity, nationality (single or dual) or immigration status, employment history 
going back 3 continuous years, and unspent criminal record check (known as Disclosure and Barring Service)
Some roles will also require an additional level of security clearance; BPSS OR Security Clearance OR Developed Vetting.

Shape Your Path:

Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more

data.description:
Capgemini Invent

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.

Your Role

As a DevOps Consultant at Capgemini Invent you will be part of our Cloud Advisory capability within the wider Business Technology capability unit. Our cloud advisory capability aims to inspire, lead and support organisations on their journey of adopting cloud. Creating business and revenue models, generating growth, ensuring regulatory compliance and reducing their carbon footprint.

 

We are growing across all levels from Consultant to Managing Consultant, offering opportunities to make a real impact  In your role, you will deliver DevOps advisory that will enable the adoption, acceleration, and innovation for our clients.

In this role you will play a key role in:

 

  • DevOps Capabilities: Assess, define, and implement DevOps capabilities to deliver innovation, agility, cost benefits, and improved time to market.
  • Platform as a Product Mindset: Advocate for treating platforms as products, focusing on user-centric design, clear documentation, and robust support models.
  • Product Lifecycle Ownership: Experience managing the end-to-end lifecycle of a platform, from ideation and roadmap development through launch, iteration, and sunset, ensuring continuous improvement and value delivery.
  • Maximize Investments: Leverage and maximize clients' existing investments in ITSM tools and frameworks.
  • Roadmap Development: Develop roadmaps to improve DevOps maturity and unlock value through thought leadership in areas like Generative AI and Platform Product Management.
  • Collaborative Transformation: Work with all organizational levels to innovate, design, and implement modern technologies, processes, and operating models, delivering sustainable transformations.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration between product, engineering, security, and operations to deliver cohesive platform solutions.
  • Innovation & Emerging Tech: Awareness of trends in platform engineering, such as platform orchestration, internal developer portals, and integration of AI/ML capabilities into platform offerings.
  • Candidates with platform product management experience are encouraged to apply. Ideal candidates will bring a product mindset to platform engineering, with a focus on user-centric design, lifecycle ownership, and cross-functional collaboration.

Key expectations from this role include:

 

  • As a Consultant: lead a stream of work and produce high quality deliverables, providing key input to shape the strategic direction and support the design of propositions.
  • As a Senior Consultant: design and lead projects / multiple streams taking ownership for elements of the proposition. 
  • As a Managing Consultant: desire to contribute to the growth and success of a top-tier consulting practice. Contribute to our market offers, knowledge and the overall strategic goals of the practice.  In delivery and leadership, you’ll be responsible for consulting sales in excess of £500,000 per annum

As part of your role you will also have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

 

 

  • Business Development – Leading/contributing to proposals, RFPs, bids, proposition development, client pitch contribution, client hosting at events.
  • Internal Contribution – Campaign development, internal think-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events & activities),  offering development.
  • Learning & Development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

Your Profile

You’re a strategic thinker and hands-on problem solver who excels at bridging business and technology. and you thrive in client-facing environments. 

You bring a strategic mindset to product-centric delivery and have a combination of the following:

 

  • Lean process design and IT/business automation across product management, engineering, and operations.
  • Comfortable in client-facing roles with consulting/coaching experience in agile delivery transformation.
  • Define OKRs/KPIs, set up processes to measure and improve speed, productivity, and quality, and implement product-centric operating models.
  • Solid understanding of hybrid/multi-cloud environments, DevOps, CI/CD, SRE, DevSecOps models, DevX, build and deployment pipelines, observability, and ITIL.Optional: Required certifications, licenses or languages
  • Understanding of observability and monitoring platform; Experience of having collaborated with developers to implement and improve observability and monitoring practices is preferred.

Security Check (SC) Clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. (https://www.gov.uk/guidance/united-kingdom-security-vetting-applicant#levels-of-national-security-clearance)

To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.


Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.

Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

What You'll Love About Working Here

You'll be part of a team where people can thrive professionally and personally. Here are just a few of the things our team values and enjoys:

 

  • Client engagements give you the opportunity to work with our leadership and experienced consulting management, where you can learn from them, challenge them and accelerate your hands-on experience, delivery capability and industry insights.
  • You’ll learn how we write compelling client propositions, structure and lead high-profile transformation, and gain hands-on exposure to leading technologies, often taking an idea from a concept to a vision, to strategy and then execution
  • Our consultants are formally trained from industry experts on management consulting and client delivery.
  • We provide a host of opportunities for learning and certification through internal and partner led programmes from AWS, Google, ServiceNow and Microsoft.
  • Les Fontaines: Capgemini Invent has a unique training environment just outside of Paris, where we can immerse ourselves in thought-leadership, share knowledge and build capabilities which will help us and our clients to succeed.
  • We hold monthly showcases of our digital transformation initiatives, sharing knowledge and showing off how the power of technology is impacting our clients.
  • There are many opportunities like monthly team drinks to connect face-to-face with the wider team over a few drinks in the city.
  • There are regular leadership connect sessions that will give you a different, more relaxed setting to meet up in the office to hear from the leadership, meet colleagues and discuss the trends and insights within the market. Team away days are always a chance to connect with the team, have fun and learn something new.

Need To Know

At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to making it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring you whole self to work.


We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.


Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.

CSR

We’re also focused on using tech to have a positive social impact. So, we’re working to reduce our own carbon footprint and improve everyone’s access to a digital world. It’s something we’re really serious about.  In fact, we were even named as one of the world’s most ethical companies by the Ethisphere Institute for the 10th year.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a team that does the right thing.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who: 

Declare they have a disability, and  Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role. 

Please opt in during the application process. 

Whilst you will have London, Manchester or Glasgow as an office base location, you must be fully flexible in terms of assignment location, as these roles may involve periods of time away from home at short notice.

 

 

 

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

data.description:
Job Description

Drive and support the digital transformation agenda for clients by assessing existing processes and technologies to improve customer experience and operational efficiency. Utilize industry knowledge and Contact Centre/CX expertise to design, plan, and implement complex digital and intelligent automation solutions aligned to client objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive and support the digital transformation agenda for clients
  • Assess existing processes and technology to identify opportunities to improve customer experience and operational efficiency, utilizing industry knowledge and Contact Centre/CX expertise
  • Create technical and resourcing business cases aligned to client objectives
  • Present at leadership review sessions with Customer and Capgemini leadership
  • Design, plan, and drive implementation of complex business solutions including digital platform technologies and Intelligent Automation
  • Collaborate across Capgemini practices to create industry-leading solutions with clear business outcome commitments
  • Build strong internal and external networks to enable future CX opportunities
  • Consult with internal stakeholders across sector verticals to drive existing and new client engagements
  • Continuously engage with the latest Contact Centre technology and market insights and share across internal and external networks
  • Develop and deliver solutions by responding to client RFIs and RFPs where Digital Transformation opportunities are present

Required Skills and Experience

  • Business consulting experience within a Professional Services organization
  • Large-scale BPO transformation and/or Professional Services experience
  • Experience designing solutions for Contact Centres and digital channels
  • Ability to create client proposals using multiple available data points
  • Experience managing CX Consultants or Process Transformation/Improvement teams
  • Exposure to commercial modelling and sizing
  • Ability to design Contact Centre/CX solutions aligned to client objectives
  • Strong understanding of latest technology trends in Contact Centre and Digital Transformation markets
  • Clear understanding of deflection and automation techniques in the Contact Centre and CX space
  • Experience designing and supporting functional requirements for CX solution implementation (e.g. chatbots, Conversational AI)

Domain and Industry Experience

  • Cross-sector experience including Financial Services, Manufacturing, Media & Entertainment, Retail, and Technology
  • Experience handling various Contact Centre processes including inbound, outbound, sales & marketing campaigns, employee queries, and customer support desks
  • Experience working in integrated Contact Centre environments across:
    • Delivery & Service Management
    • Workforce Management (WFM)
    • Learning
    • Reporting & Analytics
    • Quality

Methodologies and Technical Knowledge

  • Process Improvement methodologies
  • Knowledge of simple automation principles such as call deflection, webchat, Conversational AI, and chatbots
  • Working knowledge of Contact Centre solutions including (but not limited to):
    • AWS
    • Genesys Cloud
    • NICE
    • Zendesk

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role you will need to undergo Baseline Personnel Security Standard checks.

There are no nationality or residency restrictions, although if you have resided outside of the UK within the last 3 years, further checks may be required.

There are other criteria and check required for BPSS, and throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme. As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:

  • Declare they have a disability, and
  • Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.

Please opt in during the application process

Make it real – what does it mean for you?

You’d be joining an accredited Great Place to work for Wellbeing in 2024. Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation.  We see a healthy and happy workforce a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions.  
To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas, and we have invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy. 
You will be joining one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies®, as recognised by Ethisphere® for 12 consecutive years. We live our values by making ethical business choices every day. Working ethically is at the centre of our culture at Capgemini, meaning you will be helping to create a future we can all be proud of.

Capgemini. Make it real

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask.  When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts.  We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible.  It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.  By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion. 

Make it real | www.capgemini.com

About the job you’re considering

•    Evaluate existing services for usability, accessibility, and effectiveness and partner with stakeholders to understand needs and co-create solutions.
•    Apply the right research methods to uncover insights and evidence.
•    Prototype and test ideas, working with specialists to make them real.
•    Facilitate workshops that align stakeholders around a shared vision. 
•    Support delivery teams to adopt a holistic service design approach and contribute to shaping the Experience Design team’s direction and practice.

Your role

•    Evaluate existing services for usability, accessibility, and effectiveness and partner with stakeholders to understand needs and co-create solutions.
•    Apply the right research methods to uncover insights and evidence.
•    Prototype and test ideas, working with specialists to make them real.
•    Facilitate workshops that align stakeholders around a shared vision.
•    Translate insights into tangible opportunities for business and user value.

You can bring your whole self to work. At Capgemini building an inclusive future is part of everyday life and will be part of your working reality. We have built a representative and welcoming environment, for everyone.

Your skills and experience

•    Solid experience in service design, with a portfolio demonstrating research, service mapping, prototyping, delivery, and impact (consulting or agency experience a plus).
•    Experience with government service standards and accessibility principles (experience in GDS assessments is a plus).
•    Strong skills in user-centred design methods, from research through to delivery. Confident in planning and conducting user research, prototyping, and synthesising insights into improvements.
•    Ability to work in agile, fast-paced environments, collaborating across multidisciplinary and multi-vendor teams.
•    Confidence in engaging with stakeholders — from facilitating workshops to influencing decisions with evidence.

We are a Disability Confident Employer

Capgemini is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 2) under the UK Government’s Disability Confident scheme.
As part of our commitment to inclusive recruitment, we will offer an interview to all candidates who:
- Declare they have a disability, and
- Meet the minimum essential criteria for the role.
Please opt in during the application process

Your security clearance

To be successfully appointed to this role, it is a requirement to obtain Security Check (SC) clearance. 
To obtain SC clearance, the successful applicant must have resided continuously within the United Kingdom for the last 5 years, along with other criteria and requirements.
Throughout the recruitment process, you will be asked questions about your security clearance eligibility such as, but not limited to, country of residence and nationality.
Some posts are restricted to sole UK Nationals for security reasons; therefore, you may be asked about your citizenship in the application process.

Make it real – what does it mean for you

You will be encouraged to have a positive work-life balance. Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed hybrid working in all that we do and make  flexible working arrangements the day-to-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements


You will be empowered to explore, innovate, and progress. You will benefit from Capgemini’s ‘learning for life’ mindset, meaning you will have countless  training and development opportunities from thinktanks to hackathons, and access to 250,000 courses with numerous external certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Harvard ManageMentor, Cybersecurity qualifications and much more

You will reimagine what’s possible: creating value for the world’s leading organisations through technology to build a sustainable, more inclusive future. You will work with a range of clients all with a unique set of business, technological and societal ambitions, which will make a real impact across the UK.

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of freethinkers, entrepreneurs and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s  leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future. By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself  to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a 
better place rarely is.

With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.

Role Overview

The Generative Business Services (GBS) GTM and Offer Lead is a senior level role that will drive the next generation of thought leadership, offer development, deal shaping, and sales & market facing activity support across all Capgemini Group business lines, focused on Southern & Central Europe.

 

This is a strategic role designed to lead and build partnerships across all BSv Practices and working in close collaboration with other parts of the Group (e.g., Invent, PBS, I&D). The goal is a shared vision for success and a joint value proposition focused on Value Realization.

 

This role will seek to drive and secure the strategic goals and objectives for key clients of Capgemini in the rapidly transforming Global Business / Shared Service and Digital Transformation space (Generative AI, S4, and Platforms). As the face of Capgemini for C-level client stakeholders, this role is expected to generate market interest and excitement around our integrated offer, stay abreast of the market demand and trends, and vision of the future, and responding to them rapidly. This role will be primarily focused on the Southern & Central Europe market, and responsible and instrumental for the global offer development and related activities. 

 

The GBS GTM and Offer Leader’s mission is to help our clients reinvent their GBS model. Primarily, this role will drive a technology and Gen AI transformation as a major force to deliver the next generation of services and business outcomes. The key success factors include people transformation, process excellence, technology adoption, and data-driven business insights leading to industry best practice performance.

 

The specific job responsibilities of GBS vary depending on the client i.e., company and industry specifics, but typically include:

 

  • Defining and delivering the latest global offer, assets, and capabilities across BSv Practices (Intelligent Finance and Accounting Operations, Supply Chain, People Operations, Customer Operations, and Intelligent Automation IFAO, ISCO, IPO, ICO, IA etc.).
  • Defining and owning the Capgemini’s value proposition for the GBS offer across all BSv Practices and other parts of the Group and anticipating and responding to rapidly changing market needs.
  • Bringing inspiration and new industry developments (e.g., Gen AI) to the clients and leading by example across the Group and promoting advancements beyond existing transformation, delivery, and technology solutions.
  • Support Go To Market (GTM) Leads and in market sales activities including lead generation, response creation, proposal development, commercials client interactions etc.
  • Lead and represent Capgemini BSv at analyst and market facing events and conferences (e.g., SSON) to generate new GBS Offer business.
  • Leading partnerships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, 3rd parties, and employees.

    A successful GBS GTM and Offer Lead must have a strategic mindset supported by a strong track record in driving results and achieving measurable outcomes, as well as excellent leadership and communication skills. The GBS GTM Offer Lead should also have a deep understanding of the industry and technology and people market dynamics.

Performance metrics

  1. Analyst rankings in GBS area
  2. Revenue and sold margin
  3. 2 x pull through deals >50ME per annum.
  4. Create 30ME GBS advisory pipeline across the practice to convert 15ME+ business in 2024.

Qualifications (Education/Experience/Certification): Optional

  • English at CEFR Grade C1 (Advanced) or equivalent
  • Seasoned GBS leader with a proven track record in GBS industry in terms of advisory, GBS setup and GBS leadership (operational and project / transformation).
  • Very strong presentation and storytelling skills.
  • Deal-shaping experience and a successful track record in GBS transactions.
  • Strong track record of driving offer development leading to results and achieving measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills.

Strategic mindset and “out of the box” thinking.
